Bi nan yoor tiwan ni bi joo toor karyaa tiib na, ni ŋisambil ŋi bi joo teŋni kitork aasin na, ni ŋisambil ŋi bi joo seer tulalee aayon na, ni tikumann aawan ni mɔmɔk bi joo tun lituln Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni na. 15Bi nan yoor salmaa, ni tikunabr aawan mɔmɔk: bi nan yoor yoor nsambim ni ŋisambil ŋi bi joo moi mmii na. 16Ubɔr Solomonn aah nan ŋa tikumann aawan ni bi joo tun Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatuln na: jaatɔlk tiib bilee na, ni tɔroku tiib, ni nkin sakpiin na, nan nyuun sakpen ke bi ŋaŋ naanyunyuun. 17Jaatɔlk tiib bilee na nan naahn tɔb la: bimɔk aafɔfɔk nan ye ŋitaa moninko ni ŋilole, le bi naan tiwan nibaa tɔŋ bi mɔmɔk paab, le naafɔfɔk nan ye ŋitaa ŋinaa ni ligeln. Bi nan naan ŋisubinyaan mann goln ni. Bi nan di tikumann le naan ŋi mu.
Baah di Juda aanib buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni pu na
(Jeremia 52.24-27)
18Butɔb aajab aayidaan Nebusaradann nan ki chuu Utotoorninkpel Seraya, ni utotoor u paa u pu, bi yin u ke Sefania na, ni Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aanikpaam bitaa buen tinaagbiir ni Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni. 19U nan ki chur kitiŋ ngbaan ponn ni Juda aajab aayidaan, ni ubɔr aasusurb biŋmu bi nan beenin bi ki ponn ni na, ni uja u paa bijab aayidaan pu ki nan joo baagbann na, ni binikpaam imonko itaa bibaa mu. 20Nebusaradann nan di bi buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ aabɔr u nan bi Ribla aatiŋ 21ki bi Hamaf aapepel ni na chee. Nima chee ubɔr ngbaan nan ti cha bi ku bi.
Kina le bi nan di Juda aanib buen tinaagbiir ni ki cha baatiŋ.
Juda aayidaan Gedalia aabɔr
(Jeremia 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
22Babiloŋ aatiŋ aabɔr Nebukadnesar nan di Ahikam aajapɔɔn Gedalia u aayaaja nan ye Safann na ŋa Juda aayidaan, le ki cha u joo Juda aanib bi mɔmɔk baa nan di bi buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni na. 23Juda aaninkpiib ni baajab bi kaa nan di bibaa tii Babiloŋ yaab na aah ŋun kina na, le bi buen Gedalia chee Mispa aatiŋ ni. Bininkpiib ngbaan le nan ye Netania aajapɔɔn Ismael, ni Karea aajapɔɔn Johanann, ni Tanhumef u nyan ni Netofa aatiŋ ni na aajapɔɔn Seraya, ni Maaka aatiŋ aanii Jesania. 24Le Gedalia nan bui bi ke, “M puu tii nimi ke ijawaan ibaa aa bi ni ga li san Babiloŋ aaninkpiib. Kal kitiŋ kee pu man, ni yaa tun tii Babiloŋ aatiŋ aabɔr kan, ni ga li ŋan tii nimi.”
25Tɔ, libinbaal ngbaan aaŋmalole ni, le Netania aajapɔɔn Ismael, u aayaaja nan ye Elisama, aan u nyan ni libɔrdichal ni na, di bijab kipiik buen Mispa aatiŋ ni ki ti tak Gedalia ki ku u. U nan ku Israel yaab, ni Babiloŋ yaab bi nan bi u chee na mu. 26Le Israel yaab, biwankpadam ni bigiim mɔmɔk, ki kpee butɔb aajab aaninkpiib san Babiloŋ yaab ijawaan, le ki fii di buen Ijipt aatiŋ ni.
Baah nyan Jehoyachinn kiyondiik ni pu na
(Jeremia 52.31-34)
27Libiln li ponn ni Efil‑Merodak nan jin Babiloŋ aatiŋ aanaan na, u nan san Juda yaab Aabɔr Jehoyachinn kinimbaak le ki nyan u kiyondiik ni. Nimina nan ŋa baah nan chuu Jehoyachinn buen tinaagbiir ni pu na aabin piitaa ni lilolole aaŋmapiik ni ilee aawiin moninko ni ilole daal la. 28Efil‑Merodak nan san u kinimbaak ki tii u nsisii mu kpa kipak na ki jer bibɔrb bi mu nan bi Babiloŋ ni tinaagbiir ni na. 29Kina pu na, Jehoyachinn nan kan nsan ki kpeln waayondiik ni aawanpeenkaan, ki gur ji ubɔr chee tijikaar le ki ti kpo. 30Waah nan bi limɔfal ni n‑yoonn mumɔk na, bi nan luu u iwiin mɔmɔk aajikaar kina le ki ti saa waakundaal.

english_text:
The Descendants of Adam
(Genesis 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-32)
1-4Adam was the father of Seth, and his descendants were Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah, who had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
5Japheth was the father of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 6Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah. 7Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
8Ham was the father of Ethiopia, Egypt, Put, and Canaan, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 9Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan. 10Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior. 11Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim, 12Pathrusim, Casluhim, and Caphtorim, the ancestor of the Philistines. 13Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth. 14-16Canaan was also the ancestor of the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and Arkites, the Sinites, the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
17Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them. 18Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather. 19Eber named his first son Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided into tribal regions. Eber's second son was Joktan, 20-23the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.
24-27Shem's descendants included Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, later renamed Abraham.
Abraham's Family
(Genesis 25.1-4,12-16)
28Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
29-31Ishmael had twelve sons, who were born in the following order: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
32Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. 33Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
Esau's Family
(Genesis 36.1-14)
34Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob. 35Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. 36Eliphaz was the father of Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek. 37Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
The First Edomites and Their Kings
(Genesis 36.20-43)
38Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. 39Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna. 40Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
41Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran. 42Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
43Before kings ruled in Israel, Bela son of Beor ruled the country of Edom from its capital of Dinhabah. 44After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king. 45After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king. 46After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab. 47After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king; 48after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king; 49and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king. 50After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
51The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, 52Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, 53Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, 54Magdiel, and Iram.
translation_text:
Ki nyan Adam aayoonn ki ti saa Abraham aayoonn na aabɔr
(Mpiin 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-26)
1Sef aate le nan ye Adam, le Sef mu ma Enos, le Enos mu ma Kenann. 2Kenann mu aajapɔɔn le nan ye Mahalalel u nan ma Jared na. 3Jared le nan ma Enok, le Enok mu ma Metusela, u nan ma Lamek na, 4le Lamek mu ma Nowa. Nowa nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Bima le nan ye Sem, ni Ham, ni Jafef.
5Jafef aajapɔtiib le nan ye Gomer, ni Magog, ni Madai, ni Jafann, ni Tubal, ni Mesek, ni Tiras. Bima le ye binib bi beenin joo baayimbil na aayaajatiib. 6Gomer aayaabitiib le nan ye Askenas, ni Rifaf, ni Togama aanib. 7Jafann aayaabitiib le nan ye Elisa, ni Speenn, ni Saiprus, ni Rodes aanib.
8Ham aajapɔtiib le nan ye Kus, ni Ijipt, ni Libia, ni Kanaann aanib. Bima le ye binib bi beenin joo baayimbil na aayaajatiib. 9Kus aayaabitiib le nan ye Seba, ni Hafila, ni Sabta, ni Raama, ni Sabteka aanib. Raama mu aayaabitiib le nan ye Seba, ni Dedann aanib. 10Kus aajapɔɔn u bi nan yin u ke Nimrod na le nan puen ye dulnyaa wee ni aanii u nan nyaŋni butɔb ni pam na. 11Ijipt aayaabitiib le nan ye Lidia, ni Anam, ni Lehab, ni Naftu, 12ni Patrus, ni Kaslu, ni Krete aanib, (Krete aanib le ye Filistia yaab aayaajatiib). 13Kanaann aajapɔtiib le nan ye Saidonn, u nan ye upol na, ni Hef. Bima le ye binib bi beenin joo baayimbil na aayaajatiib. 14Kanaann le nan ki ye Jebus ni Amor, ni Girgas, 15ni Hif, ni Arka, ni Sinn, 16ni Afad, ni Semar, ni Hamaf aanib aayaaja.
17Sem aajapɔtiib le nan ye Elam, ni Asur, ni Apaksad, ni Lud, ni Aram, ni Us, ni Hul, ni Geter, ni Mesek. Bima le ye binib bi beenin joo baayimbil na aayaajatiib. 18Apaksad aajapɔɔn le nan ye Sela u nan ma Eber na. 19Eber nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Ubaa aayimbil le ye Peleg. Baah nan ma u buyoonn na dulnyaa aanib nan yakr yakr la. Uken na aayimbil le nan ye Joktann. 20Joktann aayaabitiib le nan ye Almodad, ni Selef, ni Hasamafef, ni Jera, 21ni Hadoram, ni Usal, ni Dikla, 22ni Ebal, ni Abimael, ni Seba, 23ni Ofir, ni Hafila, ni Jobab aanib.
24Mmaal ngbaan aah nan dii pu ki nyan Sem mɔk ki ti saa Abram mɔk na sɔ: Sem, ni Apaksad, ni Sela, 25ni Eber, ni Peleg, ni Reu, 26ni Serug, ni Nahor, ni Tera, 27ni Abram, (Abram le bi ki yin u ke Abraham na).
Ismael aayaabitiib aayimbil
(Mpiin 25.12-16)
28Abraham nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Aisak, ni Ismael. 29Ismael aajapɔtiib le nan nan kpaln ŋinibol kipiik ni ŋilee ŋee. Bima le ye Nebayof (Ismael aajapɔpol), ni Kedar, ni Adbeel, ni Mibsam, 30ni Misma, ni Duma, ni Masa, ni Hadad, ni Tema, 31ni Jetur, ni Nafis, ni Kedema.
32Abraham aapuu uken u bi nan yin u ke Ketura na nan ma u chee mbijabim muloob la. Bima le ye Simrann, ni Joksann, ni Medann, ni Midiann, ni Isbak, ni Sua. Joksann nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Seba, ni Dedann. 33Midiann mu nan ma mbijabim muŋmu la. Bima le nan ye Efa, ni Efer, ni Hanok, ni Abida, ni Eldaa.
Esɔ aayaabitiib aayimbil
(Mpiin 36.1-19)
34Abraham aajapɔɔn Aisak nan ma mbijabim mulee la, Esɔ ni Jakob. 35Esɔ aajapɔtiib le nan ye Elifas, ni Rewel, ni Jeus, ni Jalam, ni Kora. 36Elifas le nan ye Temann, ni Omar, ni Sefi, ni Gatam, ni Kenas, ni Timna, ni Amalek aanibol aayaaja. 37Rewel mu le nan ye Nahaf, ni Sera, ni Sama, ni Misa aanibol aayaaja.
Edom aajan aatindam aayimbil
(Mpiin 36.20-30)
38-42Seir aajapɔtiib bi aayimbil paan ni na le nan ye Edom aatindam:
Lotann le nan ye Hori ni Homam aataŋaal pu aayaaja. (Lotann nan kpa ninkpan ubaa, le bi yin u ke Timna.)
Sobal mu le nan ye Alfann, ni Manahaf, ni Ebal, ni Sefi, ni Onam aataŋaal pu aayaaja.
Sibeonn nan ma mbijabim mulee la, Aya ni Ana. Ana mu nan ma Disonn, le Disonn nan ye Hamrann, ni Esbann, ni Itrann, ni Kerann aataŋaal pu aayaaja.
Eser mu le nan ye Bilhann, ni Saafann, ni Jaakann aataŋaal pu aayaaja.
Le ujapɔɔn Disann mu nan ye Us ni Arann aataŋaal pu aayaaja.
Edom aatiŋ aabɔrb aayimbil
(Mpiin 36.31-43)
43-50Bibɔrb bimina le nan joo Edom aatiŋ ki paa paa tɔb pu. N‑yaayoonn ngbaan Israel aa nan kee kpa bibɔrb.
Beor, u nyan ni Dinhaba aatiŋ ni na aajapɔɔn Bela le nan puen jin nnaan.
Le Sera, u nyan ni Bosra aatiŋ ni na aajapɔɔn Johab nan paan u pu.
Husam, u nyan ni Temann aapepel ni na, mu le nan paan.
Bedad, u nyan ni Afif aatiŋ ni na aajapɔɔn Hadad le nan paan Husam pu. (Uma le nan nyaŋ Midiann yaab butɔb ni, Moab aatingbaln pu na.)
Samla, u nyan ni Mosreka na, le nan paan.
Saul, u nan nyan ni Rehobof, ni bi limɔɔl chee na, le nan paan Samla pu.
Akbor aajapɔɔn Baal Hanann mu le nan paan.
Hadad, u nyan ni Pau aatiŋ ni na, mu le nan paan Baal Hanann pu. (Upuu le nan ye Mehetabel. Mehetabel aate le nan ye Matred, le uyaaja ye Mesahab.)
51Edom aanib aah nan yakr ŋinibol ŋinibol pu na sɔ: Timna, ni Alfa, ni Jetef, 52ni Oholibama, ni Ela, ni Pinonn, 53ni Kenas, ni Temann, ni Mibsar, 54ni Magdiel, ni Iram aanibol.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1-2Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
3Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated. 4Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
5Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul. 6Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. 7 Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord. 8Ethan's son was Azariah.
The Ancestors of King David
9Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb. 10Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah. 11Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz, 12Obed, and Jesse. 13-15Jesse had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, and David. 16Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel. 17Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa.
The Descendants of Hezron
18Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon. 19After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur 20was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
21When Hezron was 60 years old, he married the daughter of Machir, who settled the region of Gilead. Their son Segub 22was the father of Jair, who ruled 23 villages in the region of Gilead. 23Some time later the nations of Geshur and Aram captured 60 towns in that region, including the villages that belonged to Jair, as well as the town of Kenath and the nearby villages. Everyone from the region of Gilead was a descendant of Machir.
24After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa.
The Descendants of Jerahmeel
25Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah. 26Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam. 27Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker. 28Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada.
Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur. 29Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid. 30Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children; 31Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
32Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children, 33but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
34-35Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai, 36the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad. 37-41Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama.
The Descendants of Caleb
42Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, had the following descendants: Mesha, Ziph, Mareshah, Hebron, 43and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. 44Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai, 45the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
46Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez. 47Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
48Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah. 49Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah. 50-51All of these were Caleb's descendants.
Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader. 52Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan, 53and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
54Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites. 55Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_text:
Juda aayaabitiib aayimbil
1Jakob nan ma mbijabim kipiik ni bilee la. Baayimbil sɔ: Rubenn, ni Simeonn, ni Liifai, ni Juda, ni Isakar, ni Sebulunn, 2ni Dann, ni Josef, ni Benjaminn, ni Naftali, ni Gad, ni Aser.
3Juda aajapɔtiib nan ye biŋmu la. U ni upuu Bafsua, u nan ye Kanaann aanii na, nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil le nan ye Er, ni Onann, ni Sela. Ujapɔpol Er nan tun titunwanbir sakpen, le Uwumbɔr ku u. 4Juda nan ma ujapɔɔn aapuu Tamar chee mbijabim mulee kpee. Bima le nan ye Peres ni Sera.
5Peres nan ma mbijabim mulee, le ki yin bi ke Hesronn ni Hamul. 6Unaal Sera ma nan ma mbijabim muŋmu la. Baayimbil le nan ye Simri, ni Etann, ni Hemann, ni Kalkol, ni Darda. 7Kami aajapɔɔn Akann, u ye Sera aayaabitiib ni ubaa na, nan di tiwan ni bi gaa butɔb ni ki ga di tii Uwumbɔr na ŋa ubaa aawan, le ki joo ni tibɔbir nan lii Israel yaab pu.
8Etann nan ma ubijabo ubaa, le ki yin u ke Asaria.
Ubɔr David aamaal
9Hesronn nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil le nan ye Jerameel, ni Ram, ni Kaleb.
10Mmaal ngbaan ki nyan Ram mɔk ki ti saa Jese mɔk na aayimbil sɔ: Ram, ni Aminadab, ni Nasonn, (Nasonn nan ye Juda aanibol ni aanikpaan ubaa la,) 11ni Salmonn, ni Boas, 12ni Obed, ni Jese.
13Jese nan ma mbijabim mulole la. Baah nan paa paa tɔb pu na sɔ: Eliab, ni Abinadab, ni Sama, 14ni Netanel, ni Radai, 15ni Osem, ni David. 16U nan ki ma mpiibim mulee mu. Baayimbil le nan ye Seruya, ni Abigail.
Jese aabisal Seruya nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Bima le nan ye Abisai, ni Joab, ni Asahel. 17Ubisal Abigail na nan mɔn Jeter, u aayaaja nan ye Ismael na, le bi ma bijapɔɔn Amasa.
Hesronn aayaabitiib aayimbil
18Hesronn aajapɔɔn Kaleb nan yoor Asuba le ki ma upiibo ki yin u ke Jeriof. U nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil le nan ye Jeser, ni Sobab, ni Aadonn. 19Asuba aakun aapuwɔb, le Kaleb yoor Efraf, le bi ma ubijabo ki yin u ke Hur. 20Hur le nan ma Uri, le Uri mu ma Besalel.
21Hesronn aah nan ti saa ŋibin imonko itaa na, le u yoor Makir aabisal, u aaninja nan ye Gilead na. Bi nan ma ubijabo, le ki yin u ke Segub. 22Le Segub mu ma ubijabo ki yin u ke Jair. Jair nan joo Gilead aapepel aatim moninko ni mutaa la. 23Le Gesur ni Aram aanaan nan nyaŋ ntim imonko itaa nima, le Jair ni Kenaf aatim ni ntim mu bi duun nima na nan ŋmal mu ni. Binib bi mɔmɔk nan koo nima chee na nan ye Gilead aate Makir aayaabitiib la. 24Hesronn aah kpo na, le ujapɔɔn Kaleb di waakpopii Efraf di kpan. Bi nan ma ubijabo le ki yin u ke Asur. Uma le nan naan Tekoa aatiŋ.
Jerameel aayaabitiib aayimbil
25Hesronn aajapɔpol Jerameel nan ma mbijabim muŋmu la. Baayimbil sɔ: Ram le nan ye upol, le Buna paa u pu, le Orenn, ni Osem, ni Ahija paa bi pu. 26-27Ram nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Maas le nan ye upol, le Jaminn ni Eker paa u pu. Jerameel nan ki kpa upii uken. Bi nan yin u ke Atara, le u ni u ma ubijabo, le ki yin u ke Onam. 28Onam nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Ubaa le nan ye Samai, le uken ye Jada. Samai mu nan ma mbijabim mulee la, Nadab ni Abisur.
29Abisur aah nan yoor upii u na aayimbil le nan ye Abihail, le u ni u ma mbijabim mulee, ki yin bi ke Abann ni Molid. 30Abisur aanaal Nadab nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Seled le nan ye upol, le Apaim paa. Tɔ, Seled ma nan kpo, kaa kpa ubo. 31Apaim le nan ma Isi, le u mu ma Sesann, le Sesann mu ma Alai.
32Samai aanaal Jada nan ma mbijabim mulee la, Jeter ni Jonatann, le Jeter nan kpo, kaa kpa ubo. 33Jonatann nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Ubaa le nan ye Pelef, le uken ye Sasa. Bimina mɔmɔk nan ye Jerameel aayaabitiib la.
34Sesann aa nan kpa mbijabim, u nan ma mpiibim ŋmeen la. U nan kpa unaagbiija u nyan ni Ijipt aatiŋ ni aan bi yin u ke Jara na. 35U nan di ubisal ubaa tii u. Bi nan ma ubijabo le ki yin u ke Atai; 36ki nyan Atai mɔk ki ti saa Elisama mɔk na mmaal ngbaan sɔ: Atai, ni Natann, ni Sabad, 37ni Eflal, ni Obed, 38ni Jehu, ni Asaria, 39ni Heles, ni Eleasa, 40ni Sismai, ni Salum, 41ni Jekamia, ni Elisama.
Kaleb aayaabitiib biken aayimbil
42Kaleb aajapɔpol Jerameel aanaal aayimbil le nan ye Mesa. Mesa le nan ma Sif, le Sif mu ma Maresa. Le u mu ma Hebronn. 43Hebronn le nan ma Kora, ni Tapua, ni Rekem, ni Sema. Bi nan ye mbijabim munaa la. 44Sema le nan ma Raham, le Raham mu ma Jokeam. Sema aakpel Rekem le nan ma Samai, 45le u mu ma Maonn. Le Maonn mu ma Bef Sur.
46Kaleb nan kpa unaagbiipii ubaa. Bi nan yin u ke Efa la. U ni u nan ma mbijabim bitaa la. Baayimbil le nan ye Harann, ni Mosa, ni Gases. Harann mu nan ma ubijabo ki yin u ke Gases.
47Uja u bi nan yin u ke Jadai na mu nan ma mbijabim muloob. Baayimbil le ye Regem, ni Jotam, ni Gesann, ni Pelet, ni Efa, ni Saaf.
48Kaleb nan ki kpa unaagbiipii uken, le bi yin u ke Maaka. U nan ma u chee mbijabim mulee la. Bima le ye Seber ni Tirana. 49U nan ki ma mbijabim mulee kpee. Ubaa le ye Saaf, u nan naan Madmana aatiŋ na; uken le nan ye Sefa u mu nan naan Makbena ni Gibea aatim na.
Kaleb nan ki kpa bisal ubaa mu kpee, le bi yin u ke Aksa.
50Bi mɔmɔk nan ye Kaleb aayaabitiib la.
Hur le nan ye Kaleb ni upuu Efraf aajapɔpol. Hur aajapɔɔn Sobal le nan naan Kiriaf Jearim aatiŋ, 51le ujapɔɔn Salma, u paa na, nan naan Betlehem aatiŋ. Le utatar, u bi nan yin u ke Haref na, mu naan Bef Gader aatiŋ.
52Sobal, u nan naan Kiriaf Jearim aatiŋ na, le nan ye Haroe aanib, ni Menuhof aanib ligeln, 53ni imaal i nan koo Kiriaf Jearim ni ki ye Ifer yaab, ni Puf yaab, ni Sumaf yaab, ni Misra yaab na aayaaja. (Sora ni Estaol aatim aanib mu nan nyan ni imaal imina ni la.)
54Salma, u nan naan Betlehem aatiŋ na, le nan ye Netofaf aanib, ni Atrof Bef Joab, ni Sor aanib aayaaja. Sor aanib nan ye Manahaf aatiŋ aataŋaal ilee na ponn ni mubaa la.
55Imaal imina, Tiraf, ni Simeaf, ni Sukaf yaab, bi nan koo Jabes aatiŋ ni na, nan ye biwanyib bi ŋmaa ŋmee ki ki lik binib aaŋmeen ki ŋmee ŋani tigbann ni na la. Bi nan ye Kenn yaab la, le ki yoor Rekab aapiib.

english_text:
The Descendants of King David
1-4 King David ruled from Hebron for seven years and six months, and during that time he had six sons, who were born in the following order: Amnon, Daniel, Absalom, Adonijah, Shephatiah, and Ithream. Ahinoam from Jezreel was the mother of Amnon; Abigail from Carmel was the mother of Daniel; Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur was the mother of Absalom; Haggith was the mother of Adonijah; Abital was the mother of Shephatiah; and Eglah was the mother of Ithream.
David then ruled from Jerusalem for 33 years, 5 and during that time, he had 13 more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. 6-8David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet. 9David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter.
The Descendants of King Solomon
10-15Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz. 16Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
17Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel, 18Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah. 19Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister. 20He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed. 21Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah, 22the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat. 23Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam. 24Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_text:
Ubɔr David aabim aayimbil
1-3David aah nan bi Hebronn ni ki ma mbijabim mu na aayimbil sɔ: Bi paa paa tɔb pu baaninkpir aah ye pu na la;
Amnonn, u aana nan ye Jesreel aatiŋ aapii u bi nan yin u ke Ahinoam na, le nan ye upol.
Daniel le nan paa, le una ye Abigail, u nyan ni Kamel aatiŋ ni na.
Absalom mu le nan paa, le una nan ye Maaka, u aate nan ye Gesur Aabɔr Talmai na;
Adonija mu le nan paa Absalom pu, le una nan ye Hagif;
Sefatia mu le nan paa, le una nan ye Abital;
Itream mu le nan paa, le una nan ye Egla.
4David aah joo Hebronn aatiŋ ŋibin ŋilole ni ligeln ŋi ponn ni na, le u nan ma bi mɔmɔk biloob nima.
U nan ye ubɔr Jerusalem ni, ki ti saa ŋibin piitaa ni ŋitaa la, 5le ki nan ma mbijabim nima pam.
Upuu Batseba, u aate nan ye Amiel na, nan ma mbijabim munaa la: Simea, ni Sobab, ni Natann, ni Solomonn.
6U nan ki ma mbijabim muwae muken. Bima le nan ye Ibhar, ni Elisua, ni Elpelet, 7ni Noga, ni Nefeg, ni Jafia, 8ni Elisama, ni Eliada, ni Elifelet. 9David nan ki ma mbijabim upuutiib waatiir chee ki kpee mumina mɔmɔk pu. U nan kpa bisal ubaa ki yin u ke Tamar.
Ubɔr Solomonn aayaabitiib aayimbil
10Ubɔr Solomonn aayaabitiib ki nya te mɔk ki ti saa japɔɔn mɔk na aayimbil sɔ: Solomonn, ni Rehoboam, ni Abija, ni Asa, ni Jehosafat, 11ni Jehoram, ni Ahasia, ni Joas, 12ni Amasia, ni Usia, ni Jotam, 13ni Ahas, ni Hesekia, ni Manase, 14ni Amonn, ni Josia. 15Josia nan ma mbijabim munaa la; Johanann, ni Jehoyakim, ni Sedekia, ni Joahas. 16Jehoyakim mu nan ma mbijabim mulee la; Jehoyachinn, ni Sedekia.
Ubɔr Jehoyachinn aayaabitiib aayimbil
17Jehoyachinn aayaabitiib bi Babiloŋ yaab nan chur bi tinaagbiir na aayimbil sɔ: Jehoyachinn nan ma mbijabim mulole la: Sealtiel, 18ni Malkiram, ni Pedaya, ni Senasar, ni Jekamia, ni Hosama, ni Nedabia. 19Pedaya nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Serubabel ni Simei. Serubabel mu nan ma mbijabim mulee la, Mesulam ni Hanania. U nan ma upiibo ubaa mu, ki yin u ke Selomif. 20U nan ki ma mbijabim biŋmu biken, Hasuba, ni Ohel, ni Berekia, ni Hasadia, ni Jusab Hesed.
21Hanania nan ma mbijabim mulee la, Pelatia, ni Jesaya. Jesaya le nan ma Refaya, le u mu ma Anann. Anann mu le nan ma Obadia, le u mu ma Sekania. 22Sekania nan ma ubijabo ubaa la. Bi nan yin u ke Semaya. Uyaabitiib nan ye biŋmu la, Hatus, ni Igal, ni Baria, ni Nearia, ni Safat. 23Nearia nan ma mbijabim mutaa la, Eliwenai, ni Hiskia, ni Asrikam. 24Eliwenai nan ma mbijabim mulole la, Hodafia, ni Eliasib, ni Pelaya, ni Akub, ni Johanann, ni Delaya, ni Anani.

english_text:
The Descendants of Judah
1Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal. 2Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
3-4Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
5Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah. 6Ashhur and Naarah were the parents of Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. 7Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
8Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
9Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family. 10One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
11Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton, 12whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
13Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai, 14who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
15Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
16Jehallelel was the father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
17-18Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
19A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
20Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon.
Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
21-22Judah also had a son named Shelah, whose descendants included Jokim and the people of the town of Cozeba, as well as Er who settled the town of Lecah and Laadah who settled the town of Mareshah. The people who lived in Beth-Ashbea were also descendants of Shelah, and they were experts in weaving cloth. Shelah was the ancestor of Joash and Saraph, two men who married Moabite women and then settled near Bethlehem—but these family records are very old. 23The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king.
The Descendants of Simeon
24Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul. 25The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma. 26The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei. 27Shimei had 16 sons and 6 daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
28-31 Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim. 32They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, 33as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
34-38As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza. 39When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located, 40and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites, 41but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
42Some time later, 500 men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi. 43They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_text:
Juda aayaabitiib aayimbil
1Juda aayaabitiib ngem aayimbil sɔ: Peres, ni Hesronn, ni Kami, ni Hur, ni Sobal. 2Sobal le nan ma Reaya, le Reaya mu ma Jahaf. Jahaf le nan ma Ahumai ni Lahad, biyaabitiib le ye binib bi koo Sora aatiŋ ni na.
3-4Hur le nan ye ute Kaleb ni upuu Efraf aajapɔpol, le uyaabitiib naan Betlehem aatiŋ. Hur nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Bima le nan ye Etam, ni Penuel, ni Eser. Etam mu nan ma mbijabim bitaa la. Baayimbil le nan ye Jesreel, ni Isma, ni Idbas. U nan kpa bisal ubaa, le bi yin u ke Haselelponi. Penuel le nan naan Gedor aatiŋ, le Eser mu naan Husa aatiŋ.
5Asur u nan naan Tekoa aatiŋ na, nan joo bipiib bilee la. Bi nan yin ubaa ke Hela, le ki yin uken na ke Naara. 6U ni Naara nan ma mbijabim binaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Ahusam, ni Hefer, ni Temeni, ni Haahastari. 7Asur ni Hela nan ma mbijabim bitaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Seref, ni Isar, ni Etnann.
8Kos le nan ma Anub ni Sobeba, ni itaŋaal i ye Harum aajapɔɔn Ahahel aayaabitiib na aayaaja.
9Uja ubaa nan bi, bi nan yin u ke Jabes. Waamaal ni aanib mɔmɔk nan lik pak uma baanja la. Waamar nan wu sakpen, nima le una nan yin u ke Jabes. 10Tɔ, Jabes nan mee Israel yaab Aawumbɔr ke, “Uwumbɔr, ŋa saanyoor ŋa m pu, ki tii mi kitiŋ ki wiir na. Li bi m chee, ki nyan mi kinimbɔŋ aawan nimɔk ga ŋmaa tii mi iween na ni.” Le Uwumbɔr nan tii u waah mee ki ban tiwan ni na.
Imaal iken aayimbil
11Suha aakpel Kaleb nan ma ubijabo ubaa, le ki yin u ke Mehir. Mehir le nan ma Estonn, 12le u mu ma mbijabim mutaa. Baayimbil sɔ: Bef‑Rafa, ni Pasea, ni Tehina. Tehina le nan ye unii u naan Nahas aatiŋ na. Bijab bimina aayaabitiib nan koo Reka aatiŋ ni la.
13Kenas nan ma mbijabim bilee la. Baayimbil sɔ: Otniel ni Seraya. Otniel mu nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Hataf ni Meonotai. 14Le Meonotai mu ma Ofra.
Seraya le nan ma Joab, u nan naan Biwanŋab Aafataŋ na. Binib bi mɔmɔk nan bi nima chee na nan nyi tiwan aanaan pu sakpen.
15Jefune aajapɔɔn Kaleb nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Iru, ni Ela, ni Naam. Le Ela mu ma Kenas.
16Jehalelel nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Sif, ni Sifa, ni Tiria, ni Asarel.
17-18Esra nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Jeter, ni Mered, ni Efer, ni Jalonn. Mered nan yoor Ijipt aabɔr aabisal u bi nan yin u ke Bitia na, le bi nan ma upiibo, ki yin u ke Miriam. Bi nan ma mbijabim bilee mu. Baayimbil le ye Samai ni Isba. Isba le nan naan Estemoa aatiŋ. Mered mu nan yoor Juda aanibol ni aapii la, le bi ma mbijabim bitaa. Baayimbil sɔ: Jered, u nan naan Gedor aatiŋ na, ni Heber, u mu nan naan Soko aatiŋ na, ni Jekutiel, u nan naan Sanoa aatiŋ na.
19Hodia le nan yoor Naham aaninkpan. Biyaabitiib le naan Gaam aataŋaal mu nan koo Keila aatiŋ ni na, ni Maakaf aataŋaal mu nan koo Estemoa aatiŋ ni na.
20Simonn nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Amnonn, ni Rina, ni Ben‑Hanann, ni Tilonn.
Isi nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Baayimbil le nan ye Sohef ni Ben‑Sohef.
Sela aayaabitiib aayimbil
21Sela nan ye Juda aajapɔtiib ponn ni ubaa la. Uyaabitiib bibaa le nan ye Er, u nan naan Leka aatiŋ na; ni Laada, u nan naan Maresa aatiŋ na, ni ntaŋaal mu nan luu ŋitanyaan aakeken ki nan koo Bef Asbea aatiŋ ni na; 22ni Jokim, ni binib bi nan koo Koseba aatiŋ ni na, ni Joas ni Saraf, bi nan yoor Moab aatiŋ aapiib ki nan ti kal Betlehem aatiŋ ni na. Ŋiyimbil ŋimina nan ŋmee ki dɔ yunn pam. 23Bi nan ye ubɔr aayamaab, le ki koo Netayim ni Gedera aatim ni.
Simeonn aayaabitiib aayimbil
24Simeonn nan ma mbijabim biŋmu la. Baayimbil sɔ: Nemuel, ni Jaminn, ni Jarib, ni Sera, ni Saul. 25Saul le nan ma Salum, le uyaabil nan ye Mibsam, le uyaabisɔsɔk nan ye Misma, 26le ki nyan Misma chee na, mmaal ngbaan nan dii kina le ti saa Hamuel, ni Sakur, ni Simei mɔk. 27Simei nan ma mbijabim kipiik ni biloob la, le ki ma mpiibim mu biloob. Tɔ, udo yaab biken aa nan ma sakpen. Kina pu na, Simeonn aanibol aa nan wiir ke Juda aanibol aah nan wiir pu na.
28Kina, ki nan saa Ubɔr David aayoonn na, Simeonn aayaabitiib nan koo Beerseba, ni Molada, ni Hasar Sual, 29ni Bilha, ni Esem, ni Tolad, 30ni Betuel, ni Homa, ni Siklag, 31ni Bef Maakabof, ni Hasar Susim, ni Bef Biri, ni Saarayim aatim ni la. 32Bi nan ki koo ntim muŋmu mumina; Etam, ni Ayinn, ni Rimonn, ni Tokenn, ni Asann ponn ni, 33ni ntimbim mu bi gob ki ti saa Baalaf aatiŋ ki bi liwilir aaŋangii wɔb na ni. Baah nan ŋmee baadichal, ni baah nan koo koo ntim mu ponn ni na aabɔr pu na sɔ:
34-38Bijab bi aayimbil paa na le nan ye bidichadam:
Mesobab, ni Jamlek, ni Amasia aajapɔɔn Josa, ni Joel, ni Jehu, (ute le nan ye Josibia, le uyaaja ye Seraya u aate nan ye Asiel na,) ni Eliwenai, ni Jaakoba, ni Jesohaya, ni Asaya, ni Adiel, ni Jesimiel, ni Benaya, ni Sisa, (ute le nan ye Sifi, le uyaaja ye Alonn u aayaajatiib nan ye Jedaya, ni Simri, ni Semaya na).
Baamaal aah nan moo kpae na, 39le bi nan yaa koo liwilir wɔb ki bi ban bi koo Gerar aatiŋ ni le baapiih ji kitiŋ ngbaan aah bi kifataŋ ki ni na aawipuul wɔb. 40Bi nan kan mmoŋmɔpaan nima le mu dɔ waa cha, ki bi suuna, kaa kpa tibaa. Ham aanib le nan puen koo nima chee.
41Ubɔr Hesekia aanaan yoonn, le bijab bi aayimbil ŋmee paacham na nan buen Gerar aatiŋ ni ki ti ber Ham aanib ni Meunn aanib bi koo nima na aaboo. Ipiih aamoŋmɔpaan aah nan bi nima sakpen na, le bi nan jenn nyan binib ngbaan ki gaa nima. 42Simeonn aanibol ikui iŋmu biken nan buen liwipuul wɔb, Edom aatiŋ pu. Isi aajapɔtiib, Pelatia, ni Nearia, ni Refaya, ni Usiel le nan loln bi pu nsan. 43Bi nan ku Amalek yaab bi nan gur na nima chee la, le ki gur koo nima ki nan saa din.

english_text:
The Descendants of Reuben
1 Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph, 2 even though it was the Judah tribe that became the most powerful and produced a leader.
3Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
4-6 The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
7-8The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon, 9and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
10When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead.
The Descendants of Gad
11The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah. 12Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat. 13Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
14They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz. 15Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
16The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon. 17Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
18The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh had 44,760 soldiers trained to fight in battle with shields, swords, bows, and arrows. 19They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab. 20Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies. 21These Israelite tribes captured 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, 2,000 donkeys, and 100,000 people. 22Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria.
The Tribe of East Manasseh
23East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. 24Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers.
The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
25The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan. 26 So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_text:
Rubenn aayaabitiib aayimbil
1Jakob aajapɔpol Rubenn aayaabitiib aayimbil sɔ: Rubenn aah nan gaa ute aapuu waatiir ubaa na, waa nan ki kpa nsan u ji tininkpir aafaal ute chee. Unaal Josef le nan gaa kina aasan. 2Ni mu nan tee ye Juda aanibol le nan ŋa bipɔɔndam le ki nyan bijojoob tii ŋinibol ŋiken na mɔmɔk. 3Jakob aajapɔpol Rubenn nan ma mbijabim binaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Hanok, ni Palu, ni Hesronn, ni Kami.
4-6Joel aayaabitiib ni uyaabisɔsɔk aayimbil sɔ: Semaya, ni Gog, ni Simei, ni Maika, ni Reaya, ni Baal, ni Beera. Asiria aabɔrkpaan, u bi nan yin u ke Tiglaf Pileser na, nan chuu Beera, u nan ye binib ngbaan aasaloln na, ki nyan u baatiŋ ni.
7Baah nan ŋmee Rubenn aanibol ngbaan aamaal aadichadam bi aayimbil bil na sɔ: Jeyel, ni Sekaria, 8ni Bela u aate nan ye Asas na. Uyaaja le nan ye Sema, u ye Joel aataŋaal ni aanii na. Ntaŋaal mue nan koo Aroer aatiŋ, ni lipepel li bi ŋŋangan wɔb ki ti saa Nebo ni Baal Meonn aatim ni na la. 9Bi nan kpa tiwakor sakpen Gilead aatiŋ ni, le ki gaa kitiŋ ngbaan ki nyan nteersakpiin mu bi liwipuul wɔb ki ti saa Yufrates Aamɔɔl chee na.
10Ubɔr Sɔɔl aayoonn na, Rubenn aanibol nan tak Hagar yaab, ki ku bi butɔb ni, le ki gaa baatiŋ ki bi Gilead aawipuul wɔb na.
Gad aayaabitiib aayimbil
11Gad aanibol nan bi Rubenn aanibol aaŋangan wɔb, Basann aatiŋ pu, le ki yoor kina ti saa liwipuul wɔb Saleka aatiŋ ni. 12Joel le nan naan ntaŋaal mu loln nsan na, le Safam aataŋaal paa. Janai ni Safat le nan naan itaŋaal iken Basann aatiŋ pu. 13Linibol ngbaan aataŋaal ilole imina aanib sɔ: Mikael, ni Mesulam, ni Seba, ni Jorai, ni Jakann, ni Sia, ni Eber. 14Bi nan ye Abihail, u aate ye Huri na aayaabitiib la. Biyaajatiib le nan ye Abihail, ni Huri, ni Jaroa, ni Gilead, ni Mikael, ni Jesisai, ni Jado, ni Bus. 15Abdiel aajapɔɔn Ahi, u aayaaja nan ye Guni na, le nan ye itaŋaal imina aasaloln. 16Bi nan koo Basann, ni Gilead aapepel ni, ni ntim mu bi nima chee na ni, ni mmoŋmɔpaan aatiŋ ki bi Saronn aafataŋ ni na la. 17Juda Aabɔr Jotam, ni Israel Aabɔr Jeroboam uken aayoonn, le bi nan ŋmee nimina mɔmɔk bil.
Liwipuul wɔb aanibol aajab
18Butɔb aajab ŋichur imonko ilee ni ŋinaa, ni ikui ilole ni imonko itaa le nan bi Rubenn, ni Gad aanibol, ni Manase aanibol ligeln li bi liwipuul wɔb na ni. Bijab ngbaan nan nyi kijaak aapen, ni kijaak aajum, ni itɔi aabɔr pam. 19Bi ni Hagar aanibol ŋimina, Jetur, ni Nafis, ni Nodab yaab nan too tɔb butɔb. 20Bi nan di baanaadii tii Uwumbɔr la, le ki mee u ki ban nterm. Le Uwumbɔr nan kii baameel ki cha bi nyaŋ Hagar yaab ni bimaantɔtiib. 21Bi nan gaa laakumii tiib ŋichur piiŋmu, ni ipiih ŋichur ikui ilee ni piiŋmu, ki kpee ibon ŋichur ŋilee, le ki chur butɔb aanaagbiib mu ŋichur nkub. 22Butɔb ngbaan aah nan ye Uwumbɔr aageehn na, bi nan ku baadim pam. Bi nan gur koo lipepel ngbaan ni le ki ti saa buyoonn baadim nan nyaŋ bi, ki di bi buen kitiyayan ni.
Manase yaab bi bi liwipuul wɔb na aabɔr
23Manase yaab bi nan bi liwipuul wɔb na nan koo Basann aapepel ni, ki di ti saa ŋŋangan wɔb Baal Hemonn, ni Senir, ni Hemonn Aajool mɔk. Bi nan pɔr sakpen. 24Baataŋaal aasalolm sɔ: Efer, ni Isi, ni Eliel, ni Asriel, ni Jeremia, ni Hodafia, ni Jadiel. Bi mɔmɔk nan ye butɔb aajakpaam la, le ki ye baataŋaal aanikpaam.
Uwumbɔr aah nan daa liwipuul wɔb aanibol aatafal pu na
25Tɔ, binib ngbaan nan yii Uwumbɔr u biyaajatiib nan dii na, le ki dii ŋitimbol ŋi aanib Uwumbɔr jenn nyan bi baatiŋ pu na aawaa. 26Kina pu le Uwumbɔr nan cha Asiria yaab aabɔrkpaan Pul (u bi nan ki yin u ke Tiglaf Pileser na) bɔ baatingbaln ni. U nan chur Rubenn, ni Gad, ni Manase yaab bi bi liwipuul wɔb na tinaagbiir ki di bi ti kaan Hala, ni Habor, ni Hara aatim ni, ni Gosann Aamɔɔl chee.

english_text:
The Descendants of Levi
1Levi was the father of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
2Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 3Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
4-14Eleazar's descendants included Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Ahimaaz, Azariah, Johanan, Azariah the priest who served in the temple built by King Solomon, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, Shallum, Hilkiah, Azariah, Seraiah, and Jehozadak. 15King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
16 Levi's three sons had sons of their own. 17Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei. 18Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 19Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
20-21Gershon's descendants included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah, Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.
22-24Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
25Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth. 26-27Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
28Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
29-30Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.
The Temple Musicians
31After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship. 32These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
33-38Here is a list of these musicians and their family lines:
Heman from the Kohathite clan was the director. His ancestors went all the way back to Jacob and included Joel, Samuel, Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah, Zuph, Elkanah, Mahath, Amasai, Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah, Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah, Izhar, Kohath, Levi.
39-43Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
44-47Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
48The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent.
The Descendants of Aaron
49Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
50-53Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz.
The Towns for the Levites
(Joshua 21.1-42)
54Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in. 55They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it. 56But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh. 57-59So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh. 60From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
61The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
62The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
63The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
64So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them. 65All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
66Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim. 67-69These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon. 70And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.
71The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them. 72-73The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them. 74-75The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them. 76Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
77The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun. 78-79They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them. 80-81And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_text:
Liifai yaab aamaal
1Liifai nan ma mbijabim mutaa la.
Baayimbil le nan ye Gesonn, ni Kohaf, ni Merari.
2Kohaf mu nan ma mbijabim munaa la.
Baayimbil sɔ: Amram, ni Isar, ni Hebronn, ni Usiel.
3Amram nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Aaronn ni Moses. Bininkpan le nan ye Miriam.
Aaronn mu nan ma mbijabim binaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Nadab, ni Abihu, ni Eleasar, ni Itamar.
4Eleasar aayaabitiib ni uyaabisɔsɔk aayimbil sɔ: Fineas, ni Abisua, 5ni Buki, ni Usi, 6ni Serahia, ni Merayof, 7ni Amaria, ni Ahitub, 8ni Sadok, ni Ahimaas, 9ni Asaria, ni Johanann, 10ni Asaria, (uma le nan tun lituln ubɔr Solomonn aah nan maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal li Jerusalem ni na ponn ni,) 11ni Amaria, ni Ahitub, 12ni Sadok, ni Salum, 13ni Hilkia, ni Asaria, 14ni Seraya, ni Jehosadak. 15Ubɔr Nebukadnesar nan chur Jehosadak, ni Juda, ni Jerusalem aanib biken buen tinaagbiir ni. Uwumbɔr le nan cha u ŋa kina.
Liifai aayaabitiib biken aayimbil
16Liifai nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Gesonn, ni Kohaf, ni Merari. 17Bi mɔmɔk mu nan ma mbijabim. Gesonn le nan ma Libni ni Semei, 18le Kohaf nan ma Amram, ni Isar, ni Hebronn, ni Usiel, 19Merari mu ma Mali, ni Musi.
20Gesonn aayaabitiib ni uyaabisɔsɔk aayimbil sɔ: Libni, ni Jahaf, ni Sima, 21ni Joa, ni Ido, ni Sera, ni Jeaterai.
22Kohaf mu aayaabitiib ni uyaabisɔsɔk aayimbil sɔ: Aminadab, ni Kora, ni Asir, 23ni Elkana, ni Ebiasaf, ni Asir, 24ni Tahaf, ni Uriel, ni Usia, ni Saul.
25Elkana nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Amasai, ni Ahimof. 26Ahimof aayaabitiib ni uyaabisɔsɔk aayimbil sɔ: Elkana, ni Sofai, ni Nahaf, 27ni Eliab, ni Jeroham, ni Elkana.
28Samuel nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Joel, u nan ye upol na, ni Abija, u nan ye uwaatiir na.
29Merari aayaabitiib ni uyaabisɔsɔk aayimbil sɔ: Mali, ni Libni, ni Simei, ni Usa, 30ni Simea, ni Hagia, ni Asaya.
Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aalahngaab ni biwangbaab aayimbil
31Baah nan yoor Uwumbɔr Aakaal Aadakaa di buen Jerusalem ponn ni na, bijab bimina le Ubɔr David nan cha bi ye bilahngaab ni biwangbaab nin chee bi dooni Uwumbɔr Jerusalem ni na. 32Waahr aan Ubɔr Solomonn nin maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal na, bi nan yakr le ki tun lituln Uwumbɔr Aabool ponn ni. 33Ŋidichal ŋi nan yeh lituln limina na aayimbil sɔ:
Kohaf aataŋaal ponn ni, Hemann le nan ye njan aalahngaab aasaloln. Ute le nan ye Joel. Waadichal ki ti saa Jakob mɔk aanib aayimbil sɔ: Hemann, ni Joel, ni Samuel, 34ni Elkana, ni Jeroham, ni Eliel, ni Toa, 35ni Suf, ni Elkana, ni Mahaf, ni Amasai, 36ni Elkana, ni Joel, ni Asaria, ni Sefania, 37ni Tahaf, ni Asir, ni Ebiasaf, ni Kora, 38ni Isar, ni Kohaf, ni Liifai, ni Jakob.
39Asaf le nan ye lelee aalahngaab aasaloln. Waadichal ki ti saa Liifai mɔk aanib aayimbil sɔ: Asaf, ni Berekia, ni Simea, 40ni Mikael, ni Baaseya, ni Malkija, 41ni Efni, ni Sera, ni Adaya, 42ni Etann, ni Sima, ni Simei, 43ni Jahaf, ni Gesonn, ni Liifai.
44Etann, u nan ye Merari aataŋaal pu aanii na, le nan ye bilahngaab bi paa bileler pu na aasaloln. Waadichal ki ti saa Liifai mɔk aanib aayimbil sɔ: Etann, ni Kisi, ni Abdi, ni Maluk, 45ni Hasabia, ni Amasia, ni Hilkia, 46ni Amsi, ni Bani, ni Semer, 47ni Mali, ni Musi, ni Merari, ni Liifai.
48Biŋeen aatɔtiib Liifai yaab biken le nan tun ŋitun ŋi mɔmɔk gur ki bi, baah dooni Uwumbɔr nin chee na.
Aaronn aayaabitiib aayimbil
49Aaronn, ni ujapɔtiib, ni uyaabitiib le nan seer tulalee aayon, ki toor kitork ki joo seer mmii ni, kitork aabimbiln paab. Bima le nan yeh Chain Chain Aapepel ni aadoon, ki toor kitork ki ga cha Uwumbɔr di cha pinn Israel yaab aatunwanbir na. Bi nan ŋani nimina mɔmɔk, Uwumbɔr aatutunn Moses aah nan mɔk pu na la. 50Aaronn aayaabitiib aayimbil sɔ: Eleasar, ni Fineas, ni Abisua, 51ni Buki, ni Usi, ni Serahia, 52ni Merayof, ni Amaria, ni Ahitub, 53ni Sadok, ni Ahimaas.
Liifai yaab aakookoo yaan
54Aaronn aayaabitiib bi nan ye Kohaf aataŋaal pu aanib na le nan puen gaal kitiŋ, baah di nin chee tii Liifai yaab na. 55Baapepel le nan ye Hebronn, ni bi Juda aatiŋ pu na aapepel, ni tiwakor aamoŋmɔpaan i maln goln nima chee na. 56Le Jefune aajapɔɔn Kaleb nan tee yeh ikpaakon ni ntimbim mu bi nima chee na.
57-59Aaronn aayaabitiib le nan yeh ntim mu paa na; Hebronn, kima ponn ni le unii yaa kaa nyi ki peln ku uken kan, u san ti koo na; ni Jatir, ni Libna, ni Estemoa, ni Hilenn, ni Debir, ni Asann, ni Bef Semes aatim, ni mu aamoŋmɔpaan. 60Baatim mu nan bi Benjaminn aapepel ni na mu sɔ: Geba, ni Alemef, ni Anatof, ni mu aamoŋmɔpaan. Baatim mu ponn ni bi ni baadichal nan koo na, nan ti kpaan ntim kipiik ni mutaa la. 61Bi nan too inaan le ki yakr ntim kipiik Manase aanibol ligeln li bi liwilir wɔb na aapepel ni, ki tii Kohaf aataŋaal i gur na aadichal.
62Bi nan yakr ntim kipiik ni mutaa le tii Gesonn aataŋaal aadichal, Isakar aanibol, ni Aser aanibol, ni Naftali aanibol, ni Manase aanibol ligeln li bi liwipuul wɔb Basann aatiŋ ni na aapepel ni. 63Bi nan ki yakr kina le tii Merari aataŋaal aadichal ntim kipiik ni mulee, Rubenn, ni Gad, ni Sebulunn aapepel ni. 64Kina le Israel yaab nan yakr ntim, ni mu aamoŋmɔpaan tii Liifai yaab, ke bi li koo mu ponn ni. 65Bi nan ki too inaan le ki yakr ntim mu bi Juda, ni Simeonn, ni Benjaminn aapepel aan ŋaayimbil ŋmee paacham na mu ki tii Liifai yaab.
66Bi nan tii Kohaf aataŋaal pu aadichal ŋibaa ntim ni mu aamoŋmɔpaan Efraim aapepel ni. Ntim ngbaan aayimbil sɔ: 67Sekem, ki bi Efraim aagongon ni, kima ponn ni le unii yaa kaa nyi ki peln ku uken kan, u san ti koo nima, ni Geser, 68ni Jokmeam, ni Bef Horonn, 69ni Aijalonn, ni Gaf Rimonn. 70Manase aanibol ligeln li bi liwilir wɔb na ponn ni mu, bi nan di Aner, ni Bileam aatim, ni mu aamoŋmɔpaan le tii bi.
71Baah nan tii Gesonn aataŋaal aadichal ntim mu ni mu aamoŋmɔpaan na aayimbil sɔ:
Golann ki bi Basann ni na, ni Astarof aatim mu bi Manase aanibol ligeln li bi liwipuul wɔb aapepel ni na.
72Bi nan ki tii bi Kedes, ni Daberaf, 73ni Ramof, ni Anem aatim mu bi Isakar aapepel ni na.
74Baatim mu nan bi Aser aapepel ni na le ye Masal, ni Abdonn, 75ni Hukok, ni Rehob.
76Naftali aapepel mu ni, baatim le nan ye Kedes, ki bi Galilee ni na, ni Hamonn, ni Kiriataim.
77Merari aataŋaal pu aadichal ŋi gur na aatim, ni mu aamoŋmɔpaan le paa na.
Sebulunn aapepel ni, baatim le nan ye Rimono ni Tabor:
78Rubenn aapepel li bi Jɔɔdann Aamɔɔl aawipuul wɔb, Jeriko aapuwɔb na ni, baatim le nan ye Beser ki bi kitiŋ ki bi taar na pu na, ni Jasa, 79ni Kedemof, ni Mefaaf.
80Gad aapepel ni, baatim le nan ye Ramof aatiŋ ki bi Gilead ni na, ni Mahanaim, 81ni Hesbonn, ni Jaser.

english_text:
The Descendants of Issachar
1Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
2Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were 22,600 people in Tola's family by the time David became king.
3Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders. 4Their families were so large that they had 36,000 soldiers in their clans. 5In fact, according to family records, the tribe of Issachar had a total of 87,000 warriors.
The Descendants of Benjamin and Dan
6Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
7Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was 22,034.
8Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. 9The official family records listed 20,200 soldiers in the families of this clan, as well as their family leaders.
10Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. 11They were family leaders in their clan, which had 17,200 soldiers prepared to fight in battle. 12Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan.
Dan was the father of Hushim.
The Descendants of Naphtali
13Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.
The Descendants of Manasseh
14Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead. 15Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah.
Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
16Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem. 17Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
18Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
19Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
The Descendants of Ephraim
20Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath, 21Zabad, and Shuthelah.
Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath. 22Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him. 23Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
24Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
25Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan, 26Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama, 27Nun, and Joshua.
28The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
29The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages.
The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages.
The Descendants of Asher
30Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
31Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith. 32Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua. 33Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. 34Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram. 35And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal. 36Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, 37Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera. 38Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
39Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
40These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of 26,000 soldiers.
translation_text:
Isakar aayaabitiib aayimbil
1Isakar nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Tola, ni Pua, ni Jasub, ni Simronn.
2Ujapɔɔn Tola nan ma mbijabim muloob la. Baayimbil sɔ: Usi, ni Refaya, ni Jeriel, ni Jamai, ni Ibsam, ni Semuel. Bima le nan ye Tola aataŋaal aadichadam, le ki nan ye butɔb aajakpaam. Ubɔr David aayoonn na, biyaabitiib nan ti saa binib ŋichur moninko ni ŋilee ni ikui iloob la.
3Usi nan ma Israhia baanja la. Israhia nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Maikel, ni Obadia, ni Joel, ni Isia. U ni bi mɔmɔk nan ye bidichadam la. 4Bi nan kpa puutiib ni mbim sakpen. Biyaabitiib nan ŋmaa kan butɔb aajab ŋichur piitaa ni ŋiloob la.
5Baah nan ŋmee Isakar aanibol aadichadam bi ga ŋmaa buen butɔb na, bi nan ti kpaan bijab ŋichur imonko inaa ni ŋilole la.
Benjaminn ni Dann aayaabitiib aayimbil
6Benjaminn nan ma mbijabim bitaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Bela, ni Beker, ni Jediael.
7Bela nan ma mbijabim muŋmu la. Baayimbil sɔ: Esbonn, ni Usi, ni Usiel, ni Jerimof, ni Iri. Bi nan ye bidichadam le baataŋaal ni. Bi nan ki ye butɔb aajakpaam la. Biyaabitiib bi nan ye butɔb aajab na nan ye binib ŋichur moninko ni ŋilee ni bijab piitaa ni binaa la.
8Beker nan ma mbijabim muwae la. Baayimbil sɔ: Semira, ni Joas, ni Elieser, ni Eliwenai, ni Omri, ni Jeremof, ni Abija, ni Anatof, ni Alemef. 9Baah nan ŋmee baadichal aayimbil na, biyaabitiib nan ti saa ŋichur moninko ni ikui ilee la. Bi mɔmɔk nan ye bijab bi ŋeer butɔb na la.
10Jediael nan ma Bilhann baanja la, le Bilhann ma nan ma mbijabim mulole. Baayimbil sɔ: Jeus, ni Benjaminn, ni Ehud, ni Kenaana, ni Setann, ni Tasis, ni Ahisahar. 11Bi mɔmɔk nan ye ntaŋaal ngbaan aadichadam, ni butɔb aajakpaam la. Biyaabitiib ŋichur kipiik ni ŋilole, ni ikui ilee le nan ye butɔb aajab. 12Supim ni Hupim mu nan ye linibol limina aanib la.
Dann nan ma Husim baanja la, le u ye ubijabo.
Naftali aayaabitiib aayimbil
13Naftali nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Jasiel, ni Guni, ni Jeser, ni Salum. Bi nan ye Bilha aayaabitiib la.
Manase aayaabitiib aayimbil
14Manase nan ma unaagbiipii u nyan ni Aram aatiŋ ni na chee mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Asriel ni Makir. Makir le nan ma Gilead. 15Makir le nan chɔi bipiib tii Hupim ni Supim. Uninkpan aayimbil le nan ye Maaka. Makir aajapɔleler le nan ye Selofehad. Uma nan ma mpiibim ŋmeen la.
16Makir aapuu Maaka nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bi nan yin bi ke Peres ni Seres. Peres nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Ulam ni Rakem. 17Ulam mu nan ma ubijabo le ki yin u ke Bedann. Manase aajapɔɔn Makir mu aajapɔɔn Gilead aayaabitiib le nan ye bi mɔmɔk.
18Gilead aaninkpan Hamolekef nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Isod, ni Abieser, ni Mala. 19Semida nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Ahiann, ni Sekem, ni Liki, ni Aniam.
Efraim aayaabitiib aayimbil
20Efraim aayaabitiib ki ti saa uyaabisɔsɔk aayimbil sɔ: Sutela, ni Bered, ni Tahaf, ni Eleada, ni Tahaf, 21ni Sabad, ni Sutela. Efraim nan ki kpa mbijabim mulee ki kpee Sutela pu. Bima le nan ye Eser ni Elead. Bi nan ban bi su Gaf yaab aawakor le bi ku bi. 22Bite Efraim nan wii baakpuul ni ti yunn sakpen, le unaabitiib buen ti sɔŋ usui. 23Le u nan ki doon upuu chee, le u dek ki nan ma ubijabo. Bi nan yin u ke Beria la. Baadichal aah nan kan tibɔr ti na pu le bi nan yin u kina.
24Efraim nan ma upiibo ubaa, le ki yin u ke Seera. Uma le nan naan Bef Horonn Paacham ni Bef Horonn Taab, ni Usenn Seera aatim.
25Bi nan ki yin Efraim aajapɔɔn uken ke Refa. Refa aayaabitiib aayimbil sɔ: Resef, ni Tela, ni Tahann, 26ni Ladann, ni Amihud, ni Elisama, 27ni Nunn, ni Josua.
28Baah nan gaa lipepel li ki koo nima na le ye Betel, ni ntim mu bi maln goln ki na, ki di kina ti saa Naarann aatiŋ ki bi liwipuul wɔb na, ki nyan nima ki di toŋ liwilir wɔb, Geser, ni ntim mu maln goln ki na. Ntim mu nan ki kpee na le ye Sekem ni Aya aatim, ni ntim mu maln goln mu na.
29Manase aayaabitiib le nan yeh Bef Sann, ni Taanak, ni Megido, ni Dor aatikpaam, ni ntim mu maln goln mu na.
Jakob aajapɔɔn Josef aayaabitiib aah nan koo nin chee na le bi na.
Aser aayaabitiib aayimbil
30Aser aayaabitiib sɔ: U nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Imna, ni Isfa, ni Isfi, ni Beria. U nan ma upiibo ubaa mu, le ki yin u ke Sera.
31Beria nan ma mbijabim mulee la. Bima le nan ye Heber, ni Malkiel. Malkiel le nan naan Birsaif aatiŋ.
32Heber nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Jaflet, ni Somer, ni Hotam. U nan ma upiibo ubaa mu, le ki yin u ke Sua.
33Jaflet mu nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Pasak, ni Bimhal, ni Asfaf.
34Unaal Somer mu nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Roga, ni Jehuba, ni Aram.
35Unaal Hotam ma nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Sofa, ni Imna, ni Seles, ni Amal.
36Sofa aayaabitiib aayimbil sɔ: Sua, ni Hanefer, ni Sual, ni Beri, ni Imra, 37ni Beser, ni Hod, ni Sama, ni Silsa, ni Itrann, ni Beera.
38Jeter aayaabitiib le nan ye Jefune, ni Pispa, ni Ara; 39le Ula mu aayaabitiib nan ye Ara, ni Haniel, ni Risia.
40Bi mɔmɔk nan ye Aser aayaabitiib la. Bi nan ye bidichadam la, le ki nyi butɔb aabɔr sakpen, le ki ye bisalolmbamɔm. Aser aayaabitiib bi nan ye butɔb aajab na, nan ti saa ŋichur moninko ni ŋiloob la.

english_text:
More Descendants of Benjamin
1Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah, 2Nohah, and Rapha. 3Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud, 4Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah, 5Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
6-7Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
8-11Shaharaim and his wife Hushim had two sons: Abitub and Elpaal. But Shaharaim later divorced her and his other wife, Baara. Then he moved to the country of Moab and married Hodesh, and they had seven sons: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. They were all family leaders in his clan. 12Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
13Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath. 14-16Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha. 17-18Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab. 19-21Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath. 22-25Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Zichri, Hanan, Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah, Iphdeiah, and Penuel. 26-27Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri. 28These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
29Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there 30along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 31Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, 32and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
The Descendants of King Saul
33Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 34Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, 35and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz. 36Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, 37Binea, Raphah, Eleasah, Azel, 38as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. 39Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet. 40Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of 150 children and grandchildren.
All of these belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_text:
Benjaminn aayaabitiib aayimbil
1Benjaminn nan ma mbijabim biŋmu la. Baayimbil ni baaninkpir sɔ: Bela, ni Asbel, ni Ahara, 2ni Noha, ni Rafa.
3Bela aayaabitiib aayimbil sɔ: Adar, ni Gera, ni Abihud, 4ni Abisua, ni Naamann, ni Ahoa, 5ni Gera, ni Sefufann, ni Huram.
6-7Ehud aayaabitiib aayimbil le nan ye Naamann, ni Ahija, ni Gera. Bi nan ye bidichadam le ki koo Geba aatiŋ ni. Tɔ, bi nan jenn nyan bi nima mpɔɔn, le bi ti koo Manahaf aatiŋ ni. Usa ni Ahihud aate Gera le nan di bi buen nima chee.
8-9Saharaim aapuutiib le nan ye Husim ni Baara. U nan yii bi, le ki di bi lii. Nee aapuwɔb, le u nan ti koo Moab aatingbaln ni, le ki yoor Hodes. Bi nan ma mbijabim mulole la. Baayimbil sɔ: Jobab, ni Sibia, ni Mesa, ni Malkam, 10ni Jeus, ni Sakia, ni Mirma. Ujapɔtiib ngbaan mɔmɔk nan ŋa bidichadam la.
11U ni Husim mu nan ki ma mbijabim mulee. Bima le nan ye Abitub ni Elpaal.
12Elpaal nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Eber, ni Misam, ni Semed. Semed le nan maa Ono ni Lod aatim, ni ntimbim mu bi maln goln mu na.
Benjaminn yaab bi nan koo Gaf ni Aijalonn aatim ni na
13Beria ni Sema nan ye bidichadam le ki koo Aijalonn Aatiŋ ni. Bima le nan jenn nyan binib bi nan koo Gaf aatiŋ ni na. 14Beria aayaabitiib sɔ: Ahio, ni Sasak, ni Jeremof, 15ni Sebadia, ni Arad, ni Eder, 16ni Maikel, ni Ispa, ni Joha.
Benjaminn yaab bi nan koo Jerusalem aatiŋ ni na
17Binib bi nan ye Elpaal aayaabitiib na aayimbil sɔ: Sebadia, ni Mesulam, ni Hiski, ni Heber, 18ni Ismerai, ni Islia, ni Jobab.
19Binib bi nan ye Simei aayaabitiib na aayimbil sɔ: Jakim, ni Sikri, ni Sabdi, 20ni Elienai, ni Siletai, ni Eliel, 21ni Adaya ni Beraya, ni Simraf.
22Binib bi nan ye Sasak aayaabitiib na aayimbil sɔ: Ispann, ni Eber, ni Eliel, 23ni Abdonn, ni Sikri, ni Hanann, 24ni Hanania, ni Elam, ni Antotija, 25ni Ifdeya, ni Penuel.
26Binib bi nan ye Jeroham aayaabitiib na aayimbil sɔ: Samserai, ni Seharia, ni Atalia, 27ni Jaaresia, ni Elaija, ni Sikri.
28Bimina le nan ye ŋiyaajayil ni biyaabitiib kpaam bi nan koo Jerusalem ni na.
Benjaminn yaab bi nan koo Gibeonn ni Jerusalem aatim ni na
29Jeyel le nan naan Gibeonn aatiŋ, le ki koo nima. Bi nan yin upuu ke Maaka la, 30le ki yin ujapɔpol ke Abdonn. Ujapɔtiib biken aayimbil sɔ: Sur, ni Kis, ni Baal, ni Ner, ni Nadab, 31ni Gedor, ni Ahio, ni Seker, 32ni Miklof. Miklof aajapɔɔn le nan ye Simea. Biyaabitiib nan koo Jerusalem ni, ki gbɔk baataŋaal yaab la.
Ubɔr Sɔɔl aadichal
33Ner aajapɔɔn le nan ye Kis, le Kis mu ma Ubɔr Sɔɔl. Sɔɔl nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Jonatann, ni Malkisua, ni Abinadab, ni Esbaal. 34Jonatann le nan ma Meribaal, le Meribaal mu ma Maika.
35Maika nan ma mbijabim munaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Pitonn, ni Melek, ni Tarea, ni Ahas. 36Ahas aajapɔɔn le nan ye Jehoada, le u mu nan ma mbijabim mutaa. Baayimbil sɔ: Alemef, ni Asmafef, ni Simri. Le Simri nan ma Mosa. 37Mosa mu le nan ma Binea, le Binea mu ma Rafa. Rafa mu le nan ma Eleasa, le Eleasa mu ma Asel.
38Asel nan ma mbijabim muloob la. Baayimbil sɔ: Asrikam, ni Bokeru, ni Ismael, ni Searia, ni Obadia, ni Hanann. 39Asel aanaal Esek nan ma mbijabim mutaa la. Baayimbil sɔ: Ulam, ni Jeus, ni Elifelet.
40Ulam aajapɔtiib nan ye bijab bi nyi butɔb aabɔr ki ŋmaa too ipiin pam na la. Ujapɔtiib ni uyaabitiib nan ti kpaan mbijabim nkub ni piiŋmu la. Bi mɔmɔk aayimbil ŋmee ki bi paacham na nan ye bidichadam le Benjaminn aanibol ni.

english_text:
The People Who Returned from Babylonia and Settled in Jerusalem
1Everyone in Israel was listed in the official family records that were included in the history of Israel's kings.
The people of Judah were taken to Babylonia as prisoners because they sinned against the Lord. 2 And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites. 3People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
4-6There were 690 people from the Judah tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They were all descendants of Judah's three sons: Perez, Shelah, and Zerah. Their leaders were Uthai, Asaiah, and Jeuel. Uthai was the son of Ammihud and a descendant of Omri, Imri, Bani, and Perez. Asaiah was a descendant of Shelah; Jeuel was a descendant of Zerah.
7-9There were also 956 family leaders from the Benjamin tribe who settled in Jerusalem. They included: Sallu son of Meshullam, grandson of Hodaviah, and great-grandson of Hassenuah; Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi and grandson of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, grandson of Reuel, and great-grandson of Ibnijah.
The Priests Who Settled in Jerusalem
10-12Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
13There was a total of 1,760 priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple.
The Levites Who Settled in Jerusalem
14-16Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah.
The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
17Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan, 18and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
19Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent. 20Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
21Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
22There was a total of 212 guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work, 23and now they guarded the temple gates.
24There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple. 25Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty. 26The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there. 27They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning.
The Duties of the Levites
28Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used. 29Others were responsible for the temple furnishings and its sacred objects, as well as the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices. 30But only the priests could mix the spices. 31Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings. 32The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
33The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
34All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem.
King Saul's Family
(1 Chronicles 8.29-38)
35Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived. 36They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 37Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth 38the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
39Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul.
Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal. 40-41Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz. 42-44The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_text:
Binib bi nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na
1Bi nan ŋmee Israel yaab mɔmɔk aayimbil ki dii baadichal, Israel Aabɔrb Aagbaŋ ni la.
Juda aanib aatunwanbir pu, le Uwumbɔr nan cha bi chur bi buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni, ke u di daa bitafal. 2Binib bi nan loln nsan ki gir ni baatiŋ pu bido bido na nan ye bitotoorb, ni Liifai yaab, ni Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatutum, ni Israel yaab biken. 3Juda, ni Benjaminn, ni Efraim, ni Manase aanib nan ti koo Jerusalem ni la.
4-6Juda aanibol ni yaab bi nan ti koo Jerusalem ponn ni na nan ti kpaan binib ikui iloob ni imonko inaa ni kipiik la.
Juda aajapɔɔn Peres aayaabitiib aasaloln le nan ye Amihud aajapɔɔn Utai. Uyaaja le nan ye Omri. Uyaajatiib biken le nan ye Imri ni Bani.
Juda aajapɔɔn Sela aayaabitiib mu aasaloln le nan ye Asaya. Uma le nan ye waadichal aayidaan.
Juda aajapɔɔn Sera aayaabitiib aasaloln le nan ye Jewel.
7-8Benjaminn aanibol ni yaab bi nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni na sɔ: Salu, u aate nan ye Mesulam na. Mesulam mu aate le nan ye Hodafia, le uyaaja ye Hasenua; ni Jeroham aajapɔɔn Ibneya; ni Ela, u aate nan ye Usi, aan uyaaja mu ye Mikri na; ni Sefatia aajapɔɔn Mesulam, u aayaaja nan ye Rewel na. Rewel aate le nan ye Ibnija.
9Linibol limina aadichal ŋi nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni na nan kpaan binib ikui iwae ni piiŋmu, ni biloob la. Bijab ngbaan mɔmɔk nan ye bidichadam la.
Bitotoorb bi nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni na
10-12Bitotoorb bimina le nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni: Jedaya, ni Jehoyarib, ni Jakinn, ni Hilkia aajapɔɔn Asaria, uma le nan ye Uwumbɔr Aadichal ponn ni aaninkpiib aayidaan. Uyaajatiib le nan ye Mesulam, ni Sadok, ni Merayof, ni Ahitub; ni Jeroham aajapɔɔn Adaya, u aayaajatiib nan ye Pasur ni Malkija na; ni Adiel aajapɔɔn Maasai, u aayaajatiib nan ye Jasera, ni Mesulam, ni Mesilemif, ni Imer na.
13Bitotoorb bi nan ye bidichadam na, nan ti kpaan bijab lichur ni ikui ilole ni imonko itaa la. Bi nan ye binib bi nyi Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatuln mɔmɔk aabɔr sakpen na la.
Liifai yaab bi nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni na
14-16Liifai yaab bimina le nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni:
Hasub aajapɔɔn Semaya, u aayaajatiib nan ye Asrikam ni Hasabia, bi nan ye Merari aataŋaal pu yaab na, ni Bakbakar, ni Heres, ni Galal aataŋaal pu yaab; ni Maika aajapɔɔn Matania, u aayaajatiib nan ye Sikri, ni Asaf na; ni Semaya aajapɔɔn Obadia, u aayaajatiib nan ye Galal ni Jedutunn na; ni Asa aajapɔɔn Berekia, u aayaaja nan ye Elkana, u nan bi lipepel li ye Netofa aatiŋ aapepel ni na.
Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aakikiib bi nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni na
17Uwumbɔr Aadichal aakikiib bimina le nan koo Jerusalem ponn ni; Salum, ni Akub, ni Talmonn, ni Ahimann. Salum le nan ye baasaloln. 18Ki nyan n‑yaayoonn na, ki ti saa n‑yoonn ngbaan na, baataŋaal ni aanib nan koo mbisamɔb mu bi yin mu ke Ubɔr Aabisamɔb na aawipuul wɔb la. N‑yaayoonn na bi nan si ki kii Liifai yaab aakookoo yaan aabisamɔi la.
19Kore aajapɔɔn Salum, u aayaaja nan ye Ebiasaf na, ni Kora aataŋaal yaab biken aatuln le nan ye ke bi li si kii Uwumbɔr Aabool aabisamɔb, ke biyaajatiib aatuln aah nan ye ke bi li kii Uwumbɔr aakookoo yaan pu na. 20Eleasar aajapɔɔn Fineas nan lik baatuln pu n‑yoonn mbaa, le Uwumbɔr nan bi u chee.
