Liifai yaab bi nan saa ŋibin moninko ki jer na le nan ye Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan aamaam aaninkpiib. 9Liifai aanii Jesua, ni ujapɔtiib, ni udo yaab, ni Kadmiel, ni ujapɔtiib bi aataŋaal nan ye Hodafia yaab na, le nan kpaan ki loln nsan Uwumbɔr Aadichal aamaam ngbaan ni. Henadad aataŋaal yaab bi mu ye Liifai yaab na nan ter bi.
10Bijab ngbaan aah nan piin ki bi bilni Uwumbɔr Aadichal aadinyikl aatakpal na, le bitotoorb di baawanpeenkaan peen, le ki joo kakaan tiib biŋaal ni, ki sil baasisiiyaan chee, le Asaf aataŋaal yaab bi ye Liifai yaab na mu yoor baachayakrtuun. Bi nan gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr, Ubɔr David aayoonn aakaal aah nan mɔk pu na. 11Bi nan gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr ke,
“Uwumbɔr kpa tiŋann,
le waah gee Israel yaab pu na aa kpa ndoon.”
Unii mɔk nan tar mpɔɔn pu, le ki pak Uwumbɔr, waah cha bi ŋmaa bil Uwumbɔr Aadichal aadinyikl aatakpal pu na. 12Bitotoorb ni Liifai yaab, ni itaŋaal aayidam bi nan por na pam nan kan njan Aameen Aadichal na, le baah si lik Uwumbɔr Aadichal aadinyikl aatakpal ngbaan na, bi nan kaani le ki wii, mpombiin pu, le bi gur na ma nan tar mpɔɔn pu ni mpopiin ŋmeen. 13Ubaa aa nan nyi ni ye iwiil na, ni ni ye mpopiin aafuuk na, ba pu? kifuuk ngbaan nan fuu dandar dandar.

english_text:
Foreigners
Want To Help Rebuild the Temple
1The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel. 2 So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
3But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
4Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building. 5During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work.
Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
6 In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
7Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
8-10 A letter was also written to Artaxerxes about Jerusalem by Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors, including the judges, the governors, the officials, and the local leaders. They were joined in writing this letter by people from Erech and Babylonia, the Elamites from Susa, and people from other foreign nations that the great and famous Ashurbanipal had forced to settle in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
11This letter said:
Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
12You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations. 13You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
14We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you. 15If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place. 16If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
17King Artaxerxes answered:
Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
18After your letter was translated and read to me, 19I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations. 20And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
21I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice. 22Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
23As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city.
Work on the Temple Starts Again
24 The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_text:
Bidim aah kaa nan kii ke bi ki gir maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal pu na
1Juda ni Benjaminn yaab aadim nan ŋun ke Israel yaab bi nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na bi maa Bidindaan Uwumbɔr Aadichal, 2le bi buen Serubabel ni itaŋaal ngbaan aayidam chee ki ti bui bi ke, “Cha man ti ter nimi aan ni maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan. Ti mu dooni Uwumbɔrbaan u ni dooni na la; ki nyan n‑yoonn mu Asiria Aabɔrkpaan Esaradonn joo ni timi do na, uma le ti toor kitork tii.”
3Le Serubabel, ni Josua, ni itaŋaal ngbaan aayidam bui bi ke, “Taa ban nimi aaterm ke ti di maa Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Aadichal. Pesia aabɔrkpaan Sairus aah bui timi pu na, timi tibaa le ga maa li.”
4Le baadim, bi nan puen koo kitiŋ ngbaan pu na, pɔɔn bibaa ke bi faan Juda yaab ngbaan ki yɔl bitaakpab, aan bi di cha ki taa ki maa. 5Bi nan tii Pesia aatiŋ aabɔrkpaan aaninkpiib ŋimombil, ke bi ter bi ki jenn Juu yaab ngbaan. Bi nan ŋani kina ki nyan Sairus aayoonn ki ti saa Darius aayoonn.
Bidim aah kaa nan ki kii ke bi ki gir ma Jerusalem pu na
6Ubɔrkpaan Sekes aah nan laa jin nnaan buyoonn na, le binib bi nan koo Jerusalem aatiŋ, ni Juda aatim muken ni na aadim ŋmee tibɔr ti kaa ŋan na bi pu.
7Pesia aabɔrkpaan Ataksekes mu aayoonn, le Bislam, ni Mitredaf, ni Tabeel, ni biŋeen aatɔtiib, mu ki ŋmee kigbaŋ tii ubɔrkpaan ngbaan. Bi nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ngbaan Aram yaab aaliin ni, le bi ti karni ki ki nabr tii u.
8Le lipepel ngbaan aayidaan Rehum, ni waagbaŋmeer Simsai, mu ki ŋmee kigbaŋ ki bii Jerusalem, ki tii Ataksekes ke:
9“Kigbaŋ kee nyan ni Rehum, u ye uyidaan na, ni waagbaŋmeer Simsai, ni biŋeen aatɔtiib, bi ye bibɔjirb, ni bininkpiib biken, bi ye Elam aapepel aatim Erek, ni Babiloŋ, ni Susa ni yaab na, 10ki di kpee binib bi mpɔɔndaan Asurbanipal nan nyan bi baatim ni, ki di bi ti kaan Samaria aatiŋ ni, ni Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir wɔb aapepel ni kookoo na, aajab chee la.”
11Kigbaŋ ngbaan aabɔr sɔ:
“Ubɔrkpaan Ataksekes, timi saanaagbiib, bi bi Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir aapepel na le ŋmee kigbaŋ kee tii si.
12“Ti ban ke sin mpɔɔndaan li nyi ke Juu yaab bi nyan saapepel ŋiken ni ki gir ni na, nan kal Jerusalem ni, le ki ki bi maa titunwanbir aatiŋ ki nya aapuwɔb na. Bi piin ki ki bi maa kaagon, ki ga gbeen doo ŋi. 13Mpɔɔndaan, bi yaa ki gir maa kitiŋ ngbaan ni kaagon kan, binib ngbaan ga yii, kaan ki pa lampoo, le nnaan ni aamombil ga bar. 14Mpɔɔndaan, taah ye saatutum na, taa ban ke kina aatuln tun, 15kina pu na, ti bui ke aa cha bi lik aayaajatiib aah nan ŋmee tigbann ti bil na ponn ni. Aa yaa ŋa kina kan, aa ga kan ke kitiŋ ngbaan aa si ubaa aapuwɔb kpala, ki nyan n‑yaajayoonn na, ki tii bibɔrb ni ŋipepel aayidam tibɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la. Kaanib pɔɔ njoom pam. Kina pu le bi nan kuln kitiŋ ngbaan. 16Mpɔɔndaan, kina pu na, ti bee ke bi yaa ki gir maa ki ni kaagon kan, saan ki ŋmaa joo Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir wɔb aapepel.”
17Ubɔrkpaan ngbaan aah nan gar pu na sɔ:
“M dooni lipepel aayidaan Rehum, ni waagbaŋmeer Simsai, ni biŋeen aatɔtiib bi bi Samaria aatiŋ ni, ni Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir wɔb na.
18“Naah ŋmee kigbaŋ ki tii ni mi na, bi nabr ki, ki karn ki tii mi. 19M cha bi fiir lik, ki sil kan ke ki nyan n‑yaajayoonn na, Jerusalem nan yiil nnaan mɔmɔk aamɔb, le ki kpa bibɔbam, ni binib bi kaa si nnaan aapuwɔb na pam. 20Bibɔrb bi kpa mpɔɔn sakpen na nan joo Jerusalem ni Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir aapepel mɔmɔk, ki gaal lampoo ni ŋimombil, 21kina pu na, ni siin nkaal ke bijab ngbaan di cha kitiŋ ngbaan aamaam, ki ti saa buyoonn m ga tii nimi bumɔb na. 22Ŋa kina mala man, aan tibir tibaa taa dan m pu.”
23N‑yoonn mu ubɔrkpaan Ataksekes aagbaŋ ngbaan fuu Rehum, ni Simsai, ni biŋeen aatɔtiib na, le bi ŋa mala ki buen Jerusalem ni, ki di mpɔɔn kiir Juu yaab ke bi taa ki maa kitiŋ ngbaan.
Uwumbɔr Aadichal aamaam aah ki piin pu na
24Uwumbɔr Aadichal aamaam nan sil, kaa ki cha, ki ti saa Pesia aabɔrkpaan Darius aanaanjil aabileler ni.

english_text:
1 Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did. 2 So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
3Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple? 4Give us the names of the workers!”
5But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
6Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors sent a report to Darius, 7which said:
King Darius, we wish you the best! 8We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
9We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple. 10We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
11They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
12 We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple, 13-15 took its gold and silver articles, and put them in the temple of his own god in Babylon.
They also said that during the first year Cyrus was king of Babylonia, he gave orders for God's temple to be rebuilt in Jerusalem where it had stood before. So Cyrus appointed Sheshbazzar governor of Judah and sent these gold and silver articles for him to put in the temple. 16Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
17Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_text:
1N‑yoonn ngbaan le Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr bilee bimina, Hagai, ni Ido aajapɔɔn Sekaria nan piin ki tuk Juu yaab bi koo Jerusalem ni Juda aatim muken ponn ni na tibɔr, Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u joo bi na aayimbil pu. 2Sealtiel aajapɔɔn Serubabel, ni Jehosadak aajapɔɔn Josua aah ŋun baabɔr ngbaan na, le bi piin ki ki bi maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal, Jerusalem ponn ni, le Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr bilee ngbaan ter bi.
3Naa nan yunn, le Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir wɔb aapepel aayidaan Tatenai, ni Setar Bosenai, ni baaninkpiib biken kpaan dan Jerusalem, ki nan baa bi ke, “Ŋma tii nimi nsan ke ni maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal lee ki toor li?” 4Bi nan ki baa ki bee binib bi mɔmɔk ter lituln ngbaan ni na aayimbil. 5Tɔ, Uwumbɔr nan bi Juu yaab aayidam ngbaan chee, le Pesia aaninkpiib ngbaan aa nan ŋmaa ŋa nibaa, see bi ŋmee kigbaŋ tii ubɔrkpaan Darius, ki ŋun waah ga len pu na waahr. 6Baah nan di tibɔr ti tun ubɔrkpaan ngbaan chee na sɔ:
7“Ubɔrkpaan Darius, Uwumbɔr cha saayoonn li kpa nsuudoon.
8“Ti ban ke sin mpɔɔndaan li nyi ke ti nan buen Juda aapepel, ki ti kan ke bi kpir ŋitakpasakpiin, le ki di maa Uwumbɔr sakpiin na Aadichal, ki di ŋikpan sakpiin saŋ laagon ponn ni. Bidimaab ngbaan joo nlandiin le maa li, le ni cha mɔb mbamɔm.
9“Le ti nan baa binib ngbaan aayidam ke ŋma tii bi nsan ke bi ki gir maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan ki toor li. 10Ti nan ki baa bi ki bee baayimbil, ke aa li nyi binib bi loln nsan aan lituln ngbaan tun na.
11“Bi nan gar timi ke, ‘Ti ye Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni taab na aatutum la, le ki ki bi maa uma Uwumbɔr Aadichal li Israel yaab aabɔrkpaan ubaa nan puen maa n‑yaayoonn na. 12Tɔ, tiyaajatiib nan cha Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni taab na aaŋuul fii, le u nan cha Babiloŋ aatiŋ aabɔr Nebukadnesar, u nan ye Kaldii aanii na, nan nyaŋ bi ki chur bi tinaagbiir. Bi nan wii Uwumbɔr Aadichal, le ki di binib ngbaan buen tinaagbiir ni, Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni. 13Le Ubɔrkpaan Sairus aah nan jin nnaan Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni libiln li ponn ni na, le u tii nsan ke bi ki gir maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan. 14U nan ki giin Uwumbɔr Aadichal ponn ni aasalmaa ni tikunabr aasambil ŋi Nebukadnesar nan yoor li ponn ni na, Jerusalem ni, ki ti di siin waawaa aadir ni Babiloŋ ni na. Ubɔrkpaan Sairus nan di ŋisambil ngbaan ŋa uja u bi yin u ke Sesbasar, aan u nan ye Juda aayidaan na aaŋaal ni la. 15Ubɔrkpaan ngbaan nan bui u ke u di ni giin ti siin Uwumbɔr Aadichal ponn ni, Jerusalem aatiŋ ni, ki ki gir maa Lidichal ngbaan, laah nan si nin chee na. 16Le Sesbasar nan dan ki nan bil laadinyikl aatakpal; le laamaam nan piin ki nan saa din wee, tɔ, Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan aamaam aa kee doo.’
17“Mpɔɔndaan, cha bi lik nnaan aagbann ni, Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni, ki lik ke Sairus nan sil tii kina aasan ke bi ki gir maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal Jerusalem ni aan waa nan siin, ki cha ti ŋun saamɔboln tibɔr tee ni.”

english_text:
King Cyrus' Order Is Rediscovered
1King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia. 2Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said:
This official record will show 3that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built 27 meters high and 27 meters wide, 4with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything. 5Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places.
King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
6King Darius sent this message:
Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple. 7Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
8Starting at once, I am ordering you to help the leaders by paying their expenses from the tax money collected in Western Province. 9And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil. 10I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
11If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump. 12I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully.
The Temple Is Dedicated
13Governor Tattenai, Shethar Bozenai, and their advisors carefully obeyed King Darius. 14 With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia. 15On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
16The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple. 17One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel. 18Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written.
The Passover
19 Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month. 20The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
21The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel. 22For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_text:
Baah ban ki kan Ubɔr Sairus aah nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ki na pu na
1Kina pu le ubɔrkpaan Darius nan tii nsan ke bi ban kan kigbaŋ ngbaan, nnaan aagbann ponn ni, Babiloŋ aatiŋ pu, 2le bi nan ti kan ki Ekbatana aatiŋ ki bi Media aapepel ni na, le ki ŋmee kina:
3“Ubɔrkpaan Sairus aah nan jin nnaan na aajan aabiln ponn ni, le u nan siin nkaal, ke bi ki gir maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal li nan bi Jerusalem ponn ni na, aan bi li toor kitork nima, ki kpee kitork ki bi joo seer mmii ni na mu. Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan aapaacham aafɔfɔk li ye ŋitaa imonko inaa ni kipiik, ki li waa kina mu. 4Bi yaa di ŋitakpal maa iluul itaa kan, bi ti di likpaln paan. Nnaan ponn ni aamombil le bi ga di tun lituln ngbaan mɔmɔk. 5Ki kpee na, salmaa ni tikunabr aasambil ŋi Ubɔr Nebukadnesar nan yoor ni Uwumbɔr Aadichal ponn ni, Jerusalem ni, ki di buen Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni na, bi ki giin ŋi mɔmɔk ti siin ŋaah nan si nin chee Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan ponn ni, Jerusalem ni na.”
Darius aah bui ke bi cha lituln ngbaan li tun pu na
6Le Darius nan di tibɔr timina tun ke:
“Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir wɔb aapepel aayidaan Tatenai, ni Setar Bosenai, ni niŋeen aatɔtiib, taa ki bɔ Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan aabɔr ni man, 7ki taa ki leŋ nsan laamaam. Cha man Juda aapepel aayidaan ni Juu yaab aayidam ki gir maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal, laah nan si nin chee na. 8M sil do ki siin ke ni ter bi aan bi ki gir maa li. Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir aapepel aah kani lampoo chee nnaan ponn ni aamombil ŋi na, le ni ga li joo pa lituln ngbaan pu mala mala, aan lituln ngbaan taa ki sil. 9Iwiin mɔmɔk kan, ni li tii bitotoorb baah ban tiwan ni na, ki taa yii. Ni yaa ye inaajabi, bee ipiih, bee ipihbi kan, ni tii bi, aan bi li joo seer mmii ni tii Uwumbɔr u bi paacham na. Bi yaa ti ki ban njikaabim, bee n‑yaan, bee ŋisubil aadaan, bee olif aakpan kan, ni tii bi. 10Ni li ŋani kina, aan bi li ŋmaa toor kitork ki ga piir Uwumbɔr u bi paacham na aasui, ki mee u ke u ŋa waanyoor ŋa m ni njapɔtiib pu. 11M ki siin nkaal ke unii umɔk yii maamɔb na kan, bi nyan nlɔkdɔ waadiik ni, ki kpir mumɔb chɔk chɔk, ki di saa chaar u, ki cha waadichal kpaln litapuln. 12Uwumbɔr u lee Jerusalem ke bi li dooni u nima chee na, cha ubɔr, bee litimbol li yii nkaal mue ki pɔɔn bibaa ke bi ber uma Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan nima chee na lir. Min Darius le siin nkaal ngbaan. Unii mɔmɔk li joo mu mbamɔm.”
Baah di Uwumbɔr Aadichal tii uma Uwumbɔr pu na
13Le uyidaan Tatenai, ni Setar Bosenai, ni biŋeen aatɔtiib ŋa ubɔrkpaan ngbaan aah siin pu na. 14Juu yaab aayidam ngbaan nan maa Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan mala, le Hagai ni Sekaria bi nan ye Uwumbɔr aabɔnabr na nan pɔɔk bitaakpab. Israel yaab Aawumbɔr, ni Pesia aabɔrkpaam Sairus, ni Darius, ni Ataksekes aah nan bui bi pu na, bi nan doo Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan aamaam. 15Ubɔrkpaan Darius aayoonn aabiloloob ni aaŋmal u bi yin u ke Adar na aawiin itaa daal, le bi nan doo laamaam. 16Le Israel aanib, bitotoorb, ni Liifai yaab, ni binib bi mɔmɔk nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na, nan di Uwumbɔr Aadichal ngbaan tii uma Uwumbɔr, ni mpopiin ŋmeen. 17Baah nan ban bi di li tii Uwumbɔr na, bi nan kɔr inaaja nkub, ni ipiih ikui ilee, ni ipihbi ikui inaa, ki toor kitork, le ki di iŋoob kipiik ni ilee toor titunwanbir aachapinn aatork; uŋoob ubaa mɔk si Israel aanibol kipiik ni ŋilee na aasisii. 18Bi nan ki tii bitotoorb ni Liifai yaab Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatuln Jerusalem ni, Moses aakaal aagbaŋ aah nan mɔk pu na.
Lakr‑jer Aajim
19Libiln li paa na aajan aaŋmal aawiin kipiik ni inaa daal, le binib bi nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na nan jin Lakr‑jer Aajim. 20Bitotoorb ni Liifai yaab mɔmɔk nan toor bibaa, kaa ki kpa tijɔŋ tibaa. Liifai yaab le nan kɔr Lakr‑jer Aajim aatork aawakor tii binib bi mɔmɔk nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na, ni bitotoorb, ni bibaa. 21Israel yaab bi mɔmɔk nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na, ni binib bi nan yii binib biken bi nan koo kitiŋ ngbaan pu na aawaa aasan, ki dan ke bi nan li dooni Israel yaab Aadindaan Uwumbɔr na mɔmɔk nan ŋman tiwakor ngbaan. 22Bi nan di mpopiin jin Boroboro u kaa kpa boroboro aanyɔk na Aajim ki ti saa iwiin ilole. Uwumbɔr aah nan cha Asiria aabɔrkpaan san bi kinimbaak ki ter bi, bi maa bima Israel yaab Aawumbɔr Aadichal na pu, le bi nan kpa mpopiin pam.

english_text:
Ezra Comes to Jerusalem
1-6Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest.
Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
7Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
8-9God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month. 10Ezra had spent his entire life studying and obeying the Law of the Lord and teaching it to others.
Artaxerxes Gives a Letter to Ezra
11Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
12 Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
13-14Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
15When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem. 16Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
17Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem. 18If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God. 19Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple. 20If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
21Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you. 22They will be allowed to give as much as 3.4 tons of silver, 10 tons of wheat, 2,000 liters of wine, 2,000 liters of olive oil, and all the salt you need.
23They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me. 24We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
25Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them. 26Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away.
Ezra Praises God
27Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said:
Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem. 28God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_text:
Esra aah fuu ni Jerusalem ni pu na
1Nee aapuwɔb, Ataksekes aah nan ye Pesia aabɔrkpaan buyoonn na, le uja ubaa nan bi, bi nan yin u ke Esra. Esra aate le nan ye Seraya, le Seraya mu aate nan ye Asaria, u aate nan ye Hilkia na. 2Hilkia aate nan ye Salum la, le Salum mu aate nan ye Sadok, u aate nan ye Ahitub na. 3Ahitub aate nan ye Amaria la, le Amaria mu aate nan ye Asaria, u aate nan ye Merayof na. 4Merayof aate le nan ye Serahia, le Serahia mu aate nan ye Usi, u aate nan ye Buki na. 5Buki aate nan ye Abisua la, le Abisua mu aate nan ye Fineas, le Fineas aate nan ye Eleasar, u aate nan ye utotoorninkpel Aaronn na.
6-7Esra nan ye ugbanbae la, le ki nyi Israel yaab Aadindaan Uwumbɔr aakaal i u nan di tii Moses na mbamɔm. Esra Aadindaan Uwumbɔr aah nan bi u chee pu na, ubɔrkpaan ngbaan nan tii u tiwan ni mɔmɔk u ban na la. Ataksekes aanaan yoonn aabilolole ni, le Esra, ni Israel yaab bibaa, ni bitotoorb, ni Liifai yaab, ni Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aawangbaab ni bilahngaab, ni bikikiib, ni bitutum, nan nyan Babiloŋ ki cha Jerusalem. 8-9Njan aaŋmal aajan aawiin daal le bi nan nyan Babiloŋ ni, le Uwumbɔr nan ter bi, le bi ti fuu Jerusalem, ŋmaŋmu aajan aawiin daal. 10Esra nan di ubaa tii Uwumbɔr Aakaal aabaem la, le ki tun yaah len pu na, ki joo i, ni yaah len pu na mɔk Israel aanib.
Ubɔr Ataksekes aah nan ŋmee kigbaŋ ki tii Esra na aabɔr
11Ubɔrkpaan Ataksekes le nan di kigbaŋ kimina tii Esra, u ye utotoor ni ugbanbae, u nyi ikaal i Uwumbɔr nan di tii Israel yaab mbamɔm na ke:
12“Kigbaŋ kee nyan ni ubɔrkpaan Ataksekes chee la, le ki cha Esra u ye utotoor, ni ugbanbae, u nyi Uwumbɔr u bi Paacham na Aakaal na chee.
13“Min le siin ke maanaan mɔmɔk ni aanib bi ye Israel yaab na, ni bitotoorb, ni Liifai yaab, ki ban ke bi gir dii si buen Jerusalem na kpa kina aasan. 14Min, ni maasusurb bilole na, le tun si ke ni ti lik ke Jerusalem, ni Juda aatim yaab joo Saawumbɔr Aakaal mu u di ŋa aaŋaal ni na aan baa joo mu. 15Aa ga li joo salmaa ni tikunabr aapiin i m ni maasusurb ban ke ti di tii Israel yaab Aawumbɔr, u Waadichal bi Jerusalem ni na. 16Aa ga ki li joo salmaa, ni tikunabr ti aa ga gaa Babiloŋ aapepel mɔmɔk ni aapiin i Israel aanib ni bitotoorb ga tii Baawumbɔr, u Waadichal bi Jerusalem ni na.
17“Aa taa ji ŋimombil ngbaan yɔl yɔl, aa di ŋi daa inaaja, ni ipihja, ni ipihbi, ni njikaabim, ni ŋisubil aadaan, ki di ni toor kitork, Uwumbɔr Aadichal aatork aabimbiln pu, Jerusalem ni. 18Aa ga ŋmaa di salmaa ni tikunabr ti gur na ŋa nimi Aawumbɔr aah ban ke ni di tun pu na. 19Aa ti di ŋisambil ŋi bi di tii si ke bi li joo tun Uwumbɔr Aadichal ponn ni aatuln na, ŋa Uwumbɔr aaŋaal ni Jerusalem ni. 20Aa yaa ki ban tiwan nimɔk bi di tun Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatuln na kan, aa ga ŋmaa di nnaan ni aamombil daa ni.
21“M siin Yufrates aamɔɔl aawilir aapepel aaninkpiib bi tun nnaan aamombil aatuln na, ke bi tii Esra, u ye ugbanbae ki nyi Uwumbɔr u bi Paacham na Aakaal mbamɔm na, tiwan ni mɔmɔk u ban na, 22ki ti saa tikunabr ti aanyunyuun ga pii ndibim kuruwaa ŋichur ŋitaa ni ikui inaa na, ni njikaabim kuruwaa ŋichur kipiik na, ni ŋisubil aadaan kpalba tiib ŋichur ŋilee na, ni olif aakpan kpalba tiib ŋichur ŋilee na, ni n‑yaan waah ban pu na. 23Aa tii tiwan ni mɔmɔk Uwumbɔr u bi Paacham na ban Waadichal ni na, ki taa cha waaŋuul fii m pu, bee bi ga nan paan m pu na. 24Aa taa gaa bitotoorb, ni Liifai yaab, ni biwangbaab ni bilahngaab, ni bikikiib, ni bitutum, ni unii umɔk tun Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatuln na ubaa lampoo.
25“Le sin Esra, di nlan mu Uwumbɔr tii si na ban binib bi ga li lik ŋitun aabɔŋ na, ni bibɔjirb bi ga li joo Yufrates Aamɔɔl Aawilir aapepel aanib bi mɔmɔk bi Saawumbɔr aakaal ponn ni na. Aa mɔk unii umɔk aa nyi Nkaal ngbaan na. 26Unii umɔk yii Saawumbɔr aakaal, bee nnaan mue aakaal na kan, bi daa utafal libuul ngbaan ni. Bi ku u, bee bi jenn nyan u kitiŋ ngbaan ni, bee bi gaa waawangol, bee bi di u ŋa kiyondiik ni.”
Esra aah pak Uwumbɔr pu na
27Le Esra bui ke, “Pak Uwumbɔr, u ye tiyaajatiib Aadindaan na man. U cha ubɔrkpaan kpa mpopiin ke u nyuŋ uma Uwumbɔr Aadichal li bi Jerusalem ni na kina. 28Uwumbɔr aageehn pu le ubɔrkpaan ngbaan, ni waasusurb, ni waaninkpiib bi kpa mpɔɔn sakpen na lik faar mi. Ndindaan Uwumbɔr pɔɔk ntaakpab, le m ŋman ki cha Israel yaab aataŋaal pam aayidam nyan Babiloŋ ki dii mi gir Jerusalem ni.”

Binib bi nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na
1Itaŋaal imina aayidam le nan bi tinaagbiir ni Babiloŋ aatiŋ ni, le ki nan dii min Esra ki gir Jerusalem ni, buyoonn ubɔrkpaan Ataksekes nan ye Pesia aabɔr na:
2-14Fineas aataŋaal ni, Gesom.
Itamar aataŋaal ni, Daniel.
David aataŋaal ni, Sekania aajapɔɔn Hatus.
Paros aataŋaal ni, Sekaria ni bijab nkub ni piiŋmu. Tɔ, biyaajatiib aayimbil aagbaŋ nan bi.
Pahaf Moab aataŋaal ni, Serahia aajapɔɔn Eliehoenai, u nan joo bijab ikui ilee la.
Satu aataŋaal ni, Jahasiel aajapɔɔn Sekania, ni bijab ikui itaa.
Adinn aataŋaal ni, Jonatann aajapɔɔn Ebed, ni bijab piiŋmu.
Elam aataŋaal ni, Atalia aajapɔɔn Jesaya, ni bijab imonko itaa ni kipiik.
Sefatia aataŋaal ni, Maikel aajapɔɔn Sebadia, ni bijab imonko inaa.
Joab aataŋaal ni, Jehiel aajapɔɔn Obadia, ni bijab ikui ilee ni kipiik ni biniin.
Bani aataŋaal ni, Josifia aajapɔɔn Selomif, ni bijab nkub ni imonko itaa.
Bebai aataŋaal ni, Bebai aajapɔɔn Sekaria ni bijab moninko ni biniin.
Asgad aataŋaal ni, Hakatann aajapɔɔn Johanann, ni bijab nkub ni kipiik.
Adonikam aataŋaal ni, Elifelet, ni Jewel, ni Semaya, ni bijab imonko itaa. Bimina nan paani puwɔb la.
Bigfai aataŋaal ni, Utai, ni Sakur, ni bijab imonko itaa ni kipiik.
Liifai yaab bi ga tun Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatuln na
15M nan kuun binib ngbaan mɔmɔk nnyunsan mu aanyun puu cha Ahafa aatiŋ ni na chee, le ti nan doon nima chee iwiin itaa. M nan kan ke bitotoorb bi binib ngbaan ni, le Liifai yaab ma aa bi. 16Le m nan tun yin ni biyidam ngbaan biwae: Elieser, ni Ariel, ni Semaya, ni Elnatann, ni Jarib, ni Elnatann, ni Natann, ni Sekaria, ni Mesulam, ni bimɔmɔkb bilee, Joyarib ni Elnatann. 17M nan tun bi Ido, u ye binib ngbaan aayidaan na chee, Kasifia aatiŋ ni, ke bi ti bui u ke u ni uŋeen aatɔtiib bi tun Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatuln na tii ni timi binib aan bi nan li tun Uwumbɔr aatuln Waadichal ni. 18Uwumbɔr aageehn pu le bi nan di Liifai aanii u nyi lituln ki nyan ni Mali aataŋaal ni aan bi yin u ke Serebia na tun ni, le ujapɔtiib ni ukpetiib ni unaatiib, binib kipiik ni biniin dii ni u. 19Bi nan ki cha Merari aataŋaal ni yaab, Hasabia ni Jesaya, ni baamaal binib moninko mu dan. 20Bi nan ki cha Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aatutum ikui ilee ni moninko, bi aayaajatiib Ubɔr David ni waaninkpiib nan tii bi kina aatuln ke bi li ter Liifai yaab na, mu dan. Bi nan ŋmee bi mɔmɔk aayimbil bil.
Esra ni binib ngbaan aah lul bumɔb ki mee limeel pu na
21Ahafa Aanyunsan ngbaan chee le m nan siin ke ti mɔmɔk lul bumɔb ki sunn tibaa taab, timi Aawumbɔr chee, ki mee u aan u cheen timi lisachuln ngbaan ni, ki li kii timi, ni timi aabim, ni timi aawan mɔmɔk. 22M yaa ba nan ti bui ubɔrkpaan ngbaan ke u tii timi bijab bi ga li kii timi bidim chee timi aasachuln ngbaan ni na kan, m ba ga nan jinn mbaa inimɔɔn, ba pu? m nan puen bui u ke timi Aawumbɔr ŋani waanyoor ŋani unii umɔk tii u naadii na pu, le ki nan ki kpaan dar unii umɔk yii waamɔb ki fenn upuwɔb tii u na aatafal. 23Ti nan lul bumɔb ki mee Uwumbɔr ke u li kii timi, le u kii timi aameel ngbaan.
Uwumbɔr Aadichal aapiin
24M nan nyan bitotoorb bi ye bisalolm na ponn ni Serebia, ni Hasabia, ni kipiik biken, 25le ki nan ŋaŋ tikunabr, ni salmaa, ni ŋisambil ŋi ubɔrkpaan ngbaan ni waasusurb, ni waaninkpiib, ni Israel aanib nan tii ke bi ti li joo tun Uwumbɔr Aadichal ponn ni aatuln na, le ki di tii bitotoorb ngbaan. 26-27Maah nan tii bi pu na sɔ:
tikunabr ti aanyunyuun ga pii njikaabim bɔtɔ tiib ikui iŋmu na,
ni tikunabr aasambil nkub, ŋi aanyunyuun ga pii njikaabim kuruwaa ŋichur ŋitaa ni ikui inaa na,
ni salmaa ti aanyunyuun ga pii njikaabim bɔtɔ imonko itaa ni kipiik ni biŋmu,
ni salmaa aasambil moninko, ŋi aanyunyuun ga pii njikaabim kuruwaa biniin ni siib na,
ni tikumann aasambil ŋilee, ŋi aadaak ni salmaa aasambil na ye tiwanbaan na.
28M nan bui bi ke, “Uwumbɔr u ye niyaajatiib Aawumbɔr na le nyan nimi, kina le ye tikunabr ni salmaa aasambil ŋi bi joo tii u ipiin na mu. 29Ni li kii ŋi mbamɔm aan ŋi ti fuu Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni. Ni ti ŋaŋ ni mɔmɔk bitotoorb aadir ni, nima chee, ki di tii bitotoorb aayidam ni Liifai yaab, ni Israel yaab aayidam Jerusalem ni.” 30Le bitotoorb ni Liifai yaab nan kii tikunabr, ni salmaa, ni ŋisambil ngbaan, ke ni ti fuu Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni, Jerusalem ponn ni.
Binib ngbaan aah nan gir Jerusalem pu na
31Ti nan nyan Ahafa Aanyunsan ngbaan chee njan aaŋmal aawiin kipiik ni ilee daal, le ki cha Jerusalem. Timi Aawumbɔr nan bi ti chee, le ki kii timi bidim, ni binib bi ga keln timi nsan ni na chee. 32Taah nan ti fuu Jerusalem na, le ti nan di iwiin itaa fuur. 33Le ti nan buen Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni winaa daal, le ki ti ŋaŋ tikunabr, ni salmaa, ni ŋisambil ngbaan, le ki di ŋi tii Uria aajapɔɔn Meremof u nan ye utotoor na. Binib bi nan kpee u pu na le nan ye Fineas aajapɔɔn Eleasar, ni Liifai yaab bilee, bima le nan ye Jesua aajapɔɔn Josabad, ni Binui aajapɔɔn Noadia. 34Ti nan ŋaŋ tiwan ngbaan mɔmɔk le ki kahn ni, le ki ŋmee ni mɔmɔk ŋa kigbaŋ ni, libuul ngbaan ni.
35N‑yoonn ngbaan le binib bi mɔmɔk nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na nan joo ni ipiin ke bi nan toor kitork ki di see mmii ni tii bima Israel yaab Aawumbɔr. Bi nan tii inaaja kipiik ni ilee Israel yaab mɔmɔk pu, ni ipihja imonko inaa ni kipiik ni iloob, ni ipihbi imonko itaa ni kipiik ni ilole; bi nan ki tii iŋoob kipiik ni ilee ke bi di toor bibaa aatunwanbir pu aatork. Bi nan di tiwakor tee mɔmɔk toor kitork ki di see mmii ni tii Uwumbɔr. 36Bi nan ki nyan ubɔrkpaan ngbaan aah nan tii bi kigbaŋ ki na ki di tii Yufrates Aamɔɔl aawilir aapepel aayidaan ni waaninkpiib, le bi nan tii bi nterm, ni Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni aadoon aaterm.

english_text:
Ezra Condemns Mixed Marriages
1Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said:
Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
2Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
3This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock 4until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners.
Ezra's Prayer
5At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms, 6and prayed:
I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens. 7Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
8But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery. 9We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
10Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands 11that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things. 12 And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters.
Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
13You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home. 14Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all! 15Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_text:
Esra aah mee Uwumbɔr pu na
1Nimina mɔmɔk aah ŋa doo na, le Israel yaab aayidam bibaa dan nan bui mi ke binib ngbaan, ni bitotoorb, ni Liifai yaab aa yakr binib bi koo gbɔk bi ki ye Amonn yaab, ni Moab yaab, ni Ijipt yaab, ni Kanaann yaab, ni Hef yaab, ni Peres yaab, ni Jebus yaab, ni Amor yaab na chee. Bi tun inimɔɔn, ni tijɔŋ aatun ŋi binib ngbaan tun na la. 2Bi yoor biwɔwɔmpiib la, le bima Uwumbɔr aanib bi bi chain na kpaln tijɔŋ aanib. Biyidam ni bininkpiib na le nan ye biyikpaadam. 3Maah ŋun kina na, le m daa kar maawanpeenkaan, ni n‑yikpir, ni nlangban, mpombiin pu. 4M nan ka nima, kinimbaak ni, le kijook aatork nan fuu, le binib kuun ni m chee, binib bi ijawaan nan chuu bi, bima Israel yaab Aawumbɔr aah nan len pu, binib bi nan nyan ni tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na aatunwanbir pu na.
5Kijook aatork aayoonn aah nan fuu ni na, le m fii maah ka nin chee ki wii na, ki beenin pee maawankpir na, le ki gbaan, ki yoor ŋŋaal paacham, ki mee Ndindaan Uwumbɔr. 6M nan bui ke, “Uwumbɔr, inimɔɔn sakpiin pu, le maa ŋmaa yaar n‑yil paacham aanimbiin ni. Timi aatunwanbir muun ti nyaŋ, ki fɔk jer timi, ti fɔk ti pii kitaapaak. 7Ki nyan tiyaaja tiib yoonn ki nan saa din, timi saanib tun titunwanbir sakpen. Timi aatunwanbir pu le timi, ni timi aabɔrb, ni timi aatotoorb koo ntiyayam aabɔrb aaŋaal ni, le bi ku timi, ki sun timi aawangol, ki di timi buen tinaagbiir ni. Ti kpaln binimɔɔnib le ki nan saa din wee. 8Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, le aa san timi kinimbaak, ki cha ti ponn ni siib nyan tinaagbiir ngbaan ponn ni, ki ti koo nsuudoon ni, kitiŋ ki bi chain na ponn ni. Aa nyan timi tinaagbiir ngbaan ni, le ki tii timi limɔfapɔln. 9Ti nan ye binaagbiib la, le aa nyan timi tinaagbiir ngbaan ni. Aa cha Pesia aatiŋ aabɔrb san timi kinimbaak, ki tii timi nsan ke ti li bi limɔfal ni, ki ki gir maa Saadichal li nan ber na, ki cha ti kan nsuudoon, Jerusalem ni Juda aatim muken ni.
10“Uwumbɔr, ti ga ki len ke ba, tiwan ni mɔmɔk ŋa na pu? Ti ti ki gir yii ikaal ngbaan, 11ikaal i aa nan di tii saabɔnabr bi ye saatutum na, ke bi di tii timi na. Aa nan bui timi ke kitiŋ ki ti ban ti koo ki ponn ni na aa ŋan, ba pu? binib bi bi ki pu na di inimɔɔn ni tijɔŋ aatuln le gbiin kaapepel mɔmɔk. 12Bi nan bui timi ke ti yaa ban ke ti li kpa mpopiin kitiŋ ngbaan pu, aan ki nan kpaln tiyaabitiib aatiŋ kan, ti taa yoor baapiibim, ki taa ter bi aan bi kan tinyoor baatun ni. 13Timi Aawumbɔr, saah ŋa timi tiwan mɔmɔk ki daa titafal pu na, ti nyi ke saa daa titafal ki ŋeer timi aatunwanbir, le ki cha ti ponn ni siib ŋmar. 14Kina kan, ti ga ŋa kinye ki suln saakaal bɔr, ki ki gir yoor bibiindam ngbaan aapiibim? Ti yaa ŋa kina kan, saaŋuul ga fii ti pu sakpen, le aa ga kuln ti mɔmɔk aan ubaa taa ŋmar. 15Uwumbɔr, Israel yaab Aadindaan, aa ye ubamɔndaan la, le ki tee cha ti ŋmar. Ti kpiir timi aataani tuk si; taa kpa nsan ke ti dan nan sil aanimbiin ni.”

english_text:
The Plan for Ending Mixed Marriages
1While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
2Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said:
Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel, 3if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
4Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
5Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah. 6Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
7-8The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
9Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
10Ezra the priest stood up and said:
You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty! 11Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
12Everyone in the crowd shouted:
You're right! We will do what you say. 13But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
14Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
15Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
16Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month, 17and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year.
The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
18-19Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering:
Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers; 20Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer; 21Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim; 22Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
23Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also known as Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
24Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife.
These temple guards had foreign wives:
Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
25Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives:
Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
26Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
27Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
28Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
29Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
30Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
31-32Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah from the family of Harim;
33Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
34-37Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu from the family of Bani;
38-42Shimei, Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah, Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah, Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph from the family of Binnui;
43Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
44These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_text:
Israel yaab aah kpiir baatunwanbir pu na
1Esra aah nan gbaa kitiŋ ki mee limeel, Uwumbɔr Aadichal aabisamɔb chee, ki wii ki kpiir titunwanbir timina na, le Israel yaab aanipaak, bijab, ni bipiib, ni mbim dan nan mann goln u, ki wii pam. 2Le Elam aataŋaal ni aanii u bi yin u ke Jehiel na aajapɔɔn Sekania, bui Esra ke, “Ti nyan Uwumbɔr aapuwɔb, ki yoor biwɔwɔm aapiib, tɔ, nimina mɔmɔk mu na, Israel yaab beenin kpa limakl. 3Taah ban pu dandana wee na le ye ke ti ga puu tipuukpaan tii timi Aawumbɔr, ke ti ga di bipiib ngbaan ni baabim lii. Ti ga ŋa aa ni binib bi nyuŋni Uwumbɔr aakaal na aah sur timi ke ti ŋa pu na. Ti ga ŋa Uwumbɔr aakaal aah len pu na. 4Ni ye sin aatuln le ke aa fii sil. Ti si aachaŋ ni, kina pu na, fii sil ki cha kina ŋa.”
5Le Esra nan piin ki cha bitotoorb aayidam, ni Liifai yaab aayidam, ni binib bi gur na puu tipuur ke bi ga ŋa Sekania aah len pu na. 6Nee aapuwɔb le u siir Uwumbɔr Aadichal aabisamɔb chee, ki koo Eliasib aajapɔɔn Jehohanann aadiik ni, ki ti dɔ nima ki wii, binib bi nyan tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na aah tun titunwanbir ti na pu. Waa nan jin, kaa nyun mu.
7Le binib ngbaan aayidam nan cha ntuun buen Jerusalem ni Juda aatim mɔmɔk ni, ke binib bi mɔmɔk nyan tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na kuun ni, Jerusalem ni. 8Bi nan bui ke joo cha ni iwiin itaa daal na, unii umɔk yii kaa dan na, bi ga gaa waawangol mɔmɔk, le waan ki li kpa nsan ke u ye binib ngbaan ponn ni ubaa. 9Joo cha ni iwiin itaa daal ngbaan, ŋmawae aawiin moninko daal na, bijab bi mɔmɔk koo Juda ni Benjaminn aapepel ni na nan kuun ni Jerusalem ni, Uwumbɔr Aadichal aapaan ni. Utaal nan bi nu sakpen, ki kpee nkuun ngbaan aanyunyuun pu na, unii mɔk nan si jii la.
10Utotoor Esra le nan fii sil ki len bi chee tibɔr. U nan bui bi ke, “Naah yoor biwɔwɔmpiib pu na, le ni nyan Uwumbɔr aapuwɔb, ki joo ni tibɔbir Israel aanib mɔmɔk pu. 11Dandana wee na, kpiir nimi aatunwanbir tuk Uwumbɔr u ye niyaajatiib mu Aawumbɔr na, ki ŋa tiwan ni ga piir usui na. Taa ki kpaan biwɔwɔm bi bi timi aatiŋ pu na chee man, ki di naah joo nwɔwɔmbim mu na lii.”
12Le binib ngbaan teen mpɔɔn pu ke, “Ti ga ŋa saah len pu na la,” 13le ki tee ki len ke, “Kinipaak ngbaan wiir sakpen a, le utaal mu ki nu sakpen. Taan ŋmaa li si lipaal do kina. Timi bi bi titunwanbir timina ponn ni na wiir sakpen, tibɔr ngbaan mu aa ye liwinbaal aabɔr. 14Cha timi aaninkpiib gaar Jerusalem ni do, ki lik tibɔr ngbaan ponn ni, le ki nin cha unii umɔk joo uwɔwɔnbo na, ni waayidam, ni waatiŋ ni aabɔjirb dan nwiin mundaal aa ga siin udaan na. Kina le ga cha Uwumbɔr nyan waaŋuul ti pu, tibɔr tee pu.” 15Binib bimina baanja le aa nan kii kina: bima le ye Asahel aajapɔɔn Jonatann, ni Tikfa aajapɔɔn Jaseya, le Mesulam, ni Liifai aanii Sabetai mu sil bipuwɔb.
16Binib bi nan nyan tinaagbiir ni ki gir ni na biken mɔmɔk nan kii utotoor Esra aah ban pu na, le u nan nyan biyidam, itaŋaal ngbaan ni, le ki ŋmee baayimbil ŋa kigbaŋ ni. Ŋmapiik aajan aawiin daal, le bi nan piin baatuln ki bi fiir lik, 17le ki joo cha ni iŋmal itaa ni na, bi fiir binib bi mɔmɔk joo nwɔwɔmbim na aabɔr doo.
Bijab bi nan joo nwɔwɔmbim na
18Bijab bi nan joo nwɔwɔmbim na aayimbil sɔ:
Bitotoorb, itaŋaal, itaŋaal:
Josua ni ukpetiib ni unaatiib bi aate ye Jehosadak na aataŋaal ni: Maaseya, ni Elieser, ni Jarib, ni Gedalia. 19Bi nan puu ke bi ga di bipuutiib lii, le ki di upihja toor baatunwanbir aachapinn aatork.

38-42Binui aataŋaal ni: Simei, ni Selemia, ni Natann, ni Adaya, ni Maknadebai, ni Sasai, ni Sarai, ni Asarel, ni Selemia, ni Semaria, ni Salum, ni Amaria, ni Josef.
