Limeel li ban nterm na
1Ndindaan Uwumbɔr u gaal mi lir na, m wii le nwiin ti lir,
le kinyeek kan, m bi aanimbiin ni.
2Ŋun maameel; li pel maah wii ki ban nterm pu na.
3Tibɔr pam le kan mi, le maa ki daa nkun chee.
4M gur bi ke unii mɔk aah ti ban u kpo kan
u bi pu na la, maa ki kpa mpɔɔn mubaa.
5Bi di mi ki di mee bitekpiib chee la;
m gur bi ke baah ku binib bi na aah dɔ baakaakul
ponn ni pu na la,
ki naahn binib bi aa suln bibɔr kookoo na la,
ki bi ke binib bi kaan ki kan saaterm na.
6Aa di mi mee lii likaakul taab la,
aa di mi mee lii mbuu mu nyoo
ki bɔɔn sakpen na ponn ni la.
7Saaŋuul dɔ nyik m pu la,
le laanyunyuun nyii mi bil taab.
8Aa cha njɔtiib san cha mi;
aa cha m gur nu bi chee la.
M gur ye kaasisik ni aajangeln la
kaan ŋmaa minn buen nibaa chee;
9falaa pu, nnimbil aa ki waa mbamɔm.
Uwumbɔr, idaa mɔmɔk, m yin si la
le ki yoor ŋŋaal paacham ki mee si.
10Saa tun iwaan aatun tii bitekpiib.
Baa fii sil ki pak si.
11Baa len saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu likaakul ni.
Baa len saah tun saapuur aatun ŋi na aabɔr kitekpiitiŋ ni.
12Baa kani saatukpaan na mbɔmbɔɔn aah bi nin chee na,
kaa kani saaŋann kitiŋ ki bi suln kaanib bɔr na ni.
13Uwumbɔr, m yin si ki ban nterm la;
m mee si kichakpiik mɔmɔk ni.
14Uwumbɔr, ba ŋa aa yii mi?
Ba ŋa aa fenn aapuwɔb tii mi?
15Maah fii ubo pu na, m ji falaa le ki duun nkun;
saah dar ntafal pu na, le maa ti ki kpa mpɔɔn mubaa.
16Saaŋuusakpeln le nyiir mi bilni;
maah san si ijawaan pu na le bii mi doo.
17Kitaak yaa woln kan,
i mann goln mi ke nwam na le nwiin ti lir;
i gob mi ŋipepel mɔmɔk pu la.
18Aa cha njɔnyaan mu ti san cha mi,
le mbɔmbɔɔn baanja gur ye njɔ.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Ethan the Ezrahite.)
The Lord's Agreement with David
1 Our Lord, I will sing
of your love forever.
Everyone yet to be born
will hear me praise
your faithfulness.
2I will tell them, “God's love
can always be trusted,
and his faithfulness lasts
as long as the heavens.”
3You said, “David, my servant,
is my chosen one,
and this is the agreement
I made with him:
4 David, one of your descendants
will always be king.”
5Our Lord, let the heavens
now praise your miracles,
and let all your angels
praise your faithfulness.
6None who live in the heavens
can compare with you.
7You are the most fearsome
of all who live in heaven;
all the others fear
and greatly honor you.
8You are Lord God All-Powerful!
No one is as loving
and faithful as you are.
9You rule the roaring sea
and calm its waves.
10You crushed the monster Rahab,
and with your powerful arm
you scattered your enemies.
11The heavens and the earth
belong to you.
And so does the world
with all its people
because you created them
12and everything else.
Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon
gladly praise you.
13You are strong and mighty!
14Your kingdom is ruled
by justice and fairness
with love and faithfulness
leading the way.
15Our Lord, you bless those
who join in the festival
and walk in the brightness
of your presence.
16We are happy all day
because of you,
and your saving power
brings honor to us.
17Your own glorious power
makes us strong,
and because of your kindness,
our strength increases.
18Our Lord and our King,
the Holy One of Israel,
you are truly our shield.
19In a vision, you once said
to your faithful followers:
“I have helped a mighty hero.
I chose him from my people
and made him famous.
20 David, my servant, is the one
I chose to be king,
21and I will always be there
to help and strengthen him.
22“No enemy will outsmart David,
and he won't be defeated
by any hateful people.
23I will strike down and crush
his troublesome enemies.
24He will always be able
to depend on my love,
and I will make him strong
with my own power.
25I will let him rule the lands
across the rivers and seas.
26He will say to me,
‘You are my Father
and my God,
as well as the mighty rock
where I am safe.’
27 “I have chosen David
as my first-born son,
and he will be the ruler
of all kings on earth.
28My love for him will last,
and my agreement with him
will never be broken.
29“One of David's descendants
will always be king,
and his family will rule
until the sky disappears.
30Suppose some of his children
should reject my Law
and refuse my instructions.
31Or suppose they should disobey
all of my teachings.
32Then I will correct
and punish them
because of their sins.
33But I will always love David
and faithfully keep all
of my promises to him.
34“I won't break my agreement
or go back on my word.
35I have sworn once and for all
by my own holy name,
and I won't lie to David.
36His family will always rule.
I will let his kingdom last
as long as the sun 37and moon
appear in the sky.”
38You are now angry, Lord,
and you have turned your back
on your chosen king.
39You broke off your agreement
with your servant, the king,
and you completely destroyed
his kingdom.
40The walls of his city
have been broken through,
and every fortress
now lies in ruins.
41All who pass by
take what they want,
and nations everywhere
joke about the king.
42You made his enemies powerful
and let them celebrate.
43But you forced him to retreat
because you did not fight
on his side.
44You took his crown
and threw his throne
in the dirt.
45You made an old man of him
and put him to shame.
46How much longer, Lord?
Will you hide forever?
How long will your anger
keep burning like fire?
47Remember, life is short!
Why did you empty our lives
of all meaning?
48No one can escape the power
of death and the grave.
49Our Lord, where is the love
you have always shown
and that you promised
so faithfully to David?
50Remember your servant, Lord!
People make jokes about me,
and I suffer many insults.
51I am your chosen one,
but your enemies chase
and make fun of me.
52Our Lord, we praise you
forever. Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Litimbol aabɔbir aayoonn aalahn
1Uwumbɔr, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk m ga li gaa ilahn
saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu;
m ga li mooni ke aa ŋani saah len pu na
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
2M nyi ke saageehm ga li bi n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na,
ki nyi ke aa tun saah puu tipuur ti na, kaa kpelni daalbaadaal
ke kitaapaak aah kaa kpelni pu na.
3Aa len ke, “M puu tipuur tii uja u m lee u na,
uma le ye maatutunn David; m puu tii u ke,
4‘Aayaabil ga li ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk;
m ga cha bi li ye binaanjirb ki ti saa
n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.’”
5Paacham aawan gaa ilahn saatukpaan na pu la;
Uwumbɔr, bi gaa ilahn saah ŋani saah len pu na pu.
6Uwumbɔr, ubaa aa bi paacham ki bi ke sin na;
paacham yaab ubaa aaŋeen aatɔ aa ye si.
7Saatuuntiib aakuun ni kan,
bi mɔmɔk pak si la; le bi mɔmɔk san si ijawaan.
8Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan,
ubaa aa bi ki kpa mpɔɔn ke sin na;
Uwumbɔr, aa ŋani saah puu pu na mɔmɔk la.
9Sin le joo nnyusakpem mu pɔɔ sakpen na;
aa cha mu aanyunkpenn doon suuna.
10Aa wɔb kipeewanbiik Rahab, ki ku ki;
aa di saapɔɔn sakpiin le nyaŋ saadim.
11Paacham ni kitiŋ mɔmɔk ye sin yaan la,
sin le naan dulnyaa ni tiwan ni mɔmɔk bi u ni na.
12Sin le naan ŋŋangan ni ŋŋangii;
Tabor Aajool ni Hemonn Aajool gaa mpopiin aalahn aa pu.
13Saapɔɔn nyaŋ a. Aa kpa mpɔɔn sakpen a.
14Saanaan si mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn pu la;
saatuln mɔmɔk ni kan,
saageehm ni saah bi chob pu na nyani mpaan pu la.
15Binib bi joo ilahn dooni si,
aan ki bi saaŋann aawiin ni na kpa mpopiin.
16Sin pu le bi mɔɔni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk, le ki pak si, saaŋann pu.
17Aa tii timi ŋinyaŋ sakpiin, saageehm cha ti nyaŋ.
18Uwumbɔr, sin le nyan timi aakikiir,
sin Israel yaab Aawumbɔr u bi chain na le tii timi, timi aabɔr.
Uwumbɔr aah puu tipuur ti tii David na
19N‑yoonn mu jer na le aa nan kpiir tuk
saatutum bi dii si mbamɔm na ke,
“M tii butɔb aajakpaan ubaa nterm;
m di libɔrjal tii unii u m lee u binib ngbaan ponn ni na.
20M di maakpan mu bi chain na kpir maatutunn David aayil pu,
ki ŋa u ubɔr.
21Maapɔɔn ga li bi u chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
maapɔɔn le ga tii u mpɔɔn.
22Waadim aan ŋmaa nyaŋ u daalbaadaal;
bibiindam aan ŋmaa nyaŋ u.
23M ga ku waadim, ki ku binib bi mɔmɔk nan u na.
24M ga li gee u, ki li si upuwɔb; m ga cha u li kani linyaŋ.
25M ga taln waanaan ki nya Kaasisik ni Aanyusakpem mɔk
ki ti saa Yufrates Aamɔɔl mɔk.
26U ga bui mi ke, ‘Sin le ye nte, ni Maawumbɔr;
sin le ye maakikiir, sin le ye u gaal mi lir na.’
27M ga ŋa u njapɔpol,
uma le ga li ye ubɔrkpaan u jer bibɔrb mɔmɔk na.
28M ga li joo maah puu tipuur ti na tii u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
le min ni uma aamɔbaan ga li bi
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
29Uyaabitiib aan doo ke kitaapaak aah kaa door pu na;
uyaabil ga li ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
30Tɔ, uyaabitiib yaa yii, kaa dii maakaal,
kaa bi ke maah mɔk bi pu na,
31ki yaa kaa lik faar maamɔkm, kaa joo maakaal kan,
32m ga daa bitafal, baatunwanbir pu;
m ga cha bi ji falaa, baataani pu.
33Tɔ, m ga li beenin gee David ma,
ki ga li beenin joo maah puur tipuur ti na tii u.
34Maan bii maah puu tipuur tii u na, kaan bar tipuur ngbaan pu kibaa.
35M puu maayimbil li bi chain na pu ke maan gii inyamɔn tuk David.
36U ga li kpa yaabitiib n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
le m ga li lik waanaan pu ki ti saa dulnyaa aadoon.
37Waanaan ga li si chob ke uŋmal u ye
kitaapaak aaseeraadaan bamɔnn na aah si chob pu na.”
Ubɔr aalirm aawiil
38Le saaŋuul fii saah lee ubɔr u na pu; aa siir cha u ki yii u.
39Aa bii tipuur ti aa nan puu tii saatutunn ngbaan na,
ki di waabɔryikpupuk mee lii tikpakpar ni.
40Aa tur waatiŋ aagon lii kitiŋ,
le ki cha waajawan aadir kpaln ŋilangben.
41Unii umɔk jer na su waawangol la;
binib bi koo gbɔk u na laa u la.
42Aa di linyaŋ tii waadim; ki tii bi mpopiin.
43Aa cha waajawan aa ki kpa tinyoor, ki cha bi nyaŋ u butɔb ni.
44Aa chuu gaa u chee nnaan aajaangbeek ki di waabɔrjal mee lii kitiŋ,
45Aa cha u por kaa kee fuu waayoonn, ki cha u kpaln unimɔɔnii.
Ŋŋmarm aameel
46Uwumbɔr, aa ga di aabaa bɔr kookoo la aa?
Saaŋuul ga li wu ke mmii na ki ti saa bayoonn?
47Teer ke maamɔfal aa fɔk;
teer ke aa naan ti mɔmɔk aan ti ye tiwan ni ga kpo na la.
48Ŋma ga li bi kaan kpo?
Unibɔn aan ŋmaa mɔk ke waan kpo.
49Ndindaan, saajan aageehm na bi la chee?
Saah nan puu tipuur ti tii Ubɔr David na bi la chee?
50Taa suln baah seei mi saatutunn pu na bɔr,
taa suln binib bi kaa nyi si na aamɔpuur aah lir m pu pu na.
51Uwumbɔr, saadim seei saah lee ubɔr u na.
Bi seei u waah cha nin chee mɔmɔk na la.
52Pak Uwumbɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk man.
Amii, amii.
NAANAA AAGBAŊ
(Ilahn 90–106)

english_text:
BOOK IV
(Psalms 90–106)
(A prayer by Moses, the man of God.)
God Is Eternal
1Our Lord, in all generations
you have been our home.
2You have always been God—
long before the birth
of the mountains,
even before you created
the earth and the world.
3At your command we die
and turn back to dust,
4 but a thousand years
mean nothing to you!
They are merely a day gone by
or a few hours in the night.
5You bring our lives to an end
just like a dream.
We are merely tender grass
6that sprouts and grows
in the morning,
but dries up by evening.
7Your furious anger frightens
and destroys us,
8and you know all our sins,
even those we do in secret.
9Your anger is a burden
each day we live,
then life ends like a sigh.
10 We can expect seventy years,
or maybe eighty,
if we are healthy,
but even our best years
bring trouble and sorrow.
Suddenly our time is up,
and we disappear.
11No one knows the full power
of your furious anger,
but it is as great as the fear
that we owe to you.
12Teach us to use wisely
all the time we have.
13Help us, Lord! Don't wait!
Pity your servants.
14When morning comes,
let your love satisfy
all our needs.
Then we can celebrate
and be glad for what time
we have left.
15Make us happy for as long
as you caused us trouble
and sorrow.
16Do wonderful things for us,
your servants,
and show your mighty power
to our children.
17Our Lord and our God,
treat us with kindness
and let all go well for us.
Please let all go well!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr ni unibɔn
1Uwumbɔr, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan,
sin le ye timi aakookoo yaan.
2Waahr aan aa nin naan ŋigongon ni dulnyaa na,
aa nan ye Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ndoon na,
ki ga li beenin ye Uwumbɔr ki ti saa
n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
3Aa tuk unibɔn ke u ki gir ŋa waah nan ye tiwan ni na;
aa cha u ki gir kpaln titan.
4Ŋibin lichur naahn liwinbaal le aa chee;
ŋi bi ke fen u jer na la,
ki naahn kikurk kibaa aah ga yunn kinyeek pu na.
5Aa joo timi cha ke nwam na la;
timi aamɔfal aa fɔk ke tidaŋ na la.
Ti naahn timoor ti ga punn kichakpiik ni,
6ki muun mala ki kpaan faa mpuun,
le kijook kan, ti kuur ki kpo na la.
7Saaŋuul le kuln timi;
saaŋuusakpeln cha ijawaan chur timi la.
8Aa joo timi aatunwanbir bilni aanimbiin ni,
hali timi aatunwanbir ti bɔr na,
aa joo bilni nin chee aa ga li waa ti na la.
9Saaŋuul le junn timi aamɔfal;
timi aamɔfal wɔŋni ke tibɔlɔikaan na la.
10Timi aabin ye imonko itaa ni kipiik baanja la,
le binib bi pɔɔ na fuur imonko inaa;
tɔ, ŋi mu aah joo ni tiwan ni na tii timi na
le ye tibɔr ni nsuubiin;
limɔfal kpaan doo le na, timi aadoon le na.
11Ŋma kee kan saaŋuul aapɔɔn mbamɔm?
Ŋma nyi saaŋuusakpeln aah ga joo ni ijawaan i na.
12Mɔk timi, timi aamɔfal aafɔfɔk aah ye pu na, aan ti ŋa nlan.
13Saaŋuul ga ki yunn ki ti saa kinye?
Uwumbɔr, san saatutum kinimbaak.
14Kichakpiik mɔk ni kan,
di saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na gbiin timi,
aan ti gaa ilahn ki li kpa mpopiin ki ti saa timi aamɔfal aadoon.
15Tii timi mpopiin dandana wee ke saah nan tii timi mpombiin pu timi aafalaa aabin mɔmɔk yoonn na.
16Cha timi saatutum kan saapɔɔn sakpiin aatun;
Cha timi aayaabitiib kan saapak sakpeŋ.
17Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, cha saanyoor li bi ti pu.
Tii timi tinyoor timi aatun mɔmɔk ni.

english_text:
The Lord Is My Fortress
1Live under the protection
of God Most High
and stay in the shadow
of God All-Powerful.
2Then you will say to the Lord,
“You are my fortress,
my place of safety;
you are my God,
and I trust you.”
3The Lord will keep you safe
from secret traps
and deadly diseases.
4He will spread his wings
over you
and keep you secure.
His faithfulness is like
a shield or a city wall.
5You won't need to worry
about dangers at night
or arrows during the day.
6And you won't fear diseases
that strike in the dark
or sudden disaster at noon.
7You will not be harmed,
though thousands fall
all around you.
8And with your own eyes
you will see the punishment
of the wicked.
9The Lord Most High
is your fortress.
Run to him for safety,
10and no terrible disasters
will strike you
or your home.
11 God will command his angels
to protect you
wherever you go.
12 They will carry you
in their arms,
and you won't hurt your feet
on the stones.
13 You will overpower
the strongest lions
and the most deadly snakes.
14The Lord says, “If you love me
and truly know who I am,
I will rescue you
and keep you safe.
15When you are in trouble,
call out to me.
I will answer and be there
to protect and honor you.
16You will live a long life
and see my saving power.”
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr u ye timi aakikiir na
1Unii umɔk chaa Uwumbɔr chee ti ban nkiirm na,
unii umɔk bi Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan aaŋaal ni na
2ga bui u ke, “Sin le kii mi ki joo mi.
Sin le ye Maawumbɔr, sin pu le m mak.”
3U ga nyan si tibɔbir timɔk bɔɔ na ni, ni nkun aaween mɔmɔk ni.
4U ga taln waafeen biin aa pu; aa ga kan u chee ŋŋmarm;
waaŋann le ga li kii si ki joo si.
5Saan san kinyeek aajawaan ibaa,
kaan san nwiin pu aabɔlirkaan tibaa,
6kaan san tiweenbir ti chur binib mbɔmbɔɔn ni na,
kaan san nwiin pu aawanbir ti ku na.
7Nibaakan, lichur ga lir ki kpo aa chee,
le ŋichur kipiik kpo ki dɔ goln si, le nibaa aan ŋa sin ma.
8Aa ga lik le ki kan Uwumbɔr aah dar bibiindam aatafal pu na.
9Aa di Uwumbɔr le ŋa u kiir si na,
uma Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na le ye saakikiir,
10kina pu na, kinimbɔŋ kibaa aan kan si,
mbimbinpɔɔl mubaa aan duun ni saadichal.
11Uwumbɔr ga cha waatuuntiib li joo si ki li kii si nimɔk aa cha na.
12Bi ga li joo si biŋaal ponn ni paacham,
aataal taa gbeer ŋitakpal.
13Aa ga taa taa ichinn ni ikuub pu,
aa ga taa taa ichinn ni ikuub i bir na pu.
14Uwumbɔr bui ke, “M ga gaa binib bi gee mi na lii,
ki li kii binib bi nyi mi ke m ye Uwumbɔr na.
15Bi yaa yin mi kan, m ga kii baayim;
bi yaa bi tibɔr ni kan, m ga li bi bi chee.
M ga nyan bi tibɔr ni, ki nyuŋ bi.
16M ga di limɔfafɔfɔŋ le tii bi; m ga gaa bi lii.”

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the Sabbath.)
Sing Praises to the Lord
1It is wonderful to be grateful
and to sing your praises,
Lord Most High!
2It is wonderful each morning
to tell about your love
and at night to announce
how faithful you are.
3I enjoy praising your name
to the music of harps,
4because everything you do
makes me happy,
and I sing joyful songs.
5You do great things, Lord.
Your thoughts are too deep
6 for an ignorant fool
to know or understand.
7Though the wicked sprout
and spread like grass,
they will be pulled up
by their roots.
8But you will rule
over all of us forever,
9and your hateful enemies
will be scattered
and then destroyed.
10You have given me
the strength of a wild ox,
and you have chosen me
to be your very own.
11My eyes have seen,
and my ears have heard
the doom and destruction
of my evil enemies.
12Good people will prosper
like palm trees,
and they will grow strong
like the cedars of Lebanon.
13They will take root
in your house, Lord God,
and they will do well.
14They will be like trees
that stay healthy and fruitful,
even when they are old.
15And they will say about you,
“The Lord always does right!
God is our mighty rock.”
translation_text:
Likpaakool daal aalahn
1Uwumbɔr, ni ŋan sakpen ke ti doon si,
Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na, ni ŋan ke ti gaa ilahn ki nyuŋ si,
2ni ŋan ke ti li mooni saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, kichakpiik mɔk ni,
ki moon ke aa ŋani saah puu tipuur ti na, kinyeek,
3ni ŋan ke ti di ibeeŋmin aawan ni tibar gaa ilahn ki pak si.
4Uwumbɔr, saatukpaan na tii mi mpopiin;
saah tun pu na, le m ga gaa mpopiin aalahn.
5Uwumbɔr, saatun nyaŋ sakpen. Saalandak nyoo pam.
6Nimina le ye tiwan ni ujɔr aan ŋmaa bee na;
ulatiir mu aan ŋmaa bee naatataa.
7Bibiindam ga ŋmaa muun ke timoor na,
binib bi tun taani na ga ŋmaa kan tinyoor,
tɔ, liwinbaal le bi ga nan kuln kookoo,
8ba pu? sin Uwumbɔr le bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk
ki kpa mpɔɔn jer mpɔɔn mɔmɔk.
9Ti nyi ke saadim ga kpoi, le bibiindam mɔmɔk ga lir.
10Aa cha m pɔɔ ke upɔɔnaa na la; aa tii mi mpopiin.
11M kan maadim aah lir pu na, ki ŋun bibiindam aah wii pu na.
12Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na ga ŋa tinyoor ke libɔkpal aasui na la;
bi ga muun ke Lebanonn aasantina aasui na la.
13Bi naahn isui i bi ŋum i Uwumbɔr Aadichal chee na la,
bi muuni timi Aawumbɔr Aadichal aachiln ni la,
14le ki beenin lu ŋisubil buyoonn i por na,
ki kpa tifasɔnn ki pɔɔ n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
15Nimina le mɔk ke Uwumbɔr si chob la,
maakikiir aa kpa ngalm mubaa.

english_text:
The Lord Is King
1Our Lord, you are King!
Majesty and power
are your royal robes.
You put the world in place,
and it will never be moved.
2You have always ruled,
and you are eternal.
3The ocean is roaring, Lord!
The sea is pounding hard.
4Its mighty waves are majestic,
but you are even more majestic,
and you rule over all.
5Your decisions are firm,
and your temple will always
be beautiful and holy.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr
1Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr. U kpa nnaan aapak ni mpɔɔn.
Kitiŋ nyal si kaabuul ni, kaan foor.
2Uwumbɔr, ki nyan mpiin na, saabɔrjal si chob la,
aa nan bi le n‑yoonn nin piin.
3Uwumbɔr, nnyusakpem aanyunkpenn aafuuk nyan paacham la;
tinyunkpenn na fii le ki kpa kifuuk.
4Uwumbɔr lik paacham aawan mɔmɔk ki joo ni,
u pɔɔ jer nnyusakpem aah ŋuuni pu na,
ki pɔɔ jer nnyusakpem aanyunkpenn.
5Uwumbɔr, saakaal bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
le Saadichal sil bi chain n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

english_text:
The Lord Punishes the Guilty
1 Lord God, you punish
the guilty.
Show what you are like
and punish them now.
2You judge the earth.
Come and help us!
Pay back those proud people
for what they have done.
3How long will the wicked
celebrate and be glad?
4All of those cruel people
strut and boast,
5and they crush and wound
your chosen nation, Lord.
6They murder widows,
foreigners, and orphans.
7Then they say,
“The Lord God of Jacob
doesn't see or know.”
8Can't you fools see?
Won't you ever learn?
9God gave us ears and eyes!
Can't he hear and see?
10God instructs the nations
and gives knowledge to us all.
Won't he also correct us?
11 The Lord knows how useless
our plans really are.
12Our Lord, you bless everyone
that you instruct and teach
by using your Law.
13You give them rest
from their troubles,
until a pit can be dug
for the wicked.
14You won't turn your back
on your chosen nation.
15Justice and fairness
will go hand in hand,
and all who do right
will follow along.
16Who will stand up for me
against those cruel people?
17If you had not helped me, Lord,
I would soon have gone
to the land of silence.
18When I felt my feet slipping,
you came with your love
and kept me steady.
19And when I was burdened
with worries,
you comforted me
and made me feel secure.
20But you are opposed
to dishonest lawmakers
21who gang up to murder
innocent victims.
22You, Lord God, are my fortress,
that mighty rock
where I am safe.
23You will pay back my enemies,
and you will wipe them out
for the evil they did.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye unibɔn mɔmɔk aabɔjir
1Ndindaan Uwumbɔr u dar binib aatafal na,
kpiir saaŋuul mɔk binib.
2Sin le ye unibɔn mɔmɔk aabɔjir;
fii sil ki tii bigaadam tiwan ni ŋeer bi na.
3Taa cha bibiindam aapopiin ki yunn.
Uwumbɔr, taa cha ni ki yunn.
4Taa cha titunwanbirdam aagaak ki yunn,
aan bi li beenin kpa kipupuk baatunwanbir aatuln pu.
5Uwumbɔr, bi wɔi saanib; bi muk binib bi ye saanib na.
6Bi ku bikpopiib ni nkpobim,
ki ku biwɔwɔm bi bi timi aatiŋ pu na.
7Bi len le ke, “Uwumbɔr aa waa timi;
uma u ye Israel yaab Aawumbɔr na aa nyi.”
8Maanib, ba ŋa ni ye bigbaam ni bijɔrb kina?
Bayoonn aan ni ga bae?
9Uwumbɔr le naan timi aatafal, kina pu na u ŋun.
Uma le naan timi aanimbil, kina pu na, u waa.
10Uma le sur ŋitimbol, u dar ŋitafal.
Uma le ye unibɔn mɔmɔk aamɔmɔkr,
kina pu na, u nyi tiwan mɔmɔk aabɔr.
11Uwumbɔr nyi baalandak;
u nyi ke baalandak ye kijɔrk ŋmeen la.
12Uwumbɔr, saah bae unii u ki joo saakaal mɔk u na kpa mpopiin.
13Aa tii u lifuur, tibɔr aawiin daal,
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu bi gbii libuul bilni bibiindam na.
14Uwumbɔr aan siir cha waanib;
waan suln binib bi ye waanib na aabɔr.
15Bi ga ki kan ibamɔn libɔjil ni,
le binib bimɔk aabimbin ŋan na ga sil ibamɔn ngbaan aachaŋ ni.
16Ŋma nan sil nchaŋ ni bibiindam chee?
Ŋma nan sil mpuwɔb titunwanbirdam chee?
17Uwumbɔr yaa kaa ba nan ter mi kan,
kina m ba nan san mala sunn bitekpiib chee.
18Uwumbɔr, m bui ke, “M bi lir la;”
le saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na chuu mi siin chob.
19N‑yoonn mumɔk m dak ilandak aan ni muk mi na,
le aa sɔŋ nsui ki tii mi mpopiin.
20Aa ni bibɔjirb bi gaal igaŋgaŋlik na aa kpaani tɔb chee.
Bima le cha ibamɔn gangal tun lituln,
21ki kpokl binib bi aabimbin ŋan na pu
ki cha bi ku binib bi kaa tun taani na,
22le Uwumbɔr tee si mpuwɔb; Maawumbɔr le kii mi.
23U ga daa bitafal baabiin pu, ki kuln bi baatunwanbir pu;
Tidindaan Uwumbɔr ga kuln bi.

english_text:
Worship and Obey the Lord
1Sing joyful songs to the Lord!
Praise the mighty rock
where we are safe.
2Come to worship him
with thankful hearts
and songs of praise.
3The Lord is the greatest God,
king over all other gods.
4He holds the deepest part
of the earth in his hands,
and the mountain peaks
also belong to him.
5The ocean is the Lord's
because he made it,
and with his own hands
he formed the dry land.
6Bow down and worship
the Lord our Creator!
7 The Lord is our God,
and we are his people,
the sheep he takes care of
in his own pasture.
Listen to God's voice today!
8 Don't be stubborn and rebel
as your ancestors did
at Meribah and Massah
out in the desert.
9For forty years
they tested God and saw
the things he did.
10Then God got tired of them
and said,
“You never show good sense,
and you don't understand
what I want you to do.”
11 In his anger, God told them,
“You people will never enter
my place of rest.”
translation_text:
Kipak aalahn
1Dan man, aan ti nan pak Uwumbɔr.
Cha ti gaa mpopiin aalahn tii Uwumbɔr u kii timi na man.
2Cha ti di idoon dan unimbiin ni man,
ki gaa mpopiin aapak aalahn man,
3ba pu? Uwumbɔr ye Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan la,
ubɔr mpɔɔnsakpiindaan u joo dindatiib mɔmɔk na.
4Uma le joo kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk,
ki nya kitakpaluŋ ki nyoo sakpen na ni
ki ti saa ligongoln li paa sakpen na paab.
5Uma le lik waah naan nnyusakpem mu na pu,
ni kitiŋ ki u naan na mu pu.
6Dan man, aan ti nan gbaan ki doon u;
Cha ti gbaan man Uwumbɔr u naan timi na aanimbiin ni.
7Uma le ye timi Aawumbɔr; timi le ye binib bi u lik ti pu na,
ki ye binib bi u tii bi tiwan na.
Li pel man waah len pu din wee na;
8“Taa cha nitafal li pɔɔ ke niyaajatiib aah nan bi pu
Meriba aatiŋ ni na,
ke baah nan ŋa pu nteersakpiin ni, Masa aatiŋ ni na.
9Nima chee bi nan tɔŋ mi ki lik, ki nyi maah tun pu tii bi na.
10Nlaasaab nan nyan binib ngbaan ni, ŋibin imonko ilee ponn ni.
Le m bui ke, ‘Baa si mpuwɔb kpala. Bi yii, kaa joo maakaal.’
11Maaŋuul nan fii, le m puu tipuukpaan ke,
‘Naan koo kitiŋ ki ponn ni m ba ga tii nimi lifuur na.’”

english_text:
Sing a New Song to the Lord
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
Everyone on this earth,
sing praises to the Lord,
2sing and praise his name.
Day after day announce,
“The Lord has saved us!”
3Tell every nation on earth,
“The Lord is wonderful
and does marvelous things!
4The Lord is great and deserves
our greatest praise!
He is the only God
worthy of our worship.
5Other nations worship idols,
but the Lord created
the heavens.
6Give honor and praise
to the Lord,
whose power and beauty
fill his holy temple.”
7 Tell everyone of every nation,
“Praise the glorious power
of the Lord.
8He is wonderful! Praise him
and bring an offering
into his temple.
9Everyone on earth, now tremble
and worship the Lord,
majestic and holy.”
10Announce to the nations,
“The Lord is King!
The world stands firm,
never to be shaken,
and he will judge its people
with fairness.”
11Tell the heavens and the earth
to be glad and celebrate!
Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures
12and the fields to rejoice
with all their crops.
Then every tree in the forest
will sing joyful songs
13to the Lord.
He is coming to judge
all people on earth
with fairness and truth.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔrkpaan
(1 Bibɔrb Aabɔr 16.23-33)
1Gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii Uwumbɔr man.
Dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk, gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man.
2Gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man, ki pak u.
Iwiin mɔmɔk kan,
ni li mooni waah gaa timi lii pu na aabɔnyaan.
3Moon waah kpa kipak pu na ki tuk ŋitimbol,
ki moon waah tun ŋitukpaan pu na tuk binib mɔmɔk.
4Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen, le ni ŋan ke ti pak u sakpen;
ti ga nyuŋ u ki jer dindatiib mɔmɔk.
5Ŋitimbol ŋiken na mɔmɔk aawaa po ye tiwan ni bi naan ni na la,
le Uwumbɔr naan paacham.
6Kipak ni nnaan aapɔɔn le mann goln u;
le mpɔɔn ni kinyaan gbii Waadichal ni.
7Kitiŋ kee aanib mɔmɔk, li pak Uwumbɔr man;
pak man waapɔɔn ni waah kpa kinyuŋ sakpen pu na.
8Pak Uwumbɔr aayimbil li kpa kinyuŋ na man;
li joo ni ipiin ki di dan man Waadichal ponn ni.
9Uwumbɔr u bi chain na yaa choo kan, gbaan unimbiin ni man;
kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk li jii unimbiin ni.
10Bui ŋitimbol mɔmɔk ke, “Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr.
Kitiŋ si kaabuul ni chib, kaan ŋmaa foor daalbaadaal;
u ga di ibamɔn ji binib tibɔr.”
11Kitiŋ ni kitaapaak, li mɔɔni man.
Nnyusakpem, ni tiwanfuurkaan nimɔk bi aa ponn ni na,
faa kifuuk man;
12-13ikpaakon, ni tiwan nimɔk bi i ponn ni na, li mɔɔni man.
Uwumbɔr yaa nan dan ke u nan joo kitiŋ kan,
isui i bi kichook ni na ga di mpopiin teen mpɔɔn pu.
U ga di ibamɔn ni mbimbinyaan ji dulnyaa aanib tibɔr.

english_text:
The Lord Brings Justice
1The Lord is King!
Tell the earth to celebrate
and all islands to shout.
2Dark clouds surround him,
and his throne is supported
by justice and fairness.
3Fire leaps from his throne,
destroying his enemies,
4and his lightning is so bright
that the earth sees it
and trembles.
5Mountains melt away like wax
in the presence of the Lord
of all the earth.
6The heavens announce,
“The Lord brings justice!”
Everyone sees God's glory.
7Those who brag about
the useless idols they worship
are terribly ashamed,
and all the false gods
bow down to the Lord.
8When the people of Zion
and of the towns of Judah
hear that God brings justice,
they will celebrate.
9The Lord rules the whole earth,
and he is more glorious
than all the false gods.
10Love the Lord
and hate evil!
God protects his loyal people
and rescues them
from violence.
11If you obey and do right,
a light will show you the way
and fill you with happiness.
12You are the Lord's people!
So celebrate and praise
the only God.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye ujojoorkpaan
1Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr, kina pu na, kitiŋ, li mɔɔni.
Nnyusakpem aadik, li mɔɔni man.
2Ntaalangbam, ni mbɔmbɔɔn le mann goln u;
u joo mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn le joo binib.
3Mmii le lolni u pu nsan le ki wu waadim bi mann goln u na.
4Waawiihn mu moor ke utaal na le wolni dulnyaa pu;
kitiŋ kan kina le ki jii.
5Ŋigongon donn ke nsiikpan na le Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni,
ŋi donn kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk Aadindaan aanimbiin ni la.
6Paacham aawan mooni waah kpa mbimbinyaan pu na,
le ŋitimbol waa waah kpa kinyuŋ pu na.
7Unii umɔk dooni ŋiwaa na jin inimɔɔn a;
ŋiwaa mɔmɔk gbaani Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni la.
8Sionn aanib kpa mpopiin, le Juda aatim mɔɔni.
Uwumbɔr, saabɔjil pu le bi mɔɔni.
9Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na,
sin le ye kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk aajojoor;
saapɔɔn nyaŋ dindatiib mɔmɔk aapɔɔn.
10Uwumbɔr gee binib bi kaa gee titunwanbir na;
u kii waanib aamɔfal; u gaal bi bibiindam chee lir.
11Nwiihn woln binib bi aabimbin ŋan na pu,
le mmɔɔn bi bininyaam chee.
12Nimi bi aabimbin ŋan na, li mɔɔni man,
Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na pu.
Teer Uwumbɔr u bi chain na aah ŋa pu na, ki tii u idoon.

english_text:
The Lord Works Miracles
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
He has worked miracles,
and with his own powerful arm,
he has won the victory.
2The Lord has shown the nations
that he has the power to save
and to bring justice.
3God has been faithful
in his love for Israel,
and his saving power is seen
everywhere on earth.
4Tell everyone on this earth
to sing happy songs
in praise of the Lord.
5Make music for him on harps.
Play beautiful melodies!
6Sound the trumpets and horns
and celebrate with joyful songs
for our Lord and King!
7Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures,
and the earth to shout
with all its people.
8Order the rivers
to clap their hands,
and all the hills
to sing together.
9Let them worship the Lord!
He is coming to judge
everyone on the earth,
and he will be honest
and fair.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye dulnyaa aajojoor
1Gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii Uwumbɔr man; u tun ŋitukpaan;
u di ubaa aapɔɔn mu bi chain na le kan linyaŋ.
2Uwumbɔr moon waah kan linyaŋ pu na;
u cha ŋitimbol bee ke u kpa mpɔɔn ki joo gaal binib lir.
3U joo waah puu tipuur ti tii waanib Israel yaab na.
Waa nya bipuwɔb, le ki kpa ngeehm tii bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
Binib bimɔk bi ni kookoo na kan timi Aawumbɔr aanyaŋ.
4Kitiŋ mɔmɔk, gaa mpopiin aalahn tii Uwumbɔr,
di ilahn pak u ki li joo mpopiin tar.
5Gaa ilahn pak Uwumbɔr man. Di tibar gaa ilahn man.
6Pii kakaan ni ikpiin man,
ki di mpopiin teen mpɔɔn pu tii Uwumbɔr u ye timi aabɔr na.
7Nnyusakpem, ni tiwanfuurkaan ni mɔmɔk bi aa ponn ni na,
faa kifuuk man;
kitiŋ, ni binib bi mɔmɔk bi aa pu na, gaa ilahn man.
8Nimi ŋimɔɔ, faa kifuuk man;
nimi ŋigongon, kpaan man ki gaa mpopiin aalahn
Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni,
9ba pu? u choo ke u nan joo dulnyaa la;
u ga di mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn le joo dulnyaa aanib.

english_text:
Our Lord Is King
1 Our Lord, you are King!
You rule from your throne
above the winged creatures,
as people tremble
and the earth shakes.
2You are praised in Zion,
and you control all nations.
3Only you are God!
And your power alone,
so great and fearsome,
is worthy of praise.
4You are our mighty King,
a lover of fairness,
who sees that justice is done
everywhere in Israel.
5Our Lord and our God,
we praise you
and kneel down to worship you,
the God of holiness!
6Moses and Aaron were two
of your priests.
Samuel was also one of those
who prayed in your name,
and you, our Lord,
answered their prayers.
7 You spoke to them
from a thick cloud,
and they obeyed your laws.
8Our Lord and our God,
you answered their prayers
and forgave their sins,
but when they did wrong,
you punished them.
9We praise you, Lord God,
and we worship you
at your sacred mountain.
Only you are God!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔrkpaan
1Uwumbɔr le ye ubɔr, le binib aawon gbaa.
U ka waabɔrjal pu, tiwan ni kpa ifeen na aapaacham,
le kitiŋ jii.
2Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn Sionn pu,
uma le ye ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aayidaan.
3Unii mɔmɔk ga pak waayimbikpaan li kpa ijawaan na.
U bi chain la.
4Ubɔrkpaan, aa gee ibamɔn aawan la;
aa cha ibamɔn bi Israel aatiŋ pu;
aa joo ni mbimbinyaan ni ibamɔn.
5Pak Tidindaan Uwumbɔr man;
li dooni u man waabɔrjal taab.
U bi chain la.
6Moses ni Aaronn le nan ye waatotoorb,
le Samuel nan ye unii u mee u na;
bi nan yin Uwumbɔr, le u kii baayim ngbaan.
7U nan bi ntaalangbam ni le ki len bi chee tibɔr;
bi nan kii waakaal, ni waah bui bi pu na.
8Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, aa kii saanib aayim;
aa mɔk bi ke aa ye Uwumbɔr u joo cha pinni taani na la,
tɔ, aa nan tee daa bitafal, baatunwanbir pu.
9Pak Tidindaan Uwumbɔr man,
li dooni u waagongoln li bi chain na pu man.
Tidindaan Uwumbɔr bi chain la.

english_text:
(A psalm of praise.)
The Lord Is God
1Shout praises to the Lord,
everyone on this earth.
2Be joyful and sing
as you come in
to worship the Lord!
3You know the Lord is God!
He created us,
and we belong to him;
we are his people,
the sheep in his pasture.
4Be thankful and praise the Lord
as you enter his temple.
5 The Lord is good!
His love and faithfulness
will last forever.
translation_text:
Kipak aalahn
1Dulnyaa mɔmɔk, gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr man.
2Di mpopiin doon Uwumbɔr man;
di mpopiin aalahn dan u chee man.
3Taa suln man ke Uwumbɔr ye Tidindaan la.
Uma le nan ŋa timi ŋitimbol, le ti ye uyaab;
ti ye waanib la, ti ye waapiih la.
4Di idoon jer waadichal aabisamɔi ni,
di kipak koo waachiln ni.
Doon u ki pak u man.
5Uwumbɔr ŋan la; waageehm aa kpa ndoon,
u joo waah puu tipuur ti na ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A King and His Promises
1I will sing to you, Lord!
I will celebrate your kindness
and your justice.
2Please help me learn
to do the right thing,
and I will be honest and fair
in my own kingdom.
3I refuse to be corrupt
or to take part
in anything crooked,
4and I won't be dishonest
or deceitful.
5Anyone who spreads gossip
will be silenced;
no one who is conceited
will be my friend.
6I will find trustworthy people
to serve as my advisors;
only an honest person
will serve as an official.
7No one who cheats or lies
will have a position
in my royal court.
8Each morning I will silence
any lawbreakers I find
in the countryside
or in the city of the Lord.
translation_text:
Ubɔr aah puu tipuur ti na
1Uwumbɔr, maalahn ye ibamɔn ni ngeehm aalahn la,
le m gaa mu tii si.
2Maatuln aan li kpa tijɔŋ.
Bayoonn aan aa ga dan m chee?
M ga li joo mbimbin mu ŋan na le bi maadichal ponn ni,
3kaan kii tii titunwanbir kpala.
M nan binib bi fenn bipuwɔb tii Uwumbɔr na;
m ni bima aan kpaan ki tun lituln.
4Maan tun beebee aatuln,
kaan tun titunwanbirdam chee lituln.
5M ga jenn nyan unii umɔk looni len titunwanbir
uŋeen aatɔ pu na;
maan kii tii unii u kpa kigaak ni inimpoo na.
6M ga kii tii binib bi kii tii Uwumbɔr na
ki cha bi li koo maabɔrchiln ni.
Binib bi kaa kpa taani na ga li kpa nsan ki tun maatuln.
7Unyamɔndaan ubaa aan kan nkookoo yaan maabɔrchiln ni;
uŋmaŋmannii ubaa aan sil nnimbiin ni.
8Iwiin mɔmɔk kan, m ga li ku bibiindam bi bi timi aatiŋ pu na la;
m ga jenn nyan titunwanbirdam mɔmɔk Uwumbɔr aatiŋ ponn ni.

english_text:
(A prayer for someone who hurts and needs to ask the Lord for help.)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen.
2Don't hide from me
in my time of trouble.
Pay attention to my prayer
and quickly give an answer.
3My days disappear like smoke,
and my bones are burning
as though in a furnace.
4I am wasting away like grass,
and my appetite is gone.
5My groaning never stops,
and my bones can be seen
through my skin.
6I am like a lonely owl
in the desert
7or a restless sparrow
alone on a roof.
8My enemies insult me all day,
and they use my name
for a curse word.
9Instead of food,
I have ashes to eat
and tears to drink,
10because you are furious
and have thrown me aside.
11My life fades like a shadow
at the end of day
and withers like grass.
12Our Lord, you are King forever
and will always be famous.
13You will show pity to Zion
because the time has come.
14We, your servants,
love each stone in the city,
and we are sad to see them
lying in the dirt.
15Our Lord, the nations
will honor you,
and all kings on earth
will praise your glory.
16You will rebuild
the city of Zion.
Your glory will be seen,
17and the prayers of the homeless
will be answered.
18Future generations must also
praise the Lord,
so write this for them:
19“From his holy temple,
the Lord looked down
at the earth.
20He listened to the groans
of prisoners,
and he rescued everyone
who was doomed to die.”
21All Jerusalem should praise
you, our Lord,
22when people from every nation
meet to worship you.
23I should still be strong,
but you, Lord, have made
an old person of me.
24You will live forever!
Years mean nothing to you.
Don't cut my life in half!
25 In the beginning, Lord,
you laid the earth's foundation
and created the heavens.
26They will all disappear
and wear out like clothes.
You change them,
as you would a coat,
but you last forever.
27You are always the same.
You are God for all time.
28Every generation of those
who serve you
will live in your presence.
translation_text:
Naah muk unachipɔɔn u na aameel
1Uwumbɔr, li pel maameel ki ŋun maah wii ki ban nterm pu na.
2M yaa bi tibɔr ni kan, taa fenn aapuwɔb tii mi,
li pel m chee, ki kii mi mala buyoonn m yin si na.
3Maamɔfal bi wɔŋni ke iŋmanyuu na la; nwon bi wu ke mmii na la.
4Bi gbaa mi bil ke timokuun na la; maa ki neen tijikaar tibaa.
5M ker idun mpɔɔn pu la; m gur ye ngban ni ikpab ŋmeen la.
6M gur naahn timoor ni aanyoon u bi nteersakpiin ni na la,
ki naahn ufiin u bi tilangbenn ni na.
7M dɔ waa kinyeek la;
m naahn unyoon u ka kidiipaab ubaa baanja na la.
8Maadim seei mi le nwiin ti lir;
binib bi ŋani mi mbɔnyun na joo maayimbil puuni lir
biken pu la.
9-10Saaŋuul li pɔɔ sakpen na pu, nfatan le gur ye maajikaar,
le maanyunyunn ŋmalni maanyunyukoo ni.
Aa bɔ yoor mi le ki di mee.
11Maamɔfal gur naahn kijook aajunjuŋ la;
m gur bi ke timokuun na la.
12Uwumbɔr, le sin ma ye ubɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk;
n‑yoonn mɔmɔk aanib ga teer aabɔr.
13Aa ga fii sil ki san Sionn kinimbaak;
n‑yoonn fuu ni ke aa san ki kinimbaak;
n‑yoonn mu ŋan na sɔ.
14Kaah ber ki kuln pu na, saatutum beenin gee ki la;
kaah gur tilangbenn pu na, bi san ki kinimbaak la.
15Ŋitimbol ga li san Uwumbɔr ijawaan la;
kitiŋ kee aabɔrb mɔmɔk ga li san waapɔɔn ijawaan la.
16Uwumbɔr yaa ki gir maa Sionn kan,
u ga nyan waapɔɔn sakpiin mpaan pu.
17U ga ŋun waah yii waanib bi na pu ki pel baameel.
18Ŋmee bil Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na,
aan n‑yoonn mu choo na yaab nan kan,
aan baah kaa kee ma binib bi na nan pak u.
19Uwumbɔr bi waabuul li bi paacham ki bi chain na,
le ki lik ni taab, u bi paacham le ki lik ni kitiŋ taab do,
20u ŋun binib bi bi tiyondir ni na aah ker idun pu na,
ki gaa baah siin ke bi ku binib bi na lir.
21Kina pu le bi ga moon waayimbil Sionn ni,
le bi pak u Jerusalem ni,
22n‑yoonn mu ŋitimbol ni nnaan mɔmɔk dan ke bi nan kpaan ki doon u na.
23M laa ye unachipɔɔn la, le Uwumbɔr cha maa ki kpa mpɔɔn,
u gii maamɔfal pu.
24Uwumbɔr, taa yoor mi buen dandana; cha m por waahr.
Uwumbɔr, aa bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la;
25n‑yoonn mu jer na le aa nan naan kitiŋ,
ki di aabaa aaŋaal naan paacham.
26Kitiŋ ni paacham ga doo, le aa ma ga li beenin bi;
ni mɔmɔk ga kpoi ke ŋibɔkul na,
aa ga di ni mae ke kikekekpiik na, ni mɔmɔk ga wɔŋ.
27Le sin ma beenin bi, kaan kpeln, saayoonn aan doo.
28Timi aabilb ga li bi lifuur ni, le aa ga li kii bi,
le biyaabitiib ga nan kan ŋŋmarm.

english_text:
(By David.)
The Lord's Wonderful Love
1With all my heart
I praise the Lord,
and with all that I am
I praise his holy name!
2With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
I will never forget
how kind he has been.
3The Lord forgives our sins,
heals us when we are sick,
4and protects us from death.
His kindness and love
are a crown on our heads.
5Each day that we live,
he provides for our needs
and gives us the strength
of a young eagle.
6For all who are mistreated,
the Lord brings justice.
7He taught his Law to Moses
and showed all Israel
what he could do.
8 The Lord is merciful!
He is kind and patient,
and his love never fails.
9The Lord won't always be angry
and point out our sins;
10he doesn't punish us
as our sins deserve.
11How great is God's love for all
who worship him?
Greater than the distance
between heaven and earth!
12How far has the Lord taken
our sins from us?
Farther than the distance
from east to west!
13Just as parents are kind
to their children,
the Lord is kind
to all who worship him,
14because he knows
we are made of dust.
15We humans are like grass
or wild flowers
that quickly bloom.
16But a scorching wind blows,
and they quickly wither
to be forever forgotten.
17The Lord is always kind
to those who worship him,
and he keeps his promises
to their descendants
18who faithfully obey him.
19God has set up his kingdom
in heaven, and he rules
the whole creation.
20All of you mighty angels,
who obey God's commands,
come and praise your Lord!
21All of you thousands
who serve and obey God,
come and praise your Lord!
22All of God's creation
and all that he rules,
come and praise your Lord!
With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aageehm
1M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la.
M joo nwon mɔmɔk pak waayimbil li bi chain na la.
2M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la,
kaan suln waah ŋa mi tiŋann pu na.
3U cha pinn mi maatunwanbir, le ki sɔŋni maaween mɔmɔk.
4U nyani mi nkun ni,
le ki joo ngeehm ni linimbaasaln aanyoor ŋani mi.
5U tii mi tiwanyaan ŋmeen la, le m bi, ki pɔɔ,
ki kpa mpɔɔn ke likaagiil na.
6Uwumbɔr nyi baah muk binib bi na bɔr
le ki ter bi ki tii bi baabamɔn.
7U nan di waah ban u tun pu na kpiir mɔk Moses,
le ki cha Israel aanib kan waapɔɔn aatun.
8Uwumbɔr ye unimbaasaln la, le ki gee timi,
waaŋuul aa fiir woween, le u gee timi sakpen.
9Waa galni binib ki ti cha dik dik,
waaŋuul sɔŋni mala mala la.
10Waa dar timi aatafal ki ŋeer taah tun pu na,
kaa teeni timi, timi aatunwanbir ni timi aataani pu.
11Kitiŋ ni kitaapaak aah daa tɔb chee pu na,
kina le waageehm wiir binib bi san u na chee.
12Liwipuul ni liwilir aah daa tɔb chee pu na,
kina le u nyan timi aatunwanbir ti chee ki di buen dandar.
13Ubo aate aah gee u sakpen pu na,
kina le Uwumbɔr gee binib bi san u na.
14U nyi taah nyan ni tiwan ni ponn ni na;
u teer ke ti ye titan la.
15Tima kan, timi aamɔfal bi ke timoor na la.
Ti muuni woween ki ŋan ke nsupuun na la;
16libuln le daar mu pu, le ki di mu buen;
le ubaa aan ki kan mu.
17Uwumbɔr aageehm aa door binib bi san u na ma chee,
18le waaŋann aa kpa ndoon binib bi tii waah puu tipuur ti na naadii
ki joo waakaal mbamɔm na chee.
19Uwumbɔr di waabɔrjal siin paacham;
uma le ye unibɔn ni tiwan mɔmɔk aabɔr.
20Nimi Uwumbɔr aatuuntiib bi pɔɔ sakpen ki kii waah len pu na,
ki pel waah len pu na, pak uma Uwumbɔr man.
21Paacham yaab bi kpa mpɔɔn na mɔmɔk,
ni nimi waatutum bi ŋani waageehn na,
pak Uwumbɔr man.
22Tiwanfuurkaan ni mɔmɔk bi waah joo nin chee mɔmɔk na,
pak Uwumbɔr man.
M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la.

english_text:
The Lord Takes Care of His Creation
1I praise you, Lord God,
with all my heart.
You are glorious and majestic,
dressed in royal robes
2and surrounded by light.
You spread out the sky
like a tent,
3and you built your home
over the mighty ocean.
The clouds are your chariot
with the wind as its wings.
4 The winds are your messengers,
and flames of fire
are your servants.
5You built foundations
for the earth, and it
will never be shaken.
6You covered the earth
with the ocean that rose
above the mountains.
7Then your voice thundered!
And the water flowed
8down the mountains
and through the valleys
to the place you prepared.
9Now you have set boundaries,
so that the water will never
flood the earth again.
10You provide streams of water
in the hills and valleys,
11so that the donkeys
and other wild animals
can satisfy their thirst.
12Birds build their nests nearby
and sing in the trees.
13From your home above
you send rain on the hills
and water the earth.
14You let the earth produce
grass for cattle,
plants for our food,
15wine to cheer us up,
olive oil for our skin,
and grain for our health.
16Our Lord, your trees
always have water,
and so do the cedars
you planted in Lebanon.
17Birds nest in those trees,
and storks make their home
in the fir trees.
18Wild goats find a home
in the tall mountains,
and small animals can hide
between the rocks.
19You created the moon
to tell us the seasons.
The sun knows when to set,
20and you made the darkness,
so the animals in the forest
could come out at night.
21Lions roar as they hunt
for the food you provide.
22But when morning comes,
they return to their dens,
23then we go out to work
until the end of day.
24Our Lord, by your wisdom
you made so many things;
the whole earth is covered
with your living creatures.
25But what about the ocean
so big and wide?
It is alive with creatures,
large and small.
26 And there are the ships,
as well as Leviathan,
the monster you created
to splash in the sea.
27All of these depend on you
to provide them with food,
28and you feed each one
with your own hand,
until they are full.
29But when you turn away,
they are terrified;
when you end their life,
they die and rot.
30You created all of them
by your Spirit,
and you give new life
to the earth.
31Our Lord, we pray
that your glory
will last forever
and that you will be pleased
with what you have done.
32You look at the earth,
and it trembles.
You touch the mountains,
and smoke goes up.
33As long as I live,
I will sing and praise you,
the Lord God.
34I hope my thoughts
will please you,
because you are the one
who makes me glad.
35Destroy all wicked sinners
from the earth
once and for all.
With all my heart
I praise you, Lord!
I praise you!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr u nan naani tiwan mɔmɔk na aapak
1M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la.
Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, saapɔɔn nyaŋ sakpen a.
Aa kpa nnaan aapɔɔn ni nnyuŋ;
2aa ye nwiihn ŋmeen la.
Aa taln paacham ke likekeln na la,
3le ki maa saadichal nnyun mu bi paab na aapaacham.
Aa di ntaalangbam le ŋa saataan aatɔroku,
le ki dik libuln aafeen pu.
4Libuln le ye saatuuntiib, le imiigaal ye saatutum.
5Aa di kitiŋ nyal siin kaabuul ni, le kaan ki foor daalbaadaal.
6Aa di nnyusakpem paan ki pu ke likekeln na,
le nnyun biin ŋijoo pu.
7Saah kae nnyun na, le mu san buen;
mu aah ŋun saah teen ki len pu na le mu chii ki san buen.
8Mu puu labr ŋijoo pu le ki sunni tifatann ni,
ki buen saah toor nin chee tii mu na.
9Aa siin mu aanaanmɔk, nin chee mu aan ki ŋmaa jer na,
ke mu taa ki ŋmaa biin kitiŋ pu.
10Aa cha uyayak aanyunbun puu tifatann ni,
le ŋimɔɔ puu ŋigongon aakaasisik ni.
11Muma le tii ipeel nnyun aan i nyu;
nima chee le timoor ni aabon aanyunyuu door.
12Isui i si gbɔk nima chee na ponn ni
le inyoon ter yaanyandil ki gaa ilahn.
13Aa cha utaal nya kitaapaak ki lir ni ŋigongon pu,
le ki cha kitiŋ kani saanyoor.
14Aa cha timoor muuni, le tiwakor kani ki ŋmɔ,
ki tii unibɔn njikaabim,
muma le u joo ko kisaak ki kani tijikaar,
15ki cha u kani ndaan mu piir usui na,
ki tii u olif aasui aakpan mu cha unimbil wɔb ŋan na,
ni tijikaar ti ga tii u mpɔɔn na.
16Lebanonn aasantina aasui kani utaal,
ima le ye Uwumbɔr ubaa aasui i u bun na.
17Nima chee inyoon ter yaanyandil;
le inaakpaapiin mam kpiini yaabim isui i fɔk na ponn ni.
18Ipɔɔŋoob bi ŋijoo ŋi paa na pu la,
le ŋijoo paab aalapol bɔrni ŋijootakpal ni.
19Aa naan uŋmal ke u li mɔk iŋmal aawiin;
nwiin nyi buyoonn mu ga lir na.
20Sin le naan kinyeek, le ipeel mɔmɔk nya ni mbɔmbɔɔn ni.
21Ichinn yaa chuun ban tinann kan, i ŋuuni,
le ki ban tijikaar ti Uwumbɔr tii i na.
22Nwiin yaa ti puu kan, le i gir ti doon yaabuu ni,
23le binib nya ki buen baatuln ni, ki ti bi tun, ki ti saa kijook.
24Uwumbɔr, aa naan tiwan sakpen a.
Aa di nlansakpem le naan ni mɔmɔk,
saawanfuurkaan le gbii kitiŋ pu.
25Nnyusakpem bi, le ki waa sakpen;
mu ponn ni le tiwanfuurkaan ni wiir sakpen na bi,
ni filk na, ni niwaatiir mɔmɔk bi.
26Iŋɔsakpiin chuun mu pu,
le nnyun ni aapeesakpiin na gbiir mu ponn ni.
Sin le naan nnyun ni aapeesakpiin ngbaan.
27Ni mɔmɔk lik sin pu le ke aa tii ni tijikaar
buyoonn ni ban ti na.
28Aa tii ni, le ni ji ti, aa tii ni tijikaar, le ni ji babr.
29Aa yaa fenn siir kan, le ijawaan chuu ni;
aa yaa chuu naafuurk kan, le ni kpo,
ki gir kpaln titan ti ponn ni ni nyan ni na.
30Tɔ, aa yaa tii ni kifuurk kan,
le ni kpaln tiwan ni aa naan na;
sin le tii kitiŋ aawan limɔfapɔln.
31Uwumbɔr aapak ga yunn
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
Uwumbɔr aasui ga li piin waah naan tiwan ni na pu.
32U yaa lik kitiŋ pu kan, ki jii la;
u yaa meeh ŋijoo kan, le iŋmanyuu nya ni.
33Maamɔfal mɔmɔk aayoonn ni, m ga li gaa ilahn tii Uwumbɔr;
m ga li gaa ilahn ki pak Maawumbɔr n‑yoonn mumɔk m bi limɔfal ponn ni na.
34Usui li piin maalahn pu, ba pu?
maapopiin mɔmɔk nya ni uma chee la.
35U kuln titunwanbirdam mɔmɔk kitiŋ kee pu;
bibiindam taa ki li bi kpala.
M joo nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr la.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.

english_text:
The Lord Can Be Trusted
1 Praise the Lord
and pray in his name!
Tell everyone
what he has done.
2Sing praises to the Lord!
Tell about his miracles.
3Celebrate and worship
his holy name
with all your heart.
4Trust the Lord
and his mighty power.
5Remember his miracles
and all his wonders
and his fair decisions.
6You belong to the family
of Abraham, his servant;
you are his chosen ones,
the descendants of Jacob.
7The Lord is our God,
bringing justice
everywhere on earth.
8He will never forget
his agreement or his promises,
not in thousands of years.
* 9 God made an eternal promise
10 to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
11when he said, “I'll give you
the land of Canaan.”
12At the time there were
only a few of us,
and we were homeless.
13We wandered from nation
to nation, from one country
to another.
14 God did not let anyone
mistreat our people.
Instead he protected us
by punishing rulers
15and telling them,
“Don't touch my chosen leaders
or harm my prophets!”
16 God kept crops from growing
until food was scarce
everywhere in the land.
17 But he had already sent Joseph,
sold as a slave into Egypt,
18 with chains of iron
around his legs and neck.
19Joseph remained a slave
until his own words
had come true,
and the Lord had finished
testing him.
20 Then the king of Egypt
set Joseph free
21 and put him in charge
of everything he owned.
22Joseph was in command
of the officials,
and he taught the leaders
how to use wisdom.
23 Jacob and his family
came and settled in Egypt
as foreigners.
24 They were the Lord's people,
so he let them grow stronger
than their enemies.
25They served the Lord,
and he made the Egyptians plan
hateful things against them.
26 God sent his servant Moses.
He also chose and sent Aaron
27to his people in Egypt,
and they worked miracles
and wonders there.
28 Moses and Aaron obeyed God,
and he sent darkness
to cover Egypt.
29 God turned their rivers
into streams of blood,
and the fish all died.
30 Frogs were everywhere,
even in the royal palace.
31 When God gave the command,
flies and gnats
swarmed all around.
32 In place of rain,
God sent hailstones
and flashes of lightning.
33He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees,
and he made splinters
of all the other trees.
34 God gave the command,
and more grasshoppers came
than could be counted.
35They ate every green plant
and all the crops that grew
in the land of Egypt.
36 Then God took the life
of every first-born son.
37 When God led Israel from Egypt,
they took silver and gold,
and no one was left behind.
38The Egyptians were afraid
and gladly let them go.
39 God hid them under a cloud
and guided them by fire
during the night.
40 When they asked for food,
he sent more birds
than they could eat.
41 God even split open a rock,
and streams of water
gushed into the desert.
42God never forgot
his sacred promise
to his servant Abraham.
43When the Lord rescued
his chosen people from Egypt,
they celebrated with songs.
44 The Lord gave them the land
and everything else
the nations had worked for.
45He did this so that his people
would obey all his laws.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr ni waanib
(1 Bibɔrb Aabɔr 16.8-22)
1Di idoon tii Uwumbɔr man,
moon waah kpa mpɔɔn pu na man;
bui ŋitimbol waah tun ŋitun ŋi na man.
2Gaa ilahn ki pak Uwumbɔr man;
ki tuk binib waah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na.
3Taah ye waanib pu na, cha tisui li piin man;
Cha binib bimɔk dooni u na li kpa mpopiin.
4Li cha Uwumbɔr chee ti ban nterm man;
ki li dooni u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
5-6Nimi waatutunn Abraham aayaabitiib,
nimi bi ye Jakob aayaabitiib bi u nyan bi na,
teer Uwumbɔr aah tun lijinjiir aatun ŋi na,
ni waah nan jin binib tibɔr pu na man.
7Uwumbɔr le ye Tidindaan,
waakaal ye dulnyaa wee mɔmɔk aakaal la.
8U ga li joo waah puu tipuur ti na
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
9U ga li joo tipuur ti u nan puu tii Abraham ni Aisak na.
10Uwumbɔr puu tipuur ti kaa kpa ndoon na tii Jakob.
11U bui ke, “M ga di Kanaann aatiŋ tii si,
ki ga li ye saatiŋ la.”
12Uwumbɔr aanib aa nan wiir,
le ki ye biwɔwɔm Kanaann aatiŋ ni.
13Bi nan chuun yiini ki ti nya kitiŋ kee ni,
ki ti saa kitiŋ kee ni,
ki nya nnaan mue ni, ki ti saa mue ni.
14Uwumbɔr aa nan cha ubaa muk bi;
waah nan ban u li kii bi pu na, le u nan sak bibɔrb ke,
15“Taa tii maatutum titotonn man;
taa meeh maabɔnabtiib man.”
16Uwumbɔr nan tun ni nkon baatiŋ pu,
ki chuu gaa baajikaar mɔmɔk.
17Tɔ, u nan tee tun uja ubaa ke u loln bi pu nsan,
uma le ye Josef, u bi nan kooh ŋa tinaagbiir ni na.
18Bi nan di tikululn gbin utaa, ki di tikur aabuen leen usil
19ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu u nan puu ke tiwan ni ga ŋa na gbiin kina.
Uwumbɔr aamɔboln nan mɔk ke u sil ye ubamɔndaan.
20Le Ijipt aabɔr cha u kan ubaa;
ŋitimbol aajojoor ngbaan gaa u lii.
21U nan di tininkpir tii u ki cha u ye kitiŋ ngbaan kookoo aabɔr,
22ki kpa mpɔɔn ki lik ubɔr aaninkpiib,
ki kpa mpɔɔn ke u bui ubɔr aasusurb baah ga ŋa pu na.
23Le Jakob nan buen Ijipt ki ti kal nima.
24Uwumbɔr nan cha waanib pɔr pam,
ki cha bi kpa mpɔɔn jer baadim.
25U nan cha Ijipt yaab nann waanib ki ŋmanni bi.
26Le u nan tun waatutunn Moses, ni Aaronn, u u nan lee u na.
27Uwumbɔr nan cha bi tun waatukpaan
ki tun iwaan aatun Ijipt aatiŋ ni.
28Baa nan yii waamɔb.
Uwumbɔr nan cha mbɔmbɔɔn biin kitiŋ ngbaan pu,
29U nan cha baamɔɔ aanyun kpaln nsin ki ku baajan mɔmɔk.
30Ŋipulaatal nan gaa baatiŋ, hali ki ti kpaan gbiin libɔrchiln ni mu.
31Uwumbɔr nan di umɔb len,
le tisibir ni tinaapulor gbiin kitiŋ ngbaan mɔmɔk ni.
32U nan cha ŋitaanal lir, ki cha utaal moor kitiŋ ngbaan ni,
kaa cha utaal nun.
33U nan bii baadaan aasubil ni ŋisubil ŋiken aasui,
ki kool isui mɔmɔk lir.
34U nan di waamɔb le len,
le itoon churbakaa u kaa kpa nkahm na dan.
35I nan di timoor ni tisufar ti mɔmɔk bi kitiŋ ngbaan pu na ŋman;
i nan ŋman baajikaar mɔmɔk pel pel.
36U nan ku Ijipt aadichadaan mɔmɔk aajan aabijabim,
37le ki nin cheen Israel yaab nyan kitiŋ ngbaan ponn ni.
Bi nan tu tikunabr ni salmaa mam,
le bi mɔmɔk kpa laafee ki pɔɔ.
38Ijipt yaab nan san bi ijawaan la;
le baah nan nyan baatiŋ ni na, Ijipt yaab aasui nan piir.
39Uwumbɔr nan di ntaalangbam le biin waanib pu,
ki tii bi mmii kinyeek ke mu tii bi nwiihn.
40Bi nan mee Uwumbɔr le u cha ichakpee dan;
u nan cha tijikaar nyan ni paacham ke bi nan ji ki bab.
41U nan chuu piir litakpal, le nnyun chee nyan ni,
ki puu nteersakpiin ni ke limɔɔl na.
42U nan teer waah nan puu tipuukpaan ti tii waatutunn
Abraham na.
43Kina le u nan cheen waanib bi u gann bi na nyan,
le bi nan gaa ilahn ki tar mpopiin pu.
44U nan di binib biken aatim tii bi, ki cha bi gaa baakpaakon,
45aan ni cha bi kii waamɔb ki li joo waakaal.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.

english_text:
A Nation Asks for Forgiveness
1 We will celebrate
and praise you, Lord!
You are good to us,
and your love never fails.
2No one can praise you enough
for all the mighty things
you have done.
3You bless those people
who are honest and fair
in everything they do.
4Remember me, Lord,
when you show kindness
by saving your people.
5Let me prosper with the rest
of your chosen ones,
as they celebrate with pride
because they belong to you.
6We and our ancestors
have sinned terribly.
7 When they were in Egypt,
they paid no attention
to your marvelous deeds
or your wonderful love.
And they turned against you
at the Red Sea.
8But you were true to your name,
and you rescued them to prove
how mighty you are.
9 You said to the Red Sea,
“Dry up!”
Then you led your people across
on land as dry as a desert.
10You saved all of them
11and drowned every one
of their enemies.
12 Then your people trusted you
and sang your praises.
13But they soon forgot
what you had done
and rejected your advice.
14 They became greedy for food
and tested you there
in the desert.
15So you gave them
what they wanted,
but later you destroyed them
with a horrible disease.
16 Everyone in camp was jealous
of Moses and of Aaron,
your chosen priest.
17Dathan and Abiram rebelled,
and the earth opened up
and swallowed them.
18Then fire broke out
and destroyed all
of their followers.
19 At Horeb your people
made and worshiped the statue
20of a bull, instead of you,
their glorious God.
21You worked powerful miracles
to save them from Egypt,
but they forgot about you
22and the fearsome things
you did at the Red Sea.
23You were angry and started
to destroy them,
but Moses, your chosen leader,
begged you not to do it.
24 They would not trust
you, Lord,
and they did not like
the promised land.
25They would not obey you,
and they grumbled
in their tents.
26So you threatened them
by saying, “I'll kill you
out here in the desert!
27 I'll scatter your children
everywhere in the world.”
28 Your people became followers
of a god named Baal Peor,
and they ate sacrifices
offered to the dead.
29They did such terrible things
that you punished them
with a deadly disease.
30But Phinehas helped them,
and the sickness stopped.
31Now he will always
be highly honored.
32 At Meribah Spring
they turned against you
and made you furious.
33Then Moses got into trouble
for speaking in anger.
34 Our Lord, they disobeyed you
by refusing to destroy
the nations.
35Instead they were friendly
with those foreigners
and followed their customs.
36Then they fell into the trap
of worshiping idols.
37 They sacrificed their sons
and their daughters to demons
38 and to the gods of Canaan.
Then they poured out the blood
of these innocent children
and made the land filthy.
39By doing such gruesome things,
they also became filthy.
40 Finally, Lord, you were angry
and terribly disgusted
with your people.
41So you put them in the power
of nations that hated them.
42They were mistreated and abused
by their enemies,
43but you saved them
time after time.
They were determined to rebel,
and their sins caused
their downfall.
44You answered their prayers
when they were in trouble.
45You kept your agreement
and were so merciful
46that their enemies
had pity on them.
47 Save us, Lord God!
Bring us back
from among the nations.
Let us celebrate and shout
in praise of your holy name.
48 Lord God of Israel,
you deserve to be praised
forever and ever.
Let everyone say, “Amen!
Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann waanib pu pu na
1Pak Uwumbɔr man.
Doon Uwumbɔr man, ba pu? u kpa tiŋann; waageehm aa kpa ndoon.
2Ŋma ga ŋmaa bee waah tun ŋitukpaan ŋi na?
Kipak kibaa aa bi ki ga ŋeer u.
3Binib bi keei waamɔb ki ŋani ni ŋan na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na
kpa mpopiin la.
4Uwumbɔr, buyoonn aa ban aa ter saanib na kan, aa teer mbɔr;
aa cha m li bi binib bi ponn ni aa gaa lii na.
5Cha m kan saah tii saanib liwangol li na,
ki mu kan mpopiin mu aa di tii saatimbol na,
ki kan binib bi ye saanib na aapopiin aamakl.
6Ti tun titunwanbir ke tiyaajatiib aah tun pu na la;
ti kpa mbiin le ki ye titunwanbirdam.
7Tiyaajatiib aah nan bi Ijipt aatiŋ ni na,
baa nan bee Uwumbɔr aatukpaan aatataa;
bi nan suln waah mɔk bi waageehm kaa ti ki nyi mumɔk pu na,
le ki yii waamɔb Limɔɔkal Aanyusakpem na chee.
8Tɔ, waah nan puu pu na, u nan gaa bi lii,
ke ni mɔk waah kpa mpɔɔn sakpiin mu na.
9U nan di umɔb le tuk Limɔɔkal Aanyusakpem ngbaan,
le mu foor, le u cha waanib chuun kitikuun pu ki puur.
10U nan gaa bi binib bi kaa gee bi na chee lii;
u nan gaa bi baadim chee lii.
11Tɔ, baadim ma nan tee bee nnyun ni; ubaa kina aa nan gur.
12Le waanib nan tii waah puu tipuur ti na naadii,
ki gaa ilahn ki pak u.
13Tɔ, naa yunn le bi kpaan suln waah tun pu na,
le kaa sɔŋ bisui ke u sur bi, le ki ŋani baageehn.
14Le nteersakpiin ngbaan ni, kikpeek cha bi tɔŋ Uwumbɔr;
15le u tii bi baah ban pu na,
ki mu ki cha iween sakpiin ibaa lir bi pu.
16Nteersakpiin ngbaan ni le bi nan kpa lipiipoln Moses
ni Aaronn u Uwumbɔr nan lee u na pu,
17le kitiŋ chuu piir ki di Datann nab,
ki biin Abiram ni waadichal pu;
18le mmii ker lir ni baadidiliib pu le ki wun ku bibiindam ngbaan.
19Sainai aajoo chee le bi nan di salmaa naan unaajabo
le ki dooni liwaal ngbaan;
20bi nan di Uwumbɔr aapak tii kiwakork ki ŋmɔ timoor na aanaŋ.
21Bi suln Uwumbɔr u nan di waapɔɔn sakpiin tun ŋitun Ijipt
aatiŋ ni ki gaa bi lii na aabɔr.
22Bi suln waajinjiir aatun ŋi u nan tun nima chee na bɔr,
ni iwaan aatun ŋi u nan tun Limɔɔkal Aanyusakpem chee na aabɔr.
23Uwumbɔr aah nan bui ke u ga kuln waanib na,
waatutunn Moses, u u nan lee u na aa nan kii kina;
u nan kiir Uwumbɔr, le waaŋuul aa kuln bi.
24Le bi nan yii mmɔɔn aatiŋ;
ba pu? baa nan pak ke Uwumbɔr ga ŋa waah puu tipuur ti na.
25Bi nan gaar baakakar ponn ni le ki ŋulni,
kaa pel Uwumbɔr aah len pu na.
26Kina pu le u nan sak bi mbamɔm
ke u ga cha bi kpoi nteersakpiin ngbaan ni,
27ki cha biyaabitiib yaa koo binib bi kaa nyi u na ponn ni,
ki cha bi kpoi biwɔwɔm aatim ni.
28Peor aatiŋ ni, le Uwumbɔr aanib ti kpee binib bi dooni
liwaal Baal na pu,
le ki jin baah di tiwan ni toor tii ŋiwaa ŋi po ye
unibɔn aawanaankaan na.
29Baatun le nan fiin Uwumbɔr aaŋuul,
le iween i bir sakpen na lir ni bikaasisik ni.
30Tɔ, Fineas nan fii sil ki daa binib bi aabɔr aa ŋan na aatafal,
le iween ngbaan doo.
31Ki nyan n‑yoonn ngbaan ki joo cha,
bi nan teer nimina ki pak Fineas,
le bi ga li beenin teer, ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu choo na.
32Meriba aanyunbun chee
le binib ngbaan nan ki cha Uwumbɔr aaŋuul fii.
Bi pu, Moses nan koo tibɔr ni.
33Bi nan gbir uponn ni sakpen,
le u len tibɔr kaa teer ke u sil ki dakl lik waahr.
34Uwumbɔr aah nan bui ke bi ku binib bi kaa nyi u na,
baa nan ŋa kina,
35bi tee labr, le bi ni bima yoor tɔb aabim,
le ki gaa binib ngbaan aabimbin,
36le ki dooni ŋiwaa, le nimina kuln bi.
37Bi nan di bijapɔtiib ni bibisatiib toor kitork tii kinimbɔŋ.
38Binikurb ngbaan aah nan ku mbim mu kaa tun taani ubaa na,
le ni bii kitiŋ ngbaan.
39Baatun nan cha bi ŋa bibaa tijɔŋdam,
le kaa ki si Uwumbɔr aapuwɔb.
40Le Uwumbɔr aaŋuul nan fii bima waanib pu;
bi nan gur sukr uponn ni la.
41Le u siir cha bi, ki di bi ŋa binib bi kaa nyi u na aapɔɔn ni,
le baadim gur joo bi.
42Baadim nan muk bi, le bi kpaln baanaagbiib.
43N‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, Uwumbɔr nan gaal waanib lir la,
le bi yii, ki ki nyan upuwɔb ki moo koo titunwanbir ni.
44Tɔ, bi mu yaa tee wii ki yin u kan, le u pel baayim ngbaan,
ki bee ke bisui bii.
45Bima pu le u teer waah nan puu tipuur ti na,
le waageehm sakpem pu, u sɔŋ usui.
46U nan cha binib bimɔk muk bi na san bi kinimbaak.
47Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, gaa timi lii,
ki nyan ni timi ŋitimbol ngbaan ni ki giin ni,
aan ti ga li kpa idoon ki pak saayimbil li bi chain na.
48Pak Uwumbɔr u ye Israel yaab Aadindaan na man;
li pak u dandana, ni n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
Cha unii mɔmɔk len ke, “Amii”.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.
ŊMUŊMU AAGBAŊ
(Ilahn 107–150)

english_text:
BOOK V
(Psalms 107–150)
The Lord Is Good to His People
1 Shout praises to the Lord!
He is good to us,
and his love never fails.
2Everyone the Lord has rescued
from trouble
should praise him,
3everyone he has brought
from the east and the west,
the north and the south.
4Some of you were lost
in the scorching desert,
far from a town.
5You were hungry and thirsty
and about to give up.
6You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
7At once he brought you
to a town.
8You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
9To everyone who is thirsty,
he gives something to drink;
to everyone who is hungry,
he gives good things to eat.
10Some of you were prisoners
suffering in deepest darkness
and bound by chains,
11because you had rebelled
against God Most High
and refused his advice.
12You were worn out
from working like slaves,
and no one came to help.
13You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
14He brought you out
of the deepest darkness
and broke your chains.
15You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
16He breaks down bronze gates
and shatters iron locks.
17Some of you had foolishly
committed a lot of sins
and were in terrible pain.
18The very thought of food
was disgusting to you,
and you were almost dead.
19You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
20By the power of his own word,
he healed you and saved you
from destruction.
21You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
22You should celebrate
by offering sacrifices
and singing joyful songs
to tell what he has done.
23Some of you made a living
by sailing the mighty sea,
24and you saw the miracles
the Lord performed there.
25At his command a storm arose,
and waves covered the sea.
26You were tossed to the sky
and to the ocean depths,
until things looked so bad
that you lost your courage.
27You staggered like drunkards
and gave up all hope.
28You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
29He made the storm stop
and the sea be quiet.
30You were happy because of this,
and he brought you to the port
where you wanted to go.
31You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
32Honor the Lord
when you and your leaders
meet to worship.
33If you start doing wrong,
the Lord will turn rivers
into deserts,
34 flowing streams
into scorched land,
and fruitful fields
into beds of salt.
35But the Lord can also turn
deserts into lakes
and scorched land
into flowing streams.
36If you are hungry,
you can settle there
and build a town.
37You can plant fields
and vineyards that produce
a good harvest.
38The Lord will bless you
with many children
and with herds of cattle.
39Sometimes you may be crushed
by troubles and sorrows,
until only a few of you
are left to survive.
40But the Lord will take revenge
on those who conquer you,
and he will make them wander
across desert sands.
41When you are suffering
and in need,
he will come to your rescue,
and your families will grow
as fast as a herd of sheep.
42You will see this because
you obey the Lord,
but everyone who is wicked
will be silenced.
43Be wise! Remember this
and think about the kindness
of the Lord.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aaŋann aapak
1“Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann pu na,
ni di idoon tii u, waageehm aa kpa ndoon.”
2Nimi bi mɔmɔk kan waaŋmarm na,
di tibɔbaan ngbaan giin pak u man.
U gaa nimi, nimi aadim chee lii,
3ki nyan nimi ntiyayam ni ki giin ni nimi, nimi aatiŋ ni;
u nyan ni nimi liwipuul ni liwilir wɔb,
ki nyan ni nimi ŋŋangan ni ŋŋangii wɔb.
4Bibaa nan chuun yiini nteersakpiin mu kaa kpa isan na,
kaa kan kitiŋ ki ponn ni bi ga li koo na.
5Nkon ni nnyunyuu nan chuu bi, le biwon mɔmɔk yɔl.
6Le baamukl ni, bi yin Uwumbɔr,
le u nyan bi baafalaa ngbaan ni.
7U nan di bi buen kitiŋ ki ponn ni bi ga ti li koo na.
8Ni ŋan ke bi doon Uwumbɔr
waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu,
ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.
9U tii nnyunyuu aah joo binib bi na nnyun,
le ki tii nkon aah joo binib bi na tijikaar ti ŋan na.
10Binib bibaa nan bi mpombiin, ni mbɔmbɔɔn ni,
ki ye biyom, ki bi tikululn aafalaa ni,
11ba pu? bi nan yii Uwumbɔr u kaa kpa ŋeen aatɔ na aakaal,
ki yii waah mɔk bi pu na.
12Le litupɔɔl nan cha bi diŋ; bi nan lir, le ubaa aa bi ki ter bi.
13Le baamukl ponn ni bi yin Uwumbɔr,
le u nyan bi baafalaa ngbaan ni.
14U nan nyan bi baapombiin ni mbɔmbɔɔn ni,
ki geei baakululn na yuk yuk.
15Ni ŋan ke bi di idoon tii Uwumbɔr,
waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu,
ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.
16U gbaa wiil tikumann aajaaleŋ mam, ki gbaa wɔi tikur aadɔ.
17Binib bibaa nan ye bijɔrb,
le ki ji baatunwanbir aafalaa le baabiin aatun pu;
18baa nan gee ke binimbil kan tijikaar,
le nkon ti ban mu ku bi.
19Le baamukl ponn ni bi yin Uwumbɔr,
le u nyan bi baafalaa ni.
20U nan di waamɔboln le tii bi laafee, ki nyan bi nkun ponn ni.
21Ni ŋan ke bi di idoon tii Uwumbɔr,
waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu,
ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.
22Ni ŋan ke bi di kitork aapiin tii u idoon,
ki di mpopiin aalahn len waah tun pu na mɔmɔk.
23Bibaa nan koo iŋɔi ni ki puur nnyusakpem,
nnyusakpem ponn ni, le baajikaar nan nyan ni.
24Bi kan Uwumbɔr aah ga ŋmaa tun
waatukpaan ŋi nnyusakpem pu na.
25U nan di umɔb le len,
le libusakpeln piin ki bi daar le ki fiin tinyunkpenn.
26Iŋɔi nan fii paacham paacham ki gir nan lir nnyonyoon ponn ni,
kina aanimaln ponn ni le biŋɔŋaab aataakpab yɔl.
27Biwon nan gbaa, le bi chuun gbeer ke bidagbiirb na,
baah nan kpa nlan mu na bee fam.
28Le baamukl ponn ni bi yin Uwumbɔr,
le u nyan bi baafalaa ni.
29U nan cha kitaabuŋ ŋmin chii,
le tinyunkpenn doon suuna.
30Bisui nan piir kina pu,
le u cha bi di baaŋɔi ti fuu baah cha nin chee na.
31Ni ŋan ke bi di idoon tii uma Uwumbɔr,
waageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu,
ni ŋitukpaan ŋi u tun tii bi na pu.
32Ni ŋan ke bi moon waah kpa mpɔɔn pu na, kinipaak aah kuun nin chee na,
ki pak u bininkpiib aakuun ni.
33Uwumbɔr cha ŋimɔɔ foor pel pel ki kuur, ki cha inyunbun aa ki bun.
34U cha kitiŋ ki kpa tijikaar na kpaln nteersakpiin,
bibiindam bi koo nima chee na pu.
35U kpeln nteersakpiin ŋa tibɔr ti kpa nnyun na
ki cha kitikuun kpaln inyunbun i puu na aatiŋ.
36U cha nkon aah joo binib bi na kun nima chee,
le ki maa kitiŋ ki koo nima.
37Bi nan kon ikpaakon ki ŋum ŋisubil aasui
ki nan kan tijikaar sakpen.
38U nan ŋa waanyoor ŋa waanib pu,
le bi ma mbim pam, ki cha baawakor moo pɔr.
39Bidim aah nan nyaŋ Uwumbɔr aanib
ki joo mbiin ni falaa jinni bi inimɔɔn ni na,
40u nan lik seen binib bi muk bi na,
ki cha bi chuun yiini nteersakpiin mu kaa kpa isan na ponn ni.
41Tɔ, u nan nyan binib bi kaa kpa na baanimbaak ni,
ki cha baadichal pɔr ke ipiih na.
42Binib bi aabimbin ŋan na kani kina, le ni mɔ bi,
le bibiindam ma ŋmin chii.
43Cha binib bi kpa nlan na li dakl lik timina;
Cha bi dakl lik Uwumbɔr aageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by David.)
With God on Our Side
1Our God, I am faithful to you
with all my heart,
and you can trust me.
I will sing
and play music for you
with all that I am.
2I will start playing my harps
before the sun rises.
3I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear;
I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
4Your love reaches higher
than the heavens,
and your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
5Our God, may you be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6Answer my prayers
and use your powerful arm
to give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
7Our God, from your holy place
you made this promise:
“I will gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
8The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is my symbol
of royal power.
9Moab is merely my washbasin,
and Edom belongs to me.
I shout with victory
over the Philistines.”
10Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress
or lead me to Edom?
11Have you rejected us?
You don't lead our armies.
12Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
13Only you give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Limeel li ga li kii si saadim chee na
(Ilahn 57.7-11; 60.5-12)
1Uwumbɔr, m kpa limakl.
M ga gaa ilahn ki pak si. M ga fii sil,
2ki ga moo pel maabar.
M ga gaa ilahn lichakpitaawoln.
3Uwumbɔr, m ga doon si ŋitimbol ni.
M ga pak si binib ni.
4Saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na chaar jer paacham;
le saaŋann fuur kitaapaak.
5Uwumbɔr, mɔk saah pɔɔ sakpen pu na kitaapaak ni,
ki mɔk saapak kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu.
6Ŋun maameel, ki di saapɔɔn gaa timi lii,
aan saah gee binib bi na ŋmar.
7Uwumbɔr bi waadichal li bi chain na ni ki len ke,
“M ga di linyaŋ yakr Sekem aatiŋ,
ki yakr Sukof aafataŋ tii maanib.
8Gilead ni Manase aatim ye min yaan la,
Efraim aatiŋ le ye maakur aayikpupuk,
le Juda ye maabɔr aajaangbeek.
9Moab aatiŋ le ga li ye maasapeek;
m ga di maanaatak di mee paan Edom pu,
ki mɔk ke ki ye min mbaa aatiŋ la.
M ga nyaŋ Filistia aatiŋ le ki teen mpɔɔn pu.”
10Uwumbɔr, ŋma ga di mi buen kitiŋ ki bi maa ŋigon gob ki na ponn ni?
Ŋma ga cheen mi Edom aatiŋ ponn ni?
11Aa sil yii timi la aa?
Saan ki dii timi aajab buen butɔb ni ii?
12Ter timi, timi aadim chee; unibɔn aaterm aa ye nibaa.
13Uwumbɔr yaa bi ti chee kan, ti ga nyaŋ, u ga nyaŋ timi aadim.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1I praise you, God!
Don't keep silent.
2Destructive and deceitful lies
are told about me,
3and hateful things are said
for no reason.
4I had pity and prayed
for my enemies,
but their words to me
were harsh and cruel.
5For being friendly and kind,
they paid me back
with meanness and hatred.
6My enemies said,
“Find some worthless fools
to accuse him of a crime.
7Try him and find him guilty!
Consider his prayers a lie.
8 Cut his life short
and let someone else
have his job.
9Make orphans of his children
and a widow of his wife;
10make his children beg for food
and live in the slums.
11“Let the people he owes
take everything he owns.
Give it all to strangers.
12Don't let anyone be kind to him
or have pity on the children
he leaves behind.
13Bring an end to his family,
and from now on let him be
a forgotten man.
14“Don't let the Lord forgive
the sins of his parents
and his ancestors.
15Don't let the Lord forget
the sins of his family,
or let anyone remember
his family ever lived.
16He was so cruel to the poor,
homeless, and discouraged
that they died young.
17“He cursed others.
Now place a curse on him!
He never wished others well.
Wish only trouble for him!
18He cursed others more often
than he dressed himself.
Let his curses strike him deep,
just as water and olive oil
soak through to our bones.
19Let his curses surround him,
just like the belt and clothes
he wears each day.”
20Those are the cruel things
my enemies wish for me.
Let it all happen to them!
21Be true to your name, Lord God!
Show your great kindness
and rescue me.
22I am poor and helpless,
and I have lost all hope.
23I am fading away
like an evening shadow;
I am tossed aside
like a crawling insect.
24I have gone without eating,
until my knees are weak,
and my body is bony.
25 When my enemies see me,
they say cruel things
and shake their heads.
26Please help me, Lord God!
Come and save me
because of your love.
27Let others know that you alone
have saved me.
28I don't care if they curse me,
as long as you bless me.
You will make my enemies fail
when they attack,
and you will make me glad
to be your servant.
29You will cover them with shame,
just as their bodies
are covered with clothes.
30I will sing your praises
and thank you, Lord,
when your people meet.
31You help everyone in need,
and you save them from death.
translation_text:
Uja u bi limukl ni na aabɔr
1Uwumbɔr, m pak si la, taa li ŋmin.
2Bibiindam ni binyamɔndam tak mi la,
bi gee inyamɔn paani mi la,
3le ki len tibɔr ti kaa ŋan na m pu;
maa nyi tiwan ni pu bi tak mi na.
4M gee bi, ki mee Uwumbɔr tii bi, le baa lik waa kina, ki galn mi.
5Bi joo mbiin le pa mi maaŋann pu,
ki joo kinanaŋ pa mi maah gee bi pu na.
6Nyan ubeebeedaan ubaa aan u ji maadin tibɔr,
ki cha waadin ubaa galn u.
7Cha bi ji u tibɔr ki len ke waabɔr bii;
cha waameel li ye tibɔbir aa chee.
8Cha waamɔfal kuln dandana; cha uja uken gaa waatuln.
9Cha waabim kpaln nkpobim, ki cha upuu kpaln ukpopii.
10Cha waabim kpaln biwanmeeb bi kaa kpa do na;
Cha bi jenn nyan bi baah koo tilangbenn ti ponn ni na.
11Cha waah joo binib bi aapɔln na gaa waawangol mɔmɔk,
ki cha biwɔwɔm gaa waah tun ki kan tiwan ni mɔmɔk na.
12Taa cha ubaa li kpa u pu tiŋann,
ki taa cha ubaa kpiin waakpobim bi gaar puwɔb na.
13Cha uyaabitiib mɔmɔk kpo,
ki cha n‑yoonn mu choo na yaab suln waayimbil bɔr.
14Uwumbɔr, teer uyaajatiib aatunwanbir bɔr,
ki taa cha una aatunwanbir pinn u kpala.
15Cha Uwumbɔr li teer baatunwanbir bɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
ki tee cha ubaa taa ki teer bima bɔr kpala.
16Uja ngbaan aa dakl daalbaadaal ke u ŋa binib tiŋann;
u nan muk binib le ki ku bigiim ni bifalaadam,
ni binib bi kaa kpa nterm na.
17U nan gee timɔpur, kina pu na, cha bi puun timɔpur lii u pu.
Waa nan gee ke u mee Uwumbɔr aanyoor ŋa ubaa pu,
kina pu na, ubaa mu taa mee Uwumbɔr aanyoor ŋa u pu.
18U nan puuni timɔpur ke waah peeni tiwan pu na la;
cha ubaa aamɔpur gir ni u pu ke nnyun aah sɔŋni tiwan pu na,
ki koo waakpab ni ke nkpan na.
19Cha ti biin u pu ke tiwanpeenkaan na,
ki mann goln u ke waah buu ligbapapaln le na.
20Uwumbɔr, daa maadim bi len tibɔbir m pu na aatafal kina.
21Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, tee ter mi
ke saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na,
ki gaa mi lii saageehm nyaan sakpem pu.
22M ye ugiin le kaa kpa nibaa,
maamuk ti dɔ nsui ni taab taab la.
23M bi ke kijook aajunjuŋ na la, le ki ban m wɔŋ;
libuln daa mi buen ke unaaduun na la.
24Maah kaa ki ji tijikaar na, le ntaaŋaayil yɔl,
m gur ye igban ni ikpab ŋmeen la,
25Binib yaa kan mi kan, bi laa mi la,
le ki ŋani mi mbɔnyun ki gbakr biyil.
26Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, ter mi;
saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu, gaa mi lii,
27Cha maadim bee ke sin le gaal mi lir.
28Bi ga li puuni timɔpur lir m pu,
le aa ma ga li ŋani saanyoor ŋani m pu.
Cha binib bi muk mi na lir,
ki cha min, saatutunn, kan mpopiin.
29Cha maadim kpaln inimɔɔn aanib;
cha inimɔɔn li ye baawanpeenkaan.
30M ga doon Uwumbɔr mpɔɔn pu;
m ga pak u binib aah kuun nin chee na,
31ba pu? uma le kii ugiin
ki gaal u binib bi siin ke bi ku u na chee lir.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Lord Gives Victory
1 The Lord said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right side,
until I make your enemies
into a footstool for you.”
2The Lord will let your power
reach out from Zion,
and you will rule
over your enemies.
3Your glorious power
will be seen on the day
you begin to rule.
You will wear the sacred robes
and shine like the morning sun
in all of your strength.
4 The Lord has made a promise
that will never be broken:
“You will be a priest forever,
just like Melchizedek.”
5The Lord is at your right side,
and when he gets angry
he will crush
the other kings.
6He will judge the nations
and crack their skulls,
leaving piles of dead bodies
all over the earth.
7He will drink from any stream
that he chooses, while winning
victory after victory.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr, ni waah lee ubɔr u na
1Uwumbɔr bui ndindaan ke, “Kaln ŋŋangii wɔb
ki ti saa buyoonn m ga di saadim mɔmɔk ŋa aataapɔtan ni na.”
2Uwumbɔr ga taln saanaan aapɔɔn ki nya Sionn ni.
U ki len ke, “Li ye saadim aajojoor.”
3Nwiin mundaal aa ga tak saadim na,
saanib ga nya sil ki ter si bibaa pu la.
Saanachipɔm ga dan aa chee ŋijoo ŋi bi chain na pu
ke kichakpiik ni aamaln na la.
4Uwumbɔr puu tipuukpaan, kaan kpeln ti ke,
“Aa ga li ye utotoor ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na
ke Melkisedek aah nan ye pu na la.”
5Tidindaan bi aaŋangii wɔb;
waaŋuul yaa fii kan, u ga nyaŋ bibɔrb.
6U ga ji ŋitimbol tibɔr,
ki cha baah to butɔb nin chee na kpaln ŋinikpol ŋmeen;
u ga nyaŋ bibɔrb, kitiŋ kee mɔmɔk pu.
7Ubɔr ngbaan ga nyu nnyun nkpen mu bi nsan chee na,
aan ki moo pɔɔk ki kan linyaŋ.

english_text:
Praise the Lord for All He Has Done
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all my heart
I will thank the Lord
when his people meet.
2The Lord has done
many wonderful things!
Everyone who is pleased
with God's marvelous deeds
will keep them in mind.
3Everything the Lord does
is glorious and majestic,
and his power to bring justice
will never end.
4The Lord God is famous
for his wonderful deeds,
and he is kind and merciful.
5He gives food to his worshipers
