and always keeps his agreement
with them.
6He has shown his mighty power
to his people
and has given them the lands
of other nations.
7God is always honest and fair,
and his laws can be trusted.
8They are true and right
and will stand forever.
9God rescued his people,
and he will never break
his agreement with them.
He is fearsome and holy.
10 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the first step
to wisdom and good sense.
God will always be respected.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aapak aalahn
1Pak Uwumbɔr man.
M ga di nsui mɔmɔk pak Uwumbɔr, waanib aah kuun nin chee na.
2Uwumbɔr aah tun ŋitun ŋi na nyaŋ a.
Binib bi mɔmɔk aasui piir ŋi pu na ban ke bi bee ŋaatataa.
3Waah tun ni mɔmɔk na kpa kipak ni nnaan aapɔɔn la;
waabimbinyaan aa kpa ndoon.
4Uwumbɔr cha ti teer waatukpaan na pu,
u kpa tiŋann le ki san kinimbaak mu.
5U tii binib bi nyuŋni u na tijikaar;
waa suln waah puu tipuur ti na bɔr.
6Waah gaa biwɔwɔm aatiŋ tii waanib pu na, le u mɔk bi waapɔɔn.
7U bi chob le ki tun waatun mɔmɔk waah puu ke u ga ŋa pu na;
aa ga ŋmaa li kpa waakaal mɔmɔk pu kipupuk.
8Waakaal aa kpa ndoon; yaabimbin ŋan le ki ye ibamɔn.
9U gaa waanib lii ki puu tipuur ti kaa kpa ndoon na tii bi.
U bi chain le ki kpa mpɔɔn.
10Aa yaa ban aa li kpa nlan kan, nyuŋ Uwumbɔr;
u tii binib bi keei waamɔb na nlan.
Ni ŋan ke ti pak u n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

english_text:
God Blesses His Worshipers
1Shout praises to the Lord!
The Lord blesses everyone
who worships him and gladly
obeys his teachings.
2Their descendants will have
great power in the land,
because the Lord blesses
all who do right.
3They will get rich and prosper
and will always be remembered
for their fairness.
4They will be so kind
and merciful and good,
that they will be a light
in the dark for others
who do the right thing.
5Life will go well for those
who freely lend
and are honest in business.
6They won't ever be troubled,
and the kind things they do
will never be forgotten.
7Bad news won't bother them;
they have decided
to trust the Lord.
8They are dependable
and not afraid,
and they will live to see
their enemies defeated.
9 They will always be remembered
and greatly praised,
because they were kind
and freely gave to the poor.
10When evil people see this,
they angrily bite their tongues
and disappear.
They will never get
what they really want.

The Lord Helps People in Need
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Everyone who serves him,
come and praise his name.
2Let the name of the Lord
be praised now and forever.
3From dawn until sunset
the name of the Lord
deserves to be praised.
4The Lord is far above
all of the nations;
he is more glorious
than the heavens.
5No one can compare
with the Lord our God.
His throne is high above,
6and he looks down to see
the heavens and the earth.
7God lifts the poor and needy
from dust and ashes,
8and he lets them take part
in ruling his people.
9When a wife has no children,
he blesses her with some,
and she is happy.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aaŋann aapak
1Pak Uwumbɔr man.
Nimi Uwumbɔr aatutum, pak waayimbil man.
2Bi li pak waayimbil n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
3Pak Uwumbɔr aayimbil man,
ki nya liwipuul ki ti saa liwilir.
4Uwumbɔr le ye ŋitimbol mɔmɔk aajojoor;
waah kpa kipak ki na jer paacham.
5Ubaa aa bi ke Tidindaan Uwumbɔr na.
U koo paacham paacham la,
6le ki tee gbuuni taab ki lik ni kitaapaak ni kitiŋ.
7U fiini bigiim bi dɔ titan ni na siini paacham;
ki nyani binib bi kaa kpa tiwan na baanimbaak ni,
8ki joo bi ŋani biyidam aajɔtiib,
binib bi ye waanib na aajojoob aajɔtiib.
9U nyuŋni upii u kaa kpa ubo na waadichal ni;
u tii u mbim, le usui piir.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.

english_text:
The Lord Works Wonders
1 God brought his people
out of Egypt, that land
with a strange language.
2He made Judah his holy place
and ruled over Israel.
3 When the sea looked at God,
it ran away,
and the Jordan River
flowed upstream.
4The mountains and the hills
skipped around like goats.
5Ask the sea why it ran away
or ask the Jordan
why it flowed upstream.
6Ask the mountains and the hills
why they skipped like goats!
7Earth, you will tremble,
when the Lord God of Jacob
comes near,
8 because he turns solid rock
into flowing streams
and pools of water.
translation_text:
Lakr‑jer aajim aalahn
1Israel yaab aah nan nyan Ijipt aatiŋ ni na,
bima Jakob aayaabitiib aah nan nyan kiwɔwɔtiŋ ngbaan ni buyoonn na,
2le Juda yaab nan kpaln Uwumbɔr aanib bi u bi bikaasisik ni na,
Israel yaab nan kpaln Uwumbɔr yaab.
3Nnyusakpem Mamam nan lik le ki san;
le Jɔɔdann Aamɔɔl sil kaa ki puu.
4Ŋijoo nan yuk ja ja ke iŋoob na; le ŋigongon yuk ke ipihbi na.
5Nnyunsakpem, ba nan ŋa aan aa san?
Jɔɔdann aamɔɔl, ba nan ŋa aan aa sil kaa ki puu?
6Nimi ŋijoo, ba nan ŋa aan ni yuk ja ja ke iŋoob na?
Nimi ŋigongon, ba nan ŋa aan ni yuk ke ipihbi na?
7Kitiŋ, li jii; ba pu? Uwumbɔr choo,
Uwumbɔr u tiyaaja Jakob mu nan dii u na,
8Uwumbɔr u kpelni ŋitakpal ŋani nnyun,
ki kpelni ŋijootakpal ŋani inyunbun i puu na, li jii uma aanimbiin ni.

english_text:
The Lord Deserves To Be Praised
1We don't deserve praise!
The Lord alone deserves
all of the praise,
because of his love
and faithfulness.
2 Why should the nations ask,
“Where is your God?”
3Our God is in the heavens,
doing as he chooses.
4 The idols of the nations
are made of silver and gold.
5They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
6Their ears can't hear,
and their noses can't smell.
7Their hands have no feeling,
their legs don't move,
and they can't make a sound.
8Everyone who made the idols
and all who trust them
are just as helpless
as those useless gods.
9People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
10Family of Aaron the priest,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
11All of you worship the Lord,
so you must trust him
to help and protect you.
12The Lord will not forget
to give us his blessing;
he will bless all of Israel
and the family of Aaron.
13 All who worship the Lord,
no matter who they are,
will receive his blessing.
14I pray that the Lord
will let your family
and your descendants
always grow strong.
15May the Lord who created
the heavens and the earth
give you his blessing.
16The Lord has kept the heavens
for himself,
but he has given the earth
to us humans.
17The dead are silent
and cannot praise the Lord,
18but we will praise him
now and forevermore.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔrbaan u ye mbamɔn na
1Uwumbɔr, sin baanja,
sin baanja, kaa ye timi, le ti ga tii kipak;
ba pu? aa kpa ngeehm n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
ki ŋani saah puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.
2Ŋitimbol aa kpa nsan ke ŋi baa timi ke,
“Nimi Aawumbɔr bi la chee?”
3Timi Aawumbɔr bi paacham la; u ŋani waah gee pu na.
4Bima kan, bi di tikunabr ni salmaa le naan baawaa,
unibɔn aaŋaal le naan ŋi.
5Ŋi kpa imɔi le kaa tee ŋmaa len,
ki kpa ŋinimbil, kaa tee waa.
6Ŋi kpa ŋitafal, kaa tee ŋun,
ki kpa ŋimɔfal, kaa tee ŋun nnunun.
7Ŋi kpa iŋaal, kaa tee ŋmaa chur tiwan,
ki kpa ŋitaa, kaa tee ŋmaa chuun;
ŋaan ŋmaa faa kifuuk.
8Cha binib bi mɔmɔk naan ŋi ki kpa ŋi pu limakl na
li gur bi ke ŋiwaa ŋi bi naan na.
9Nimi Israel aanib, li kpa Uwumbɔr pu limakl man.
U ter nimi, le ki kii nimi.
10Nimi Uwumbɔr aatotoorb, li kpa limakl Uwumbɔr pu man.
U ter nimi, le ki kii nimi.
11Nimi bimɔk dooni u na, li kpa limakl Uwumbɔr pu man.
U ter nimi, le ki kii nimi.
12Uwumbɔr teer ti bɔr le ki ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa ti pu;
u ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa Israel aanib pu
ki ŋa waatotoorb mɔmɔk pu waanyoor.
13U ga ŋa waanyoor ŋa binib bi mɔmɔk nyuŋni u na pu,
binikpaam ni biwaatiib mɔmɔk pu.
14Uwumbɔr tii nimi ni niyaabitiib bibilb.
15Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni kitiŋ na ŋa waanyoor ŋa ni pu.
16Uwumbɔr baanja le yeh paacham, le u tee di kitiŋ tii unibɔn.
17Bitekpiib le aa pak Uwumbɔr,
unii umɔk sunn buen kitekpiitiŋ ni na aa pak u,
18le timi bi fu na ma ga di idoon tii u;
ti ga doon u dandana ni n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.

english_text:
When the Lord Saves You from Death
1I love you, Lord!
You answered my prayers.
2You paid attention to me,
and so I will pray to you
as long as I live.
3Death attacked from all sides,
and I was captured
by its painful chains.
But when I was really hurting,
4I prayed and said, “Lord,
please don't let me die!”
5You are kind, Lord,
so good and merciful.
6You protect ordinary people,
and when I was helpless,
you saved me
7and treated me so kindly
that I don't need
to worry anymore.
8You, Lord, have saved
my life from death,
my eyes from tears,
my feet from stumbling.
9Now I will walk at your side
in this land of the living.
10 I was faithful to you
when I was suffering,
11though in my confusion I said,
“I can't trust anyone!”
12What must I give you, Lord,
for being so good to me?
13I will pour out an offering
of wine to you,
and I will pray in your name
because you
have saved me.
14I will keep my promise to you
when your people meet.
15You are deeply concerned
when one of your loyal people
faces death.
16I worship you, Lord,
just as my mother did,
and you have rescued me
from the chains of death.
17I will offer you a sacrifice
to show how grateful I am,
and I will pray.
18I will keep my promise to you
when your people
19gather at your temple
in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Uja u nyan nkun ni na aah pak Uwumbɔr pu na
1Uwumbɔr aah ŋun maayim pu na,
le m gee u, u pel maameel,
2n‑yoonn mumɔk m yin u na kan, u pel m chee la.
3Nkun aanimaln nan mann goln mi;
le likaakul aajawaan gob mi siin;
ijawaan sakpiin le nan chuu mi,
4le m yin Uwumbɔr, m nan bui ke,
“Uwumbɔr, m gaŋ si, gaa mi lii.”
5Uwumbɔr san kinimbaak le ki kpa tiŋann;
timi Aawumbɔr ye unimbaasaln la.
6Uwumbɔr le kii binib bi kaa kpa nterm na;
maah nan bi limukl ni na, u nan nyan mi.
7Uwumbɔr aah kpa m pu tiŋann pu na, le m kpa nsuudoon.
8Uwumbɔr nyan mi nkun ni;
u pir maanyunyunn, kaa cha m lir.
9Kina pu na, m bi Uwumbɔr aanimbiin ni
le dulnyaa aanib ponn ni.
10Buyoonn m nan bui ke, “M doo kookoo a” na,
m nan beenin mak u pu,
11hali ijawaan aah nan joo mi aan m bui ke,
“Taa ki tii ubaa naadii” na, m nan beenin mak u pu.
12Ba aan m ga di tii Uwumbɔr, waaŋann sakpenn tee pu?
13Uwumbɔr aah gaa mi lii pu na,
m joo ni ndaan aapiin ki nan dooni u.
14Waanib mɔmɔk aanimbil ni le m ga tii u
maah puu ke m ga tii u ni na.
15Uwumbɔr aanii ubaa yaa kpo kan, ni wu u sakpen.
16Uwumbɔr, m ye saatutunn la;
m tun saatuln ke nna aah nan tun pu na la.
Aa nyan mi nkun ni.
17M ga tii si idoon aapiin, ki di maameel tii si.
18-19Saadichal li bi Jerusalem ponn ni na,
saanib mɔmɔk aanimbil ni
le m ga tii si maah puu ke m ga tii si tiwan ni na.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1 All of you nations,
come praise the Lord!
Let everyone praise him.
2God's love for us is wonderful;
his faithfulness never ends.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aapak
1Ŋitimbol mɔmɔk, pak Uwumbɔr man.
Binib mɔmɔk, pak Uwumbɔr man.
2Waah kpa ngeehm mu ti pu na pɔɔ pam,
u ye mbamɔndaan n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.

english_text:
The Lord Is Always Merciful
1 Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
2Let Israel shout,
“God is always merciful!”
3Let the family of Aaron
the priest shout,
“God is always merciful!”
4Let every true worshiper
of the Lord shout,
“God is always merciful!”
5When I was really hurting,
I prayed to the Lord.
He answered my prayer,
and took my worries away.
6 The Lord is on my side,
and I am not afraid
of what others can do to me.
7With the Lord on my side,
I will defeat
my hateful enemies.
8It is better to trust the Lord
for protection
than to trust anyone else,
9including strong leaders.
10Nations surrounded me,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
11They attacked from all sides,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
12They swarmed around like bees,
but by the power of the Lord,
I got rid of them
and their fiery sting.
13Their attacks were so fierce
that I nearly fell,
but the Lord helped me.
14 My power and my strength
come from the Lord,
and he has saved me.
15From the tents of God's people
come shouts of victory:
“The Lord is powerful!
16With his mighty arm
the Lord wins victories!
The Lord is powerful!”
17And so my life is safe,
and I will live to tell
what the Lord has done.
18He punished me terribly,
but he did not let death
lay its hands on me.
19Open the gates of justice!
I will enter and tell the Lord
how thankful I am.
20Here is the gate of the Lord!
Everyone who does right
may enter this gate.
21I praise the Lord
for answering my prayers
and saving me.
22 The stone that the builders
tossed aside
has now become
the most important stone.
23The Lord has done this,
and it is amazing to us.
24This day belongs to the Lord!
Let's celebrate
and be glad today.
25 We'll ask the Lord to save us!
We'll sincerely ask the Lord
to let us win.
26 God bless the one who comes
in the name of the Lord!
We praise you from here
in the house of the Lord.
27The Lord is our God,
and he has given us light!
Start the celebration!
March with palm branches
all the way to the altar.
28The Lord is my God!
I will praise him and tell him
how thankful I am.
29Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
translation_text:
Linyaŋ aadoon aameel
1Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann pu na, ni li dooni u man;
waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
2Cha Israel aanib len ke,
“Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”
3Cha Uwumbɔr aatotoorb len ke,
“Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”
4Cha binib bi mɔmɔk dooni u na len ke,
“Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”
5Buyoonn nsui nan bii na, le m nan yin Uwumbɔr,
le u nan kii maayim ki gaa mi lii.
6Uwumbɔr bi m chee, kina pu na,
maan san ijawaan; ubaa aan ŋmaa ŋa mi nibaa.
7Uwumbɔr le ye u ter mi na,
le m ga kan maadim aah ga lir pu na.
8Aa yaa mak Uwumbɔr pu kan,
ni ŋan jer ke aa li mak unibɔn pu.
9Aa yaa mak Uwumbɔr pu kan,
ni ŋan jer ke aa li mak biyidam pu.
10Bidim pam le nan mann goln mi;
le m nan di Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn doo bi mɔmɔk.
11Bi nan mann goln mi ŋipepel mɔmɔk,
le m di Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn doo bi mɔmɔk.
12Bi nan san gonni mi ke inangbee na la,
le bi mɔmɔk wun mala ke mmii aah wu ikokon pu na;
m nan di Uwumbɔr aapɔɔn le doo bi.
13Bi nan di tijar le tak mi ki ban bi nyaŋ mi,
le Uwumbɔr tee ter mi.
14Uwumbɔr tii mi mpɔɔn sakpiin, u gaa mi lii.
15Li pel Uwumbɔr aanib aakookoo yaan ponn ni
linyaŋ aapopiin aafuuk aah nyani pu na ke,
“Uwumbɔr di waapɔɔnsakpiin na nyaŋ;
16waapɔɔn joo ni timi linyaŋ;
waapɔɔnsakpiin mu u joo to butɔb na le nyaŋ kina.”
17Maan kpo, m ga li kpa limɔfal,
le ki moon Uwumbɔr aah tun pu na aabɔr.
18U daa ntafal sakpen a; u mu aa tee cha m kpo.
19Chuu piir Uwumbɔr Aadichal aabisamɔi tii mi;
m ga koo li ponn ni le ki ti doon u.
20Uwumbɔr aabisamɔb sɔ;
binib bi aabimbin ŋan na baanja le ga ŋmaa koo ni.
21Uwumbɔr, aa ŋun maayim pu ki tii mi linyaŋ,
nima pu le m pak si.
22Litakpal li bidimaab yii li na, lima le ye litakpajal.
23Uwumbɔr le ŋa kina, li ni gar timi pam.
24Uwumbɔr aanyaŋ aawiin daal le na;
cha ti li kpa mpopiin, cha ti li mɔɔni man.
25Uwumbɔr, gaa timi lii. Uwumbɔr, tii timi linyaŋ.
26Tinyoor bi unii u choo Uwumbɔr aayimbil pu na.
Ti bi Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni le ki mee waanyoor ŋani nimi pu.
27Uwumbɔr ye Tidindaan la, u kpa ti pu tiŋann.
Bar isubon ŋa niŋaal ni man, ki piin kitork aajim ngbaan,
ki chuun mann goln kitork aabimbiln.
28Aa ye Maawumbɔr la, le m dooni si,
m ga moon saah kpa mpɔɔn pu na.
29Uwumbɔr aah kpa tiŋann pu na, ni li dooni u man.
Waageehm bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.

english_text:
In Praise of the Law of the Lord
1Our Lord, you bless everyone
who lives right
and obeys your Law.
2You bless all those
who follow your commands
from deep in their hearts
3and who never do wrong
or turn from you.
4You have ordered us always
to obey your teachings;
5I don't ever want to stray
from your laws.
6Thinking about your commands
will keep me from doing
some foolish thing.
7I will do right and praise you
by learning to respect
your perfect laws.
8I will obey all of them!
Don't turn your back on me.
9Young people can live
a clean life
by obeying your word.
10I worship you
with all my heart.
Don't let me walk away
from your commands.
11I treasure your word
above all else;
it keeps me from sinning
against you.
12I praise you, Lord!
Teach me your laws.
13With my own mouth,
I tell others the laws
that you have spoken.
14Obeying your instructions
brings as much happiness
as being rich.
15I will study your teachings
and follow your footsteps.
16I will take pleasure
in your laws
and remember your words.
17Treat me with kindness, Lord,
so that I may live
and do what you say.
18Open my mind
and let me discover
the wonders of your Law.
19I live here as a stranger.
Don't keep me from knowing
your commands.
20What I want most
and at all times
is to honor your laws.
21You punish those boastful,
worthless nobodies who turn
from your commands.
22Don't let them sneer
and insult me
for following you.
23I keep thinking about
your teachings, Lord,
even if rulers plot
against me.
24Your laws are my greatest joy!
I follow their advice.
25I am at the point of death.
Let your teachings
breathe new life into me.
26When I told you my troubles,
you answered my prayers.
Now teach me your laws.
27Help me to understand
your teachings,
and I will think about
your marvelous deeds.
28I am overcome with sorrow.
Encourage me,
as you have promised to do.
29Keep me from being deceitful,
and be kind enough
to teach me your Law.
30I am determined to be faithful
and to respect your laws.
31I follow your rules, Lord.
Don't let me be ashamed.
32I am eager to learn all
that you want me to do;
help me to understand more.
33Point out your rules, Lord,
and I won't disobey
even one of them.
34Help me to understand your Law;
I promise to obey it
with all my heart.
35Direct me by your commands!
I love to do what you say.
36Make me want to obey you,
rather than to be rich.
37Take away my foolish desires,
and let me find life
by walking with you.
38I am your servant!
Do for me what you promised
to those who worship you.
39Your wonderful teachings
protect me from the insults
that I hate so much.
40I long for your teachings.
Be true to yourself
and let me live.
41Show me your love
and save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
42Then I will have an answer
for everyone who insults me
for trusting your word.
43I rely on your laws!
Don't take away my chance
to speak your truth.
44I will keep obeying your Law
forever and ever.
45I have gained perfect freedom
by following your teachings,
46and I trust them so much
that I tell them to kings.
47I love your commands!
They bring me happiness.
48I love and respect them
and will keep them in mind.
49Don't forget your promise
to me, your servant.
I depend on it.
50When I am hurting,
I find comfort in your promise
that leads to life.
51Conceited people sneer at me,
but I obey your Law.
52I find true comfort, Lord,
because your laws have stood
the test of time.
53I get furious when evil people
turn against your Law.
54No matter where I am,
your teachings
fill me with songs.
55Even in the night
I think about you, Lord,
and I obey your Law.
56You have blessed me
because I have always followed
your teachings.
57You, Lord, are my choice,
and I will obey you.
58With all my heart
I beg you to be kind to me,
just as you have promised.
59I pay careful attention
as you lead me,
and I follow closely.
60As soon as you command,
I do what you say.
61Evil people may set a trap,
but I obey your Law.
62Your laws are so fair
that I wake up and praise you
in the middle of the night.
63I choose as my friends
everyone who worships you
and follows your teachings.
64Our Lord, your love is seen
all over the world.
Teach me your laws.
65I am your servant, Lord,
and you have kept your promise
to treat me with kindness.
66Give me wisdom and good sense.
I trust your commands.
67Once you corrected me
for not obeying you,
but now I do obey.
68You are kindhearted,
and you do good things,
so teach me your laws.
69My reputation is being ruined
by conceited liars,
but with all my heart
I follow your teachings.
70Those liars have no sense,
but I find happiness
in your Law.
71When you corrected me,
it did me good
because it taught me
to study your laws.
72I would rather obey you
than to have a thousand pieces
of silver and gold.
73You created me
and put me together.
Make me wise enough to learn
what you have commanded.
74Your worshipers will see me,
and they will be glad
that I trust your word.
75Your decisions are correct,
and you were right
to punish me.
76I serve you, Lord.
Comfort me with your love,
just as you have promised.
77I love to obey your Law!
Have mercy and let me live.
78Put down those proud people
who hurt me with their lies,
because I have chosen
to study your teachings.
79Let your worshipers come to me,
so they will learn
to obey your rules.
80Let me truly respect your laws,
so I won't be ashamed.
81I long for you to rescue me!
Your word is my only hope.
82I am worn out from waiting
for you to keep your word.
When will you have mercy?
83My life is wasting away
like a dried-up wineskin,
but I have not forgotten
your teachings.
84I am your servant!
How long must I suffer?
When will you punish
those troublemakers?
85Those proud people reject
your teachings,
and they dig pits
for me to fall in.
86Your laws can be trusted!
Protect me from cruel liars.
87They have almost killed me,
but I have been faithful
to your teachings.
88Show that you love me
and let me live,
so that I may obey
your commands.
89Our Lord, you are eternal!
Your word will last as long
as the heavens.
90You remain faithful
in every generation,
and the earth you created
will keep standing firm.
91All things are your servants,
and the laws you made
are still in effect today.
92If I had not found happiness
in obeying your Law,
I would have died in misery.
93I won't ever forget
your teachings,
because you give me new life
when I follow them.
94I belong to you,
and I have respected your laws,
so keep me safe.
95Brutal enemies are waiting
to ambush and destroy me,
but I obey your rules.
96Nothing is completely perfect,
except your teachings.
97I deeply love your Law!
I think about it all day.
98Your laws never leave my mind,
and they make me much wiser
than my enemies.
99Thinking about your teachings
gives me better understanding
than my teachers,
100and obeying your laws
makes me wiser than those
who have lived a long time.
101I obey your word
instead of following a way
that leads to trouble.
102You have been my teacher,
and I won't reject
your instructions.
103Your teachings are sweeter
than honey.
104They give me understanding
and make me hate all lies.
105Your word is a lamp
that gives light
wherever I walk.
106Your laws are fair,
and I have given my word
to respect them all.
107I am in terrible pain!
Save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
108Accept my offerings of praise
and teach me your laws.
109I never forget your teachings,
although my life is always
in danger.
110Some merciless people
are trying to trap me,
but I never turn my back
on your teachings.
111They will always be
my most prized possession
and my source of joy.
112I have made up my mind
to obey your laws forever,
no matter what.
113I hate anyone
whose loyalty is divided,
but I love your Law.
114You are my place of safety
and my shield.
Your word is my only hope.
115All you worthless people,
get away from me!
I am determined to obey
the commands of my God.
116Be true to your word, Lord.
Keep me alive and strong;
don't let me be ashamed
because of my hope.
117Keep me safe and secure,
so that I will always
respect your laws.
118You reject all deceitful liars
because they refuse
your teachings.
119As far as you are concerned,
evil people are garbage,
and so I follow your rules.
120I tremble all over
when I think of you
and the way you judge.
121I did what was fair and right!
Don't hand me over to those
who want to mistreat me.
122Take good care of me,
your servant,
and don't let me be harmed
by those conceited people.
123My eyes are weary from waiting
to see you keep your promise
to come and save me.
124Show your love for me,
your servant,
and teach me your laws.
125I serve you,
so let me understand
your teachings.
126Do something, Lord!
They have broken your Law.
127Your laws mean more to me
than the finest gold.
128I follow all your commands,
but I hate anyone
who leads me astray.
129Your teachings are wonderful,
and I respect them all.
130Understanding your word
brings light to the minds
of ordinary people.
131I honestly want to know
everything you teach.
132Think about me and be kind,
just as you are to everyone
who loves your name.
133Keep your promise
and don't let me stumble
or let sin control my life.
134Protect me from abuse,
so I can obey your laws.
135Smile on me, your servant,
and teach me your laws.
136When anyone disobeys you,
my eyes overflow with tears.
137Our Lord, you always do right,
and your decisions are fair.
138All your teachings are true
and trustworthy.
139It upsets me greatly
when my enemies neglect
your teachings.
140Your word to me, your servant,
is like pure gold;
I treasure what you say.
141Everyone calls me a nobody,
but I remember your laws.
142You will always do right,
and your teachings are true.
143I am in deep distress,
but I love your teachings.
144Your rules are always fair.
Help me to understand them
and live.
145I pray to you, Lord!
Please answer me.
I promise to obey your laws.
146I beg you to save me,
so I can follow your rules.
147Even before sunrise,
I pray for your help,
and I put my hope
in what you have said.
148I lie awake at night,
thinking of your promises.
149Show that you love me, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
150People who disobey your Law
have made evil plans
and want to hurt me,
151but you are with me,
and all your commands
can be trusted.
152From studying your laws,
I found out long ago
you made them to last forever.
153I have not forgotten your Law!
Look at the trouble I am in,
and rescue me.
154Be my defender and protector!
Remember your promise
and save my life.
155Evil people won't obey you,
and so they have no hope
of being saved.
156You are merciful, Lord!
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
157I have a lot of brutal enemies,
but still I never turn
from your laws.
158Those unfaithful people
who refuse to obey you
are disgusting to me.
159Remember how I love your laws,
and show your love for me
by keeping me safe.
160All you say can be trusted;
your teachings are true
and will last forever.
161Rulers are cruel to me
for no reason.
But with all my heart
I respect your words,
162because they bring happiness
like treasures taken in war.
163I can't stand liars,
but I love your Law.
164I praise you seven times a day
because your laws are fair.
165You give peace of mind
to all who love your Law.
Nothing can make them fall.
166You are my only hope
for being saved, Lord,
and I do all you command.
167I love and obey your laws
with all my heart.
168You know everything I do.
You know I respect every law
you have given.
169Please, Lord, hear my prayer
and give me the understanding
that comes from your word.
170Listen to my concerns
and keep me safe,
just as you have promised.
171If you will teach me your laws,
I will praise you 172and sing
about your promise,
because all your teachings
are what they ought to be.
173Be ready to protect me
because I have chosen
to obey your laws.
174I am waiting for you
to save me, Lord.
Your Law makes me happy.
175Keep me alive,
so I can praise you,
and let me find help
in your teachings.
176I am your servant,
but I have wandered away
like a lost sheep.
Please come after me,
because I have not forgotten
your teachings.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aakaal
1Binib bi aabimbin ŋan
aan bi dii Uwumbɔr aakaal na kpa mpopiin.
2Binib bi joo waamɔboln
ki kii tii u bisui mɔmɔk ni na kpa mpopiin,
3baa tun taani ubaa; bi dii Uwumbɔr aasan la.
4Uwumbɔr, aa di saakaal tii timi
le ki mɔk timi ke ti li dii i mbamɔm.
5M ba mak ke m li kpa naadii ki li joo saakaal.
6M yaa kpa saamɔbon pu ntafaŋum kan,
maan ji inimɔɔn daalbaadaal.
7Buyoonn m bi bae saakaal nyaan ngbaan mbamɔm na kan,
m ga di nsui mɔmɔk pak si.
8M ga kii tii saakaal, kina pu na, taa di mi lii.
Saah ga kii Uwumbɔr aakaal pu na
9Binib bi laa diin na yaa ban baabimbin li ŋan kan,
see bi kii saakaal.
10M joo nsui mɔmɔk le pɔɔni mbaa ke m li tun saatuln;
taa cha m yii saakaal.
11M joo saakaal nsui ni, ke m taa tun si titunwanbir.
12Uwumbɔr, m pak si; kina pu na, mɔk mi saasan.
13M ga ki gir len mpɔɔn pu saah tii ikaal i mɔmɔk na.
14M gee ke m li dii saakaal ki jer ke m li kpa liwangosakpeln.
15M bae saakaal, m moo lik saah mɔk mmɔkm pu na.
16Saakaal tii mi mpopiin, maan suln saakaal bɔr.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aah kpa mpopiin pu na
17Li kpa tiŋann min saatutunn pu,
aan m li bi ki kii saah mɔk mi pu na.
18Woln nnimbil aan m kan ibamɔnkpaan i bi saakaal ni na.
19Maan yunn kitiŋ kee pu, kina pu na,
taa di saakaal bɔr mi.
20Nnimbil man ke m li nyi saakaal n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
21Aa kae binib bi kpa kigaak na mbamɔm;
ki puuni lir binib bi yii saakaal na pu.
22Maah joo saakaal pu na,
nyan mi baasiibil ni baalaar ni.
23Bitinjoob kuuni le ki kpokl m pu,
le mma ga li bae saakaal.
24Saah mɔk mmɔkm pu na tii mi mpopiin;
muma le ye maasusur.
Pɔɔn aabaa ki kii Uwumbɔr aakaal
25M lir le ki dɔ titan ponn ni,
cha maamɔfal ki gir ni ke saah puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.
26M kpiir maah tun pu na,
le aa kii tii mi; mɔk mi saasan.
27Ter mi aan m bee saakaal aatataa,
aan m li dakl lik saah tun litukpaan pu na.
28Mpombiin le nyaŋ mi kookoo;
cha nwon pɔɔk ke saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.
29Taa cha m yenn buen kinimbɔŋ wɔb,
di saaŋann sakpenn mɔk mi saakaal.
30M kii ke m ga li si chob; m kpa ŋuntii ki tii saakaal.
31Uwumbɔr, m dii saah mɔk pu na; taa cha m ji inimɔɔn.
32M ga di lineen kii saakaal, ba pu?
aa ga cha m moo bee yaatataa.
Ŋuntii aameel
33Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saakaal aatataa,
le m ga kii i n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
34Kpiir saakaal aatataa mɔk mi, aan m kii tii i.
M ga di nsui mɔmɔk joo i.
35Taa cha m nya saakaal aapuwɔb, ba pu?
ima chee le m kani mpopiin.
36Cha m li kpa lineen saakaal pu ki jer liwangol.
37Taa cha ntafal li bi tiwan ni kaa kpa tinyoor na ni;
saah puu pu na, li kpa m pu tiŋann.
38Li joo tipuur ti aa puu tii mi, saatutunn na,
saapuur ti aa nan puu tii binib bi kii saamɔb na.
39Nyan mi ŋisiibil ŋi m san ŋi ijawaan na ni;
saakaal ye ikaal kpaan la.
40M gee ke m joo saakaal;
saabimbinyaan pu, tii mi limɔfapɔln.
Tii Uwumbɔr aakaal naadii
41Uwumbɔr, mɔk mi saah gee mi pu na,
ki gaa mi lii, saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.
42Le m ga ŋmaa gar binib bi seei mi na, ba pu?
m tii saamɔboln naadii.
43Maamakl aah bi saakaal ponn ni pu na,
cha m li ŋmaa len ibamɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
44M ga kii tii saakaal n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
45Maah pɔɔni mbaa ke m li joo saakaal na,
nibaa aan muk mi maamɔfal ni.
46M ga di saakaal moon tii bibɔrb, kaan san inimɔɔn.
47Maah gee saakaal pu na, i tii mi lineen la.
48M gee saakaal ki pak i, m ga li dak i pu.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aapɔɔn
49Teer saah nan puu tipuur ti tii mi, saatutunn na;
ti tii mi limakl.
50Buyoonn m nan bi falaa ni na m nan kpa mpopiin;
ba pu? saah puu tipuur ti na nan tii mi limɔfal.
51Bigaadam lik seeni mi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la,
le maa yii saakaal ki nyan ipuwɔb.
52Uwumbɔr, m teer saakaal i bi n‑yoonn mu jer na pu,
le i joo ni mi mpopiin.
53M yaa kan bibiindam bi bii saakaal kan, maaŋuul fiir la.
54N‑yoonn siib mu ponn ni m bi kitiŋ kee pu na,
m di saakaal naan ilahn.
55Uwumbɔr, kinyeek kan, m teer saabɔr, le ki dak saakaal pu.
56M joo saakaal le ki kani maapopiin.
Di aabaa tii Uwumbɔr aakaal
57Uwumbɔr, sin baanja le ye tiwan ni m ban na,
m puu ke m ga li joo saakaal.
58M joo nsui mɔmɔk mee si ke aa san mi kinimbaak
ke saah puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na.
59M lik maabimbin suuna, le ki puu ke m ga li dii saakaal la.
60M kii saakaal kaan taan kpala.
61Bibiindam pen mi kitaŋ la, le maan tee suln saakaal pu.
62M fii kinyetaasiik le ki pak si, saakaal i bi chob na pu.
63M ye binib bi mɔmɔk tun saatuln ki kii saakaal na aajɔ la.
64Uwumbɔr, saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na gbii kitiŋ kee pu la;
mɔk mi saakaal.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aah kpa tinyoor pu na
65Uwumbɔr, aa joo saah nan puu tipuur ti na,
aa kpa tiŋann min saatutunn pu.
66Maah tii saakaal naadii pu na, tii mi saalan ni ichiin.
67Waahr aan aa nin daa ntafal na, m nan tun taani;
tɔ, dandana ma kan, m kii saamɔb.
68Aa kpa tiŋann sakpen a. Mɔk mi saakaal.
69Binib bi kpa kigaak na geei inyamɔn paani mi,
le m tee joo nsui mɔmɔk keei tii saakaal.
70Binib bimina aa kpa ŋuntii, le mma neen saakaal.
71Maatafadaan nan ŋan tii mi la, ba pu?
mu cha m bae saakaal.
72Saah tii ikaal i na kpa tinyoor tii mi
ki jer dulnyaa wee ni aamombil mɔmɔk.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aah bi chob pu na
73Sin le naan mi, ki cha m kpa limɔfal;
tii mi nlan aan m di bae saakaal.
74M kii tii saah len pu na,
kina pu le binib bi nyuŋni si na yaa kan mi kan,
bi ga li kpa mpopiin.
75Uwumbɔr, m nyi ke saakaal ŋan,
ki nyi ke saabamɔn pu le aa daa ntafal.
76Cha saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na sɔŋ nsui
ke saah nan puu pu tii mi, saatutunn na.
77Maah neen saakaal pu na,
san mi kinimbaak, ki tii mi limɔfal.
78Cha binib bi kpa kigaak na ji inimɔɔn
baah geei inyamɔn i paani mi na pu;
mma kan, m ga dakl suuna ki lik saakaal aatataa.
79Cha binib bi nyuŋni si ki nyi saakaal na dan m chee.
80Cha m li joo saakaal, saah ban pu na,
ki nya nlirm aanimɔɔn ni.
Limeel li ban ŋŋmarm na
81Uwumbɔr, maah kii si ke aa nan gaa mi lii pu na
cha nwon mɔmɔk kpo a;
m di maagaakii ŋa saabɔr ni la.
82Maah lik ki ban tiwan ni aa puu ke aa ga ŋa na pu na
le nnimbil ti gur wu,
le m baa ke, “Bayoonn aan aa ga ter mi?”
83Maa ki bi tibɔr tibaa ni, ke lidabuul li kpa nween na la;
tɔ, m mu aa tee suln saakaal bɔr.
84M kiir si ki ti bak a;
bayoonn aan aa ga daa binib bi muk mi na aatafal?
85Binib bi kpa kigaak, kaa dii saakaal na, gbii ibuu bil mi.
86Unii ga ŋmaa nyii saakaal pu ki fii sil;
binib joo inyamɔn le muk mi, kina pu na, ter mi.
87Ni gur pɔkaa kina bi ku mi a, le m beenin joo saakaal.
88Li kpa m pu tiŋann saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu,
nima kan, m ga ŋmaa li joo saakaal.
Li kpa naadii Uwumbɔr aakaal pu
89Uwumbɔr, saamɔboln ga li bi
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na;
li bi paacham kaa kpa ndoon.
90Saabamɔn ga li bi ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na;
aa baa kitiŋ siin libubaan ni, le kaan ki ŋmaa foor.
91Saakaal pu le tiwan mɔmɔk beenin bi ki nan saa din wee,
ba pu? ni mɔmɔk ye saatutum la;
92Maapopiin aah nyan ni saakaal ni na,
kina pu le maafalaa aa ku mi.
93Saakaal pu, le maa kpo, kina pu na, maan ŋmaa suln i bɔr.
94Sin le yeh mi, gaa mi lii.
M pɔɔni mbaa ke m li joo saakaal.
95Bibiindam kii mi ke bi ku mi la,
le m ga li dakl lik saakaal aatataa.
96M bee ke tiwan mɔmɔk kpa naadoon;
le saakaal ma aa kpa ndoon.
Li gee Uwumbɔr aakaal
97M gee saakaal sakpen a. M dakl i pu le nwiin ti lir.
98Saakaal bi m chee n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la,
ki cha m moo kani nlan jer maadim.
99Maah dakl lik saakaal aatataa na,
m moo beer tiwan aatataa jer binib bi mɔk mi na mɔmɔk.
100Maah dii saakaal na,
m kpa nlan sakpen ki jer bininkpiib.
101Maah ban ke m kii saamɔboln na
m yii mbimbin mu kaa ŋan na mɔmɔk.
102Sin aabaa aah ye maamɔmɔkr na, maa lik saakaal fam.
103Saakaal mɔ sakpen a, i mɔ jer tisiir.
104M kani nlan saakaal chee pam, kina pu na,
maa gee mbimbin mumɔk kaa ŋan na.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aah kpa nwiihn mu na
105Saamɔboln ye karyaa u mɔk mi nsan na la,
le ki wiin maasan ni.
106M ga li joo maapuur kpaan ti m puu
ke m ga li dii saakaal bamɔnn na.
107Uwumbɔr, maafalaa nyaŋ sakpen a;
cha m li kpa limɔfal saah nan puu ke m ga li kpa pu na.
108Uwumbɔr, gaa maah tii si idoon i na, ki mɔk mi saakaal.
109M kii n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ke m di maamɔfal pa talmaa;
maan suln saakaal.
110Bibiindam pen mi kitaŋ la, le maa yii saakaal.
111Saakaal le ye maawangol ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na; ima le ye maapopiin.
112M nyan sil ke m li dii saakaal ki ti saa maakundaal.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aah ŋan pu na
113M nan binib bi kaa di bisui mɔmɔk tii si na,
le ki tee gee saakaal ma.
114Sin le ye maakikiir, m kpa limakl saah len pu na pu.
115Nimi titunwanbirdam, siir m chee man.
M ga li dii Maawumbɔr aakaal la.
116Saah nan puu pu na, tii mi mpɔɔn, aan m li kpa limɔfal;
taa cha maamakl bee fam.
117Chuu mi, aan m li bi ŋŋmarm ni, ki li kpa ŋuntii saakaal pu.
118Unii umɔk yii saakaal na, aa mu yii uma la;
le baabeebee aakpokl na ye fam.
119Aa ŋani bibiindam mɔmɔk ke timoor na la,
kina pu le m gee saakaal.
120M san sin le ijawaan; saakaal pu le ijawaan joo mi.
Taa nya Uwumbɔr aakaal aapuwɔb
121M tun tiwan ni ŋan ki si chob na, taa di mi tii maadim,
122Puu ke aa ga ter saatutunn;
taa cha binib bi kpa kipupuk na li muk mi.
123Maah lik ki ban ke aa gaa mi lii ke saah nan puu pu na
le cha nnimbil ti wu.
124Li joo mi, saatutunn, ke saageehm na aah ban pu na,
ki mɔk mi saakaal.
125M ye saatutunn la; tii mi nlan aan m li nyi saakaal aatataa.
126Uwumbɔr, binib aah yii saakaal pu na, ni ŋeer ke aa fii sil.
127M gee saakaal ki jer salmaa u bi pun u mmii ni ki nyan waajɔŋ na.
128Kina pu na, m dii saakaal mɔmɔk;
le kaa gee nsan mumɔk kaa ŋan na.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aadiim aaneen
129Saakaal ye ikaal kpaan la; m di nsui mɔmɔk le kii tii i.
130Saakaal aatataa tii inimbiwoln la, le ki tii maanyidam nlan.
131Maah kpa saakaal pu lineen pu na,
le m gur ka waa mmɔb ki fuur yiŋni.
132Fenn ni m chee ki san mi kinimbaak
ke saah san binib bi gee si na kinimbaak pu na.
133Saah nan puu pu na, taa cha m lir, ki taa cha kinimbɔŋ nyaŋ mi.
134Nyan mi binib bi muk mi na aaŋaal ni, aan m ŋmaa dii saakaal.
135Di saanyoor gbii mi ki mɔk mi saakaal.
136Binib aah yii saakaal pu na cha m wii,
le maanyunyunn ti puu ke limɔɔl na.
Uwumbɔr aakaal aah bi chob pu na
137Uwumbɔr, saabimbin ŋan la, le saakaal si chob.
138Saah tii ikaal i na ŋan le ki si chob.
139Maadim aah kaa lik faar saakaal na,
le ni wu mponn ni ke mmii na.
140Saah puu tipuur ti na aa kpeln.
Min u ye saatutunn na gee ti sakpen a.
141Maa ye unikpaan, le bi lik seen mi,
m mu aa tee suln saakaal bɔr.
142Saabimbinyaan ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
le saakaal ye mbamɔn n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
143Tibɔr muk mi sakpen, le saakaal ma joo ni mi mpopiin.
144Saakaal si chob n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la;
tii mi nlan mu m ga li joo beer tiwan aatataa na,
ki cha m li kpa limɔfal.
Ŋŋmarm aameel
145M yin si ni maalandak mɔmɔk la;
Uwumbɔr, pel m chee, aan m dii saakaal.
146M yin si la; gaa mi lii, aan m li joo saakaal.
147M fii lichakpitaawoln le ki yin si ki ban nterm;
maamakl bi saah puu tipuur ti na ni la.
148M yaa dɔ kinyeek kan, m dɔ waa la,
ke m dakl suuna ki lik saakaal aatataa.
149Uwumbɔr, saageehm aah bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na, pel m chee;
san mi kinimbaak, ki gaa maamɔfal lii.
150Binib bi kaa joo saakaal kpala na kpokl m pu,
ki moo foor duuni mi la.
151Uwumbɔr, le sin le bi gbɔk mi, le saakaal mɔmɔk aa kpelni.
152N‑yoonn mu jer na le m nan bae saakaal;
aa siin i ke i li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.
Nterm aagaŋ
153Maah kaa yii saakaal na,
lik maah ji falaa pu na, ki gaa mi lii.
154Ter mi maabɔr ni, ki gaa mi lii,
saah nan puu pu na, gaa mi lii.
155Bibiindam aah yii saakaal na, saan gaa bi lii.
156Uwumbɔr, le saanimbaasaln nyaŋ sakpen a;
san mi kinimbaak ki gaa mi lii.
157M kpa bidim, ni binib bi muk mi na sakpen,
tɔ, m tee beenin dii saakaal.
158Bibɔmbɔtukb ngbaan aah kaa dii saakaal na,
m yaa kan bi kan, ni bii nsui la.
159Uwumbɔr, lik maah gee saakaal pu na.
Saageehm aa kpelni, kina pu na, gaa mi lii.
160Saamɔbon mɔmɔk ye ibamɔn la,
le saakaal mɔmɔk aa kpa ndoon.
Di aabaa tii Uwumbɔr aakaal
161Bipɔɔndam joo inyamɔn i kaa kpa tataa na le tak mi,
le mma pak saakaal.
162Saah puu tipuur ti na pu
le m kpa mpopiin ke unii u pii liwangol na la.
163Maa gee ke m kan inyamɔn kpala,
le ki tee gee saakaal ma.
164Saakaal i bi chob na pu,
le m dooni si nfum mulole liwinbaal.
165Binib bi gee saakaal na bi lifuur ni la,
le nibaa aa bi ki ga nyaŋ bi.
166Uwumbɔr, m kii si le ke aa nan gaa mi lii,
le ki ŋani saah ban pu na.
167M gee saakaal ni nsui mɔmɔk, le ki dii i.
168M dii saakaal ni saah mɔk mi pu na;
aa kani maah ŋani tiwan ni mɔmɔk na.
Limeel li ban nterm na
169Uwumbɔr, cha maaterm aawiil pii si.
Saah nan puu pu na,
tii mi nlan mu m ga li joo beer tiwan aatataa na.
170Saah nan puu pu na, ŋun maameel, ki gaa mi lii.
171Saah mɔk mi saakaal na, m ga li pak si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
172Saakaal aah bi chob pu na, m ga di i gaa ilahn.
173Maah dii saakaal pu na, gor n‑yoonn mɔmɔk ki ter mi.
174Uwumbɔr, m kiir buyoonn aa ga gaa mi lii na, ki ti bak a.
Saakaal ponn ni le m kani mpopiin.
175Tii mi limɔfal, aan m pak si; cha saakaal ter mi.
176M chuun yiini ke upiih u wɔŋ na la;
maah kaa yii saakaal pu na, dan nan ban kan mi, saatutunn.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1When I am in trouble, I pray,
2“Come and save me, Lord,
from deceitful liars!”
3What punishment is fitting
for you deceitful liars?
4Your reward should be
sharp and flaming arrows!
5But I must live as a foreigner
among the people of Meshech
and in the tents of Kedar.
6I have spent too much time
living among people
who hate peace.
7I am in favor of peace,
but when I speak of it,
all they want is war.
translation_text:
Limeel li ban nterm na
1Maah nan bi tibɔr ni na, m nan yin Uwumbɔr,
le u nan kii maayim ngbaan.
2Uwumbɔr, nyan mi binyamɔndam ni biŋmaŋmannim chee.
3Nimi binyamɔndam, Uwumbɔr ga ŋa nimi kinye?
U ga daa nitafal kinye?
4U ga di uja aapiin i ka na,
ni limiisakɔl li kpa mmii na le daa nitafal.
5Ni chee aakookoon aa ŋan ke unii u koo Mesek ni,
kaa ŋan ke unii u koo Kedar aanib chee na la.
6M koo binib bi kaa gee nsuudoon na chee ni yunn sakpen a.
7Buyoonn m ti len nsuudoon aabɔr na kan,
bima ban butɔb la.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Will Protect His People
1I look to the hills!
Where will I find help?
2It will come from the Lord,
who created heaven and earth.
3The Lord is your protector,
and he won't go to sleep
or let you stumble.
4The protector of Israel
doesn't doze
or ever get drowsy.
5The Lord is your protector,
there at your right side
to shade you from the sun.
6You won't be harmed
by the sun during the day
or by the moon at night.
7The Lord will protect you
and keep you safe
from all dangers.
8The Lord will protect you
now and always
wherever you go.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye timi aakikiir
1M lik ŋijoo paab; la chee aan maaterm ga nya ni?
2Maaterm ga nya ni Uwumbɔr,
u naan paacham ni taab na chee la.
3Waan cha aa lir; saakikiir ka waa n‑yoonn mɔmɔk la.
4Israel yaab aakikiir aa geeni kpala.
5Uwumbɔr ga li kii si, u si gbɔk si ke u li kii si la.
6Nwiin pu kan, nwiin aan see si,
le uŋmal mu aan ŋa si nibaa kinyeek.
7Uwumbɔr ga li kii si linimaln mɔmɔk ni,
u ga li joo si, nibaa taa pii si.
8U ga li kii si, saah choo pu na, ni saah ga li cha pu na,
dandana ni n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
A Song of Praise
1It made me glad when they said,
“Let's go to the house
of the Lord!”
2Jerusalem, we are standing
inside your gates.
3Jerusalem, what a strong
and beautiful city you are!
4Every tribe of the Lord
obeys him and comes to you
to praise his name.
5David's royal throne is here
where justice rules.
6Jerusalem, we pray
that you will have peace,
and that all will go well
for those who love you.
7May there be peace
inside your city walls
and in your palaces.
8Because of my friends
and my relatives,
I will pray for peace.
9And because of the house
of the Lord our God,
I will work for your good.
translation_text:
Jerusalem aatiŋ aapak
1M nan kpa mpopiin buyoonn bi nan bui mi ke,
“Cha ti buen Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni” na.
2Le dandana ti si Jerusalem aabisamɔi ni.
3Jerusalem ye kitiŋ ki bi ki gir maa ki na la;
ki ye kitiŋ ki ŋan ki kpa mpɔɔn na.
4Uwumbɔr aanib choo nima la, ke bi nan doon u,
waakaal aah mɔk pu na.
5Nima chee le Israel yaab aabɔrb nan kal ki jin baanib tibɔr.
6Mee Uwumbɔr ke u cha nsuudoon li bi Jerusalem ni man;
“Cha binib bi gee Jerusalem na kan liwangol.
7Cha nsuudoon li bi Jerusalem ni,
ki cha lifuur li bi kaabɔrdichal ni.”
8Ndo yaab ni njɔtiib pu le m bui Jerusalem aatiŋ ke,
“Nsuudoon li bi aa pu.”
9Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Aadichal pu
le m mee limeel ke Jerusalem kan liwangol.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Mercy
1Our Lord and our God,
I turn my eyes to you,
on your throne in heaven.
2Servants look to their master,
but we will look to you,
until you have mercy on us.
3Please have mercy, Lord!
We have been insulted
more than we can stand,
4and we can't take more abuse
from those proud,
conceited people.
translation_text:
Linimbaasaln aameel
1Uwumbɔr, m lik sin pu la, m lik paacham,
nin chee aa bi ki joo dulnyaa na.
2Tidindaan Uwumbɔr, unaagbiija aah bi udindaan pu,
aan unaagbiipiibo mu bi udindaan pu pu na,
kina le ti mu lik aa pu,
ki kii n‑yoonn mu aa ga san timi kinimbaak na.
3Uwumbɔr, san timi kinimbaak;
bi lik seen timi sakpen a, san timi kinimbaak.
4Biwankpadam laa timi, ni yunn sakpen,
le bigaadam bi muk timi na ŋani timi mbɔnyun.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1The Lord was on our side!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“The Lord was on our side!
Otherwise, the enemy attack
3would have killed us all,
because it was furious.
4We would have been swept away
in a violent flood
5of high and roaring waves.”
6Let's praise the Lord!
He protected us from enemies
who were like wild animals,
7and we escaped like birds
from a hunter's torn net.
8The Lord made heaven and earth,
and he is the one
who sends us help.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr le ye waanib aakikiir
1Israel yaab, gar mi man,
Uwumbɔr yaa kaa ba si tipuwɔb kan, ti ba bi la?
2“Uwumbɔr yaa kaa ba si tipuwɔb
buyoonn timi aadim tak timi na kan,
3bi ba ga nan di baaŋuusakpeln li bi kpa ti pu na nab timi;
4bi ba ga nan di timi buen ke nwam na,
ki biin ti pu ke tinyunkpenn na,
5tinyunkpenn sakpenn ngbaan ba ga cha ti bee nnyun ni.”
6Cha ti doon Uwumbɔr u kaa cha timi aadim kuln timi na.
7Ti ŋmar ke unyoon aah ŋmar nya ukpan aataŋ ni pu na la;
baataŋ koo, le ti ŋmar.
8Timi aaterm nyani Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni kitiŋ na chee la.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord's People Are Safe
1Everyone who trusts the Lord
is like Mount Zion
that cannot be shaken
and will stand forever.
2Just as Jerusalem is protected
by mountains on every side,
the Lord protects his people
by holding them in his arms
now and forever.
3He won't let the wicked
rule his people
or lead them to do wrong.
4Let's ask the Lord to be kind
to everyone who is good
and completely obeys him.
5When the Lord punishes
the wicked,
he will punish everyone else
who lives an evil life.
Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aanib aah kpa ŋŋmarm pu na
1Binib bi kii tii Uwumbɔr na naahn Sionn Aajool
li kaa damni, kaa foor kpala na la.
2Ŋijoo aah mann goln Jerusalem aatiŋ pu na,
kina le Uwumbɔr mu mann goln waanib n‑yoonn mue,
ni n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
3Bibiindam aan ŋmaa li joo bininyaam n‑yoonn mɔmɔk;
bi yaa joo bi kina kan,
nibaakan, bininyaam ngbaan mu ga nan tun titunwanbir.
4Uwumbɔr, li kpa bininyaam bi joo saakaal na pu tiŋann.
5Tɔ, aa yaa nan daa bibiindam aatafal kan,
aa daa binib bi yii saasan na mu aatafal.
Nsuudoon li bi Israel yaab pu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Celebrating the Harvest
1It seemed like a dream
when the Lord brought us back
to the city of Zion.
2We celebrated with laughter
and joyful songs.
In foreign nations it was said,
“The Lord has worked miracles
for his people.”
3And so we celebrated
because the Lord had indeed
worked miracles for us.
4Our Lord, we ask you to bless
our people again,
and let us be like streams
in the Southern Desert.
5We cried as we went out
to plant our seeds.
Now let us celebrate
as we bring in the crops.
6We cried on the way
to plant our seeds,
but we will celebrate and shout
as we bring in the crops.
translation_text:
Ŋŋmarm aameel
1Uwumbɔr aah nan di timi giin Jerusalem aatiŋ ni na,
ni nan naahn tidaŋ la.
2Ti nan laa, le ki gaa mpopiin aalahn. Le ŋitimbol ŋiken nan bui ke,
“Uwumbɔr tun ŋitukpaan tii bi.”
3Mbamɔn, u sil tun ŋitukpaan tii timi; ti kpa mpopiin sakpen a.
4Uwumbɔr, giin timi buen timi aatiŋ pu,
ke utaal aah joo ni nnyun nan tii imɔɔsan i kuur na pu na.
5Cha binib bi nan bi bu baajikaabim ki wii na nan chee ti, ni mpopiin.
6Binib bi tu lijikaabuul cha ki wii na ga di mpopiin aalahn le gir ni,
ba pu? bi ga chee njikaabim pam.

english_text:
(A song by Solomon for worship.)
Only the Lord Can Bless a Home
1Without the help of the Lord
it is useless to build a home
or to guard a city.
2It is useless to get up early
and stay up late
in order to earn a living.
God takes care of his own,
even while they sleep.
3Children are a blessing
and a gift from the Lord.
4Having a lot of children
to take care of you
in your old age
is like a warrior
with a lot of arrows.
5The more you have,
the better off you will be,
because they will protect you
when your enemies
attack you in court.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aaŋann aapak
1Uwumbɔr yaa kaa maa lidichal kan, udimaar aatuln ye fam la;
Uwumbɔr yaa kaa kiir kitiŋ kan,
ukikiir u si kii na aatuln ye fam la.
2Aa yaa fii kichakpiik ni mala
ki nan gir ni kijoobɔŋ ke aa tun ki kan kan, ni ye fam la.
Uwumbɔr aah gee binib bi na dɔ geen le u tii bi baah ban pu na.
3Mbim ye Uwumbɔr aapiin le ki tii timi; bi ye tinyoor bamɔnn la.
4Uja yaa pɔɔn ki kpa mbijabim kan,
bi bi ke ipiin i bi uja aaŋaal ni na la.
5Uja u kpa kina aapiin sakpen na kpa mpopiin.
U yaa ti yiŋ waadim libɔjil chee kan, waan lir kpala.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Rewards His Faithful People
1The Lord will bless you
if you respect him
and obey his laws.
2Your fields will produce,
and you will be happy—
all will go well.
3Your wife will be as fruitful
as a grapevine,
and just as an olive tree
is rich with olives,
your home will be rich
with healthy children.
4This is how the Lord will bless
everyone who respects him.
5I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion
and let Jerusalem prosper
as long as you live.
6May you live long enough
to see your grandchildren.
Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Ŋuntii aapar
1Binib bi san Uwumbɔr ki joo waakaal na kpa mpopiin.
2Saatuln le ga tii si saah ban pu na;
aa ga kan liwangol ki li kpa mpopiin.
3Aapuu ga li bi ke ŋisubil aasub bu lu na le saachiln ni,
le saabim ga li bi ke olif aasui i laa diin na saasambil taab.
4Uja u kii tii Uwumbɔr na ga sil kan kina aanyoor.
5Uwumbɔr u bi Sionn ni na, ŋa waanyoor ŋa aa pu.
Uwumbɔr cha Jerusalem aatiŋ kan liwangol saamɔfal aayoonn.
6Uwumbɔr cha aa li bi ki nan kan aayaabitiib.
Nsuudoon li bi Israel yaab pu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Protection
1Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
But they have not defeated me,
3though my back is like a field
that has just been plowed.”
4The Lord always does right,
and he has set me free
from the ropes
of those cruel people.
5I pray that all who hate
the city of Zion
will be made ashamed
and forced to turn and run.
6May they be like grass
on the flat roof of a house,
grass that dries up
as soon as it sprouts.
7Don't let them be like wheat
gathered in bundles.
8And don't let anyone
who passes by say to them,
“The Lord bless you!
I give you my blessing
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
Israel yaab aadim pu aameel
1Israel aatimbol, bui timi saah nan laa diin aan saadim muk si pu na aabɔr:
2“Maah nan laa ye ubo pu na le maadim nan joo mbiin muk mi,
le kaa ŋmaa nyaŋ mi.
3Bi nan chɔi mpuwɔb
le ni naahn ke baah mann ipɔn le bukpaab ni na.
4Le Uwumbɔr u ŋan na nan nyan mi tinaagbiir ni.”
5Cha bi nyaŋ ki jenn giin unii umɔk kaa gee Sionn aatiŋ na.
6Cha bi li bi ke timoor ti punn kidiik paab,
ki kuur kaa kee muun na;
7Ubaa aa chee ti, ki kuun ti, ki buu ti.
8Ubaa aan jer bi chee ki bui ke, “Uwumbɔr ŋa waanyoor ŋa ni pu;”
kaan bui ke, “Ti mee tinyoor Uwumbɔr aayimbil pu ŋa ni pu.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Trusting the Lord in Times of Trouble
1From a sea of troubles
I cry out to you, Lord.
2Won't you please listen
as I beg for mercy?
3If you kept record of our sins,
no one could last long.
4But you forgive us,
and so we will worship you.
5With all my heart,
I am waiting, Lord, for you!
I trust your promises.
6I wait for you more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
Yes, I wait more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
7Israel, trust the Lord!
God is always merciful
and has the power to save you.
8 Israel, the Lord will save you
from all your sins.
translation_text:
Limeel li ban nterm na
1Uwumbɔr, maasuubiin ponn ni le m yin si.
2Ndindaan, pel maawiil; pel maah yin ki ban nterm pu na.
3Aa yaa ba ŋmee timi aatunwanbir mɔmɔk bilni kan,
ubaa aa ba ga ŋmar kaa kpo.
4Le aa di cha pinn timi, ke ti li san si ijawaan.
5M kpa kikpeek le ki kii Uwumbɔr aaterm,
waamɔboln pu le m kpa limakl.
6M kpa kikpeek ki kii Uwumbɔr ki jer
kinyeek aakikiir aah kii kitaak aah ga woln buyoonn pu na.
7Uwumbɔr aageehm aah kaa kpelni na
aan u gee ke u gaa nimi lii n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na,
nimi Israel yaab, tii u naadii man.
8Uma le ga nyan waanib Israel yaab baatunwanbir mɔmɔk ni.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Trust the Lord!
1I am not conceited, Lord,
and I don't waste my time
on impossible schemes.
2But I have learned to feel safe
and satisfied,
like a young child
in its mother's arms.
3People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
now and forever.
translation_text:
Mbimbin mu bi suuna na aameel
1Uwumbɔr, m di cha kigaak aatuln kaa ki kpa kalimbaani.
Ntafal aa bi tibɔr ti jer mi na ni,
kaa bi tiwan ni pɔɔ jer maalan na ni.
2M bi suuna, le ki faar maah kpa ni na.
M bi suuna ke ubo aah pui una aataa pu pu na la.
3Israel yaab, tii Uwumbɔr naadii man dandana
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Is Always with His People
1Our Lord, don't forget David
and how he suffered.
2Mighty God of Jacob,
remember how he promised:
3“I won't go home
or crawl into bed
4or close my eyelids,
5until I find a home for you,
the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
6 When we were in Ephrath,
we heard that the sacred chest
was somewhere near Jaar.
7Then we said, “Let's go
to the throne of the Lord
and worship at his feet.”
8Come to your new home, Lord,
you and the sacred chest
with all its power.
9Let victory be like robes
for the priests;
let your faithful people
celebrate and shout.
10David is your chosen one,
so don't reject him.
11 You made a solemn promise
to David, when you said,
“I, the Lord, promise
that someone in your family
will always be king.
12If they keep our agreement
and follow my teachings,
then someone in your family
will rule forever.”
13You have gladly chosen Zion
as your home, our Lord.
14You said, “This is my home!
I will live here forever.
15I will bless Zion with food,
and even the poor will eat
until they are full.
16Victory will be like robes
for the priests,
and its faithful people
will celebrate and shout.
17 I will give mighty power
to the kingdom of David.
Each of my chosen kings
will shine like a lamp
18and wear a sparkling crown.
But I will disgrace
their enemies.”
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr Aadichal aah kpa kipak pu na
1Uwumbɔr, taa suln David,
ni waah nan jin falaa u mɔmɔk na pu.
2Uwumbɔr, teer tipuur ti u nan puu na tii si
u ye Mpɔɔnsakpiindaan u Jakob mu nan dii na.
3U nan puu ke, “Maan kun linampal, kaan doon geen,
4maan fuur, kaan geen,
5see m ti maa nin chee Uwumbɔr ga li koo na,
uma Uwumbɔr Mpɔɔndaan u tiyaaja Jakob nan dii u na.”
6Betlehem ni le ti ŋun Nkaal Aadakaa bɔr,
le ki ti kan u Jearim aakpaakon ni.
7Le ti bui ke, “Cha ti buen Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni man;
cha ti li dooni u waabɔrjal taab man.”
8Uwumbɔr, dii Nkaal Aadakaa u ye saapɔɔn aamɔkl na
koo Saadichal ni, ki nan li bi nima n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
9Cha saatotoorb li tun lituln li ŋan na n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
Cha saanib gaa mpopiin aalahn.
10Uwumbɔr, saah nan puu tipuur ti tii saatutunn David na;
taa yii saah lee ubɔr u na.
11Aa nan puu tipuur ti saan cha ti bee fam na tii David ke,
“M ga ŋa aajapɔɔn ubaa ubɔr,
uma le ga paan aa pu ki ji nnaan.
12Aajapɔtiib yaa dii mi mbamɔm,
ki kii ikaal i m di tii bi na kan,
bijapɔtiib mu le ga nan gaa nnaan,
ki li ye bibɔrb n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.”
13Uwumbɔr lee Sionn la; u ban u di nima le ŋa udo;
14u len ke, “Do le m ga li bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk,
do le m ban ke m li joo maanib.
15M ga di liwangol limɔk Sionn aatiŋ ban na tii ki;
m ga tii kaagiim tijikaar bi ji bab.
16M ga ŋa maanyoor ŋa kaatotoorb aatuln mɔmɔk pu,
le kaanib ga gaa mpopiin aalahn mpɔɔn pu.
17Do le m ga ŋa David aayaabitiib ubaa ubɔrkpaan;
do le m ga kaan ubɔr u m lee u na
ki ti saa n‑yoonn mu kaa kpa ndoon na.
18M ga jinn waadim inimɔɔn,
le waanaan ma ga pɔɔk ki kan liwangol.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Living Together in Peace
1It is truly wonderful
when the people of God
live together in peace.
2It is as beautiful as olive oil
poured on Aaron's head
and running down his beard
and the collar of his robe.
3It is like the dew
from Mount Hermon,
falling on Zion's mountains,
where the Lord has promised
to bless his people
with life forevermore.
translation_text:
Kinaabitiik aageehm aapak
1Uwumbɔr aanib yaa koo tɔb chee ni kimɔbaan kan,
ni kpa mpopiin sakpen a.
2Ni bi ke Uwumbɔr aakpan mu puu sunni Aaronn aayil,
ni ulangbaln, ki puu ti kɔl waawanpeenkaan aaneen ni na la.
3Ni naahn limaln li bi Hemonn Aajool paab,
ki lir ni Sionn aagongon pu na la.
Nima chee le Uwumbɔr puu ke u ga ŋa waanyoor
ti ye limɔfal li kaa kpa ndoon na ŋa bi pu.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Praising the Lord at Night
1Everyone who serves the Lord,
come and offer praises.
Everyone who has gathered
in his temple tonight,
2lift your hands in prayer
toward his holy place
and praise the Lord.
3The Lord is the Creator
of heaven and earth,
and I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aapak aayim
1Nimi Uwumbɔr aatutum mɔmɔk, dan ki nan pak u man,
nimi bi mɔmɔk dooni u Waadichal ni kinyeek na,
dan nan pak u man.
2Yoor niŋaal paacham Waadichal ni,
ki mee uma Uwumbɔr ki pak u man.
3Uwumbɔr u naan paacham ni taab, ki bi Sionn pu na,
ŋa waanyoor ŋa ni pu.

english_text:
In Praise of the Lord's Kindness
1Shout praises to the Lord!
You are his servants,
so praise his name.
2All who serve in the temple
of the Lord our God,
3come and shout praises.
Praise the name of the Lord!
He is kind and good.
4He chose the family of Jacob
and the people of Israel
for his very own.
5The Lord is much greater
than any other god.
6He does as he chooses
in heaven and on earth
and deep in the sea.
7The Lord makes the clouds rise
from far across the earth,
and he makes lightning
to go with the rain.
Then from his secret place
he sends out the wind.
8The Lord killed the first-born
of people and animals
in the land of Egypt.
9God used miracles and wonders
to fight the king of Egypt
and all of his officials.
10He destroyed many nations
and killed powerful kings,
11including King Sihon
of the Amorites
and King Og of Bashan.
He conquered every kingdom
in the land of Canaan
12and gave their property
to his people Israel.
13The name of the Lord
will be remembered forever,
and he will be famous
for all time to come.
14The Lord will bring justice
and show mercy to all
who serve him.
15 Idols of silver and gold
are made and worshiped
in other nations.
16They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
17They are completely deaf,
and they can't breathe.
18Everyone who makes idols
and all who trust them
will end up as helpless
as their idols.
19Everyone in Israel,
come praise the Lord!
All the family of Aaron
20and all the tribe of Levi,
come praise the Lord!
All of his worshipers,
come praise the Lord.
21Praise the Lord from Zion!
He lives here in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Kipak aalahn
1Pak Uwumbɔr man.
Uwumbɔr aatutum, pak waayimbil man.
2Nimi bi si Tidindaan Uwumbɔr Aadichal ni na, pak u man.
3Uwumbɔr aah ŋan pu na, pak u man;
u kpa tiŋann, gaa ilahn pak u man.
4U nyan Jakob ke u li ye uyoo,
u nyan Jakob aayaabitiib Israel yaab ke bi li ye waanib.
5M nyi ke Uwumbɔr kpa mpɔɔn, u kpa mpɔɔn jer ŋiwaa.
6U ŋani waah gee pu na paacham ni taab, ni nnyusakpem aataab.
7U cha kitaabuŋ nyani kitiŋ aanaanmɔk;
ki tii kitaabuŋ mmii mu moor lak lak na,
uma le ki cha libuln nyan ni waah siini waawan nin chee na.
8U nan ku njan aabijabim ni tiwakor aajan aawanja mɔmɔk Ijipt ni.
9Nima chee le u nan tun iwaan aatun,
ki di daa nima chee aabɔr, ni waaninkpiib aatafal.
10U kuln ŋitimbol pam ki ku bibɔrkpaam;
11u nan ku Amor yaab aabɔr Sihonn, ni Basann yaab aabɔr Og,
ni Kanaann aatiŋ aabɔrb mɔmɔk.
12U di baatim tii waanib Israel yaab.
13Uwumbɔr, n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan,
bi ga li mooni ke aa ye Uwumbɔr la.
Bi ga li teer saabɔr n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
14Uwumbɔr ga li kii waanib; u ga san waatutum kinimbaak.
15Ŋitimbol ŋi kaa nyi Uwumbɔr na di tikunabr ni salmaa le naan ŋiwaa;
unibɔn aaŋaal le naan ŋi.
16Ŋi kpa imɔi, le kaa tee ŋmaa len, ki kpa ŋinimbil, kaa tee waa.
17Ŋi kpa ŋitafal, kaa tee ŋun, ŋaa kpaan ŋmaa fuur.
18Cha binib bi mɔmɔk naan ŋi ki kpa ŋi pu limakl na
li gur bi ke ŋiwaa ŋi bi naan na.
19Israel aanib, pak Uwumbɔr man;
nimi Uwumbɔr aatotoorb, pak u man.
20Nimi Liifai yaab, pak Uwumbɔr man;
nimi bi mɔmɔk dooni u na, pak u man.
21Pak Uwumbɔr, Sionn aatiŋ ni, pak u, udo Jerusalem ni man.
Pak Uwumbɔr man.

english_text:
God's Love Never Fails
1 Praise the Lord! He is good.
God's love never fails.
2Praise the God of all gods.
God's love never fails.
3Praise the Lord of lords.
God's love never fails.
4Only God works great miracles.
God's love never fails.
5 With wisdom he made the sky.
God's love never fails.
6 The Lord stretched the earth
over the ocean.
God's love never fails.
7 He made the bright lights
in the sky.
God's love never fails.
8He lets the sun rule each day.
God's love never fails.
9He lets the moon and the stars
rule each night.
God's love never fails.
10 God struck down the first-born
in every Egyptian family.
God's love never fails.
11 He rescued Israel from Egypt.
God's love never fails.
12God used his great strength
and his powerful arm.
God's love never fails.
13 He split the Red Sea apart.
God's love never fails.
14The Lord brought Israel safely
through the sea.
God's love never fails.
15He destroyed the Egyptian king
and his army there.
God's love never fails.
16The Lord led his people
through the desert.
God's love never fails.
17Our God defeated mighty kings.
God's love never fails.
18And he killed famous kings.
God's love never fails.
19 One of them was Sihon,
king of the Amorites.
God's love never fails.
20 Another was King Og of Bashan.
God's love never fails.
21God took away their land.
God's love never fails.
22He gave their land to Israel,
the people who serve him.
God's love never fails.
23God saw the trouble we were in.
God's love never fails.
24He rescued us from our enemies.
God's love never fails.
25He gives food to all who live.
God's love never fails.
26Praise God in heaven!
God's love never fails.

A Prayer for Revenge
1Beside the rivers of Babylon
we thought about Jerusalem,
and we sat down and cried.
2We hung our small harps
on the willow trees.
3Our enemies had brought us here
as their prisoners;
now they wanted us to sing
and entertain them.
They insulted us and shouted,
“Sing about Zion!”
4Here in a foreign land,
how can we sing
about the Lord?
5Jerusalem, if I forget you,
let my right hand go limp.
6Let my tongue stick
to the roof of my mouth,
if I don't think about you
above all else.
7Our Lord, punish the Edomites!
On the day Jerusalem fell,
they shouted,
“Completely destroy the city!
Tear down every building!”
8 Babylon, you are doomed!
I pray the Lord's blessings
on anyone who punishes you
for what you did to us.
9May the Lord bless everyone
who beats your children
against the rocks!
translation_text:
Israel yaab aanaagbiir ponn ni aawiil
1Babiloŋ aamɔɔ chee le ti nan kal;
nima chee le ti nan teer Sionn aabɔr le ki wii.
2Ti nan di timi aabar leen isui i si nima na pu.
3Binib bi nan chur timi na nan bui timi ke ti gaa ilahn;
bi bui timi ke ti gaa mpopiin aalahn tii bi,
ki len ke, “Gaa nlahn mu ye Sionn aalahn na tii timi.”
4Ti ga ŋa kinye ki gaa nlahn tii Uwumbɔr kitiyayaŋ ponn ni?
5M yaa suln Jerusalem pu kan,
m taa ki ŋmaa gbaa kibeek daalbaadaal.
6M yaa kaa teer aabɔr,
ki dak aa pu ke sin le ye maamɔɔn sakpiin kan,
m taa ki ŋmaa gaa ilahn kpala.
7Uwumbɔr, teer Edom yaab aah nan ŋa pu
nwiin mundaal bidim nan nyaŋ Jerusalem na.
Teer baah nan len kpakpaayuk pu na ke,
“Ber ki bil kitiŋ man.”
8Babiloŋ aatiŋ, aa ga kuln.
Unii u teen si saah nan tun timi pu na kpa mpopiin,
9Unii u yoor saabipɔm
ki di lɔe ŋitakpal aan bi kpoi na kpa mpopiin.

english_text:
(By David.)
Praise the Lord with All Your Heart
1With all my heart
I praise you, Lord.
In the presence of angels
I sing your praises.
2I worship at your holy temple
and praise you for your love
and your faithfulness.
You were true to your word
and made yourself more famous
than ever before.
3When I asked for your help,
you answered my prayer
and gave me courage.
4All kings on this earth
have heard your promises, Lord,
and they will praise you.
5You are so famous
that they will sing about
the things you have done.
6Though you are above us all,
you care for humble people,
and you keep a close watch
on everyone who is proud.
7I am surrounded by trouble,
but you protect me
against my angry enemies.
With your own powerful arm
you keep me safe.
8You, Lord, will always
treat me with kindness.
Your love never fails.
You have made us what we are.
Don't give up on us now!
translation_text:
Idoon aameel
1Uwumbɔr, m joo nsui mɔmɔk dooni si la;
m gaa kipak aalahn tii si, bijojoob chee la.
2Saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na,
ni saah ŋani saah len pu na,
le m fenn lik saadichal wɔb,
ki gbaan kitiŋ ki pak saayimbil, ba pu?
aa mɔk ke saayimbil ni saakaal le jer tiwan mɔmɔk.
3M nan yin si, le aa kii maayim; aa di saapɔɔn le tii mi mpɔɔn.
4Uwumbɔr, dulnyaa wee ni aabɔrb mɔmɔk aah ŋun saah len pu na, le bi ga pak si.
5Bi ga di saah tun pu na, ni saapak sakpeŋ gaa ilahn.
6Aa bi paacham paacham la,
le aatafal tee bi binib bi sunn bibaa taab na ni,
le binib bi kpa kigaak na aan ŋmaa bɔr si.
7Buyoonn tibɔr ti mann goln mi ni kookoo na, le aa gaal mi lir.
Aa kiir maadim bi aaŋuul fii na ki joo saapɔɔn gaal mi lir.
8Aa ga ŋa saah puu tipuur ti na mɔmɔk.
Uwumbɔr, saageehm aa kpa ndoon.
Doo lituln li aa piin li na.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Lord Is Always Near
1You have looked deep
into my heart, Lord,
and you know all about me.
2You know when I am resting
or when I am working,
and from heaven
you discover my thoughts.
3You notice everything I do
and everywhere I go.
4Before I even speak a word,
you know what I will say,
5and with your powerful arm
you protect me
from every side.
6I can't understand all of this!
Such wonderful knowledge
is far above me.
7Where could I go to escape
from your Spirit
or from your sight?
8If I were to climb up
to the highest heavens,
you would be there.
If I were to dig down
to the world of the dead
you would also be there.
9Suppose I had wings
like the dawning day
and flew across the ocean.
10Even then your powerful arm
would guide and protect me.
11Or suppose I said, “I'll hide
in the dark until night comes
to cover me over.”
12But you see in the dark
because daylight and dark
are all the same to you.
13You are the one
who put me together
inside my mother's body,
14and I praise you because of
the wonderful way
you created me.
Everything you do is marvelous!
Of this I have no doubt.
15Nothing about me
is hidden from you!
I was secretly woven together
out of human sight,
16but with your own eyes you saw
my body being formed.
Even before I was born,
you had written in your book
everything about me.
17 Your thoughts are far beyond
my understanding,
much more than I
could ever imagine.
18I try to count your thoughts,
but they outnumber the grains
of sand on the beach.
And when I awake,
I will find you nearby.
19How I wish that you would kill
all cruel and heartless people
and protect me from them!
20They are always rebelling
and speaking evil of you.
21You know I hate anyone
who hates you, Lord,
and refuses to obey.
22They are my enemies too,
and I truly hate them.
23Look deep into my heart, God,
and find out everything
I am thinking.
24Don't let me follow evil ways,
but lead me in the way
that time has proven true.
translation_text:
Uwumbɔr aah nyi pel pel ki san kinimbaak pu na
1Uwumbɔr, aa ŋaŋ mi ki nyi maah bi pu na.
2Aa nyi maah ŋani tiwan nimɔk na;
aa bi dandar le ki nyi maah dak pu na.
3M yaa bi tun, bee m yaa ka fuur kan, aa waa mi;
aa nyi maatuln mɔmɔk.
4Waahr aan m nin len tibɔr na, aa puun nyi maah ga len pu na.
5Aa mann le ki ti goln mi ni kookoo; saapɔɔn le aa joo kii mi.
6Saah nyi mi pu na ti nyaŋ sakpen a; ni nyaŋ maah nyi pu na.
7Maan ŋmaa buen nibaa chee aan saa bi nima.
Maan ŋmaa buen nibaa chee kaa bi aanimbiin ni.
8M yaa ba buen paacham kan, aa bi nima chee;
m yaa ba sunn ti doon kitekpiitiŋ ni kan, aa bi nima chee.
9M yaa ba fii paacham ki buen liwipuul,
bee m yaa ba buen ti koo liwilir wɔb dandar dandar kan,
10aa ba ga li bi nima ki loln m pu nsan,
aa ba ga li bi nima ki ter mi.
11M ba ga bui libɔmbɔln ke li bɔr mi,
bee m bui nwiihn mu mann goln mi na ke mu kpaln kinyeek;
12le mbɔmbɔɔn aa bɔɔn aa chee,
kinyeek wiin chain ke nwiin pu na aa chee.
Mbɔmbɔɔn ni nwiihn ye tiwanbaan le aa chee.
13Sin le naan nwon mɔmɔk;
aa di mi kpaan tɔb ni, nna aaponn ni.
14M pak si; ba pu? Saah naan mi pu na kpa mi iwaan ni lijinjiir,
saatun mɔmɔk kpa iwaan, le aa nyi mi mbamɔm.
15Buyoonn maakpab nan bi naani suuna nna aaponn ni,
aan m bi muuni nima ubaa aa nyi na, aa nan nyi ke m bi nima,
16aa nan kan mi le bi nin ma mi.
Iwiin imɔk aa di tii mi na ŋmee ki bi saagbaŋ ni waahr
aan iwiin ngbaan ibaa nin piin.
17Uwumbɔr, saalandak ye m chee tiwankpaan la;
i wiir sakpen a.
18M yaa ban m kahn i kan, i ga li wiir jer limɔɔtambol.
M yaa dɔ geen ki ti finn kan, m beenin bi aa chee la.
19Uwumbɔr, m ba gee sakpen ke aa ku bibiindam.
M ba gee ke binib bi aabimbin pɔɔ na ba di cha mi suuna.
20Bi len aa pu tibɔbir;
bi len tiwan ni kaa ŋan na saayimbil pu.
21Uwumbɔr, m nan binib bi nan si na sakpen.
M lik seen binib bi yii si ki nyan aapuwɔb na.
22M sil nan bi kinanabamɔŋ la, m yin bi maadim la.
23Uwumbɔr, ŋaŋ mi, ki li nyi nsui ni;
tɔŋ mi, ki bee maalandak.
24Lik ke m kpa titunwanbir tibaa aan maa kpa,
ki mɔk mi nsan mu nan bi n‑yaayoonn na.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1Rescue me from cruel
and violent enemies, Lord!
2They think up evil plans
and always cause trouble.
3 Their words bite deep
like the poisonous fangs
of a snake.
4Protect me, Lord, from cruel
and brutal enemies,
who want to destroy me.
5Those proud people have hidden
traps and nets
to catch me as I walk.
6You, Lord, are my God!
Please listen to my prayer.
7You have the power to save me,
and you keep me safe
in every battle.
8Don't let the wicked succeed
in doing what they want,
or else they might never
stop planning evil.
9They have me surrounded,
but make them the victims
of their own vicious lies.
10Dump flaming coals on them
and throw them into pits
where they can't climb out.
11Chase those cruel liars away!
Let trouble hunt them down.
12Our Lord, I know that you
defend the homeless
and see that the poor
are given justice.
13Your people will praise you
and will live with you
because they do right.

(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Protection
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen when I pray
and hurry to help me.
2 Think of my prayer
as sweet-smelling incense,
and think of my lifted hands
as an evening sacrifice.
3Help me to guard my words
whenever I say something.
4Don't let me want to do evil
or waste my time doing wrong
with wicked people.
Don't let me even taste
the good things they offer.
5Let your faithful people
correct and punish me.
My prayers condemn the deeds
of those who do wrong,
so don't let me be friends
with any of them.
6Everyone will admit
that I was right
when their rulers are thrown
down a rocky cliff,
7and their bones lie scattered
like crushed rocks
on top of a grave.
8You are my Lord and God,
and I look to you for safety.
Don't let me be harmed.
9Protect me from the traps
of those violent people,
10and make them fall
into their own traps
while you help me escape.
translation_text:
Kijook aameel
1Uwumbɔr, m yin si; nan ter mi dandana.
Buyoonn m yin si na kan, pel m chee.
2Gaa maameel ke tulalee aayon aatork na,
ki gaa maaŋaal i m yoor paacham na ke kijook aatork na.
3Uwumbɔr, ban ukikiir kiir maamɔb,
ki taa cha m len tibɔr ti kaa ŋa na.
4Li kii mi aan m taa li neen ke m tun taani,
ki li kii mi m taa kpaan titunwanbirdam chee
baabiin aatuln ni.
Taa cha m kpaan bi chee baajim ponn ni.
5Unii u aabimbin ŋan na ga ŋmaa daa ntafal
ki di tibɔnyaan sur mi.
Maan tee gaa kinyuŋ titunwanbirdam chee, ba pu?
n‑yoonn mɔmɔk kan, m mee limeel baatunwanbir ngbaan pu la.
6Buyoonn baajojoob ti nyan ŋijoo paab ki ker lir ni na,
le binib ngbaan ga tii naadii ke maabɔr nan gbii.
7Baah lar idɔ pu ki chɔi chɔi i na,
kina le baakpab ga yaa likaakul aamɔgben chee.
8Ndindaan Uwumbɔr, le m ma kii tii si n‑yoonn mɔmɔk.
M ban saakiirn; taa cha m kpo.
9Li kii mi, m taa koo gaawɔb,
ni kakpalkaa mam bi titunwanbirdam di pen mi na ni.
10Cha bibiindam gir lir bibaa aagaawɔb mam ponn ni,
aan mma taa koo titotonn tibaa ni.

english_text:
(A special psalm and a prayer by David when he was in the cave.)
A Prayer for Help
1 I pray to you, Lord.
I beg for mercy.
2I tell you all my worries
and my troubles,
3and whenever I feel low,
you are there to guide me.
A trap has been hidden
along my pathway.
4Even if you look,
you won't see anyone
who cares enough
to walk beside me.
There is no place to hide,
and no one who really cares.
5I pray to you, Lord!
You are my place of safety,
and you are my choice
in the land of the living.
Please answer my prayer.
I am completely helpless.
6Help! They are chasing me,
and they are too strong.
7Rescue me from this prison,
so I can praise your name.
And when your people notice
your wonderful kindness to me,
they will rush to my side.
translation_text:
David aah nan be kitakpaluŋ ni na, le u nan mee limeel limina.
1M yin Uwumbɔr ki ban nterm la; m gaŋni u la.
2M joo ni maamuk mɔmɔk u chee la; m tuk u maabɔr mɔmɔk.
3Buyoonn m ti gor ke m di cha na,
u nyi maah ba ga ŋa tiwan ni na.
Maah chuun nsan mu pu na le maadim pen mi gaawɔb.
4M yaa fenn lik nsikakl mɔmɔk kan, ubaa aa bi ki ga ter mi,
ubaa aa bi ki ga li kii mi, ubaa aatafal aa bi m ni.
5Uwumbɔr, m wii yin si ki ban nterm la;
Uwumbɔr, sin le ye u kii mi na.
Sin le ye tiwan ni mɔmɔk m ban maamɔfal ponn ni na.
6Pel maaterm aawiil yee, itaakpayɔl le ban i ku mi.
Gaa mi maadim chee lii; bi pɔɔ nyaŋ mi.
7Nyan mi maasuubiin ni, le m ga pak si, saanib aakuun ni,
ba pu? aa kpa m pu tiŋann sakpen.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer in Time of Danger
1Listen, Lord, as I pray!
You are faithful and honest
and will answer my prayer.
2 I am your servant.
Don't try me in your court,
because no one is innocent
by your standards.
3My enemies are chasing me,
crushing me in the ground.
I am in total darkness,
like someone long dead.
4I have given up hope,
and I feel numb all over.
5I remember to think about
the many things you did
in years gone by.
6Then I lift my hands in prayer,
because my soul is a desert,
thirsty for water from you.
7Please hurry, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
I feel hopeless.
Don't turn away
and leave me here to die.
8Each morning let me learn
more about your love
because I trust you.
I come to you in prayer,
asking for your guidance.
9Please rescue me
from my enemies, Lord!
I come to you for safety.
10You are my God. Show me
what you want me to do,
and let your gentle Spirit
lead me in the right path.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
and keep my life safe.
Use your saving power
to protect me from trouble.
12I am your servant.
Show how much you love me
by destroying my enemies.
translation_text:
Limeel li ban nterm na
1Uwumbɔr, ŋun maameel.
Saaŋann pu, ŋun maah gaŋni si pu na.
Aa ye mbamɔndaan, kii maagaŋ ngbaan.
2Taa ji mi, saatutunn tibɔr;
ubaa aa bi kaa kpa taani aa chee.
3Maadin ban mi, ki chuu mi, ki nyaŋ mi kookoo a.
U di mi ŋa kiyondiik bɔmbɔɔn na ni,
le m gur bi ke binib bi kpoi n‑yaayoonn na.
4Kina pu na, m gor ke m di cha la, ntaakpab yɔl kookoo a.
5M teer n‑yoonn mu jer na;
m dak saah nan tun pu n‑yoonn ngbaan na,
saatun mɔmɔk beenin bi n‑yil ni.
6M yoor ŋŋaal paacham ki mee si;
m neen si ke kitikuun aah neen nnyun pu na la.
7Uwumbɔr, ŋun maayim dandana wee,
maa ki kpa ntaakpab pɔɔn mubaa.
Taa di aabaa bɔr mi, ni yaa kaa ye kina kan,
m ga li gur kpaan binib bi bi kitekpiitiŋ ni na chee la.
8Kichakpiik mɔmɔk ni kan,
teer mi saageehm mu bi n‑yoonn mɔmɔk na pu;
ba pu? sin pu le m kpa limakl.
Maameel chaa aa chee paacham la;
mɔk mi nsan mu m ga dii na.
9Uwumbɔr, aa chee le m chaa ti ban nkiirm;
gaa mi maadim chee lii.
10Sin le ye Maawumbɔr; mɔk mi aan m ŋa saageehn.
Li gee mi, ki mɔk mi nsanyaan.
11Uwumbɔr, saah nan puu ke aa ga ŋa pu na, gaa mi lii;
saaŋann sakpenn pu, nyan mi maabɔr ni.
12Saah gee mi pu na pu, ku maadim,
ki kuln binib bi mɔmɔk muk mi na,
ba pu? m ye saatutunn la.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for the Nation
1I praise you, Lord!
You are my mighty rock,
and you teach me
how to fight my battles.
2You are my friend, my fortress,
where I am safe.
You are my shield,
and you made me the ruler
of our people.
3 Why do we humans mean anything
to you, our Lord?
Why do you care about us?
4We disappear like a breath;
we last no longer
than a faint shadow.
5Open the heavens like a curtain
and come down, Lord.
Touch the mountains
and make them send up smoke.
6Use your lightning as arrows
to scatter my enemies
and make them run away.
7Reach down from heaven
and set me free.
Save me from the mighty flood
8of those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth.
9In praise of you, our God,
I will sing a new song,
while playing my harp.
10By your power, kings win wars,
and your servant David is saved
from deadly swords.
11Won't you keep me safe
from those lying foreigners
who never tell the truth?
12Let's pray that our young sons
will grow like strong plants
and that our daughters
will be as lovely as columns
in the corner of a palace.
13May our barns be filled
with all kinds of crops.
May our fields be covered
with sheep by the thousands,
14and every cow have calves.
Don't let our city be captured
or any of us be taken away,
and don't let cries of sorrow
be heard in our streets.
15Our Lord and our God,
you give these blessings
to all who worship you.
translation_text:
Ubɔr aah kan linyaŋ ki doon Uwumbɔr pu na
1Pak Uwumbɔr man, u ye maakikiir la.
U gor mi kiir kijaak ki toor mi kiir butɔb.
2Uma le ye maakikiir, ki si mpuwɔb;
uma le ye nin chee m bɔrni na, uma le gaal mi lir,
u chee le m mak ke nibaa aan ŋa mi.
U cha m ye ŋitimbol aayidaan.
3Uwumbɔr, unibɔn ye ba aan aatafal bi u ni;
unibɔn mu, le aa cha aatafal bi u ni.
4U bi ke litakpiln libaa aabuln na la;
waamɔfal naahn kijunjuŋ ki bi jer na la.
5Uwumbɔr, chuu daa kar kitaapaak ki sunn ni;
di aaŋaal meeh ŋijoo, aan ŋi nya iŋmanyuu.
6Cha utaal moor ki yaa saadim; too saapiin aan bi san yaa.
7Nya ni paacham, chuu daa nyan mi nnyun mu nyoo na ni,
ki gaa mi lii;
nyan mi biwɔwɔm bi kaa len ibamɔn,
8ki puur tipuur inyamɔn pu na aapɔɔn ni.
9Uwumbɔr, m ga gaa nlahnpɔɔn tii si,
m ga gbaa kibeek ki gaa ilahn tii si.
10Aa tii bibɔrb linyaŋ, ki gaa saatutunn David lii.
11Gaa mi maadim bi ye bibiindam na chee lii;
nyan mi biwɔwɔm bi kaa len ibamɔn
ki puur tipuur inyamɔn ni na aapɔɔn ni.
12Cha tijapɔtiib li bi ke isui i muuni ki pɔɔ na baanachipɔnn ni.
Cha tibisatiib li bi ke ŋigonyaan ŋi tii libɔrchiln kinyaan na.
13Cha timi aapil li gbii tijikaar mɔmɔk aabɔŋ.
Cha timi aapiih i bi kipihkpaamook ni na pɔr churbakaa.
14Cha timi aanaa pɔr ki taa li nyeeni lir, ki taa kpoi.
Taa cha mpombiin aawiil li bi timi aatim ponn ni.
15Litimbol li kpa kina na kpa mpopiin;
binib bi Aadindaan ye Uwumbɔr na kpa mpopiin.

english_text:
(By David for praise.)
The Lord Is Kind and Merciful
1I will praise you,
my God and King,
and always honor your name.
2I will praise you each day
and always honor your name.
3You are wonderful, Lord,
and you deserve all praise,
because you are much greater
