23Yada nan kaah kaa la nan foon nin, nsiimin nan ŋa ti biloondiikɔɔb le, le ki loon ti ki nan kpaa n-yonn man wee Uwonbɔr nan kpiir yada a ŋaam a bɔr ki wɔɔn ti-n. 24Mambu, nsiim nmɔn nan ye uguguur le ki jɔɔ ti chaa Masiya ban, naah li ŋa man wee Uwonbɔr n len ke ti bɔr ŋan yada bu. 25Daandaan nan yada a ŋaam a sam kaah dan nan, nsiimin kaa ji ye ti guguuru wi.
26Ni biɛn nan ye Uwonbɔr a buwaab le naah ŋa Masiya yada-n bu. 27Nim ban wee bi fun ni Uwonbɔr a nyunful Masiya a yinlin nin, nim le ta Masiya ki yee ke kuwan yeewaŋin. 28Mambu, nbɔgirim kaa ji be ban ye Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaab a sisiigin ni, kaa be biyom nin ban ye bi ba nan a sisiigin ni, kaa be bijab nin bipiib mu a sisiigin ni, ni ma bu ni biɛn ye nba le Masiya ni. 29Ni ye Masiya le ye ni ke, man ke ni ye Abiraham a yaabili le, ki li ji u faal ke Uwonbɔr a mɔsiinlin kaah wɔɔn man nin.

english_text:
1Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs. 2This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set. 3This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
4But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law, 5 so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children. 6 Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father. 7You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised.
Paul's Concern for the Galatians
8Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real. 9But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers? 10You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years. 11I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
12My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me 13when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick. 14My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself. 15Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me. 16Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
17Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention. 18It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you. 19My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you. 20I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled.
Hagar and Sarah
21Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says? 22 In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free. 23The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
24All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave. 25Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
26 But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave. 27 The Scriptures say about her,
“You have never had children,
but now you can be glad.
You have never given birth,
but now you can shout.
Once you had no children,
but now you will have
more children than a woman
who has been married
for a long time.”
28My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was. 29 But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today. 30 The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.” 31My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_text:
1Maah len man nmɔn wɔɔn le ke ufaajir nmɔn kaah le la ye kibigin, nin waah le jɔɔ nan nmɔn biɛn yɔli, waa yin jɔɔ nbɔgirim nin uyomi. 2U yin be ban guu win nin u toon tun ninkpeebin a nɔɔn le, hali ki nan kpaa u baa kaah nan siin u n-yonn man nin. 3Man mu le ye ti, taah la nan ye nbuwaab Yisa a samin yaan nin, dulinya nan a maabiyiɛrug nan ŋmag ti le ke biyomin. 4N-yonn nmɔn kaah nan nan foon biɛn nin, le Uwonbɔr tun U tɔɔl a bija, wan wee upii ma u, wee nsiim ŋmag u, 5ke un ŋa nkpenim a manug ki nyan ban be nsiim nmɔn yaan nin, wee ti kpann Uwonbɔr a bibamɔm.
6Naah ye Uwonbɔr a buwaabin bu le Uwonbɔr tun U big nmɔn a Naaŋ le ki dan ki nan be ti sufu ni, le kinaaŋ nmɔn yi ke, “Ti dindaau, ti baa.” 7Mambu, ŋaa ji ye uyomi, amaa a nin ye Uwonbɔr a big le; ŋaah ye U big n bu, le U ŋaaŋ U faajiru mu.
Pɔɔl a baga kaah be Galantiya yaabin man
8N-yonn man nan jon wee naa la nan nyi Uwonbɔr nan, ni nan ye biyom le ki sei Uwonbɔr kaah naan tiwann tan kaa ye iween nin. 9Amaa daandaan nan ni nin nyi Uwonbɔr, bee Uwonbɔr nyi ni, ke ba ŋa wee ni ji ban ni jir ki nɔɔ dulinya nan a maabiyiɛrug kan ye idaburig nin kunyunyunbaag a binbem nan naa? Ni ban ni kpann tiwann nmɔn a yomi le jigin naa? 10Ni ji iweehn nin iŋmal nin iyoo nin ibin a chiig le! 11N san ni bijawaam le, maah tun nan ki jiin ni paamin nan gab yɔli bu.
12N nabum n balin ni le, ni li be ke min na, ke maah be ke nim man nin. Naa galimi. 13Ke naah nyi man nin, maah nan bu-n bu le n nan chinn ki mɔɔn tibɔŋann nan ki sei ni. 14Hali nin n wiɛn nmɔn kaah nan mugir ni nan biɛn na, amaa naa nan yim yɔli bee ki yii mi, ni gaam le ke Uwonbɔr a malaka-n, ki ji gaam ke Masiya baantɔɔlin. 15Ni mɔmin biɛn be laa? N li fir ji siɛra ke, ni ye ni bi li fir ke, ni bi li chee ki logir ni numbili ki seim. 16Amaa daandaan nan n nin kpann ni dundaau le maah bei ni ibamɔn nin buu?
17Bininfob biba jɔɔ inunman ki ban ni ta ni baga ŋa bi ni, amaa naa ye ni ŋam bu le bi ŋaan nmɔn ni. Bi ban bin ta ni ŋa bicham ti ban, naah li ŋa man wee ni li jɔɔ inunman ki ta ni baga ŋa bi ni. 18Ni ŋan ni li jɔɔ inunman, ni ye ni tun nin ni ŋam bu, wee ni li ye man ki jɔɔ chaa ki laa ye n-yonn man wee n nan be ni ban a binba. 19N bijiɛkaam, ni wum le ke nmarwiɛn kaah choo upii ke ni wuu man nin, ki nan kpaa n-yonn man wee ni na li chegir Masiya a sam nan yaan. 20N bi ban n li be ni ban daandaan nan wee ki mann kpenn n kukɔl, nan bu-n n lam ŋmarin le ni bu.
Hega nin Sɛra a magil
21Ni beim ni, nim ban ban nsiim li ŋmag ni nan, naa nyi nsiim nmɔn kaah len man naa? 22Ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke Abiraham nan jɔɔ nbijabum milee le, uba a na nan ye uyom le wan gurin mu a na nan ye upii wan ye uba. 23U bija wan wee upiiyomin nan maa-n, u nan ma u le ke bininfob kaah maa man nin; amaa u bija wan wee upii wan ye uba-n nan maa-n, u nan ma u le ke Uwonbɔr kaah nan siin u mɔsiinl man nin.
24Ni niɛ li fir ta, pag wonn a poolin ke, bipiib bilee nan si Uwonbɔr a poor a kerim milee a sisiimin le, uyom nmɔn a yinl li nan ye: Hega; le u si tipoor tan wee Uwonbɔr nan poo Sinai a jɔɔl a paabin a sisiim, le ki nan ma u big tiyomirin. 25Daandaan nan Hega si ki sei Sinai a jɔɔl lan be Arabiya a tiŋin nin le, ki nann dulinya nan a Jerusalam le, nan bu-n u ma nin u buwaab be tiyomirin le. 26Amaa Jerusalam kan be papaab nan ma ye u ba le, le ki ye ti na. 27 Ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke:
“Upiiŋɔɔbee, che ni li mɔŋa,
fin wan kaa la nyi ma nbuwaab nan;
li yigin ki le sɔɔlin na,
fin wan kaa la nyi nmarwiɛn a tom nan;
nan bu-n upii wan a chal yii u nan a buwaab yab ki jon
upii wan jɔɔ chal nan a buwaaba.”
28N nabum daandaan nan ni nann Azig le, ni ye Uwonbɔr a buwaab le, U mɔsiinlin bu. 29Iyaayoo nmɔn, baah nan ma wan ke bininfob kaah maa bi buwaab man nin, nan mugir wan wee bi ma u Kinaaŋ a pɔɔmin nin, ni ye man le daandaan nan. 30Amaa Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin bei ke nii? “Ŋɔɔr upiiyomin nin u bigin ki jaau, upiiyom a big nin upii wan ye u ba nan a big kaa li fir lagin por lifaali.” 31Mambu n nabum, taa ye upiiyom nmɔn a buwaabi, amaa ti ye upii wan ye u ba nan a buwaab le.

english_text:
Christ Gives Freedom
1Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
2I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised. 3If you do, you must obey the whole Law. 4And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace. 5But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ. 6If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
7You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth. 8And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you. 9 A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough, 10but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
11My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised. 12I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
13My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love. 14 All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself. 15But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves.
God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
16If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires. 17 The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should. 18But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
19People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds. 20They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are 21envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
22God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful, 23gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways. 24And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires. 25God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit. 26But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_text:
Li mann ŋmag a ye n ba
1Ye n ba bu le Masiya nan nyan ti tiyomirin. Mambu mann sir nbamɔma, ki laa ji ta tiyomir a naajadaag paan a baa bu.
2Ni gbirim! Min Pɔɔl bei ni le ke ni ye ni la ŋmag lipunjiil a siimin ke, ni wɔɔn ke Masiya kaa jɔɔ tinyɔɔr tiba biɛn ki sei ni. 3N bei ni le jigin, uninfo biɛn wan ŋmag lipunjiil a siimin ke, ni kpaa le nin un ŋmag nsiim nmɔn biɛn. 4Nim ban pɔɔn ni ba ke Uwonbɔr n len ke ni bɔr ŋan nsiim a ŋmagim bu-n, ni pii bɔgir ni ba Masiya ban na, ki nyan ni ba Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl n-yaan na. 5Amaa yada bu, le kinaaŋ sei ti npɔɔn le ti jɔɔ tama ki guu nbuchin binben a yonn. 6Ni ma bu Masiya ban, taah jii ti pun bee taah kaa jii kaa kpaa talari. Nan kpaa talar le ye yada kan be npaanin nin njiɛm.
7Ni nan ti tun nbamɔm le. Ke ŋma ŋɔɔr ni ke ni laa ji nɔɔ ibamɔn nmɔn naa? 8Kularug nmɔn kaa nyan Uwonbɔr wan yin ni ban ni. 9“Boroboro a nyɔgim wama le che boroboro a yom fugir ki do.” 10Uyudaan bu n jɔɔ tidindann ke naa ji li jɔɔ lipotiɛl liba kpiɛ. Uninfo wan ŋmarin ni potiɛl nmɔn ke, Uwonbɔr li dar u daan a tul, ni baga kaa be waah ye wan ni. 11N nabum, ni ye n la bi mɔɔn lipunjiil a bɔr le ke, ba ŋa wee bi ji mugirim maa? Ni ye man ke igalin yan nan ŋa lidapunpunl bu n gab yɔliu. 12Min bi ban ke bininfob ban mugir ni lipunjiil bu nan n bin jiɛn lipunjiil wee ki li faar bi bau.
13N nabum, Uwonbɔr le nan yin ni le ni kpann ban ye biba. Amaa ni li nyi ni nɔɔ ye nba nmɔn bu ki tun tigbanann a kɔlisa a toon; amaa ni li tun tenn tab nin njiɛma. 14Nsiim nmɔn biɛn li lagin ki ŋa lisiinjal lan len ke: “Li jiɛ a kunkɔɔn tab ke ŋaah jiɛ a ba man nin.” 15Ni ye ni gbaa boo tab ki tenn tab ndam ke, ni li nyi ke ni li bii tab.
Kinaaŋ nin tigbanann a binbem a bɔr
16N bei ni le, ni li nɔɔ Kinaaŋ a binbema, wee tigbanann a bir a kɔlisa a toon laa be nin ni. 17Tigbanann kaah ban nan nin kaa chee sei kinaaŋ kaah ban nan nin ni, le kinaaŋ mu kaah ban nan nin kaa chee sei tigbanann kaah ban nan nin ni. I kɔn nin tab le, ni ma le che naa fir tun naah ban nan ni. 18Amaa ni ye kinaaŋin lii ni sam ke, nsiim kaa ŋmag ni.
19Tigbanann a binbem be npaan ni le, ni ma ye: Iwanchɔgin toon lipiibanlin bee lijabanlin, tijaginn a toon, nwanchɔgin binben, 20nin libawol manil nin kusɔɔg; kininaŋ, likɔnl, lipiiponl, liŋuul, npooton a bam, kumaabiyiɛrug, nbɔgirim, 21nin linunchɔril, lidanyugbeel, nin lidanyugbeel a toonbir, nin ban tun man a booli. N bei ni le ke maah pii nan bei ni man nin, ban tun man nmɔn kaa na li kɔɔ Uwonbɔr a naamin ni.
22Amaa kinaaŋin a looi le ye njiɛm, nmɔn, nposɔɔn, limɔril, tiŋann, nbinben ŋan, si nba bu, 23nin jiininba, ki kpiɛ choonba. Nsiim nba kaa ji be wee ki li bii ban tun nan ni. 24Masiya kaah ye ban nin ta tigbanann a kɔlisa nin bi binben biimin biɛn ki kpaa lidapunpunl buu. 25Taah be kinaaŋin bu-n, ni che ti nɔɔ kinaaŋ nmɔn a tabogi. 26Ni laa che ti li jɔɔ kalanbaani nin tab, bee ki fiin tab a ŋuui, bee ki li jɔɔ linunchɔril nin tabi.

english_text:
Help Each Other
1My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself. 2You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
3If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong. 4Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others. 5We each must carry our own load.
6Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
7You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant. 8If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life. 9Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up. 10We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord.
Final Warnings
11You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
12Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ. 13They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised. 14But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
15It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
16If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
17 On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
18My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_text:
Naah li tug tab a tugi man
1N nabum, ni ye ni kan uba tun titoonbir ke, nim ban be nin Kinaaŋin ni ter mu soon wee un mann ki sir nbamɔm, amaa wee ki li nyi ni ba bu, naa ye man ke ni mu li kɔɔ libiginlin. 2Ni li tug tab a tugi ya man, ni ye ni ŋaan man ke, ni li gbeen Masiya a siimin. 3Ni ye uninfo tiɛr ke u ye niba, wee kaah sin ye niba ke, u lar u ba le. 4Uninfo biɛn nmag u ba a toon ya. Wee ki nin fir ki fa u gbingbanl u toon ŋan bu, ki laa jɔɔ u ba magir u kpiɛgi, 5uninfo biɛn ntum u tɔɔl a tugil.
6Bininfob ban gaa Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin a wɔɔmin, ni kpaa le nin bin por baah jɔɔ niwann ŋann nan biɛn ki sei wan wɔɔnn bi.
7Ni laa che bin lar ni: Uwonbɔr kaa ye kuwanlawaŋi. Uninfosaal chiɛ waah bun niwann nan le. 8Wan bun u tɔɔl a gbanann a bam a wan booli ke, u na yin chiɛ nkum le; wan mu bun iwanbool yan gbee kinaaŋin a num ke, u na yin chiɛ limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmin le kinaaŋ ban. 9Mambu ni laa che ti bag itoon ŋan a tum bu, ni ye taa jiɛn itoon ŋan a tum ke ti na li kan tinyɔɔr n-yonn man chaan nan. 10Mambu, taah kan nsan nin ti li tun itoon ŋan, ni che ti li tun itoon ŋan ki tenn bininfob biɛn na, naah dii tɔɔ ban bu le ye ban ye biwonjiɛm a niin yaab.
Ikpaan yan joor nin ipoor
11Ni kan maah ta min tɔɔl a nɔɔ ki sɔb isɔb gbingbem yan ki sei na! 12Bininfob ban ban bin wɔɔn biba a ŋam npaan ni nin bi ma mugir ni ke ni jii ni pun. Nan bu che bi ŋaan man ye baa ban biba nmugir bi Masiya a dapunpunlin bu. 13Ban jiil bi pun nmɔn gbaa kaa nɔɔ nsiimin ni, nin ni ma biɛn ni le ki ban ni jii ni pun wee bi li jɔɔ far bi gbingban ni gbanann a binbem bu. 14Min kaa li nyi ki fa ligbingbanli, see ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a dapunpunlin a binba bu, u dapunpunl nmɔn le ku kutingbɔŋ nan a kɔlisa n gbanann nin, le n mu a kɔlisa nyan kutingbɔŋin na. 15Uninfo wan jii nin wan kaa jii kaa ye niba; nan kpaa talar le ye kuwonaaŋ pɔŋin. 16Uwonbɔr a posɔɔm nin u nyunyunbasanl li be ban nɔɔ nwɔɔm nan bu, hali nin ban ŋa Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin yada-n ban ye Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin biɛn.
17N bɔjoor kaar ye nan le, uba laa ji mugirimi, n pii jɔɔ Yisa a daagim n gbanann nin.
18N nabum, ti Yudaau Yisa a nyunyunbasanl li be nin ni naam. Ibamɔn.

english_text:
1 From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus.
To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
2I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
3Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven! 4Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people. 5God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children. 6God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
7-8 Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding, 9and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways. 10Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
11God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us. 12He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him. 13Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God. 14The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised.
Paul's Prayer
15I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people. 16So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers. 17I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God. 18My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
19I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used 20 when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven. 21There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well. 22 God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything. 23The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_text:
1Min Pɔɔl wan ye Masiya a toom Uwonbɔr a bamin nin,
N sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfogann kaab ban be Efesusi, ki si bi yada-n Masiya ban nin:
2Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be nin ni.
Kinaaŋ a kaar tan be Masiya ni
3Pagim Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a Baa, wan ŋa tikaar jaa ti bu, tikaar tan biɛn nyan papaab ki ye Kinaaŋ a kaar tan be nin Masiya nan. 4Uwonbɔr kaah kaa la nan naan dulinya n-yonn man nin, le U nan gann tim ke ti li be kasi ki laa jɔɔ igalin U ban ni. U jiɛm bu, 5U pii nan lol ke U li ta ti ki kpann U buwaab Yisa Masiya bu, U nan lol man le U nungbeelin nin U bam, 6che ti pag Uwonbɔr U jilima nin U nyunyunbasanl lan wee U sei ti yɔli U bijiɛkaagin ni.
7Yisa a chamin bu le ti kan nkpenim a manug, ni ma ye tibir a jiɛn per, Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl takpenlin bu 8man wee u kpaar tinyɔɔr takpem jaa ti bu nin nlam nin nbiɛm biɛn. 9Le U kpiir wɔɔn ti nan wee U nan woon lol U bamin ke un tun nin Masiya, U nungbeel a ŋamin nin, 10n-yonn nmɔn nan foo ke, U ni li tun ki gbeen U lol nmɔn, ki lagin waah nan naan nan papaab nin tum biɛn, wee Masiya li ye uyudaan.
11Masiya ni le Uwonbɔr nan gann ti mu, ki ta ti kpann U tɔɔl a ninfob nin waah ban niwann biɛn ntun man U bamin, 12wee tim ban chinn jɔɔ tama Masiya ni-n, nsei U kupag nin jilima.
13Ni tɔɔl nan kpiɛ ki be nin Masiya le, naah nan gbir imɔleen yan ye ibamɔn nin, ki ye ni feeja a bɔŋann nin. Naah ŋa yada-n bu, le Uwonbɔr ta U yaa daagim ki daag ni, lan ye limɔsiinl Kasi a Naaŋin, 14Kasi a naaŋ nmɔn li ye lifaal nmɔn a siɛra hali nin n-yonn man wee ti na li kan nkpenim a manug tim ban ye U ninfobin, tim li pagir U ki tenn U kupag.
Pɔɔl a wonmiɛl
15Mambu n-yonn man wee n nan gbir naah ŋa ti Yudaau Yisa yada nin naah jiɛ Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaab a bɔr man nin, 16n tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog ni bu kaa ta jiɛn ni, ki tiɛr ni bu n wonmiɛlin. 17N le miɛ ti Baa wan ye ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a Wonbɔru, ki ye ti Baa wan ye jilimadaan nin ke, Un sei ni Kinaaŋ a lam nin kpiir wɔɔn, wee ni mann biɛ U nbamɔm. 18N ji miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke Un ligir ni sufu wee ni biɛ tama kan bu wee U yin ni-n, ki ji biɛ U jilima takpenl a faal lan wee U nan siin limɔsiinl ki sei U ninfogannkaabin, 19nin U pɔɔn takpem man yab kaa jɔɔ magim wee U ta sei tim ban ŋa U yada-n. Npɔɔn nmɔn tun ki nann lipɔɔn gbingbemil le, 20U pɔɔm nmɔn le U nan ta ki fiin Masiya nkumin ki ta U kaan U nɔɔjiim paam papaab, 21niin le Masiya be ki jɔɔ npɔɔn man jon nnaam a pɔɔm, ki jon tininkper a pɔɔm, ki jon ipɔɔn biɛn, nin nnaam a yerin, ki jon iyin yan be daandaan nan nin yan la yin dan n-yonn man chaan nin na. 22Le Uwonbɔr ta niwann biɛn ŋa u nɔɔn, le ki gann u ke u li ye biwonjiɛn a laguŋ a yudaau. 23Biwonjiɛm a laguŋ nmɔn le ye U gbanann, le U gbanann nmɔn gbee nin U ma Masiya a pɔɔm, le U mu gbee nin niwann biɛn.

english_text:
From Death to Life
1 In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God. 2You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God. 3Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
4-5But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you. 6God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven. 7God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done. 8You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own. 9It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about. 10God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are.
United by Christ
11Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised. 12At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God, 13and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
14Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body 15 to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace. 16 On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body. 17 Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God. 18And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
19You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God. 20You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone. 21Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord. 22And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_text:
Nkum a nyam nin limiɛfolin a kɔɔm
1Nim bu ke, ni nan ye bitakpiib le nin ban bii nsiim ni toonbir bu. 2Naah nan be nsiim a biim nin ni toonbirin ki nɔɔ dulinya nan a sam nin kutingbɔŋ nan a yudaau a naamin, nin kinaaŋ kan tun nin bininfob ban kaa jɔɔ limɔcheelin. 3Ti biɛn nan be nsiim a biim nin tibirin nmɔn yaan le, ki tun ti tɔɔl a gbanann a kɔlisa a toon, ki tun nan mɔ ki sei ti gbanann a bam nin ti sufu. A li ke bi ma-n, ti nan ye ban li ji Uwonbɔr a ŋuufiiŋin a fala le.
4Amaa Uwonbɔr a jiɛm kaah yab ki sei ti-n bu, wan a nyunyunbasanl yab, 5le U che ti jɔɔ limiɛfol nin Yisa, hali nin taah le nan kpo nin taah bii nsiimin. U nyunyunbasanl bu le ni kan feegab. 6Le Uwonbɔr lagin fiin tim nin Masiya, ki kaan tim nin uma paab a naamin, taah be nin Masiya nan bu, 7U nan tun ni niɛ ke n-yonn man chaan nan u li wɔɔn uninfo biɛn u nyunyunbasanl lan kaa jɔɔ magimin, ki wɔɔn ti u binbenŋam Masiya bu. 8Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le ni kan nŋmarim, naah ŋa Yisa yada-n bu, naa ye ni tɔɔl a toon ŋan bu, ni ye Uwonbɔr a piini le, 9uba kaa li fir fa ligbingbanli, nan bu-n naa ye u tɔɔl a toonl li. 10Uwonbɔr le naan tim, Yisa Masiya bu le u sei ti itoon ŋan a binbem, ke ti li tun man wee u pii nan lol ke ti li tun nin na.
Ni ye nba le Yisa ni
11Mambu ni li tiɛr ke n-yonn man nan jon wee nim ban kaa nan ye Juu yaab wee Juu yaab nan yi ni “tipunjorin”, wee ki sin yi biba “ban jii-n”, (nan ye tigbanann wee bininfob ta bi nɔɔi ki ŋa-n), 12Ni li tiɛr ke iyaayoo nmɔn ni nan bɔgir nin Yisa u, baa nan kaan ni kpiɛg Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin ni, ni nan ye bicham le, kaa ji kpiɛ limɔsiinl a poorin yaan ni, kaa jɔɔ tama, kaa jɔɔ Uwonbɔr dulinya nan yaan ni. 13Amaa daandaan nan, ni nin be nin Yisa le, nim ban a bol nan fɔg nin Yisa nan, ni nin fɔɔr ki mal wa, Yisa Masiya a chamin bu.
14Nan bu-n uma baan tɔɔl le ye ti posɔɔm, u nan che tim Juu yaab nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin lagin ki ŋa uninfo uba ki tir ligonl lan nan ye nbɔgirim a gonl ki be ti sisiigin nin ki jaa, 15u tɔɔl a gbanann le u nan ta junn Juu yaab a siim nin bi kɔɔi biɛn. Ke un che nposɔɔn ndan ibol ilee nmɔn a sisiigin, wee bin lagin ki li ye libol liba, 16Masiya a kum lidapunpunlin bu, ku kidataag kan be bi sisiigin nin, ki taa bi ki lagin tigbanann tiba kpeŋileŋ, ki taa bi jir mɔŋ nin Uwonbɔr. 17U nan dan ki mɔɔn nposɔɔn a bɔŋann sei nim ban a bol nan fɔg ki mɔɔn nposɔɔn a bɔŋann nmɔn ki sei ban nan mal. 18Masiya bu le kinaaŋ kiba nmɔn ta ibol ilee nmɔn biɛn foon ti Baa Uwonbɔr ban.
19Mambu, nim ban kaa ye Juu yaabin kaa ji ye ibol iba yaab bee bichami, amaa nim nin Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin nin ye kitiŋ kiba a buwaab le, ki ye Uwonbɔr a niin yaab, 20lifiɛl lan wee Yisa a tooi nin bilinlemin nan tɔɔn li bu-n, li ma bu le n mu tɔɔn le Yisa Masiya ye litangbagil lan ye lifiɛl nmɔn a pɔɔm. 21Uma bu le kudiig a maan biɛn tɔɔ tab bu, ki che ni choo tab ki kpann kasi a wonjiɛn niin Uyudaan ni. 22Uma bu le ni mu lagin ki maa kudiig kan yaan wee Uwonbɔr be nin Kinaaŋin.

english_text:
Paul's Mission to the Gentiles
1Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles. 2You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you. 3In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways. 4 As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ. 5No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets. 6And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
7God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news. 8I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured. 9 God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind. 10Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
11God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done. 12Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith. 13This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you.
Christ's Love for Us
14I kneel in prayer to the Father. 15All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him. 16God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers 17and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love. 18 I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep. 19I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
20-21I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl kaah nan tun ki tenn ban kaa ye Juu yaab man
1Ni niɛ nan bu, le min Pɔɔl wan ye uloondiikɔɔr Masiya nin ban kaa ye Juu yaabin bu-n.
2N nyi ke ni pii gbir ke Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl a toon bu, le U nan ta litoonl nan seim ke n tun nim bu, 3ni ma ye waah nan kpiir tibɔwoonkaar ki wɔɔm, ke maah pii sɔb ti kugbɔŋ nan yaan wama-n. 4Ni ye ni karin maah sɔb nan nmɔn ke, ni li biɛ maah nyi Masiya a bɔwoonkaar man, 5Uwonbɔr kaa nan kpiir tibɔwoonkaar nmɔn ki wɔɔn n-yonn man nan jon nin a ninfobi, amaa daandaan nan Kinaaŋin kpiir tibɔwoonkaarin ki wɔɔn Uwonbɔr a kasi a tooi nin u linlema. 6U bɔwoonkaar nmɔn ye nan le, tibɔŋann nmɔn bu le ban kaa ye Juu yaabin fir ki lagin jin lifaal nin Iziral yaab, ki lagin ye gbanann tiba a ninfob, ki jɔɔ waah nan siin limɔsiinl lan Masiya bu-n ki por nin tab.
7Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le n kpann tibɔŋann nan a yomu Uwonbɔr a piini yan wee u seim u pɔɔm a toon yin nin. 8Min le joor kaa yabi Uwonbɔr a ninfob nmɔn biɛn a sisiigin, amaa ni biɛn yɔli, Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl bu le U gannim ki seim nsan ke: N mɔɔn ki wɔɔn ban kaa ye Juu yaabin Masiya a jɔɔm man kaa li fir ban kan ni, 9ki che uninfo biɛn n mann biɛ Uwonbɔr a bɔwoonkaarin a toon kaah ye man, wee Uwonbɔr, wan nan naan niwann biɛn nin, nan ŋmag ti liwoolin n-yonn man nan jon nin. 10Uwonbɔr a boni nan ye le ke daandaan nan, biwonjiɛm a laguŋ bu, Uwonbɔr a lam a booli ye nin ta wɔɔn nnaam a pɔɔm nin tininkper a pɔɔm man be paabin, 11Uwonbɔr nan ŋa ni niɛ nan ke waah gbeen u lolim man kaa jɔɔ diɛmin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nin. 12Taah ŋa Yisa yada ki be u ni nbu, le ti jɔɔ lipoobil ki li foo Uwonbɔr ban, nin tidindann. 13Ni ma bu, n balin ni le, ni laa che ni gbanann ngbɔɔ maah ji fala wan ni bu nni, ni ye kupag le sei ni.
Masiya a jiɛm
14Ni niɛ nan bu le n gbaa n dun bu n Baa Uwonbɔr a nintogil, 15Uma ban le U niin yaab ban be papaab nin dulinya nan yaan biɛn a yin nyann. 16N miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke Un ta U jɔɔm a pagim ki pɔɔg ni gbanann nmɔn U Naaŋ kan be ni nin bu, 17wee Masiya li be ni sufu-n ni yada bu. Le n miɛ u ke un che ni fir ki sir nbamɔm ki baan inyaan njiɛmin, 18wee ni li jɔɔ npɔɔn nin Uwonbɔr a ninfob gannkaab biɛn ki fir biɛ Masiya a jiɛm a yiyalim nin mi fufɔgim nin mi kpikperim nin mi nyunyɔɔm kaah ye man, 19ki biɛ Masiya a jiɛm kaah jon nnyinyin biɛn man, wee nin gbeen nin Uwonbɔr a magim nin U binbenŋam ke naah gbeen Uwonbɔr ban man nin.
20Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm kaah tun nin ti nbu, u li fir ki tun niwann biɛn ki sei ti ke nin jo taah tiɛr nan bu ki miɛ win, 21U ma Uwonbɔr ye kupag biwonjiɛm a laguŋ nin Masiya ni ki tan kpaa n-yonn man nan jon nin a ninfob biɛn, nin n-yonn man kaa jɔɔ diɛm nan! Ibamɔn.

english_text:
Unity with Christ
1As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own. 2 Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other. 3Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace. 4All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people. 5We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism. 6There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
7Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us. 8 As the Scriptures say,
“When he went up
to the highest place,
he led away many prisoners
and gave gifts to people.”
9When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth. 10This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
11Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers, 12so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong. 13This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
14We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place. 15Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head 16 of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love.
The Old Life and the New Life
17As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people. 18Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right, 19and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
20-21But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him. 22 You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits. 23Let the Spirit change your way of thinking 24 and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy.
Rules for the New Life
25 We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth. 26 Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry 27and don't give the devil a chance.
28If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
29Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
30Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
31Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude. 32 Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_text:
Masiya a gbanann a mɔkpaam
1Min wan ye uloondiikɔɔr Uyudaan a toon yin bu-n, n balin ni le ke ni che ni binbem nkpaan ni yim man wee ni nan ga-n. 2Ni jiin niba, ki li be soon, ki li jɔɔ limɔril nin njiɛm nin tab. 3Ni pɔɔn niba ki li ŋmag Kinaaŋ a mɔkpaamin nin nposɔɔn. 4Tigbanann tiba nin Kinaaŋ kiba le be, ke baah nan yin ni tama kiba bu a yim man nin, 5Uyudaan uba, yada kiba, Uwonbɔr a nyunful nba; 6Uwonbɔr uba, nin ti biɛn a Baa, wan jon niwann biɛn, nin niwann biɛn bu, nin niwann biɛn nin.
7Amaa ti biɛn nan Uwonbɔr ta U nyunyunbasanlin le sei ti uba ba uba ba ke Masiya kaah nan por man ki sei ti-n. 8Ni ma bu le ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke:
“Waah nan don papaab n-yonn man nin;
u nan ŋmag biyom takpem ma,
le ki sei bininfob ipiin.”
9(“U nan don papaab” a taai ye nii wee naa wɔɔn ke u nan jiirin kutingbɔŋ nan yaan a tum tum lee? 10Uma wan nan jiirin nin, le ye wan ji nan don papaab ki tan jon lagir kitilangbɔŋ bu naah li ŋa man wee un gbeen kutingbɔŋ nan biɛn.) 11Uma nan ta ipiin ki sei bininfosaalib, u gann biba le ki ŋa bi u tooi, le biba mu ye bilinlem, le biba mu ye bimɔleenmɔɔnib, le biba mu ye ban ŋmag biwonjiɛm a laguŋ nin ban wɔɔnn, 12U nan ŋa ni niɛ nan ke un mann Uwonbɔr a ninfob biɛn le wee bin fir tun Uwonbɔr a toon ki che Uma Masiya a gbanann n maa ki do. 13Nin ti biɛn nan n nan fir kpaag bimɔb ti yada-n wee ki chegir ki biɛ Uwonbɔr a bija-n, wee ti binbemin gbee ki foo Masiya a binbemin a magir. 14Taa ji yin ye nbuwaab tirimi, wee bilinlarib a wɔɔnimin li jɔɔ ti ki yeŋ ke kubulunkpoŋ kan wee kunyungbɔŋ daar ki yeŋ chaa kaah ban nan paami. 15Amaa ibamɔn nin njiɛm a pagim bu, ti yin nɔb le ki kpiɛ Masiya wan ye liyulin nin niwann biɛn a poolin. 16U ma bu le ti gbanann tug ki ŋmag tab, le tigbanann nmɔn tug tab ki maa tab kpiɛg nin njiɛm, le ligbanann bɔgil biɛn tun litoonl.
Limiɛfol pɔnl lan be Masiya ni
17Ni niɛ nan le n bei ni, Uyudaan bu le n si maah pag n bɔr tan nan bu, ki ke ni laa ji be ke ban kaa ye Juu yaabin kaah be man nin ni, wee bi potiɛl kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔrin ni. 18Bi biɛm ye libunbɔnl le, le baa kpiɛ Uwonbɔr kaah sei limiɛfol lan nin yaan ni, nan bu-n baa nyi niba le ki sin ji ye tukangbirdam. 19Baa san niba a fai, le ki choon tun kɔlisa birug nin tijaginn a toon, ki la jɔɔ kɔlisa ke bin tun man ki kpiɛ.
20Nim bu ke, naa ye man le ni nan tinn ki biɛ Masiya. 21N nyi naah gbir u bu, le bi tinn ni u bɔr ki wɔɔn ni ibamɔn yan be Yisa ni nmɔn. 22Bi nan wɔɔn ni, ki jiin ni binben kpegimin paam ke, ni nya ni binben kpegimin yaan na, mi ye kɔlisa birug kan lar ni le; 23ki pɔŋ ni binbem nin ni potiɛl; 24wee ki ta tigbanann pɔnn tan wee Uwonbɔr nan naan nin ki yee ki li nann Uwonbɔr nin ibamɔn a buchinn nin kasi a binbem.
25Mambu ni laa ji por tibɔkar ki tenn tabi, uninfo biɛn li pag ibamɔn ki tenn u kunkɔɔn taba, ke ti biɛn ye tigbanann tiba a ninfob le. 26“Ni ye a ŋuul fii ke a laa tun tibiri”: Ki laa che nween n nan lu wee a ŋuul kaa la sɔŋi, 27ki laa sei Sintani nsan ni. 28Wan nan ti su ke, ni kpaa talar le un jiɛn nnaayigim, amaa wee ki li tun na, ki ta u tɔɔl a nɔɔi ki li ŋaan nan ŋan na, wee ki li fir kan niba ki por sei bilanjiim. 29Ni laa che tibɔbir nyann ni mɔn ni, amaa ni li pag nan li fir ter ni kpiɛtiib, wee nin ŋa tinyɔɔr ki sei ban peligin. 30Ni laa bii Uwonbɔr a Kasi a Naaŋ a sufu, wan wee Uwonbɔr taah daag ni nkpenim a manugin a daal. 31Ni laa che ni pooi to tab bu, ni laa che ni ŋuui fii wee ni gaan tijar tab bu, ni laa kɔn ki sugir tabi, nima nmɔn nin kininaŋ biɛn ni. 32Ni li ŋaan tab tiŋanna, ki li san tab kunyunyunbaaga, ki li jiɛn tab a bir ki per ke Uwonbɔr kaah jiɛn per ti Masiya bu man nin.

english_text:
1Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children. 2 Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
3You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy. 4Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are. 5Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God.
Living as People of Light
6Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things. 7So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
8You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light 9and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful, 10as you try to please the Lord. 11Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are. 12It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark. 13But the light will show what these things are really like. 14Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say,
“Wake up from your sleep
and rise from death.
Then Christ will shine on you.”
15Act like people with good sense and not like fools. 16 These are evil times, so make every minute count. 17Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do. 18Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life. 19 When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart. 20Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything.
Wives and Husbands
21Honor Christ and put others first. 22 A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord. 23A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body. 24Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
25 A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it. 26He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water. 27Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
28In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself. 29None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church, 30because we are each part of his body. 31 As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.” 32This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church. 33So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_text:
Nwonween a binbem
1Mambu ni li toog Uwonbɔr a, naah ye U bijiɛkaamin, 2ki li be njiɛm a binbema, ke Masiya kaah jiɛ ti ki ta u ba ki mann kumanug kan jɔɔ nbaam mɔɔm ki sei Uwonbɔr ti bu man nin.
3Amaa ni laa che ti gbir iwanchɔgin toon lipiibanlin bee lijabanlin a wama ni sisiigin ni, bee ki laa tun tijaginn a toon iba, bee kujaŋuuŋ, nan bu-n naa ŋan nin Uwonbɔr a Kasi a ninfob li be man ni. 4Ki jiɛn ifa a geli nin ijɔr leen nin igel pɔɔr yan kaa kpaan ni, amaa nan kpaan nin ti li ŋaan ye liwonpagil le. 5Ni nyi ni niɛ nan bu: Ke uninfo wan tun iwanchɔgin toon upiibanlin bee ujabanlin, bee tijaginn a toon, bee kujaŋuuŋ ke, u yaa daan ye utingban kɔɔr le, le kaa na yin kan niba Masiya nin Uwonbɔr a naamin ni. 6Ni laa che uba n ta tibɔyɔɔr nan ki lar ni, ni ma che Uwonbɔr a ŋuul fii ban kaa jɔɔ limɔcheelin bu. 7Mambu ni laa jɔɔ nɔɔ nin tab nin bi.
8Ni gbaa tɔɔl la nan be libunbɔnlin le, amaa le ti Yudaau bu, ni nin kpann ban be nwonweenin le daandaan nan. Mambu ni li be ke nwonween a buwaaba, 9(nan bu-n nwonween a loonl ŋan ki jɔɔ nbuchin binben nin ibamɔn) 10ni baan ki biɛ nan gbee Uyudaan a num. 11Ni laa che ni nɔɔ be libunbɔnl a toon yan kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔr nmɔn yaan ni, amaa wee ki nyan ti npaan ni na. 12Ni ye ifa le nin uninfo n pag limɔyiildaan nmɔn kaah woog ki tun nan a bɔr. 13Amaa ni ye nwonween wonn niwann biɛn bu ke, ni nya npaan ni le ki ga, 14nwonween le wonn niwann biɛn bu le ti ga. Mambu le ni sɔb Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋin ke,
“Fin wan dɔ jiɛn nan, ligira,
fii nkumin na,
wee Masiya a wonweem nwonn a bu.”
15Mambu ni li nyi niba bu, naah li be man, ni laa be ke ban kaa jɔɔ nlamin ni, amaa ni li be ke bilandamin, 16ni taah npɔɔn man wee ni jɔɔ nan ki tun naah kpaan ni tun man nin linunmanl, nan bu-n idaa yan wee ti be nan bir pam. 17Mambu ni laa be ijɔrig a binbemi, amaa ni biɛm Uyudaan a bam kaah ye man.
18Ni laa nyu ndaam ki gbee, ke lidanyulin le nwanchɔgin binben nya, amaa wee ki che Uwonbɔr a Kasi a Naaŋin gbeen ni. 19Ni li pag tenn tab nin ilan na, liwonpagil a lan, nin Kinaaŋ a lan. Ki li gaah ilan ki pagir Uyudaan ni sufu-n na, 20ni li pagir ti Baa Uwonbɔr iyoo biɛn nin niwann biɛn nin na ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a yinl bu.
Biniinpiib nin bichiɛb a bɔr
21Ni taam ni ba ki sei taba ke naah tenn Masiya jilima man nin.
22Biniinpiib, ni taam ni ba ki sei ni chiɛb ke naah ta ni ba ki sei Uyudaan man nin. 23Nan bu-n uja le ye u poo a yudaau ke Masiya kaah ye biwonjiɛm a yudaau man nin, biwonjiɛm le ye Masiya a gbanann, le U mu ye bi feeru. 24Biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kaah ta bi ba sei Masiya man nin, man le ye biniinpiib mu n ta bi ba ki sei bi chiɛb nin niwann biɛn ni.
25Piidam, ni li jiɛ ni piiba, ke Masiya kaah jiɛ biwonjiɛm man wee ki kpo bi bu-n, 26ki nan ban bi li be kasi, ki nan ta Uwonbɔr a mɔleen ki ŋunn bi nnyumin, 27naah li ŋa man wee un ta biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan nyaginin ki sei u baa, wee tijaginn tiba laa sal bi ni bee bi laa jɔɔ tijaginn ni bee igalin iba, amaa wee ki li be kasi ki laa jɔɔ igalin ni. 28Ni ye man le, piidam ye bi li jiɛ bi piib le ke bi tɔɔl a gbanann nin. Uja wan jiɛ u poo ke u jiɛ u ba le. 29Nan bu-n, uba kaa be ki nan u tɔɔl a gbanann ni, amaa u jinn ti le ki mann ti, ke Masiya kaah mann biwonjiɛm man nin, 30nan bu-n tim li ye U gbanann nmɔn a bɔgi. 31 “Ni niɛ nan bu le uja ye un nya u baa nin u na ban le uma nin u poo nkpaag bimɔb, wee bi bilee nmɔn lagin ki ŋa gbanann tiba.” 32Ti ye tibɔr bamɔn tan woo le, amaa min pag Masiya nin biwonjiɛm a laguŋ a bɔr le. 33Ni ma bu, ni biɛn nan li jiɛ ni piib ke naah jiɛ ni ba man nin, wee uniinpii mu li tenn u chal jilimau.

english_text:
Children and Parents
1 Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says, 2 “Obey your father and your mother, 3and you will have a long and happy life.”
4 Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord.
Slaves and Masters
5 Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ. 6Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do. 7Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people. 8You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
9 Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites.
The Fight against Evil
10Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong. 11 Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks. 12We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world. 13So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
14 Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor. 15 Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet. 16Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one. 17 Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
18Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people. 19Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news. 20I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should.
Final Greetings
21-22 I want you to know how I am getting along and what I am doing. This is why I am sending Tychicus to you. He is a dear friend, as well as a faithful servant of the Lord. He will tell you how I am doing, and he will cheer you up.
23I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower! 24May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_text:
Nbuwaab nin baam nin nam a bɔr
1Nbuwaab, Uyudaan bu ni li cheel ni baam nin ni nam a mɔba, ke man le ŋan. 2“Ni li tenn ni baa nin ni na jilimau,” ke ni ma ye chinchinn a siim ki kpiɛ limɔsiinl, 3“ke ni li ŋan ki sei ni wee ni li ji limiɛfol lan fɔg a mɔm dulinya nan yaan.”
4Bibaam, ni laa fiin ni buwaab a ŋuui; amaa ni tinn bi nbamɔma ki wɔɔn bi ti Yudaau a bɔr.
Biyom nin biyudam a bɔr
5Biyom, ni li jɔɔ limɔcheel nin jilima ki tenn ni dulinya a yudam ki li san bi bijawaam, ki li tun itoon ki tenn bi nin ni sufu biɛn, ke naah bi li jɔɔ limɔcheel ki tenn Masiya man nin. 6Ni laa jɔɔ limɔcheel ki tenn bi ke bi num ngbee ni n-yonn man wee bi be ni ban ni, amaa ni li jɔɔ limɔcheel nan li gbee Uwonbɔr a num nin ni sufu biɛn naah ye Masiya a yomin bu. 7Ni li tun biyom a toon kaah ye man nin ni sufu biɛn na wee ni li ye ke ni tun tenn Uyudaan le amaa naa ye bininfobi. 8Nan bu-n ni nyi ke Uyudaan na li yɔ uninfo biɛn u toon ŋan kaah ye man, ŋaah ye uyom bee ŋaah ye a ba.
9Le nim biyudam, ni mu li ŋaan ni yomi tiŋanna, ki laa kɔɔn bi bijawaami, ki li nyi ke nim nin bi ma a yudaau be papaab le, waa gann uba ki jiɛn u tɔ.
Uwonbɔr a gbaginu nin tijawann a bɔr
10Nan joor ye nan le, ni li jɔɔ ngbananpɔɔn nin Uyudaan nin u pɔɔn takpemin bu. 11Ni ta Uwonbɔr a gbaginu ki yeeu wee ki fir to ulinlaril nin u lol birimin. 12Taa kɔnn nin bininfob ban ye tigbanann nin nchamin ni, amaa ti kɔnn nin nnaam a pɔɔm, nin tininkper a pɔɔm, nin dulinya nan a bunbɔnl a pɔɔm, nin nnaanbiim man be paabin a pɔɔm.
13Mambu ni ta Uwonbɔr a gbaginu-n ki yeeu, wee ni ye lidabiril daal nmɔn nan foon ke, ni fir baan ki sir, wee ni bɔɔn bu ni ye ni fir ŋa niwann biɛn ki yin sir ke. 14Ni mann ki baan sir nbamɔm, ki ta ibamɔn a changbam ki lol ni cham, ki li jɔɔ nbuchin binben man be ke tukur tan wee bi jɔɔ piig ligbingbanl bu-n, 15ki ŋaam sili ki ta tibɔŋann tan tenn nposɔɔn nin ki kpann inaatag ki tag. 16Nan kpiɛ ni niɛ nan biɛn bu ye, ni ta yada ki kpann nan li guu ni wee ni fir ki ŋmar ulinlaril a piin yan nyɔɔr nŋmi-n. 17Ni ta feeja kpann utɔtogir a jabig ki chig, nin Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann tan ye Kasi a Naaŋ a takoobi ki li ŋmag. 18Ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr Kinaaŋin ki li miɛ U nan yaan biɛn wee ni be nin liwonmiɛl lan a booli biɛn wee ni ban. Ki che ni niɛ nan li be ni sufu ni, ni li guu ni ba wee ki li miɛ ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin biɛn na.
19Ki li miɛ ki tenn n mu ni, wee ni ye n-yonn man n nan yaar n mɔb ke, n fir kan tibɔr ki mɔɔn tibɔwoonkaar nan ki laa san bijawaami, 20tibɔwoonkaar nmɔn bu le n ye ntoon le bi lolim tikulor nan, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ma, wee n fir ki mɔɔn tibɔŋann nmɔn naah kpaan nin n mɔɔn ti man ki laa san bijawaami.
Njoorim a poori
21Ti nabig jiɛkaag Tachikusi wan ye ti Yudaau a toon tun bamɔndaau nan li wɔɔn ni n bɔr biɛn, wee ni mu nbiɛ maah ye wan nin maah tun nan. 22Nan bu wee n nan tun u ni ban nin ye un nan wɔɔn ni taah be man, ki pɔɔg ni gbanann.
23Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a posɔɔm, nin u jiɛm, nin yada li be ti nabumin biɛn bu. 24Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl li be ban biɛn jiɛ ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nin njiɛm man kaa jɔɔ diɛmin.

english_text:
1 From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus.
To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
3Every time I think of you, I thank my God. 4And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy. 5This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it. 6God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
7You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail. 8God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
9I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand 10how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day, 11Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God.
What Life Means to Paul
12My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news. 13 The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ. 14Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
15Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help. 16They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him. 17But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail. 18But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad.
I will keep on being glad, 19because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe. 20I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
21If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more. 22I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful. 23It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better. 24-25But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith. 26Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
27Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
28Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen, 29and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him. 30 You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_text:
1Min Pɔɔl nin Timoti, tim ban ye Masiya a yomi,
Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn Uwonbɔr a ninfob gannkaab ban be Masiya nin ki be Filipi a tiŋin, ki kpiɛ ban ye biwonjiɛn sanliib nin bititeribin:
2Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be nin ni.
Pɔɔl kaah nan miɛ Uwonbɔr sei Filipi yaab man
3N tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog n-yonn man biɛn wee n tiɛr ni bu. 4Iyoo biɛn ni ye n miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni biɛn nan ke, n miɛ nin nmɔn le, 5nan bu-n naah terim man tibɔŋann nmɔn a toon yin npiinim ki nan kpaa daandaan nan, 6n jɔɔ tidindann, ki nyi ke Uwonbɔr wan piin itoon ŋan nan nin ni-n, u yin ŋmag ni man le hali nin n-yonn man wee u na yin diɛ itoon ŋan nmɔn, Masiya a jirin daal.
7Ni ŋan nin maah tiɛr ni biɛn nan bu, naah be n sufu-n nin bu; maah be libaalin bee maah pag ki wɔɔn ki mann tibɔŋannin, ni biɛn nan por Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanlin nin ma. 8Uwonbɔr le ye n siɛradaau, ki nyi maah ban n kan ni bu man nin Masiya a jiɛmin.
9N miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke: Ni jiɛm nmɔn n mann ki kpiɛ ki ji kpiɛ ni nlamin nin nbiɛmin, 10wee nin che ni fir ki gann niwann nan ŋan ki be kasi kaa jɔɔ igalin ki nan kpaa Masiya a dan daal, 11ki gbee nin nbuchin binben man nyan Yisa Masiya ni, ki li ye kupag ki tenn Uwonbɔr.
Masiya bu le ti be
12N nabum, n ban ni biɛ ke niwann nan ŋaam nan bu le che tibɔŋann nmɔn fir mɔɔn. 13Ni ma nan che bitɔtogib ban guu ibɔr niin nin, nin ibɔrniin a ninfob biɛn nan biɛ ke Masiya bu le n be libaalin. 14N baal nan bu, ni che n nabum takpem ban nɔɔ Uyudaan a samin, pɔɔg bi gbanann ki pag Uwonbɔr a bɔrin nin lipoobil kaa san bijawaami.
15Ni ye ibamɔn le ke, biba mɔɔn Masiya a bɔr nmɔn ki jɔɔ linunchɔril le nin lipiiponl, amaa le biba mu mɔɔn ti nin ti ŋam bu. 16Ban tun nin njiɛmin bi ma nyi ke Uwonbɔr le taam ŋa do ke n ji tibɔŋann nan a siɛra. 17Ban tun nin linunchɔril nin lipiiponl mɔɔn ti nin kujaŋuuŋ le, naa nan ye lipotiɛŋanli, ki tiɛr ke bin ban tibɔr ki jaa min bu n-yonn man wee bi nan baanim tikulorin. 18Ke ni niɛ nan yin ŋa baa? Nan kpaa talar le ye baah mɔɔn Masiya a bɔrin nsan man biɛn bu-n, naah ye tipotiɛbir bee ibamɔn a sam buu, Masiya a bɔrin pii mɔɔn na. Mambu ni mɔm le.
Nn ni le yin gbaa mɔm le, 19ni ma bu le n nyi ke ni wonmiɛl nin Masiya a Naaŋin yaa terim bu, nan dan n bu nan biɛn li labir ki seim nŋmarim. 20N nunman nin n tama ye le ke, n laa ji ifa, amaa wee ki li jɔɔ lipoobil daandaan nan nin iyoo biɛn, hali ni ye n kpo le bee n fo ke ni, n che Masiya a yinl nkan ndom n gbanann nin. 21Min bu ke, ni ye n fo be ke, Masiya bu le n be, n mu ti ji kpo ke, ni ye tinyɔɔr le. 22Ni ye n be ki fo nin n gbanann ke, n toon yin li lo iloon. Nin ni ma biɛn ni n yin gann ni labaa? Maa nyi! 23N be niwann nilee nmɔn a sisiigin le: N sufu ban ke n nya dulinya nan yaan ki tan li be Masiya ban, ni ma ŋan takpem; 24Amaa nim bu le ni kpaa talar ke n li be nin tigbanann. 25Ni niɛ bu ni che n biɛ ke n la li be, ki li gbaa be nin ni wee ni jo nintogil nin nmɔn nin yada, 26wee n ji nan be ni ban ke, ni mɔm man wee ni jɔɔ nin Masiya nan n mann gbeen ni min bu.
27Nan biɛn ŋa ke, ni che ni binbem li be ke Masiya a bɔŋann nin kaah wɔɔn ni man ni. Wee ni ye n dan ni ban ki nan gɔnn ni bee maa dan ni wee ki sin gbir ni bu ke, n li nyi ke ni si nbamɔm nin kinaaŋ kiba, ki lagin jɔɔ lipotiɛl liba ki kɔn ni yada wan wee ni jɔɔ tibɔŋann nin bu, 28naah kaa san bininfob ban fann ni nan. Ni ma ye siɛra ki wɔɔn bi ke baa li kan nnyaŋim mi, amaa nim li kan n nŋmarim man nyan Uwonbɔr ban. 29Uwonbɔr pii sei ni nsan ke ni li tun tenn Masiya wee ni laa pa ye naah ŋa u yada n yaa binba, amaa ke ni ji fala mu u bu. 30Ke ni tɔɔl kaah be ligbaal lan yaan wee ni kam wee n be-n, daandaan nan n le la be li ma yaan le nan.

english_text:
True Humility
1Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others. 2Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person. 3Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves. 4Care about them as much as you care about yourselves 5and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
6Christ was truly God.
But he did not try to remain
equal with God.
7Instead he gave up everything
and became a slave,
when he became
like one of us.
8Christ was humble.
He obeyed God and even died
on a cross.
9Then God gave Christ
the highest place
and honored his name
above all others.
10 So at the name of Jesus
everyone will bow down,
those in heaven, on earth,
and under the earth.
11And to the glory
of God the Father
everyone will openly agree,
“Jesus Christ is Lord!”
Lights in the World
12My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved. 13God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
14Do everything without grumbling or arguing. 15 Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world, 16as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
17Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you. 18In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me.
Timothy and Epaphroditus
19I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you. 20I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does. 21The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus. 22But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news. 23I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me. 24And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
25I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me, 26but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick. 27In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
28Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer. 29Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve. 30He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_text:
Masiya a jiininba nin u yabim
1Ni ye ni jɔɔ ngbananpɔɔn man nyan ni mɔkpaam man wee ni jɔɔ nin Masiya n ke, wee u bamin che ni sufu sɔɔn, wee ni jɔɔ nɔɔnintab nin kinaaŋin ke, wee ki jɔɔ nbinben ŋan nin tab ki san tab a nyunyunbaag ke, 2ni bi li mɔŋim pam ni ye ni potiɛl bi nann tab, wee ni jɔɔ njiɛm nba, ki jɔɔ kinaaŋ kiba nin ibonn iba. 3Ni laa jɔɔ npooton a bam bee ki far igbingban ni, amaa ni li jɔɔ jiininba ki li tenn ni kpiɛtiib jilima ki jo ni ba. 4Uba n laa che u baga be u binba a ŋam bu amaa un che u baga li be u kpiɛtiib mu a bam bu.
5Ni che ni binbem li be ke Masiya a binbemin:
6U jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a nunaŋ le,
amaa waa tiɛr ke un ta u ba kpaag nin Uwonbɔr bee niwann nan wee u li choo,
7amaa u ŋa u baa le ke waa ye niba le-n,
le ki jɔɔ uyom a binbem,
le ki jɔɔ uninfosaal a nunaŋ.
8Waah nan kpenn ki gaa uninfosaal a gbanann nin bu,
le u nan jiin u ba tum,
le ki chee nkum a mɔb, hali ki kpo lidapunpunl bu!
9Ni ma bu le che Uwonbɔr don u papaab
le ki sei u liyinl lan yab jon iyin biɛn,
10ke ni ye bi nan pur Yisa a yinl ke idun biɛn li gbaan tum,
papaab nin tum nin kutingbɔŋ kan be tumtum nan,
11le lilanbil biɛn na li pag npaan ni ke Yisa Masiya le ye Uyudaan,
wee Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Baa n kan kupag.
Ni li nyagin ke nwonweenin dulinya nan yaan
12Ni ma bu n jɔtiib, naah jɔɔ limɔcheel n-yonn man wee n be ni ban nin, ni le li jɔɔ limɔcheel nmɔn n-yonn man wee maa nan be ni ban na, ni tugir ki li tun ke bininfob ban kan nŋmarimin ki li san bijawaam ki li jegila. 13Uwonbɔr le tun nin ni le ki che ni tun ni U bamin ke waah ban ni tun man.
14Ni li tun niwann biɛn na ki laa ŋulin ni bee ki far limɔkpel nin tab bi, 15wee ki laa jɔɔ igalin ni ki li be kasi, ke Uwonbɔr a buwaab ban kaa jɔɔ igalin, naah be dulinya biig kan yaan nin titoonbirdam a sisiigin nin bu, wee ni li nyagin ke iŋmabil yan be kutingbɔŋ nan yaan nin, 16ke naah ta limiɛfol a bɔr wɔɔn bi man nin, naah li ŋa man wee n li fir fa ligbingbanl Masiya a jirin daal ke n taguunl nin n baginn kaa gab yɔli. 17Hali ni ye bi kpaarim le wur ke libawol a daam le bi ta mann kumanug ki jiin ni yada kan wee ni jɔɔ nin Uwonbɔr n bu ke, n pool peen le ni mɔm ni biɛn nan bu. 18Ni ma bu ni li jɔɔ npopeen wee ni li mɔ nin ma.
Timoti nin Ipaforɔditusi
19N jɔɔ tama ke ni ye Uyudaan Yisa chee ke n li tun Timoti wee un dan ni ban weem, n mu bi li kan ngbananpɔɔn ni ye n gbir ni bu ke. 20Maa ji jɔɔ uba ki kpiɛ u bu, wee u baga sin be ni ni ibamɔn nin. 21Ban gurin biɛn a baga be bi baantɔɔl a toon yin le, naa ye Yisa Masiya a toon yin ni. 22Amaa ni tɔɔl nyi Timoti kaah pɔɔn u ba man, nan bu-n u be ke kibijag kaah be u baa a nintogil man nin le, u terim le tibɔŋann nmɔn a mɔɔnimin. 23N jɔɔ tama ke n tun u ni ban le weem ni ye n biɛ n bɔr a sam ke. 24Le n jɔɔ tidindann Uyudaan bu ke min tɔɔl li dan daandaan nan.
25Amaa n tiɛr ke ni ŋan nin n che n na a big Ipaforɔditusi wan ye n toontunn kpiɛg nin n tɔtog kpiɛg wee ki ji ye ni toom wee ni nan tun u wee u nan terimin n jirin ni ban. 26U bi ban un kan ni biɛn nan, u sufu kaa dɔ naah nan gbir ke u bu-n bu. 27Ni sin ye ibamɔn le, u nan buŋ ki yin kpo le, amaa le Uwonbɔr san u kunyunyunbaag, naa ye u binba bu, amaa u ji nan san n mu kunyunyunbaaga, le ki nyam npoobiin a booli yin. 28Ni ma bu n jɔɔ inunman ki ban un jirin ni ban, wee ni ye ni ji kan u ke nin mɔŋ ni wee n mu n nya n potiɛri nin. 29Ni gaam u nin nmɔn takpen uyudaan a yinl bu, ki sei bininfob ban be ke u ma nan jilimau, 30nan bu-n ni nan gur wama nin un kpo Masiya a toon yin bu, ki ta u miɛfol ki tun ki seim naah kaa bi li fir terim nan ni.

english_text:
Being Acceptable to God
1Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
2Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you. 3But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done, 4although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else. 5 I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses. 6 And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
7But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless. 8Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ 9and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ. 10All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did, 11so that somehow I also may be raised to life.
Running toward the Goal
12I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize. 13My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead. 14I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done. 15All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you. 16But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
17 My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you. 18I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again 19that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
20But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ 21 has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_text:
Ibamɔn a buchinn a binbem
1Ni joorimin n nabum, ni che ni li mɔ ni Uyudaan buu! Naa ye tibɔr mugkaar ki seim nin n ji sɔb maah nan sɔb nan sei ni-n jigin ni, ni ma yin guu ni. 2Ni li nyi bininfob ban ye ibɔ nan, ki ye titoonbirdam wee ki jiil bi gbanann chɔr nan bu. 3Tim le ye ban gaa ibamɔn a pun jiil nmɔn, tim ban jiɛn Uwonbɔr kinaaŋin nin, le ki jɔɔ jilima taah be nin Masiya n bu, tim kaa jɔɔ tidindann tigbanann bu, 4min tɔɔl jɔɔ nan bu che n jɔɔ ti ma a dindann. Ni ma bu ni ye uninfo uba len ke u jɔɔ tidindann tigbanann bu ke, min jɔɔ takpem ki jon wa: 5Baah nan mam a ween iniin daal le bi nan jii n punl, n ye Iziral a ninfou le, ki nyan Bɛnjamɛnn a bolin, ki ye Hiiburu a ninfou tob tob; ki jiin nsiim mu paam ke, n ye Farasii le; 6ni ye nsiim nmɔn a ŋmagim a nunmanl bu ke, n nan mugir biwonjiɛm a laguŋ; ni ye nbuchin binben nin limɔcheel ki tenn nsiimin ke, maa jɔɔ igalin ni. 7Amaa nan biɛn nan ye tinyɔɔr ki seimin daandaan nan min lig ki miin ni ye yɔli le, Masiya bu. 8Ni la yab ki jon ni tɔɔ, maah ta niwann biɛn gab nin maah gaa Masiya n yudaau wan jɔɔ tinyɔɔr ki jon niwann biɛn nin, uma bu le n ta niwann biɛn gab. Min ban ke ni ye lifatanpol a mɔɔr le naah li ŋa man wee n fir ki gaa Masiya, 9wee ki li be nin u, wee ki laa jɔɔ min tɔɔl a buchin binbem man nyan nsiimin yaan ni, amaa maah ŋa Masiya yada n bu le n jɔɔ nbuchin binben man nyan Uwonbɔr ban n yada n bu. 10N ban n li nyi Masiya le nin u kum a fiim a pɔɔmin ki li jɔɔ nɔɔnintab nin u, ki ji fala wan wee u nan jin nin, ki li be ke uma nin u kumin, 11ni ye niwann biɛn ke, n na li kan nkum a fiim.
Li guu chaa a num kaah paa nan bu-n ban
12Naa wɔɔn ke min nyaŋ ni niɛ biɛn le, bee min yaa binbem ŋan ki tan diɛ, amaa n pɔɔn nba le ki gbaar n choo nan bu wee Masiya nan choo min. 13N nabum, maa tiɛr ke n baan tɔɔl a nɔɔ la ŋub ni. Amaa maah ŋa man ye nan le: N tam nan pii tun jon nin bu le ki gbaar ban nan la be n nintogilin bu, 14n jɔɔ inunman le ki gu chaa n num kaah paa nan bu-n ban ke n tan pii tiyɔr tan bu wee Uwonbɔr yim papaab Masiya bu-n.
15Tim ban biɛn chegir Uwonbɔr a samin nin li jɔɔ potiɛl liba ti sufu ni. Ni ye ni potiɛi kaa nan chee nan bu ke, Uwonbɔr li che ni biɛ ni taai. 16Ni le yin che ti li be nin taah nan kan nan nin.
17N nabum, nim nin ni tabin biɛn li nɔɔ maah mag man ki wɔɔn ni nna, wee ki biɛ ban a binbem nɔɔ nsan man wee ti nan sei ni-n. 18A li ke maah pii gbaa bei ni man nin, hali ki nin bei ni nin tinyinyinn ke, bininfob biba a binbem ŋa Masiya a dapunpunlin a dataag le. 19Bi na yin joor nŋmi-n le, bi weem le ye bi pooi, le bi pag ye bi fai. Bi potiɛl biɛn be dulinya nan a wan yɔɔrin le. 20Amaa tim ye papaab a tinbum le. Ti ŋa sili le ki guu ufeer wan yin nya niin ki dan nin, Uma ye Uyudaan Yisa Masiya, 21Uma wan ta u pɔɔm ki lagin niwann biɛn u nintogilin, u li kpenn ti gbanann tan kaa pɔɔ-n ki ŋa ti u jilima a gbanann.

english_text:
1Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy.
Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
2Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other. 3And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
4Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad. 5Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here. 6Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God. 7Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
8Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise. 9You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you.
Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
10The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it. 11I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have. 12I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little. 13Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
14It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time. 15 My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return. 16 Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once. 17I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
18 I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God. 19I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus! 20May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen.
Final Greetings
21Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus.
The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
22All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
23I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_text:
Nwɔɔnim
1Ni ma bu n nabum, nim ban wee n ban wee ki yuur ni kam nan, nim li ye n mɔm nin n naan yuchigirig, njɔtiib, ni ma bu le ni kpaan ni mann sir nbamɔm Uyudaan a samin!
2N balin Yuwodiɛ le ki balin Sintiche ke, Uyudaan bu bin pɔɔn biba ki li jɔɔ nmɔkpaau. 3Ni ye ibamɔn le n bei nim ban ye n naajadaag tug tab bamɔm nan, ni ter bipiib ban pɔɔn biba ki kpiɛ n bu wee ti mɔɔn tibɔŋann nan na, nin Kilɛmenn nin ban biɛn ye n toontunn tabin, wee bi yin be limiɛfol a gbɔŋin yaan nin.
4Ni che ni li mɔ ni naah be Uyudaan nin iyoo biɛn na. N ji yin mann bei ni le ke: Ni che ni li mɔ na! 5Ni ta ni binbenŋamin ki che ni li ye siɛra ki sei bininfob biɛn na. Ke Uyudaan malin na. 6Ni laa jɔɔ npotiɛ bii-n ni niwann niba bu, amaa ki li miɛ Uwonbɔr naah ban nan bu, ki li tenn U kunɔɔpoog, ki bei U naah ban nan. 7Le Uwonbɔr a posɔɔm, man yab ki lagir uninfosaal a biɛm bu-n le che ni ŋmag Masiya ni sufu ni nin ni potiɛlin.
8Ni joorimin, n nabum, nan ye ibamɔn, nin nan ye jilima, nin nan ŋan, nin nan be kasi, nin nan ye njiɛm, nin linungbeel, ni ye niwann ŋan ki tan lagir bee ki be kasi ke, ni li tiɛr tiwann nmɔn buu. 9Niwann nan wee ni tinn n ban bee ki gaa n ban bee ki gbir n ban nin ni li jɔɔ tun itoon na man. Wee nposɔɔn a Wonbɔr win li be nin ni.
Waah poor ipiin bu man
10Uyudaan bu ni mɔŋim pam nin n-yonn takpem man jon wee ni ji nan mann wɔɔn ni baga kaah be n ni man. Ni ye ibamɔn le, ni baga be n ni, amaa naa jɔɔ npaan man wee ni ta wɔɔn le. 11Naa ye maah lann niba bu le n pag man nin, amaa n tinn le ki che n num gbee maah jɔɔ nan n-yonn biɛn nin. 12N nyi maah kaa nan jɔɔ niba ke ni ye man, ki ji nyi maah nan jɔɔ takpem mu ke ni ye man. N tinn le ki nyi liwool lan ye linungbeel naah ye man niwann biɛn nin, ni baga kaa be maah jin gbee bee maah choon nin nkomi, ni baga kaa be maah jɔɔ takpem bee maah kaa jɔɔ. 13N li fir tun niwann biɛn Masiya kaah seim ngbananpɔɔn man nin bu.
14Amaa ni nan tun tiŋann pam nin naah nan terim n bɔr mugkaarin. 15Nan kpiɛ ni bu, nim Filipi yaab nyi, maah nan nyan Masedoniya, n-yonn man nan jon wee n nan chonn mɔɔn tibɔŋannin nin, biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kiba kaa la nyi ki terim niba nseimin nin ngamin ni, see nim a binba; 16hali maah la nan be Tesalonika n-yonn man wee ki nan ban literilin, ni le nan gbaa terim le. 17Naa ye n ban ipiin le, amaa n ban ni kan tinyɔɔr tan yin kpiɛ naah jɔɔ nan nin le. 18N gaa tiyɔr takpem ke ti yab tan lagira; n nin jɔɔ nan biɛn wee n ban, maah gaa ipiin yan biɛn wee ni nan ta sein Ipaforɔditusi n ni. Ki ye kumanug kan jɔɔ nbaam mɔɔm wee Uwonbɔr a num gbee le. 19Le n Wonbɔru li ta U jilima a jɔɔm man be Masiya nin ki sei ni. 20Ti Baa Uwonbɔr n gaam kupag n-yonn nin n-yonn. Ibamɔn.
Ipoor yan joor
21Ni poor Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin biɛn Masiya a yinl buu. N nabum man be n ban nin poor ni. 22Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaab biɛn poor ni, naah tɔɔ ban bu ubɔr Siiza a niin yaab ke n poor ni nbamɔma.
23Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl li be ni naamin. Ibamɔn.

english_text:
1From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
2To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ.
I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
A Prayer of Thanks
3Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. 4We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people, 5because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
