6The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness 7 from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you. 8He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you.
The Person and Work of Christ
9We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives. 10Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better. 11His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
12I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light. 13God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son, 14 who forgives our sins and sets us free.
15 Christ is exactly like God,
who cannot be seen.
He is the first-born Son,
superior to all creation.
16Everything was created by him,
everything in heaven
and on earth,
everything seen and unseen,
including all forces
and powers,
and all rulers
and authorities.
All things were created
by God's Son,
and everything was made
for him.
17God's Son was before all else,
and by him everything
is held together.
18 He is the head of his body,
which is the church.
He is the very beginning,
the first to be raised
from death,
so that he would be
above all others.
19God himself was pleased
to live fully in his Son.
20 And God was pleased
for him to make peace
by sacrificing his blood
on the cross,
so that all beings in heaven
and on earth
would be brought back to God.
21You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things. 22But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent. 23But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message.
Paul's Service to the Church
24I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church. 25God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you. 26For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people. 27God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
28We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature. 29This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_text:
1Pɔɔl wan ye Masiya a toom Uwonbɔr a bam bu-n, nin ti na a big Timoti,
2Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn nim ban ye ti nabum ban be kasi ki si bogil liba Masiya ni Kolosiya a tiŋin ni.
Ti Baa Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl nin u posɔɔm li be nin ni.
Kunɔɔpoog a wonmiɛl
3Ti tenn Uwonbɔr wan ye ti Yudaau Yisa a Baa-n kunɔɔpoog, iyoo yan biɛn wee ti miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni-n, 4nan bu-n ti gbir naah ŋa Yisa yada man, nin naah jiɛ Uwonbɔr a ninfo gannkaabin man na, 5yada nin njiɛm man bun ki nya tama kan dɔ papaab ki guu ni, wee ni pii gbir ibamɔn a mɔleen yan ye tibɔŋann nin, 6wee ki dan ni ban nin. Tibɔŋann nmɔn lo iloon le ki yabirig dulinya nan yaan biɛn, ke naah nan ti tun man ni sisiigin lidaal lan wee ni nan gbir ti, ki biɛ Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanlin nin libamɔn yan be ipoolin nin biɛn. 7Ni nan tinn Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl nmɔn ti toontunn kpiɛg Epafarasi wan wee ti ban win ban le, wan sir ti taalin ki ye Yisa a toontunnu wan si bogil liba-n, 8le uma ji bei ti naah jɔɔ njiɛm Kinaaŋin man.
9Ni niɛ nan bu, lidaal lan wee ti gbir ni bu-n, taa ta Uwonbɔr a miɛm ni bu ki jiɛn ni, le ki le miɛ Uwonbɔr ke Un gbeen ni nnyinyin man ye u bam ki sei ni kinaaŋ a lam nin nbiɛm. 10Ti miɛ ni niɛ le ke ni fir be nbinben man kpaan ki gbee Uyudaan a num niwann biɛn nin: Ki lo iloon yan ye itoon ŋan biɛn a looi, ki yabirig nin Uwonbɔr a nyinyim. 11Uma Uwonbɔr wan jɔɔ ipɔɔn biɛn nan n pɔɔg ni gbanann, U pag takpoŋin bu wee ni li jɔɔ pɔɔninba nin limɔril nin nmɔn, 12wee ni li tenn ti Baa Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog, wan sei ni npaan ke nim nin uninfo gannkaabin nan por lifaal lan be nwonween a naam a yerin nin yaan nin. 13Nan bu-n U fee ti libunbɔnl a pɔɔmin na, le ki ta ti ki kɔɔn u bijiɛkaag a naam a yerin nin, 14U big nmɔn le sei ti nkpenim a manug kan ye tibir a jiɛn per.
Yisa a ninforin nin u toon
15Masiya le ye Uwonbɔr wan wee taa ga win a nunaŋ, uma ye kibininkpeeg kan yab jon kuwonaaŋ biɛn. 16Uma bu le niwann biɛn nan naan: Nan be papaab nin tum, nan wee ti ga nin nan wee taa ga, naah ye kunaangbɔŋ bee ipɔɔn bee nnaam a pɔɔm bee tininkper a pɔɔm; uma nan naan niwann biɛn le ki ye niwann biɛn. 17U nan be ke niwann niba kaa la nan be, uma bu le niwann biɛn choo tab ki ŋmag. 18Uma ye tigbanann a yudaau, biwonjiɛm a laguŋ; ki ye npiinim nin kibininkpeeg kan nyan bitakpiib a sisiigin. Naah li ŋa man wee u li ye wan chinn niwann biɛn ni. 19Nan bu-n, Uwonbɔr nan jɔɔ linungbeel le u bu, U binbemin biɛn kaah nan gbee u ni-n. 20Uma bu le Uwonbɔr nan che niwann biɛn jir mɔŋ nin tab, Yisa a cham man nan nyan lidapunpunl bu-n le che nposɔɔn dan.
21Iyoo iba naa nan kpiɛ Uwonbɔr a ninfobin ni, ki ye Uwonbɔr a dataam ni potiɛlin nin ni binben biimin bu. 22Amaa daandaan nan, Masiya a gbanann a kum nbu le Uwonbɔr jir ki mɔŋ nin ni, ke Un ta ni sei wee ni li be kasi u numin, ki laa jɔɔ tijaginn wee bin galin ni, 23ni ye ni yin gbaa be nin ni yada ke, ki si chib, kaa fɔɔr tama kan wee tibɔŋann nin ŋmagin ke, ti ma ye tibɔŋann tan wee ni gbirin, wee bi mɔɔn ti sei kuwonaaŋ biɛn dulinya nan yaan, tan bu wee min Pɔɔl kpann utoontunn.
Pɔɔl a toon kaah ye man biwonjiɛm a laguŋin
24Daandaan nan ni mɔm, nin maah jin fala kan nim bu-n, le n la gbee nin fala nmɔn le n gbanann nin ki jin nan la paar Masiya a fala a jimin paam, u gbanann nmɔn le ye biwonjiɛm a laguŋ. 25N nin kpann biwonjiɛm a laguŋin a toontunnu le, litoonl lan wee Uwonbɔr ta seimin, ke n ta U mɔleen yin biɛn ki sei ni, 26tibɔwoonkaar tan wee Uwonbɔr nan woon ibin nin n-yonn man nan jon nin, amaa wee U nin kpiir ki wɔɔn U ninfogannkaabin daandaan nan. 27Bininfogannkaab nmɔn le Uwonbɔr nan gann ke bin kpiir liwool a bɔrin ki wɔɔn ban kaa ye Juu yaabin, liwool a pag kan yabin, ni ma ye Masiya wan be nin ni-n, ki ye kupag a tama-n. 28Yisa nmɔn le ti mɔɔn, ki kpaan bininfob ki wɔɔn bi nlam a booli biɛn, naah li ŋa man wee ti ŋa uninfob biɛn kasi ki sei Uwonbɔr, Masiya ni. 29Ni niɛ nan bu le n tun ki gbaar nin u pɔɔm biɛn man pɔɔ lagir ki be nni ki tun nin.

english_text:
1I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me. 2I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery, 3but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him. 4I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk. 5Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong.
Christ Brings Real Life
6You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him. 7Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
8Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
9God lives fully in Christ. 10And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority. 11Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body. 12 And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death. 13 You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
14 God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross. 15There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
16 Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival. 17These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
18Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires. 19 They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God.
Christ Brings New Life
20You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as, 21“Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”? 22After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up? 23Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_text:
1Nan bu-n n ban ni biɛ maah gbaar nim nin Laodisiya yaab bu man le, nin ban kaa laa nyi kan min tɔɔlin. 2N lol ye n che bi sufu le npɔɔg, wee bi lagin tab nin njiɛm, wee bi li jɔɔ nbiɛm man yab, wee ki li fir biɛ Uwonbɔr a bɔwoonkaar ti ma ye Masiya, 3uma ban le nlamgɔrikaam nin nnyinyin gbee le ki woo.
4N bei ni ni niɛ le, ni laa che uba n ta limɔkpel lan nann ibamɔn nin ki lar ni. 5Nan bu-n, hali maah kaa be ni ban nin tigbanann ni, n be ni ban kinaaŋin le ni mɔm, le ban n kan naah si nbamɔm man nin naah ŋmag ni yada-n man kenken Masiya ni.
Limiɛfol lan gaa ngbeenim Masiya nin
6Ni ma bu, naah pii nan gaa Masiya ke Uyudaan nan, ni li gbaa be u ban na, 7ki baan inyaan ki yabig nin uma, ki pɔɔg ni yada-n ke baah nan wɔɔn ni man nin, ki che ni nɔɔpoog li yaba ki tenn Uwonbɔr.
8Ni laa che uba n ta uninfosaal a biɛm man kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔrin ki lar ni kɔɔn tiyomirin ni, ni ma nyan bininfob a kaalin le nin kutingbɔŋ nan a maabiyiɛrugin, naa nyan Yisa ban ni. 9Ni ma bu Uwonbɔr a nunaŋ be Masiya a gbanann nin le waah nan ye uninfo-n, 10le Uwonbɔr ta Masiya le ki gbeen ni, wan ye npɔɔn biɛn nin tininkper a pɔɔm a yudaau win.
11Masiya ni le ni kan lipunjiil, ki nyan tibir a binbemin, naa ye lipunjiil lan wee bininfosaalib ta bi nɔɔi ki jii amaa Masiya le jii ni 12n-yonn man wee bi nan lagin pii ni nin Masiya Uwonbɔr a nyunfulin ni, wee ni ji fii nkumin nin Masiya ni yada-n Uwonbɔr a pɔɔm man nan fii-n u nkumin ni.
13Ni nan ye bitakpiib le ni birin n-yonn iba, le kaa jɔɔ lipunjiil a bir a binbemin, le Uwonbɔr che ni jɔɔ limiɛfol Masiya ni. Le ki jiɛn per ti biɛn nan a bir, 14Uwonbɔr nan pir nsiim nin mi sɔbim man kaa nan chee sei ti-n, wee ki kɔn nin ti nle ki choo mi nyan le ki kpaa mi lidapunpunl bu. 15Masiya kaah nan nyaŋ bitindam nin tininkper a pɔɔmin, u nan nyan bi npaan ni le ki che bininfob biɛn kan bi le ki ŋa bi tiyomirin waah nan nyaŋ bi lidapunpunl bu-n.
16Mambu, ni laa che uba n ji ni tibɔr naah ji tijiir tan bee naah nyu nan bu bee ki jiin liwonjiɛnl a chiig paam bee uŋmapɔɔn a chiig bee likpakɔɔl daal a chiig bu. 17Ti nan le ye tiwann tan yin dan nin a jinjiim amaa niwann bamɔn nin be Masiya ni le. 18Ni laa che uba n ta tibɔkar a jiininba nin malakam a jiɛnim ki lar ni wee ni lann ni yɔri. U yaa daan nɔɔ waah ga nan biɛn tininforin nin le, naa ye kinaaŋin ni, u donn uba u potiɛlin le naa jɔɔ bu. 19Waa ji tug nin Masiya wan ye ni yulin ni, wan bu wee tigbanann biɛn tugin, uma ŋmag tigbanann le ti ŋmag tab nin tijiin, le ti yabirig ke Uwonbɔr kaah ban ti li yabirig man.
Taah kpeg ki fo nin Masiya man
20Ni nan lagin ki kpo nin Yisa ki sei kutingbɔŋ a maabiyiɛrugaa, ba ŋaa wee ni la be ke ni ye kutingbɔŋ nan a ninfob lee, ni chee sei kutingbɔŋ nmɔn a siim man ke: 21“Laa ŋmagi! Laa lenn ni! Laa maa n lee!”? 22Ni niɛ nan biɛn ye ti wonleen le ki yin boon nin taah jɔɔ nan tun, nan bu-n ni ye uninfosaal a siim nin nwɔɔm le. 23Ibamɔn, nsiim nmɔn nann man jɔɔ nlamgɔrikaam le, nin bi tɔɔl a bam a wonjiɛnl, nin bi bɔkar a jiininba, nin baah mug ki ŋmag bi gbanann man, amaa baa ŋmag nsiim man jɔɔ tinyɔɔr ki li nyan bi tigbanann a kɔlisa nin ni.

english_text:
1 You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side. 2Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth. 3You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God. 4Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
5Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols. 6God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things. 7And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way. 8But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others. 9 And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
10 Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better. 11It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
12 God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient. 13 Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you. 14Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
15Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful. 16 Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God. 17Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him.
Some Rules for Christian Living
18 A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
19 A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
20 Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
21 Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
22 Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart. 23Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master. 24In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you. 25 But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_text:
1Mambu, ni nan fii nin Yisa nkumin na, ni ta ni sufu ki sei paab a naamin a wan yɔɔrin na, nan yaan wee Yisa ka Uwonbɔr a nɔɔjiim paamin. 2Ni ta ni potiɛl ki ŋa paab a naam a wann bu-u, ki laa ta ni potiɛl ki ŋa dulinya nan a wan yɔɔr bu. 3Nan bu-n ni kpou, le ni miɛfol woo Masiya ni le ki be Uwonbɔr ban. 4Masiya wan ye ni miɛfolin nan degirin ke, iyaayoo nim nin uma na li degirin nin kupag.
Limiɛfol kpegil nin limiɛfol pɔnl
5Mambu ni ku nan ye dulinya nan a binbem man be nin ni na: Nan ye iwanchɔgin toon, nin ni piibanlin bee ni jabanlin, nin tijaginn a toon, nin nmɔsanyunsɔɔm, nin titoonbir nin kujaŋuuŋ ni ma ye libawol manil. 6Ni niɛ nan bu Uwonbɔr a ŋuufiiŋ chaan ban tun man nmɔn bu. 7Ni nan ti jɔɔ man a binben n-yonn man wee ni nan be-n.
8Amaa daandaan nan ni kpaa le nin ni choo ni ba nyan ni niɛ biɛn nin, ni ma ye liŋuul, nin kiŋuufiiŋ, nin kininaŋ, nin kutingbiig nin timɔleenbir tan nya ti mɔɔŋi yin. 9Ni laa por tibɔkar ki tenn ni tabi, nan bu-n ni pii pir ni binben kpeg a ŋaarin ki gaba, 10ki yee nbinben pɔɔn le, nbinbem nmɔn le Uwonbɔr pɔŋir mi nin nyinyimin le mi nann uma wan naan min. 11Ni ma kaa jɔɔ nbɔgirim ban ye Juu yaab nin Girig yaabin, ban jii bi pun nin ban kaa jii bi pun, ban ye bicham nin bidindamin, nin ban jɔɔ kulɔŋ a binbem nin ban jɔɔ kufɔŋ a binbem, biyom nin ban ye bi ba, amaa Masiya le ye bi biɛn le ki be bi biɛn ni.
12Mambu, naah ye Uwonbɔr a ninfogannkaabin wee u jiɛ ni ki ŋa ni kasi-n, ni ta linyunyunbasanl nin tiŋann, nin jiininba, nin nbinben ŋan nin limɔril ki kpann daala ki yee u. 13Ni li jɔɔ limɔril nin taba, wee ki jiɛn per tab a galin, ki jiɛn per tab ke Uyudaan kaah jiɛn per ni man nin. 14Nin tiyeer nan biɛn, nan jon ni biɛn ni ye ni li jiɛ taba, njiɛm li lagin ni biɛn ki ŋmag nin nmɔkpaa man be kasi. 15Ni che Masiya a posɔɔmin li ŋmag ni sufu, ke naah ye tigbanann tiba a ninfob wee u yin nposɔɔn ni. Ni li tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpooga. 16Ni che Masiya a bɔŋann nin li be nin ni nbamɔma, wee ni li wɔɔn ni tab, ki gbeer tab nin nlamgɔrikaam, ki li gaah ilan, liwonpagil a lan, nin Kinaaŋ a lan nin linungbeel ni sufu ni ki sei Uwonbɔr. 17Mambu ni ŋaan nan biɛn ke, naah ye ni mɔleen bee ni toon ke, ni ŋa ni biɛn Uyudaan Yisa a yinl bu, ki li tenn Uwonbɔr wan ye Baa-n kunɔɔpoog u bu.
Biwonjiɛm kaah li be nin tab man limiɛfol pɔnlin
18Biniinpiib, ni chee sei ni chiɛba, man le kpaan Uyudaan ban.
19Bijab ni li jiɛ ni piiba, ki laa ŋmag bi nin titintann ni.
20Nbuwaab, ni li cheel ni baam nin ni nam a mɔɔŋi iyoo biɛn na, nan bu-n man le gbeeg Uyudaan a num.
21Baam, ni laa to ni buwaab bu, wee bi gbanann ngbɔɔ.
22Biyom, ni li cheel ni dulinya nan a yudam a mɔɔŋi niwann biɛn na, ni li tun man wee ni laa ye iyoo yan a binba wee bi lig ni, ke bi num ngbee ni, amaa wee ki li tun man nin ni sufu biɛn nin jilima ki tenn Uyudaan na. 23Ni tun nan biɛn ke, ni li tun nin ni sufu biɛn, ke ni tun tenn Uyudaan le, naa ye uninfosaali, 24naah nyi ke ni na li gaa lifaal Uyudaan ban nin wee ni ye tiyɔrin. Ni ma bu Uyudaan Masiya le ni tun ki tenn. 25Wan tun titoonbir na li gaa u toonbir nmɔn a yɔr, le naa jɔɔ njiɛm a gannimi.

english_text:
1 Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
2Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful. 3Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this. 4Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
5 When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time. 6 Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions.
Final Greetings
7 Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me. 8I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along. 9 Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
10 Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you. 11Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
12 Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely. 13I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
14 Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
15Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
16After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
17 Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
18I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
Don't forget that I am in jail.
I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_text:
1Biyudam, ni li ŋaan ni yomi tiŋann nin nan kpaan na, nan bu-n, ni nyi ke ni tɔɔl jɔɔ Uyudaan wan be paab.
Nwɔɔnim
2Ni li ta ni ba ki sei liwonmiɛl, ki li guu ni ba ki tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpooga. 3Ki ji li miɛ U ki tenn ti, wee Uwonbɔr n loor nsan ki sei ti mɔleen yin, wee ti fir mɔɔn Masiya a bɔwoonkaarin, nan bu-n, tan bu wee n be libaalin ni. 4Ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ma wee n fir mɔɔn ti nbamɔm, ke naah kpaa n mɔɔn ti man nin.
5Ni chee ni num li ween nin naah be nin ban kaa nɔɔ Yisa nan, wee ki laa bii ni saŋi yan biɛn wee ni kan ni. 6Ni che ni bɔr a pagim li gbee nin linyunyunbasanl ki mɔ ke n-yaamin, wee ni li nyi naah li jiin bininfob biɛn a binbaan yin man.
Ipoor yan joor
7Tachikusi li bei ni n bɔr biɛn, u ye ki na big jiɛkaag le wan si bogil liba u toon yin ki ye ti toontunn kpiɛg Uyudaan a toon yin, 8nan bu wee n tun u ni ban ye ni biɛ ti binbem kaah ye man, wee un pɔɔg ni sufu. 9Uma nin Onesemosi le yin nɔɔ dan, wan ye ti na big jiɛkaag ki si bogil liba-n, ki ye ni ni uba-n. Bi li bei ni nan biɛn ŋaan do.
10Arisitakusi, wan wee bi loon u ki kpiɛ n bu-n, u mu poor ni. Le Banabasi a pool a bija Mag mu poor ni. (N pii nan wɔɔn ni u bɔra; ni ye u nan foon ni ban ke, ni gaam u.) 11Josuwa wan wee bi yi Jasitusi mu poor ni. Bijab bita nmɔn le ye Juu a ninfob ban kpiɛg n bu wee ti tun Uwonbɔr a naam a toon yin nmɔn. Bi sɔŋir n sufu pam.
12Epafarasi, wan ye ni ni uba wee ki ji ye ni toontunn kpiɛg Masiya a toon nin mu poor ni. U miɛ Uwonbɔr le nin linunmanl iyoo biɛn ki tenn ni, ke ni sir kenken ki li ye bininfob chegirikaab ban tun Uwonbɔr a bam. 13N jin siɛra ke u sin tun nin linunmanl ki sei nim nin Laodisiya a tiŋ a ninfob nin Herapolisi a tiŋ a ninfoba. 14Ti jɔ Lug, wan ye utebirin, uma nin Demasi mu poor ni.
15Ni poor ti nabum ban be Laodisiya nna, ki ji poor ti ninsa Ninfa nin biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan be u niin ni. 16Ni karin kugbɔŋ nan ki diɛ a bɔɔn ke, ni pɔɔn niba wee bin karin ki, ki sei biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan be Laodisiya nna wee ni mu n karin kugbɔŋ kan be Laodisiya a wonjiɛm ban nin na. 17Ni bei Achipusi ke “Pɔɔn a ba ki diɛ litoonl lan wee Uyudaan nan ta seiŋ ke a tun nin na.”
18Min, Pɔɔl, n tɔɔl a nɔɔ le n ta ki sɔb ipoor nan. Ni laa tam n baalin bu. Uwonbɔr a nyunyunbasanl li be ni bu.

english_text:
1 From Paul, Silas, and Timothy.
To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
2We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray, 3we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
4My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people. 5When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you. 6 So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
7You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia. 8And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it. 9Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God. 10They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.

Paul's Work in Thessalonica
1My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted. 2 As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble. 3We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone. 4God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
5You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed. 6We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us. 7But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby. 8We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
9My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone. 10Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord. 11You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children. 12We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
13We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you. 14 My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
15 Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else. 16They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them.
Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
17My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person. 18We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us. 19After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us? 20You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_text:
Pɔɔl kaah nan tun man Tesalonika a tiŋin
1Ti nabum, ni tɔɔl nyi ke ti dam ni ban kaa gab yɔli. 2Ni nyi taah nan be Filipi a tiŋin wee bi sugir ti ki jin ti fala man, biba nan gbaar le ke bin gɔɔ ti wɔɔnimin, amaa Uwonbɔr a pɔɔmin le ti kan lipoobil ki mɔɔn U bɔŋann nan ki tenn ni. 3Taah bei ni tibɔr tan nan kaa ye kuŋmaruŋi, kaa ji ye ti jɔɔ lipotiɛbiril liba le, kaa ye kularug mu. 4Amaa ti pag le ke ban wee Uwonbɔr ke bi ŋan nin, Uma ta tibɔŋann nmɔn ki ŋa ti nɔɔn, ni ma bu taa ban ti pag ki penn bininfob a sufu amaa ti ban ti penn Uwonbɔr wan magir ti potiɛlin a sufu le. 5Ni nyi ke taa la nyi ki dan nan pag ni nmɔmɔmi, bee tibɔr tan degin kujaŋuuŋ a bɔri, Uwonbɔr le ye ti siɛra daau. 6Taa nan ban bininfob n pag ti, bee ni ni uba n pag ti bee uninfo uba n pag ti. Taah ye Yisa a toon yin ti bi yin ye litugil le ki sei ni, 7amaa ti nan be le soon, ke upii kaah ŋmag u buwaab man nin. 8Taah jiɛ nim takpemin bu le che ti nan mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin ki sei ni, naa ye tibɔŋann nin a binba amaa ki ban ti junn ti miɛfol ni bu taah ban nim takpem n bu. 9Ibamɔn buu, n nabum, ni li tiɛr ke taah mɔɔn Uwonbɔr a bɔŋann nin ki tenn nin, ti yaa baginn nin ti pɔɔninba-n; ti tun itoon nin le nween nin kunyiɛg naah li ŋa man wee ti laa ye litugil ki sei ni ni uba.
10Nim nin Uwonbɔr le ye ti siɛradam, taah nan be nin nim ban ŋa yada-n, ti nan be kasi le ki jɔɔ nbuchin binben, kaa jɔɔ igbarigi. 11Ni nyi ke ti le ŋmag nim le ke baa kaah ŋmag u baan tɔɔl a buwaab man nin, 12ki pɔɔgir ni gbanann, ki sɔŋir ni sufu, ki balin ni ke ni li be nbinben ŋan man gbeeg Uwonbɔr wan yin ni ki ta ni kɔɔn U naam man jɔɔ jilima-n a num.
13Ti mu le poor Uwonbɔr le iyoo biɛn, nan bu-n, naah gaa Uwonbɔr a bɔr tan wee ni gbir ti ban nin, ni chee sei tibɔr nmɔn le ke taa ye bininfosaalib a bɔri, amaa ke ti sin ye Uwonbɔr a bɔr ibamɔn le, tan tun nin nim ban ŋa yada-n. 14Amaa nim ban ye ti nabum nan, ni toog biwonjiɛm a laginn ban be Judiya wee ki be Masiya ni nle. Ni jin fala ni tɔɔl a bol yaabin le ke biwonjiɛm a laginn nmɔn kaah nan jin fala Juu yaab a nɔɔn man nin, 15bi ma nan ku Yisa nin bilinlemin ki mugir ti mu. Bi nan fiin Uwonbɔr a ŋuul pam. Le ki ji ŋa bininfob biɛn a dataag 16ki gbaar ban baah li ŋa man wee ti laa pag sei ban kaa ye Juu yaabin wee bin kan nŋmarimi. Man nmɔn le che bi bir lagin ki nan kpaa man. Le Uwonbɔr a ŋuul fii bi bu le u dar bi tul ni joorimin.
Pɔɔl kaah jɔɔ kɔlisa nin un ji gɔnn bi man
17N nabum, baah nan fee ki nyan ti wee ti nan fɔɔr sin jiɛn ni-n, ni nan ye tigbanann nin le amaa naa nan ye lipotiɛlin ni, ti gbaar le ke ni ye man biɛn ke ti le ji li kan ni. 18Ti bi ban ti dan ni ban le, min Pɔɔl baan tɔɔl le gbaar le ki le gbaar, amaa le sintani kaa sei ti nsan ni. 19Ti tama nin ti mɔm ye baa, bee ti nyaŋim a yuchigirig kan wee ti na yin ta kan jilima u Yudaan Yisa ban u jirin daalin ye ki laa? Naa ye nimaa? 20Ibamɔn nim le ye ti pag nin ti mɔm.

english_text:
1 Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves 2and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you. 3We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer, 4because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know. 5At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
6 Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
7My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you. 8Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life. 9How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us? 10Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
11We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you. 12May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown. 13And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_text:
1Taah kaa ji nan na li fir ŋmag tiba n-yonn man nin, le ti nan tiɛr ke ni ŋan nin ti laan paar Atensi ti binba. 2Ti tun Timoti wan ye ti toon tun kpiɛg Uwonbɔr a toon n-yaan wee ki mɔɔn Masiya a bɔŋann nle ni ban, ke un nan pɔɔg ni gbanann nin ni yada-n, 3wee u ba n laa lu u yada-n limugil nan bu. Ni tɔɔl nyi ke ni ye Uwonbɔr a wiib le ke ti kan limugil nmɔn a booli. 4Ibamɔn, taah nan be ni ban nin, ti le nan gbaa bei ni ke ti li kan limugil. Le ni sin tun ke naah nyi ni bu nbamɔm man nin. 5Ni ma bu ni che maah kaa ji nan na li fir ŋmag n ba-n, le n nan tun ke bin nan lig ni yada kaah si man. N nan san bijawaam le ke, nba ke ulinlaril n par lar ni wee ti yaa baginn n gab yɔli.
6Amaa Timoti le la nyan ni ban le ki foon ti ban ki ŋmagin tibɔŋann ki ta jiin ni yada nin ni jiɛm paam. U bei ti ke ni le la tiɛr ti bu le ki bi ban ni kan ti, ke ti mu kaah le ban ti kan ni man nin. 7Mambu n nabum, nin ti mugil nin ti fala a jimin biɛn nin, ti jɔɔ ngbanann pɔɔn ki jiin ni yada kan wee ni jɔɔ n paam. 8Daandaan nan, naah si nbamɔm Uyudaan a samin nan man, ti sin fo. 9Ipoor takpen ilaba wee ti yin ta sei Uwonbɔr ni buu ki jiin nmɔn man biɛn wee ti jɔɔ Uwonbɔr a nintogil ni buu? 10Nween nin kunyiɛg ti le miɛ Uwonbɔr ki bi ban ti kan ni jigin wee ki ter ni nan par ni yada-n.
11Ti Baa Uwonbɔr baan tɔɔl nin ti Yudaau Yisa n mann nsan ki sei ti wee ti dan ni ban. 12Uyudaan n che njiɛm man wee ni jɔɔ ban ni tabin n mann tann ki pii uninfo biɛn, ke ti yaa bamin kaah be nin ni man nin. 13Un pɔɔg ni sufu wee ni laa jɔɔ igbarigi ki li be kasi ti Baa Uwonbɔr a nintogil n-yonn man wee ti Yudaau Yisa na li foon nin u kasi a ninfobin.

english_text:
A Life That Pleases God
1Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder. 2Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus. 3God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex. 4Respect and honor your wife. 5Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God. 6You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things. 7God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure. 8So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
9We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this, 10and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more. 11Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do. 12 Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone.
The Lord's Coming
13My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope. 14We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died. 15 Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
16 With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life. 17Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever. 18Encourage each other with these words.
translation_text:
Nbinben man gbeeg Uwonbɔr a num
1N nabum, ni joorimin, ti wɔɔn ni na li ŋa man wee ni binbem li gbeeg Uwonbɔr a num, ke naah pii be man nin. Daandaan nan ti balin ni le ki bei ni ke ni le li gbaa be man na Uyudaan Yisa a yinlin. 2Ni nyi nwɔɔnim man wee ti ta sei ni Uyudaan Yisa a pɔɔmin. 3Ni ye Uwonbɔr a bam le ke ni li be kasi wee ki nyan ni ba iwanchɔgin toon nin ni jabanlin bee ni piibanlin; 4ke ni biɛn n tinn ki biɛ naah li ŋa man ki fir ŋmag ni baan tɔɔl a gbanann kasi nin jilima a binbemin, 5ki laa jɔɔ nmɔsanyunsɔɔm ke ban kaa ye Juu yaab wee kaa nyi Uwonbɔr n kaah be man n ni; 6ni ma bu tibɔr nan yaan uba laa tun ki bii u kpiɛg bee ki ji u kpiɛg dulimi. Uyudaan li dar bininfosaalib ban biɛn tun tibir nan a booli a tul, ke taah pii chinn bei ni ki kpaan ni man nin. 7Uwonbɔr kaa yin ti ke ti li jɔɔ tijaginn ni, amaa ke ti li jɔɔ kasi a binbem. 8Mambu uninfo wan yii kaa nɔɔ nwɔɔnim nan ke, naa ye uninfosaal le u yii amaa u yii Uwonbɔr wan sei ni U Kasi a Naaŋin le.
9Daandaan nan ki jiin kunabitiig a jiɛmin paam, naa ji ye ti sɔb le ki sei ni, Uwonbɔr le wɔɔn ni tɔɔl naah li jiɛ tab man. 10Le ni ye ibamɔn le, ni sin ban n nabum man biɛn be Masedoniya a tiŋin nin. Jigin ti balin ni le ke ni mann tun man takpema. 11Ni che ni li ye ni toonl ke ni li be nbinben ŋan, ki che ni baga li be ni tɔɔl a toon yin ki li jɔɔ ni nɔɔi tun ki jiu, ke taah bei ni man nin, 12naah li ŋa man wee ni binbem li ye jilima ki sei ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin, wee ni laa be uba bu.
Uyudaan a dam
13N nabum, taa ban ni li be ki laa nyi ban dɔɔn jiɛn nin bu, bee ki jɔɔ npoobiin ke bininfob ban gur kaa jɔɔ tama-n kaah be man nni. 14Ti ŋa yada ke Yisa kpo ki fii nkumin na, ni ma bu che ti jɔɔ yada ke Uwonbɔr le ŋmagin ban nan dɔɔn jiɛn Yisa nni ki dan.
15Uyudaan baan tɔɔl a mɔbonl le ti bei ni ke, tim ban la be ti miɛfolin wee ki guu Uyudaan a damin, taa na yin chinn ban dɔɔn jiɛn nni. 16Uyudaan baan tɔɔl li nya papaab ki jiirin, ki nan sei bimɔb nin nkukɔ pɔɔn wee ti gbir malakam a ninkpelu a kukɔl nin Uwonbɔr a natun yinkaagin a mɔr, le bininfob ban nan gaa Yisa wee ki nin kpe-n li chinn fii nkumin. 17Le ni bɔɔn bu, le tim ban mu la fo wee ki gur be dulinya nan yaan nin mu li yug lagin nin bi ki too Uyudaan kitilangbɔŋin. Le ki nin gbaa be nin Uyudaan iyoo biɛn. 18Mambu ni ta imɔbon nan ki pɔɔg tab a gbanann na man.

english_text:
1I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen. 2 You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night. 3People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
4My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief. 5You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark. 6Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert. 7People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk. 8 But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
9God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ. 10Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes. 11This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing.
Final Instructions and Greetings
12My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord. 13Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other. 14My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone. 15Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
16Always be joyful 17and never stop praying. 18Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
19Don't turn away God's Spirit 20or ignore prophecies. 21Put everything to the test. Accept what is good 22and don't have anything to do with evil.
23I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns. 24The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
25Friends, please pray for us.
26Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
27In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
28I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_text:
Ŋa sili ki li guu Uyudaan a dam
1Daandaan nan, n nabum, naa kpaa talar nin ti sɔb ki wɔɔn ni n-yonn bee idaa, 2nan bu-n ni nyi nbamɔm ke Uyudaan a dan daal na yin be le ke unaayig kaah chaan kunyiɛg man nin. 3N-yonn man wee bininfob li len ke “Nposɔɔn dan na bi gaa bi ba-n,” libol nmɔn le tibɔbir li dan bi bu, ni na yin be le ke nmarwiɛn kaah choo upii ke ni be man nin, le baa li ŋmari. 4Amaa nim, n nabum nan ma, naa be libunbɔnlin ni, mambu ni laa che lidaal nmɔn n nan lir ni ke unaayig a dan ni. 5Ni biɛn nan ye nwonween nin nweehn a buwaab le. Taa ye kunyiɛg bee libunbɔnl a ninfobi. 6Ni ma bu, ni laa che ti be ke bitab kaah be man ki dɔ jiɛn ni ni, amaa ni che ti li lig ki li chor ti bau. 7Ban dɔ jiɛn nin jiɛn kunyiɛg le, ban mu nyu ndaam gbeegin mu nyugbeeg kunyiɛg le. 8Amaa tim kaah ye nweehn a ninfobin, ni che ti li chor ti bau, ki li jɔɔ yada nin njiɛm man li guu ti gbanann, ki li jɔɔ nŋmarim a tama man wee ti li ta chig ti yul bu ke kijabig. 9Uwonbɔr kaa gann ti ke ti nan ji fala le U ŋuufiiŋin ni, amaa ke ti nan kan nŋmarim ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya bu. 10U kpo tim bu le, a lig le bee a jiɛn le ke ni, ti na li lagin ki be nin U. 11Ni ma bu ni li pɔɔg tab a gbanann ki li kpiɛg tab bu ke naah pii ŋaan man nin na.
Nwɔɔnim man joor nin ipoor
12N nabum, ti balin ni le, ni li tenn ban pɔɔn biba ni sisiigin ki ye ni sanliib Uyudaan a samin ki wɔɔn ni nwonjiɛn binben nin jilimau. 13Ni li tenn bi jilima takpema, ki li jɔɔ njiɛm nin bi toon yin bu. Ni li be nin nposɔɔn nin taba.
14Ti balin ni le, n nabum, ni kpaan ban ye bigbanyagdamin na, ki pɔɔg ban san bijawaamin a sufuu, ki ter ban a yada kaa pɔɔ-n, ki li jɔɔ limɔril nin uninfo biɛn na. 15Ni laa che uba nta tibir ki yɔ tibiri, amaa ni pɔɔn niba ki li jɔɔ nbinben ŋan nin tab nin uninfo biɛn.
16Ni che ni li mɔ ni iyoo biɛn na; 17Ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr iyoo biɛn na; 18niwann biɛn a poolin ke ni li poor Uwonbɔr a, Uwonbɔr a bam le yen ki sei ni Masiya bu.
19Ni laa junn Kinaaŋ a ŋmiimin ni; 20ni laa yin ilinlen leen yɔli. 21Ni mag i biɛn liga, ki gann yan ŋan ki li ŋmaga. 22Ni nyan niba tibir biɛn a tumin na.
23Che Uwonbɔr tɔɔl, wan ye nposɔɔn a Uwonbɔr win n ŋa ni kasi niwann biɛn nin. Ki che ni naaŋ nin ni sufu nin ni gbanann biɛn n laa nan jɔɔ igbarig ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a dan daali. 24Uwonbɔr wan yin ni nan li tun man, U ye yada daan le.
25N nabum, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr tenn ta.
26Ni poor ti nabumin biɛn nbamɔma.
27N bei ni le Uyudaan a nintogil ke ni karin kugbɔŋ nan ki sei n nabumin biɛn na.
28Ti yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl li be ni bu.

english_text:
1 From Paul, Silas, and Timothy.
To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
When Christ Returns
3My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time. 4This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
5All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering. 6It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble, 7but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels 8and with a flaming fire.
Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message. 9 Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength. 10This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
11God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do. 12Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_text:
1Min Pɔɔl nin Silasi nin Timoti,
Le sɔb kugbɔŋ nan ki tenn biwonjiɛm a laguŋ kan be Tesalonika ki be nin ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya bu:
2Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be ni bu.
Tibɔr a jim tan na li be Masiya a damin
3N nabum, ni ye ti poor Uwonbɔr le ni bu, ni ŋan nin ti ŋa man, nan bu-n ni yada-n le mann yabirig le takpem, le njiɛm man wee ni jiɛ tabin mann kpiɛg le. 4Ni ma bu Uwonbɔr a ninfob a laginn nan a sisiigin, ti far ligbingbanl le ni bu nin naah jɔɔ limɔril nin yada limugil nin libiginl biɛn a poolin wee ni la biɛ nin jɔɔ yada n bu.
5Ni niɛ biɛn ye siɛra le ki wɔɔn ke Uwonbɔr a bɔjil ŋan, le ni joorimin bi li kan ni ki kpiɛ bininfob ŋamin Uwonbɔr a naam man bu wee ni ji fala nan. 6Uwonbɔr ye ubuchin le: Ban mugir ni-n, U li yɔ bi ki jiin, 7ki sei nim ban wee bi mugir ni-n lifooril, nin ti biɛn. Ni na yin ŋa n-yonn man wee Uyudaan Yisa nan kpiir ki nyan papaab nin nŋmipeen nin u malakam ban jɔɔ npɔɔn nin. 8U li dar ban kaa nyi Uwonbɔr a tuli nin ban kaa ŋa ti Yudaau Yisa a bɔŋann nin yada-n. 9Bi li ji fala wan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmi bi tudaril nmɔn a poolin. Uwonbɔr na li ŋɔɔr bi ki nyan Uyudaan ban ki che bin lann u pɔɔm man jɔɔ jilima-n, 10lidaal lan wee u nan dan un nan gaa u pag kasi a ninfob nin u jilima ban biɛn ŋa u yada-n ban nin. Ni tɔɔl kpiɛ niin na, ni ŋa tibɔr tan wee ti pag sei nin yadau.
11Naah be ti sufu-n nin bu, le ti miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni iyoo biɛn, ke ti Wonbɔru n ŋa ni bininfob ŋam ke waah yin ni ki ban ni li be man nin, ki che naah tiɛr nan biɛn n ŋa n ŋam ki sei ni u yaa pɔɔm bu, ki che ni gbaar ni yada a toonlin. 12Ti miɛ Uwonbɔr le ke un che ti Yudaau Yisa a yinlin kan kupag ni ni, wee ni mu n kan kupag u ni, ti Wonbɔru nin Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl bu.

english_text:
The Lord's Return
1 When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends, 2not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters. 3But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear. 4 He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God. 5Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
6You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come. 7His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way. 8 Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
9 When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs. 10Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it. 11So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie. 12All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth.
Be Faithful
13My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth. 14God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ. 15My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
16God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father 17will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_text:
Limɔyiildaan
1Ki jiin ti Yudaau Yisa a dam paam nin taah na yin lagin U ban man, le ti balin ni ke, n nabum, 2ni laa che nin ŋmarin ni potiɛli, bee ki yugin ni lam ki ta jiin ilinlen leen yan wee bibam pag bee tibɔr beikaar bee kugbɔŋ kan nyan bi ban ki ke tim ban le ki nyan nin. Imɔleen yan forin nin kaah len ke ti Yudaau a dam a daa-n pii foon nin bu. 3Ni laa che uba n ta niba lar ni, lidaal nmɔn kaa la yin foo see ke wan kɔnn nin bininkpeeb nin limɔyiildaan nin nyan npaan ni, wan a binbebol ye nŋmi-n nin. 4Waa yin chee sei iween yan wee bi jiɛn nni, le ki sin yuur uba paab ki jo iween nmɔn, le ki ta uba ki siin Uwonbɔr a binbebol ki ke u ye Uwonbɔr le.
5Naa tiɛr ke maah nan be ni ban nin, n nan gbaa bei ni ni niɛ nan biɛn naa? 6Le ni nyi ni wan nan la ŋmag u daandaan nan, naah li ŋa man wee un nan kpiir uba n-yonn man kpaan nin un nyan. 7Npɔɔn man woo limɔyiildaan nmɔn a bɔɔn nin pii piin itoon na; amaa wan la ŋmag mi wee maa tun nin, le la ŋmag man le, hali nin Uwonbɔr kaah na li nyan nan ŋmag mi nmɔn. 8Le limɔyiildaan nmɔn n nin kpiirin, wan wee Uyudaan Yisa na yin foor u mɔb a faam ki ku u, u dan daal nmɔn u na li bii limɔyiildaan nmɔn. 9Limɔyiildaan nin na yin dan nin Sintani a pɔɔmin le, ki nan tun ligaril nin lijinjeel a toon ki ji tibɔkar a siɛra, 10u li ta u binben biim nmɔn ki lar bininfob ki bii bi, baah yii ibamɔn yan li sei bi nŋmarimin bu. 11Ni ma bu le Uwonbɔr ta kuŋmaruŋ a pɔɔm ŋa bi sufu ni ke nin che bi li pag tibɔkar 12wee ni joorimin Uwonbɔr na li bii ban biɛn kaa ŋa ibamɔn nin yada wee ki sin gann tibirin.
Feeja bu le Uwonbɔr gann ni
13Ni ye ti le li poor Uwonbɔr le iyoo biɛn ni bu, n nabum, nim ban wee Uyudaan jiɛ, nan bu-n npiinimin Uwonbɔr nan gann ni le ke ni kan nŋmarim Kinaaŋin a pɔɔmin ki ŋa ni u kasi a ninfob nin naah ŋa ibamɔn nin yada-n. 14Tibɔŋann tan wee ti pag tenn nin le Uwonbɔr ta yin ni, ke nim nin ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya n nan lagin kan u jilima-n. 15Ni ma bu n nabum, ni mann sir nbamɔm ki li ŋmag taah wɔɔn ni man nin, naah ye imɔleen le ti pag bee kugbɔŋ le ti sɔb sei ni ke ni.
16Ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya nin ti Baa Uwonbɔr, wan jiɛ ti nin U nyunyunbasanlin bu n kɔɔn ti lipoobil ki sei ti tama ŋaŋ, 17Un sei ni lipoobil ki pɔɔg ni gbanann nin itoon ŋan nin imɔleen ŋan.

english_text:
Pray for Us
1Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do. 2Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith. 3But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm. 4He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying. 5I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ.
Warnings against Laziness
6My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you. 7You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing, 8and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
9We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you. 10We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat. 11Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody. 12So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living. 13Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
14Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them. 15Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower.
Final Prayer
16I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
17I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
18I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_text:
Ni miɛ Uwonbɔr sei ti ni
1Ni joorimin, n nabum, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ta wee Uyudaan a bɔrin fir mɔɔn weem wee bin gaa ti nin jilima, ke naah nan gaa ti man nin. 2Ki ji miɛ Uwonbɔr ke un nyan ti bipootondam nin tininfobir a nɔɔn, nan bu-n naa ye uninfo biɛn le jɔɔ yada.
3Amaa Uyudaan ye yada daan le, u li pɔɔg ni gbanann ki guur ni wee kininbɔŋ n laa kan ni. 4Uyudaan che ti jɔɔ tidindann ni bu ke ni tun, ki le mann tun ke taah bei ni man nin.
5Uyudaan n che ni biɛ Uwonbɔr a jiɛm nin limɔril lan nyan Masiya ban nin.
Naah kpaan ti tun itoon man
6Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a yinl bu, le ti bei ni ke, n nabum, ni nyan ni num ki sin jiɛn n nabum man biɛn san ligbanyagil kaa be taah wɔɔn bi ke bi li be man nni. 7Ni baan tɔɔl nyi nbamɔm ke ni ni ye ni li tun le ke taah tun man ni. Taah nan be ni ban nin, taa nan san ligbanyagil, 8bee ki jin uba a jiir yɔli wee kaa yɔn ti bu. Amaa ti pɔɔn tiba le ki tun nween nin kunyiɛg, naah li ŋa man wee ti laa ye litugil ki sei ni ni uba. 9Nan bu che ti tun nin kaa ye ke taa bi li fir ji ni wan yɔli amaa ti ŋa limagil le ki wɔɔn ni ke ni li nɔɔ. 10Hali n-yonn man wee ti nan be ni ban ni, ti nan sei ni nsiim ke: “Wan yii kaa tun ke, u mu laa ji.”
11Ti gbir ke biba be ni sisiigin ki ye bigbanyagdam. Baa tun nin inunman ni; amaa le ki sin jɔɔ bi nɔɔi kɔɔn biba a bɔrin. 12Bininfob nmɔn a bol le ti jɔɔ Uyudaan Yisa Masiya a yinl ki kpaan bi ke bin pɔɔn biba wee ki tun ki kan bi tɔɔl a jiir ki ji.
13Amaa nim ma bu ke, n nabum, ni laa ke ni bagir itoon ŋan a tum bu. 14Ni ye uba kaa chee ti wɔɔnim man be kugbɔŋ nan yaan nan ke, ni li mann nyi u bu ki laa che ni baga be u ni, wee ifa n choo u. 15Nin ni ma biɛn ni, laa ta man a ninfobol kpann a dataagi, amaa kpaan mu ke a nabigin.
Tibɔjoor kaar
16Uyudaan wan ye nposɔɔndaan baan tɔɔl n sei ni nposɔɔn isaŋ biɛn nin niwann biɛn nin. Uyudaan li be nin ni biɛn.
17Min Pɔɔl le taa n tɔɔl a nɔɔ ki sɔb ipoor nan, maah sɔb n yinl man kugbɔŋ biɛn a diɛmin le yen. Man le n sɔb.
18Ti Yudaau Yisa Masiya a nyunyunbasanl li be ni biɛn bu.

english_text:
1From Paul.
God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
2 Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace!
Warning against False Teaching
3When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings. 4You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
5You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith. 6There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk. 7They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
8We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way. 9We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents. 10The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching 11of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me.
Being Thankful for God's Kindness
12I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me. 13 I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him. 14Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
15“Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all! 16But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life. 17I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
18Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier. 19You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences. 20Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_text:
1Min Pɔɔl wan wee Uwonbɔr ŋaam Masiya a toomin, wan ye ti feeru nin Masiya wan bu wee ti jɔɔ tama-n,
2N sɔb tenn Timoti wan ye n big bamɔŋ yada bu nle:
Ti Baa Uwonbɔr nin ti Yudaau Masiya a linyunyunbasanl nin nposɔɔn li be a bu.
Pɔɔl kaah wɔɔn Timoti waah li kɔn tibɔkar a wɔɔnim bu man
3Ke maah pii nan beiŋ man n-yonn man wee n nan jon Masedoniya-n, li be Efesusi wee ki che bininfob bibam nlaa ji wɔɔn tibɔkari, 4ki che bin nyan biba bi yaajam a bɔkpegir tan ye tibɔkar a teeni ki nyan bi yaajam a yiin npaamin. Ni ma che limɔkpel forin kaa ye Uwonbɔr a niin a toonl lan ye yada nbu. 5Nwɔɔnim nan a num kaah paa nan bu ye njiɛm le, man nyan kasi a sufu-n nin ipotiɛ ŋan nin ibamɔn a yada-n. 6Bininfob bibam yii ni niɛ le, ki tur ki kɔɔ ileen yan kaa jɔɔ bu a pagimin. 7Bi ban bi li ye ban wɔɔnn nsiim le, amaa baa nyi baah pag nan nmɔn ni bee nan wee bi pag nin tidindann nmɔn ni.
8Ti nyi nsiim nmɔn kaah ŋan, ni ye uninfo ŋmag mi nbamɔm ke. 9Ti ji nyi nsiimin kaah kaa siin sei ban ye bibuchimi, amaa ban ye tukangbirdam, nin ban kaa san Uwonbɔr, nin tibirdam, nin tijagindam nin ban galin Uwonbɔr, nin ban ku bi baam, nin ban ku bi nam nin bininfokub, 10nin ban tun iwanjaab toon, nin ban yii bi piib wee ki dɔ nin bijab tabin, nin ban jɔɔ biyom kpeŋ nin ban ye tibɔkardam, nin ban ji tibɔkar a siɛra, nin ban biɛn kaa nɔɔ ibamɔn a wɔɔnimin, 11ni niɛ nan le ye jilima a bɔŋann tan nyan tikaar a Wonbɔru ban, le u ta ŋa n nɔɔn ke n li mɔɔn na.
Uwonbɔr kaah san Pɔɔl kunyunyunbaag man
12N poor ti Yudaau Masiya, nin waah seim npɔɔn, ki ŋaam yada daan, ki taam ŋa u toon yin. 13Hali maah le nan sugir u, ki mugir u, ki pag tibɔbir ki tenn win, u nan sam kunyunyunbaaga, nan bu-n maa nan nyi maah tun nan ni, maah kaa nan jɔɔ yada-n bu. 14Ti yudaau nan kpaar u nyunyunbasanl takpem le ki jaa n bu, ki ji kpiɛ yada nin njiɛm man be Masiya nin. 15Ni niɛ nan ye ibamɔn le, ni kpaan nin bininfob n gaa ti nbamɔm: Masiya nan dan dulinya nan yaan ke u nan fee tibirdam le jaa, min le ye tibirdaan ki jon bi biɛn. 16Amaa ni niɛ bu le Uwonbɔr nan sam kunyunyunbaag, ke min wan ye chinchinn a birdaau win, wee Masiya n fir wɔɔn u mɔril lan kaa jɔɔ tarig wee ni li ye limagil ki sei ban li ŋa Yisa yada ki kan limiɛfol lan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmi. 17Daandaan nan, Ubɔr wan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛm, wan kaa kpegi, wan wee baa ga, Uwonbɔr uba, Uma ŋan nin jilima nin kupag hali nin iyoo yan kaa jɔɔ ndiɛmi. Ibamɔn.
18N bija, Timoti, n jɔɔ ikpaan nan ki ŋaan a nɔɔn, ikpaan nmɔn ye bilinlem kaah pii nan pag man ki jiin a paamin le. Ni ye a nɔɔn min nbamɔm ke a fir kɔn likɔnŋanl. 19Li ŋmag a yada nin a potiɛŋamin na. Biba nan yii mi le ki che bi yada bii. 20Bi ma ye Hamenasi nin Alɛgzanda, ban wee n ta bi ŋubin Sintani a nɔɔn ke un dar bi tul wee bin jiɛn Uwonbɔr a sugir.

english_text:
How To Pray
1First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them. 2Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God. 3This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior. 4God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
5There is only one God,
and Christ Jesus
is the only one
who can bring us
to God.
Jesus was truly human,
and he gave himself
to rescue all of us.
6God showed us this
at the right time.
7 This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
8I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
9 I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls. 10Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others, 11and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention. 12They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do. 13 After all, Adam was created before Eve, 14 and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned. 15But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_text:
1Chinchinn, n bei ni le ke, ni li miɛ Uwonbɔr ki tenn ni ba, ki li miɛ u ki tenn ni kpiɛtiib, ki li tenn Uwonbɔr kunɔɔpoog bininfob biɛn buu, 2ki li miɛ ki tenn bibɔrtiib nin biyudam biɛn wee ti fir be soon nin nposɔɔn ki li jɔɔ nwonjiɛn binben ki li be kasi. 3Ni niɛ le ŋan, ki gbee Uwonbɔr wan fee ti gabin a num, 4wan ban bininfob biɛn n kan feegab wee ki biɛ nbamɔmin. 5Nan bu-n, Uwonbɔr ye uba le, le usandanfaar mu ye uba ki be Uwonbɔr nin bininfob a sisiigin, uja nmɔn le ye Masiya, 6uma nan ta u miɛl ki daa bininfob biɛn, Uwonbɔr kaah nan pag siɛra kan ni a yoo dede. 7Ni niɛ nan bu le Uwonbɔr gannim ki ŋaam wan mɔɔn nin ntoon. N pag ibamɔn le, maa por tibɔkari, ki ye wan wɔɔn ban kaa ye Juu yaab yada a bamɔn.
8N ban bijab kaah be nan yaan biɛn ndon bi kasi a nɔɔi ki miɛ Uwonbɔr, wee ni laa jɔɔ sufu fiiŋ bee limɔkpeli. 9N mu ji ban bipiib n yee tiwann yɔɔr tan ŋan ki nɔɔn bi le, tan kaa jɔɔ igalin, bee ifa a yukper loli, bee salima bee nlanbim bee tiwann yɔɔr tan jɔɔ kudaapɔɔrugi, 10amaa wee ki li tun nan ŋan na, ni ma ŋan ki sei bipiib ban ke bi jiɛn Uwonbɔr. 11Upii ye un tinn le ki li be soon nin limɔcheel. 12Maa sei upii npaan ke un wɔɔn ni bee u li jɔɔ npɔɔn ki jon uja, u ye u li ŋmin le. 13Adam le bi nan chinn naan, le ki nin naan Iif. 14Naa ye Adam le Sintani nan lari, upii le Sintani nan lar le u labir tibirdaan. 15Amaa bipiib li kan feegab, nin baah le maa nbuwaab nan biɛn na, ni ye bi le la si bi yada bu ki jɔɔ njiɛm nin kasi a binbem ke.

english_text:
Church Officials
1It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile. 2 That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach. 3They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
4Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful. 5If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
6They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil. 7Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil.
Church Officers
8Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money. 9And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith. 10They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
11Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
12Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home. 13Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus.
The Mystery of Our Religion
14I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions, 15so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
16Here is the great mystery of our religion:
Christ came as a human.
The Spirit proved
that he pleased God,
and he was seen by angels.
Christ was preached
to the nations.
People in this world
put their faith in him,
and he was taken up to glory.
translation_text:
Biwonjiɛm sanliib a bɔr
1Ni niɛ nan ye ibamɔn le: Ni ye uninfo tiɛr u sufu ni ke u ban un ŋa uwonjiɛn sanliir ke, ni kpaan nin un tun itoon ŋan. 2Ni ma bu naa kpaan nin uwonjiɛn sanliir li jɔɔ igalin ni. Ni kpaan u li jɔɔ upii uba le kpeŋileŋ, ki laa jɔɔ kiŋuufiiŋi ki ye wan li fir ŋmag uba nbamɔm, ki li ye wan wee bininfob tenn u jilima, ki li ye wan gaan bicham, ki li ye wan li fir wɔɔnn, 3ki laa ye udanyugbeer, ki laa ye ukɔnban ni, amaa ki li ye wan be soon, ki laa ye umɔkpefari bee ulig ban ni. 4Ni kpaa talar le nin u li ye wan fir ŋmag u niin yaab nbamɔm, wee u buwaab mu li tenn u jilima. 5(Ni ye wan kaa nyi waah li ŋa man ki ŋmag u niin yaab ke, u yin ŋa nii wee ki ŋmag Uwonbɔr a ninfobaa?) 6U laa ye wan yɔɔn ta uba sei Yisa, ni ye man ke u na li kpann kalanbaanidaan ki nan kan litudaril ke ulinlarin. 7Ni kpaa le nin u li ye wan jɔɔ jilima ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin ban, wee ki laa ji ifa ki lu ulinlarin a kurug n-yaan ni.
Bititerib ban ter biwonjiɛm a bɔr
8Ni li ye man ki sei bititerib mu, ni kpaa talar le nin bi li jɔɔ nbinben ŋan wee bininfob li tenn bi jilima, ki li ye bibamɔndam, ki laa nyuu ndaam takpemi, ki laa ban bin kan tiyɔr tibɔkar bu. 9Ni kpaa le nin bi li ŋmag yada a bɔwoonkaar tan ye ibamɔn nin, wee bi sufu li ween. 10Ni kpaa le nin bin mag bititerib nmɔn a binbem ki lig, ni ye baa jɔɔ igalin ke, bin jiɛn bi wee bin ŋa bititerib. 11Ni ye man le ki sei bititerib nmɔn a piib mu, bi li ye ban jɔɔ jilima, ki laa ye bibɔɔnsubi, amaa wee ki laa ye ban jɔɔ kiŋuufiiŋi ki li be soon ki ye ban wee bininfob ŋa bi yada. 12Ni kpaa le nin utiter li jɔɔ upii uba kpeŋileŋ ki ji li ye wan li fir ŋmag u buwaab nin u niin yaab biɛn nbamɔm. 13Ban tun nbamɔm kan sisibol ŋan na ki jɔɔ lipoobil takpem nin bi yada wan wee bi jɔɔ nin Masiya-n.
Tibɔwoonkaar tan polig
14Hali nin maah le jɔɔ tama ke n li dan ki nan gɔnniŋ daandaan nan nin, n sɔb kugbɔŋ nan le n seiŋ ikpaan, 15ni ye maa dan weem ke, kugbɔŋ nmɔn li che a biɛ bininfob a binbem kaah ye man Uwonbɔr a niin, ban ye Uwonbɔr wan fo a wonjiɛmin, ki ye kijaantelig nin ibamɔn a fiɛl. 16Ti biɛn chee tibɔwoonkaarin kaah polig man ti wonjiɛnlin na:
U nan degirin nin tigbanann na,
Kinaaŋ nan wɔɔn waah kan nnyaŋim man na,
Malakam nan kan wa,
Bi nan mɔɔn u bɔr ki sei ibol biɛn na,
Bi nan ŋa u yada dulinya nan yaan na,
U nan ta u don paab nin jilimau.

english_text:
People Will Turn from Their Faith
1God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons. 2They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars 3will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth. 4Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything. 5What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat.
Paul's Advice to Timothy
6If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed. 7Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious. 8-9As the saying goes,
“Exercise is good
for your body,
but religion helps you
in every way.
It promises life
now and forever.”
These words are worthwhile and should not be forgotten. 10We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
11Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say. 12Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
13Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching. 14Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you. 15Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing. 16Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_text:
Ban wɔɔn tibɔkar a bɔr
1Kinaaŋ len na, ke idajoorikaa-n, bininfob bibam na li ta bi yada gab, ki nin nɔɔ nnaanbiim man ye bilinlarib nin npɔniim kaah wɔɔn nan. 2Nwɔɔm nmɔn nya bitingbiib ban larin ban le, ban a potiɛl denn ke bi ta kukurug toŋ le tabin nin. 3Bi kɔɔg bininfob le lipiikɔɔnl nin lijakunl, nin tijiir tibam a jim, tan wee Uwonbɔr naan ki ta sei tim ban ŋa u yada ki nyi ibamɔn nin, ke ti ga wee ki sei U kunɔɔpoogin. 4Nan wee Uwonbɔr naan nin biɛn ŋan, ti laa yii niba ni ye ti gaa ni nin kunɔɔpoog ke, 5nan bu-n Uwonbɔr a bɔr nin liwonmiɛl le che tijiir nmɔn be kasi.
Masiya a toontunn ŋau a bɔr
6A ta ni niɛ nan ki wɔɔn a nabum ke, a li ŋa usanliiŋan Masiya a toontumin, ŋaah nɔɔ ibamɔn a yada nin nwɔɔn ŋam man wugiriŋin. 7Laa nɔɔ ban kaa ye biwonjiɛmin a teeni nin tinaakpabɔri, pɔɔn a ba ki li jɔɔ nwonjiɛn binben. 8Tigbanann a tunim jɔɔ tinyɔɔr ti ba ti ni, amaa nwonjiɛn binben jɔɔ tinyɔɔr niwann biɛn ni, ki ŋmag limɔsiinl lan tun daandaan nan nin iyoo yan la chaan nin. 9Ni niɛ nan ye ibamɔn le, ni kpaan nin bininfob n gaa ti nbamɔm, 10(Mambu le ti tun nin linunmanl) nan bu-n ti jɔɔ tama Uwonbɔr wan fo-n ban, wan ye bininfob biɛn a feeru win, naah jann tɔɔ ban bu ye ban ŋa u yada n le.
11Siin nsiim wee ki wɔɔn ni niɛ nan. 12Laa che bin lig ki ziɛŋ ŋaah ye kibipɔliŋ nbu, amaa ŋa limagil ki wɔɔn yadadam a pipagirin, a miɛfolin, a bamin, a yada-n nin a kasi a toon yin. 13Hali nin maah na li dan n-yonn man, a li jɔɔ isaŋ ki karin Uwonbɔr a bɔr nmɔn ki tenn bininfoba, wee ki li mɔɔn ti ki li jɔɔ ti wɔɔn ba. 14Laa che a piin yin ŋa yɔli, nan ye ilinlen leen ki seiŋ n-yonn man wee bininkpeeb nan ta bi nɔɔ-i paan a bu-n. 15Li jɔɔ inunman tibɔr nan yaan man, ki ta a gbanann biɛn ki sei ba, ni ma yin che bininfob biɛn n kan a kpaarim. 16Li nyi a ba bu, ki li ŋmag a wɔɔmin nbamɔm. Li jɔɔ inunman bi bu, nan bu-n ni ye a ŋaan man ke, a li fee a ba nin ban pelig a wɔɔm nmɔn ki jaa.

english_text:
How To Act toward Others
1Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother, 2and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
3Take care of any widow who is really in need. 4But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do. 5 A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
6A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
7Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing. 8People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
9For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least 60 years old, and she must have been faithful in marriage. 10She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
11Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ 12and become guilty of breaking their promise to him. 13Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
14I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us. 15Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
16If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need.
Church Leaders
17Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching. 18 It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
19 Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges. 20But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
21In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
22Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them.
Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
23Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
24Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later. 25It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_text:
Yadadam a toon kaah ye man
1Laa fuun wan joŋ bu, amaa pag u nin nniɛn diin ke a baa-n. Li ŋmag nnachipɔnbum ke a na bumin, 2ki li ŋmag bipiininkpeeb ke a namin, ki ji li ŋmag nbisiɛm ke a ninsiɛbin nin kasi a binbem.
3Li lig ipukɔɔ yan sin ban literilin nbamɔm nin jilima. 4Amaa lipukɔɔl lan jɔɔ nbuwaab bee iyaabil ke, nbuwaab nin iyaabili nmɔn le ye bin chinn tinn biwonjiɛnl a sam ki li jɔɔ tun ki lig bi niin yaab, bi ŋa man ke bi li yɔ ki jiin bi baam nin bi yaajam kaah nan tun nan ki sei bin, Uwonbɔr a num kaah gbeeg nan le yen. 5Lipukɔɔl lan sin ban nterimin wee kaa jɔɔ wan li ter win, u tama be Uwonbɔr ban le, le u miɛ Uwonbɔr ki ban nterim nween nin kunyiɛg. 6Amaa lipukɔɔl lan ta liba ki sei tigbanann a bam ma pii kpou, hali nin waah le la fo-n nan biɛn yɔli. 7Ta nwɔɔm nan ki wɔɔn bininfob nmɔn na, wee bi laa jɔɔ igalin ni. 8Ni ye wan kaa ter u maali, nin naah jann tɔɔ ban bu u tɔɔl a niin yaab ke, u yaa daan kaa ji ŋa yada le nmɔn, ni bu u bir ki jon wan kaa ye uwonjiɛn na 9Lipukɔɔl lan kaa la foo ibin piloob kaa kpiɛ ipukɔɔ a kanlin ni, see wan jon ibin piloob, ki ye wan wee u chal ŋa u yada, 10wee bininfob nyi u nbamɔm u toon ŋan bu, ki ta jiin waah wubiri u buwaab man, nin waah tun jiininba a toon ki tenn biwonjiɛm man, nin waah gaan bicham u niin man, nin waah li tenn ban be limugilin literil lan, nin waah ta u ba ki sei itoon ŋan nin biɛn man. 11Amaa bipiisapɔm ban ye ipukɔɔ n ma, laa ta bi yin ki kpiɛ nin yaan ni. Nan bu-n ni ye bi kɔlisa nan jir tigbanann a bam paam ke, bi yiin Yisa le ki ban bin kun tichar. 12Ni ye man ke bi ban tibɔr a jim ki sei biba le nmɔn, nan bu-n bi bii bi chinchinn a mɔsiinlin na. 13Nan kpiɛ, ni che bi bii bi saŋi le, ki jin kɔɔ bininfob a niin yin ki chaa, naa ye bi bii bi saŋ a binba le, amaa bi su libɔɔnsul le ki jɔɔ linunmanl lan kaa jɔɔ nyɔɔri, ki kɔɔ tibɔr tan kaa nyan bi-n 14Ni bu n kpaan bipiisapɔm ban ye ipukɔɔ nbiɛn le ke bin kum bijab, ki maa nbuwaab, ki li lig bi niin nbamɔm wee ki laa che kidataagin n kan npaan ki ŋa kutingbiigin. 15Biba pii fɔra ki labir bi bɔɔn kpaa ki nin nɔɔ Sintani le. 16Ni ye upii wan ye uwonjiɛn wee ki jɔɔ ipukɔɔ u niin ke, ni ŋan nin un lig bi, ki laa che ipukɔɔ nmɔn a bɔmugkaar li tu biwonjiɛm bu, wee biwonjiɛmin nmɔn nfir lig ban le sin jɔɔ tibɔmugkaarin.
17Bininkpeeb ban wɔɔnn biwonjiɛm a toon nbamɔmin kpaan nin bin kan jilima nkerim milee, naah jann tɔɔ ban bu le ye ban a toonl ye bi li mɔɔn ti ki wɔɔn nin. 18Nan bu-n Uwonbɔr a gbɔŋ len ke, “Laa lol kinaajag a mɔb n-yonn man wee u be kuur idi,” le “Ni ŋan nin u toontunn biɛn n gaa u toon a yɔr.” 19Laa chee ki ke uninkpel galin ni, see ke bininfob bilee bee bita le lagin tab ki jin siɛra. 20Ban tun tibir ke, a fuun bi bu kubabugin na, wee ban gurin n kan ikpaan. 21Uwonbɔr a nintogil, nin Masiya a nintogil nin Malaka gannkaabin a nintogil le n kpaaniŋ ke, a chee nwɔɔm nan wee ki laa jɔɔ nbɔgirim bee ki gann ki ban uba ki jiɛn utɔ ŋaah tun nan biɛn nin ni. 22Laa jegil ki ta a nɔɔi ki paag bininfob bu, ki laa kpiɛ ban tun tibir bu wee ni tun ni. Li ŋmag a ba kasi. 23Laa nyu nnyum a binba, amaa ki li nyu ndaam wama wamau a powiɛn nin ŋaah buŋir iyoo biɛn nbu. 24Bininfob bibam a bir pii dɔ npaan ni le, ki pii chinn dɔ ki ye bin ji bi tibɔr le; le bi ba mu a bir na li nya npaan ni ni bɔɔn bu. 25Man mu le ji ye ni, itoon ŋan mu be npaan ni le, hali itoon ŋan yan kaa be npaan ni nin kaa li fir woon ni.

english_text:
1If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching. 2If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can.
False Teaching and True Wealth
These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do. 3Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ. 4Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions, 5and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth.
These people think religion is supposed to make you rich. 6And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have. 7We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave. 8So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes. 9People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps.
